geography: Approximately 3.7 km southeast of Ala near Kunming (Yunotubus fossil sample)
overview: The early Cambrian colony Yunotubus is represented by five fossil specimens preserving tubular housing and a stolon linking zooids. A morphology matrix tests its placement among pterobranchs without treating every Cambrian tube as a member of the group.

ecology.diet: Suspension feeding directly observed in Rhabdopleura normani; fossil diets are not generalized
ecology.habitat: Tube-dwelling marine colony in the sampled living Rhabdopleura normani
ecology.locomotion: Zooids remain in secreted tubes while feeding; colony-level locomotion was not observed
ecology.bodySize: Millimetre-scale zooids in the sampled living Rhabdopleura; not a class-wide size bound
ecology.guild: Suspension feeder in the living species directly studied

traits: Secreted tubular housing with fusellar construction in diagnostic fossil and living graptolithines
Colonial zooids interconnected by a stolon in Yunotubus and living rhabdopleurids
Tentaculate, ciliated feeding arms in directly observed living Rhabdopleura
evidenceSummary: The approximately 516 Ma colony preserves diagnostic tube construction and a stolon. Its pterobranch placement comes from morphology analysis; suspension feeding is directly observed only in living Rhabdopleura normani.

title.en: Tubes, zooids and a connecting stolon
title.zh: 管、个虫与连接匍匐茎

text.en: Five Yunotubus specimens preserve a colony of zooids, tubular housing and a stolon linking the units. The study describes the tube as fusellar, built from repeated ring-like sections. These structures together, rather than a tube alone, support comparison with pterobranchs.
text.zh: 五件 Yunotubus 化石保存了由个虫、管状住所和连接各部分的匍匐茎组成的群体。研究将其管壁描述为由重复环状单元构成的箍节式结构。与羽鳃类比较时，依据的是这些结构的组合，而不是单凭管状外形。

title.en: A fossil placement and a living feeding sample
title.zh: 化石分类位置与现生摄食样本

text.en: A morphology matrix places Yunotubus within the pterobranch comparison, but this does not make every Cambrian tube a pterobranch. Suspension feeding by ciliated tentacles is directly described for living Rhabdopleura normani; the fossil colony’s diet and movement were not observed in the same way.
text.zh: 形态矩阵将 Yunotubus 放进羽鳃类比较框架，但这不表示所有寒武纪管状化石都属于羽鳃类。现生 Rhabdopleura normani 以纤毛触手悬浮摄食有直接观察记录；对化石群体的食性和运动方式没有同样的直接观察。

overviewZh: 寒武纪早期的群体 Yunotubus 由五件化石标本记录，保存了管状居所及连接各个虫体的匍匐枝。形态矩阵用于检验它在羽鳃类中的位置；不能因此把所有寒武纪管状化石都归入该类。
evidenceSummaryZh: 这处约 516 Ma 的群体化石保存了可用于鉴定的管状构造和匍匐枝。其归入头盘虫类是基于形态分析；悬浮摄食仅在现生的 Rhabdopleura normani 中得到直接观察。

overview: Asteroxylon mackiei provides one specimen-level example of early lycopsid rooting architecture; its anatomy should not be generalized to every lycophyte.

ecology.diet: Photosynthetic autotrophy
ecology.habitat: Terrestrial; wetland to diverse modern habitats across the clade
ecology.locomotion: Plants remain rooted in place as they grow.
ecology.bodySize: Small herbaceous forms to extinct tree-sized lycopsids
ecology.guild: Primary producer; no single clade-wide ecological guild
ecology.locomotionZh: 植物生长时始终固着在原处。

traits: Vascular plant body plan
Microphyll-bearing shoots in sampled lycopsids
Asteroxylon root-bearing and rooting axes as a species-level exemplar
evidenceSummary: Three-dimensional reconstruction of the Rhynie chert fossil directly supports the anatomy of Asteroxylon. It does not establish a direct ancestor, a body plan shared by every lycophyte, or the clade's 425 Ma endpoint.

title.en: A branching system preserved in three dimensions
title.zh: 三维保存的分枝系统

text.en: Asteroxylon mackiei from the Rhynie chert preserves leafy shoots, axes bearing roots and separate rooting axes. The three-dimensional reconstruction makes this one extinct lycopsid's branching architecture visible. It is an anatomical case study, not a direct ancestor of living lycophytes or a body plan shared by the whole lineage.
text.zh: Asteroxylon mackiei 来自 Rhynie 燧石，保存了带叶的枝条、长有根的轴，以及另一些专门用于扎根的轴。三维重建使这一已灭绝石松类的分枝结构得以观察。它是解剖学个案，不是现生石松植物的直系祖先，也不能代表整个支系的共同体型。

title.en: An evidence-based 3D reconstruction of Asteroxylon mackiei, the most complex plant preserved from the Rhynie chert
title.zh: An evidence-based 3D reconstruction of Asteroxylon mackiei, the most complex plant preserved from the Rhynie chert

scope.en: Recorded reader-passage locators: supports; pages: e69447, 1–14; Figures 1–6; Videos 1–2
scope.zh: 读者段落的原始定位：supports; pages: e69447, 1–14; Figures 1–6; Videos 1–2

overview: Metzgeriothallus sharonae is the central fossil in this account: a Middle Devonian liverwort preserved as a body fossil. Older Ordovician spore masses may be related, but they do not establish a crown-liverwort assignment.
overviewZh:
本档案以 Metzgeriothallus sharonae 为核心：这件吉维特期化石提供了苔类的实体化石证据。更早的奥陶纪孢子团可能与苔类有关，但尚不能据此确认其属于地钱门冠群。

化石材料呈叶状配子体形态，具有中肋和二叉分枝，并伴有孢子体孢蒴。研究将其解释为小型陆生初级生产者；具体基质和湿度并未直接保存，样本也不能代表所有现生苔类的生态与体型。

ecology.diet: Like other small terrestrial primary producers, the profiled plant made its own food by photosynthesis.
ecology.habitat: The fossil is associated with moist terrestrial substrates, but the exact surface and moisture conditions were not directly observed.
ecology.locomotion: The profiled plant grew in place; this account treats it as sessile rather than mobile.
ecology.bodySize: The fossil is interpreted as a small thalloid gametophyte. It does not establish a body-size range for the whole phylum.
ecology.guild: The sample represents a small land-based primary producer; it cannot define every ecological role among living liverworts.
ecology.habitatZh: 化石与潮湿的陆生基质相关，但其确切的表面和湿度条件并未直接观察到。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所述植物在原地生长；本条将其视为固着而非可移动的生物。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 该化石被解释为一种小型叶状配子体。它不能确定整个门的体型范围。

traits: The fossil preserves a thalloid gametophyte, the plant form described in this account.
Metzgeriothallus has a medial costa, or central ridge, and a bifurcating thallus.
The fossil sample also includes a sporophyte capsule associated with the plant material.
evidenceSummary: Givetian specimens support a liverwort body-fossil record and its anatomy. Older cryptospores and sporangia remain uncertain in affinity, so they do not securely move the first established crown-liverwort evidence earlier.
evidenceSummaryZh: 吉维特期标本支持苔类的实体化石记录及其形态。更早的隐孢子和孢子囊化石亲缘关系仍有限，因此这里不将其用作地钱门冠群的可靠首现证据。
traitsZh: 化石保存了叶状配子体，这是本条记述所描述的植物形态。
Metzgeriothallus 具有中肋（中央隆脊）和分叉的叶状体。
化石样本还包括一个与植物材料相关的孢子体蒴。

overview: Aglaophyton major is represented here by Edwards's re-examination of new and historical Rhynie-chert material, which established the genus and reconstructed its axes and conducting strand without assigning it to a living higher group.

ecology.diet: Photosynthetic land-plant identity; carbon acquisition was not measured in the fossils
ecology.habitat: Rhynie Chert depositional context; the cited redescription does not establish a genus-wide habitat
ecology.locomotion: Sessile growth reconstructed from decumbent and upright axes
ecology.bodySize: Short plant reconstructed from sampled axes; no genus-wide population range
ecology.guild: Primary producer by plant identity; no detailed ecological guild is assigned

traits: Decumbent axes forming stands in the reconstruction
Dichotomously branching upright axes with terminal sporangia
Three-zoned conducting strand without differential wall thickenings
evidenceSummary: The 1986 redescription directly supports the named genus, sampled anatomy and reconstruction. The separate Rhynie U-Pb study supplies only a locality-age window, not a global genus duration, direct ancestor or settled higher placement.

title.en: Branching axes and a distinctive conducting strand
title.zh: 分枝茎轴与独特的输导组织

text.en:
Edwards’s redescription of new and historical Rhynie Chert material established Aglaophyton major and reconstructed both low, decumbent axes and upright, repeatedly forked shoots. The upright axes ended in sporangia, the structures that produce spores. In the stems, the conducting strand was divided into three zones but lacked differential wall thickenings.

These specimens support a reconstruction of the plant’s sampled anatomy, not a placement in a living higher plant group. A separate U–Pb study constrains the age of the Rhynie locality; that date is not the duration of Aglaophyton as a genus, a global range, or proof that it was a direct ancestor of later plants.
text.zh:
Edwards 对新发现及历史上的 Rhynie 燧石材料重新描述，确立了 Aglaophyton major，并复原出贴地生长的茎轴和向上伸展、反复二歧分枝的枝条。直立枝条末端具有孢子囊，即产生孢子的结构。茎内输导组织分为三个区域，但没有差异化的细胞壁加厚。

这些标本支持对所采样植物解剖结构的复原，却没有把它归入现生植物的某个高阶类群。另一项铀—铅研究约束的是 Rhynie 地点的年代；这个日期不是 Aglaophyton 属的延续时间或全球分布，也不能证明它是后期植物的直系祖先。

overview: Horneophyton lignieri is represented by a 24-section museum sample, with three historical thin sections selected for confocal imaging that revised the interpretation of its conducting tissues without making the fossil a direct ancestor.

ecology.diet: Photosynthetic land-plant identity; carbon acquisition was not measured in the fossils
ecology.habitat: Rhynie Chert sinter-surface association reported in the study context; ecological breadth is unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Sessile growth; locomotor performance does not apply
ecology.bodySize: Diminutive reconstructed plant; the sampled thin sections do not define a population range
ecology.guild: Primary producer by plant identity; transport function remains inferred from preserved cells

traits: Rhizoid-bearing rhizome and bifurcating aerial axes in the reconstruction
Papillate wall ingrowths in conducting cells
No distinct xylem and phloem recovered by the confocal analysis
evidenceSummary: Confocal microscopy and three-dimensional modelling directly document cell-wall form in named NHMUK slides. Transfer-cell resemblance and transport function remain interpretations, while the independent locality-age window is not a global range or origin date.

title.en: Three slides open a window into an early plant
title.zh: 三张切片打开早期植物的一扇窗口

text.en: Horneophyton lignieri is known from Rhynie Chert material in Scotland. The study checked 24 museum sections and chose three historical thin sections for confocal imaging. Its reconstruction shows a rhizoid-bearing rhizome and branching aerial axes, but this small selected sample does not establish the plant's full size range or ecological breadth.
text.zh: Horneophyton lignieri 的化石来自苏格兰莱尼燧石。研究核验了馆藏中的 24 张切片，再选出三张历史薄片进行共聚焦成像。复原显示植物有带假根的根茎和分枝地上轴；但这组经过筛选的少量样本不能给出其完整体型范围或生态广度。

title.en: Cell walls are observed; their role is inferred
title.zh: 观察到细胞壁，功能仍靠解释

text.en: The imaged conducting cells have papillate, labyrinth-like wall ingrowths. The study compares them with transfer cells, which move materials between tissues, and discusses a transport role. It did not identify distinct xylem and phloem in these sections, and a resemblance does not by itself prove the cells' exact job. The plant is associated with Rhynie sinter surfaces; the sample does not measure carbon uptake or a population-wide habitat preference. The 411.5 ± 1.3 Ma zircon age constrains the deposit, not each fossil slide directly.
text.zh: 成像显示输导细胞的细胞壁具有乳突状、迷宫状内突。研究将它们与负责组织间物质交换的转移细胞比较，并讨论可能的运输作用。但这些切片没有显示彼此独立的木质部和韧皮部；外形相似本身不能证明细胞的确切功能。该植物与莱尼硅华表面有关联，样本没有测量碳吸收或整个种群的栖地偏好。411.5 ± 1.3 Ma 的锆石年龄约束的是沉积地层，并非直接测定每张化石切片。

overview: Living-species clocks, fossil-integrated total-evidence dating and historical-biogeography models provide different views of cycad timing and range contraction.

ecology.diet: Photosynthetic autotrophy
ecology.habitat: Terrestrial tropical to subtropical habitats in living species
ecology.bodySize: Shrub to tree-sized seed plants

traits: Pinnate leaves in living cycads
Seed-plant reproduction
Fossil leaf sampling used in total-evidence models
evidenceSummary: Studies use different datasets and methods to estimate cycad history. Fossil-integrated models support older regional histories, but a model age is not itself a fossil occurrence.

title.en: One analysis combines living plants and fossil leaves
title.zh: 一项分析结合现生植物与化石叶片

text.en: Coiro and colleagues combined molecular data from living cycads with leaf morphology scored for living and fossil taxa, including 60 fossil species. The fossil leaf assignments and character codings are inputs to the analysis, not conclusions supplied by the model. The resulting tree and historical estimates describe the sampled dataset and analytical choices; they are not a fixed topology for every member of Cycadophyta.
text.zh: Coiro 等将现生苏铁的分子数据与现生及化石类群的叶部形态结合，其中包括 60 个化石种。化石叶片的归属和性状编码是分析输入，而非模型自动给出的结论。生成的树和历史估计描述的是特定取样数据集与分析选择，并不是适用于所有苏铁门成员的固定拓扑。

title.en: The age estimate applies to crown Cycadales
title.zh: 年代估计针对冠群苏铁目

text.en: In the study's fossilized birth–death analysis, crown Cycadales has a posterior median age of 330.4 million years, with a 95% highest posterior density interval of 296.2–358.9 million years. The displayed 330.4-to-present interval is a navigation summary linking that model estimate to living cycads. It is not a directly observed fossil first appearance for all Cycadophyta, and the interval does not mean fossils are known continuously through that time.
text.zh: 在该研究的化石化出生—死亡分析中，冠群苏铁目的后验中位年龄为 3.304 亿年，95% 最高后验密度区间为 2.962–3.589 亿年。图示的“3.304 亿年前至今”是把模型估计与现生苏铁相连的导航摘要，并非整个苏铁门的直接化石首现；它也不表示这一时期都有连续化石记录。

title.en: A modelled range contraction is not a complete map
title.zh: 模型化的分布收缩不是完整地图

text.en: The fossil-integrated biogeographic model supports an interpretation of broader high-latitude occupation followed by contraction. Ancestral areas and the number of local disappearances depend on model assumptions and the sampled fossils. Living cycads are concentrated in tropical and subtropical regions, but that modern pattern alone does not identify where the group originated or why its range changed.
text.zh: 纳入化石的生物地理模型支持一种解释：苏铁类过去在高纬度地区分布更广，后来分布范围收缩。祖先分布区和局部消失次数取决于模型假设及化石取样。现生苏铁主要分布于热带和亚热带，但仅凭现代格局无法确定该类群的起源地或分布变化的原因。

title.en: Coiro et al. (2023), cycad fossils and biogeography
title.zh: Coiro 等（2023），苏铁化石与生物地理

scope.en: The study combines molecular data from living cycads with morphology scored from living and fossil leaf taxa, including 60 fossil species. Its dating and biogeographic conclusions are outputs of sampled trees and models. They do not independently establish a direct fossil first appearance, a complete global distribution or a single cause of diversification.
scope.zh: 该研究将现生苏铁的分子数据与现生及化石叶类群的形态编码结合，其中包括 60 个化石种。其年代和生物地理结论来自特定取样树与模型，并不能独立确立直接观测到的化石首现、完整全球分布或单一多样化原因。

overview: Jurassic wood specimen Ginkgoxylon liaoningense PB22285 provides a bounded example of ginkgo-like wood anatomy. It is not treated as the first ginkgophyte, and no leaf species is associated with the wood.

ecology.diet: The source describes the producer as photosynthetic; the wood itself does not preserve feeding behavior.
ecology.habitat: A terrestrial forest or woodland is inferred for the wood producer, not directly shown by the anatomical specimen.
ecology.locomotion: The plant grew in place rather than moving; this is a growth-form description.
ecology.bodySize: Tree size is inferred from secondary wood, not measured from a whole plant.
ecology.guild: The specimen represents a terrestrial woody primary producer in the source’s functional description.

ecology.habitatZh: 根据造木植物推测其生长于陆地森林或林地，但解剖标本没有直接显示这种环境。

PB22285 shows ginkgo-like wood anatomy.

overviewZh: 侏罗纪木化石 Ginkgoxylon liaoningense PB22285 提供了一个范围明确的银杏样木材解剖案例。它不被视为银杏植物的最早代表，木材也未与某一叶种关联。

PB22285 显示银杏样木材解剖。

geography: Living conifer sample across both hemispheres
Fossil calibrations used in the dated analysis
overview: A dated tree sampling about 80% of living conifer species compares evolutionary patterns between hemispheres. Its node ages depend on fossil calibrations and models; they are not direct fossil occurrences or a complete history of the conifer total group.

ecology.diet: Not generalized by the cited dated-phylogeny study
ecology.habitat: No single habitat is assigned across the sampled living conifers
ecology.locomotion: Sessile plant growth is not an analysed outcome of the cited study
ecology.bodySize: Not generalized by the cited dated-phylogeny study
ecology.guild: No single ecological guild is assigned from the cited analysis

traits: No universal leaf morphology is generalized from the sampled molecular tree
No universal cone morphology is generalized from the sampled molecular tree
Fossil calibrations constrain sampled nodes rather than recording body characters
evidenceSummary: The cited analysis supports its sampled phylogeny, fossil calibrations and hemispheric comparison. The displayed 300–0 Ma interval is a separate, conservatively reviewed navigation envelope, not a complete fossil record or an output of the tree.

title.en: A broad sample of living conifers
title.zh: 现生松柏类的大规模取样

text.en: The dated phylogeny samples about 80% of living conifer species to compare evolutionary dynamics in the Northern and Southern Hemispheres. This is a large living-species sample, not a census of every conifer lineage that has ever existed.
text.zh: 这项定年系统树取样了约 80% 的现生松柏类物种，以比较北半球和南半球的演化动态。这是对现生物种的大规模取样，不是对所有曾存在的松柏类谱系的普查。

title.en: Modelled dates and the fossil record
title.zh: 模型年代与化石记录

text.en: Fossil calibrations help estimate ages for sampled branches, but those node ages are model results rather than direct dates on every split. The separate 300–0 Ma display is a conservative navigation span; it is not a complete, continuously documented fossil range.
text.zh: 化石校准帮助估计所取样枝系的年代，但节点年代是模型结果，并非对每次分化的直接测年。另行展示的 3 亿年至今区间是保守的导航跨度，并非完整且连续有记录的化石延限。

overviewZh: 一项带年代的系统树取样了约 80% 的现生松柏类物种，用于比较南北半球的演化模式。节点年龄取决于化石校准和模型；它们并非直接化石记录，也不代表松柏类总群的完整历史。
evidenceSummaryZh: 所引分析支持其取样系统发育关系、化石定年校准及半球间比较。图示的 300–0 Ma 区间是另行审慎审核的导航时间范围，并非完整化石记录，也不是系统树的分析结果。

geography: Hettangian South Hadley Falls Member, Massachusetts, United States
Living and fossil taxa sampled in the family-level matrix
overview: Holyoke specimen J 1430 is a Lower Jurassic, Hettangian bract-scale complex assigned to Araucariaceae. A separate combined matrix analyzes 31 living and eight fossil species. The single specimen and sampled tree do not establish an exact family origin or direct ancestry.

ecology.diet: The specimen description and family-level phylogeny do not assess diet or ecological interactions.

title.en: Body, life and relationships
title.zh: 身体、生活与关系

text.zh: 早白垩世的 Montsechia 化石保存了带叶枝轴和封闭的单种子果实。它们展示了当时部分开花植物的样貌，却没有记录 Angiospermae 首次出现的时刻。分子钟研究则通过模型和化石校准，估算现生谱系的分支年代；这是另一条时间线。
text.en: Early Cretaceous Montsechia fossils preserve leafy axes and closed, single-seeded fruits. They show what some flowering plants were like then, not the moment Angiospermae first appeared. Molecular-clock studies estimate branching dates by applying models to living lineages and fossil calibrations, so they provide a separate timeline.

title.zh: 保存枝轴与果实的 Montsechia
title.en: Montsechia axes and fruits

text.zh: 早白垩世的 Montsechia 材料保存了柔软的带叶枝轴和封闭的单种子果实。这些是具体标本上的结构，可以用于讨论早期被子植物的形态与水生生活。它们没有记录下整个类群诞生的那一刻。
text.en: Early Cretaceous Montsechia material preserves flexible leafy axes and closed single-seeded fruits. These specimen-level structures inform discussion of early angiosperm morphology and aquatic life. They do not record the moment the whole group originated.

title.zh: 分子钟里的冠群时间
title.en: Crown ages in molecular-clock models

text.zh: 分子钟研究把现生谱系的数据与化石校准结合，估计分支发生的时间。这里的“冠群”包括某个类群全部现生成员的最近共同祖先及其后代。不同校准和分析方法会影响估计，所以冠群年代不能直接写成最早化石年代。
text.en: Molecular-clock studies combine data from living lineages with fossil calibrations to estimate branching times. A crown group includes the last common ancestor of all living members and its descendants. Calibration and analysis choices affect the estimate, so a crown age is not a first fossil occurrence.

title.zh: 起源与生态扩张的不同记录
title.en: Different records of origin and ecological expansion

text.zh: 某个年代已经存在开花植物，不等于它们当时已占据各种生态系统。一个水生化石也不能代表所有早期被子植物的祖先生态。把具体标本、模型估计和生态扩张分开，能避免用一个数字讲完一段复杂历史。
text.en: The presence of flowering plants at an age does not establish dominance across ecosystems. One aquatic fossil cannot represent the ancestral ecology of every early angiosperm. Keep specimens, model estimates and ecological expansion separate.

readerLimitations.en: Anatomical observations, interpretations of behaviour and modelled branching times answer different questions. The selected material does not identify a direct ancestor or establish a complete distribution.
readerLimitations.zh: 解剖观察、行为解释与模型中的分支时间回答不同问题。所选材料不指定直接祖先，也不建立完整分布范围。

text.en: The Early Cretaceous fossil Cratolirion bognerianum preserves anatomy from roots to flowers at about 115 Ma. A morphology-matrix analysis places it within crown monocots, but does not assign it to a living family or identify the origin of the whole group.

geography: Lameta Formation coprolite phytolith assemblage, central India
overview: Grass history comes from evidence at different scales: phytoliths in latest-Cretaceous coprolites from India, later phytolith assemblages in Great Plains soils, and a sampled plastid family tree. A coprolite can preserve what passed through an animal; soil assemblages track vegetation at a regional scale; a tree models relationships among sampled lineages. None alone supplies one grass-origin date, a universal C4 history or a global grassland narrative.
overviewZh: 禾本科历史来自不同尺度的证据：印度最晚白垩世粪化石中的植硅体、后来大平原土壤中的植硅体组合，以及采样的叶绿体基因家族树。粪化石可以保存动物取食后留下的颗粒，土壤组合反映区域植被，基因树则模拟被采样谱系之间的关系。任何一条证据都不能单独给出统一的禾本科起源日期、普遍的 C4 演化史或全球草原叙事。

ecology.diet: Grasses are photosynthetic primary producers. The fossil samples do not establish one ecological role for every member of the family.
ecology.habitat: The Great Plains palaeosols record heterogeneous mixtures of C3 and C4 vegetation in the sampled region, not a single global grass habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Grass plants grow in place; this biological description does not identify the vegetation structure represented by any one phytolith sample.
ecology.bodySize: Phytolith assemblages do not yield a family-wide body-size range.
ecology.guild: The evidence supports the primary-producer role of grasses. C4 biomass in a sample does not by itself show that open grassland dominated the landscape.
ecology.habitatZh: 大平原地区的古土壤记录显示，取样区域内 C3 与 C4 植被混杂分布；这并不代表全球草类只有一种生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 禾本科植物在原地生长；这一生物学描述不能确定任何单个植硅体样本所代表的植被结构。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 植硅体组合无法给出全科范围的体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 证据支持禾草发挥初级生产者作用。样本中的 C4 生物量本身并不能证明开阔草原曾主导整个景观。

traits: The Lameta coprolites contain phytolith shapes that the cited study identifies as diagnostic of grasses; this microscopic evidence is tied to those specimens and their locality.
Great Plains samples include chloridoid and other short-cell phytoliths considered potentially C4 PACMAD grasses; the assignment describes the sampled assemblages.
On the sampled plastid tree, C4 photosynthesis is reconstructed as arising more than once rather than as a single family-wide innovation.
evidenceSummary: Prasad and colleagues describe a disputed phytolith assemblage from a particular Lameta locality; Strömberg and McInerney quantify a later regional change in Great Plains soils; GPWG II reconstructs multiple C4 origins on a sampled plastid tree. Together, these studies do not establish a body-fossil first appearance, a crown age or global vegetation cover.
evidenceSummaryZh: Prasad 等人描述了 Lameta 一处地点的植硅体组合，其解释仍有争议；Strömberg 与 McInerney 量化了大平原土壤中较晚时期的区域变化；GPWG II 在采样的叶绿体基因树上重建出多次 C4 起源。三项研究合起来仍不能确定身体化石的首次出现、冠群年龄或全球植被覆盖。

readerLimitations.en: The profile joins three evidence scales: a disputed phytolith assemblage in one Lameta coprolite sample, regional Great Plains soils and a sampled plastid tree. Together they do not establish a body-fossil first appearance, a single C4 origin or global grassland dominance.
readerLimitations.zh: 本档案并列三种证据尺度：Lameta 一处粪化石样本中仍有争议的植硅体组合、大平原区域土壤记录，以及采样的质体系统树。它们合起来仍不能确立禾本科实体化石首现、单次 C4 起源或全球草原占主导。

traitsZh: Lameta 粪化石中含有植硅体形态，所引研究将其鉴定为禾本科的诊断性形态；这类显微证据仅对应这些标本及其产地。
大平原样品包括虎尾草亚科型及其他短细胞植硅体；这些被视为可能来自 C4 型 PACMAD 禾草。该归属描述的是所取样的组合。
在所取样的质体系统树上，C4 光合作用被重建为多次独立起源，而非禾本科全科共有的一次创新。

overview: Two lines of evidence meet in Fabaceae: a 65.35 Ma fruit and leaflets from Corral Bluffs, and a broad phylogeny that revises the classification of living legumes into six subfamilies. They answer different questions about the family.

ecology.diet: Photosynthetic primary-producer identity inferred from family membership; the Corral Bluffs fruit and leaflets do not directly recover a family-wide ecology
ecology.habitat: Corral Bluffs fossil locality only; no family-wide habitat is assigned
ecology.bodySize: Fruit and leaflet evidence only; no family-wide size range is assigned
ecology.guild: Primary-producer context only; fossil morphology does not establish a family-wide guild

traits: A dated Corral Bluffs fruit and associated leaflets assigned to Fabaceae
Six-subfamily classification supported by a taxonomically broad phylogeny
Fossil family presence kept separate from subfamily assignment and crown-age inference
evidenceSummary: The Corral Bluffs fossils support a family-level occurrence, not a subfamily assignment or crown age. The living-family phylogeny revises classification but does not identify the fossil’s placement, a family origin centre or continuous global occupancy.

title.en: The fossil documents family presence
title.zh: 化石记录的是科级出现

text.en: A fruit and associated leaflets from Corral Bluffs in Colorado are assigned to Fabaceae and dated to 65.35 Ma. These preserved plant parts make a bounded fossil record for the family. They do not assign the specimen to one of the living subfamilies, set the family’s crown age, or show where Fabaceae first originated.
text.zh: 科罗拉多州 Corral Bluffs 的一枚果实及相关小叶被归入豆科，年代为 65.35 Ma。这些保存下来的植物结构构成豆科的一项有界化石记录，却没有把标本归入现生某个亚科，也不能确定该科冠群的年龄或起源地点。

title.en: A phylogeny reorganizes living legumes
title.zh: 系统发育研究重整现生豆科分类

text.en: The Legume Phylogeny Working Group assembled broad taxonomic sampling to support six subfamilies and replace the traditional, broadly defined Caesalpinioideae arrangement. This is a classification of sampled living legumes. It does not place the Corral Bluffs fossil in a subfamily, date the family’s origin or turn the fossil into an ancestor of modern plants.
text.zh: 豆科系统发育工作组通过较广的分类取样支持六个亚科，并取代传统宽泛的 Caesalpinioideae 分类框架。这是对纳入研究的现生豆科植物的分类，不会把 Corral Bluffs 化石归入某个亚科、确定豆科起源年代，或把化石认作现代植物的祖先。

overviewZh: 豆科的两类证据在此并列：一枚距今 6535 万年的果实及来自 Corral Bluffs 的小叶，以及一项将现生豆科分类修订为六个亚科的大型系统发育研究。它们回答的是有关该科的不同问题。

overview: Eocyathispongia qiania is known from one phosphatized Doushantuo specimen. Its millimetre-scale body has three connected tubes interpreted as sponge-grade anatomy, a proposal based on a single fossil.
overviewZh: Eocyathispongia qiania 目前只有一件来自陡山沱组的磷酸盐化标本。毫米级身体由三根相连的管组成，研究者据此提出海绵级的解剖解释；这是单件化石支持的假说，不是已被多件材料重复验证的形态。

ecology.diet: The fossil does not directly preserve feeding.
ecology.habitat: Marine phosphorite records the depositional setting; the animal’s life position is not established.
ecology.locomotion: A sessile life habit is an interpretation, not a directly observed state.
ecology.bodySize: The preserved specimen is millimetre-scale.
ecology.guild: Suspension feeding is inferred from a possible sponge affinity, not directly observed.
ecology.dietZh: 化石未直接保存摄食行为。
ecology.habitatZh: 海相磷块岩记录的是沉积环境；该动物生前所处的位置尚未确定。
ecology.locomotionZh: 固着生活方式是一种解释，并非直接观察到的状态。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 保存下来的标本为毫米级。

traits: Three connected tubes
Openings compared with a funnel and an osculum
Tomography reveals internal cellular organization
evidenceSummary: Electron microscopy and tomography document the holotype shape. Sponge affinity remains uncertain because the specimen lacks spicules, a replicated canal system and corroborating fossils.
evidenceSummaryZh: 电子显微镜和断层成像记录了正模的形态。标本没有骨针、重复出现的水道系统或其他化石材料支持，因此其海绵亲缘仍不确定。

title.en: One fossil, a sponge-grade hypothesis
title.zh: 一件化石与海绵级假说

text.en: Eocyathispongia qiania is known from one phosphatized Doushantuo specimen. Its millimetre-scale body has three connected tubes interpreted as sponge-grade anatomy, a proposal based on a single fossil.
text.zh: Eocyathispongia qiania 目前只有一件来自陡山沱组的磷酸盐化标本。毫米级身体由三根相连的管组成，研究者据此提出海绵级的解剖解释；这是单件化石支持的假说，不是已被多件材料重复验证的形态。

title.en: Three connected tubes in one holotype
title.zh: 一个正模中的三根相连管道

text.en: The phosphatized holotype is millimetre-scale and preserves three connected tubes; openings were compared with a funnel and an osculum. SEM and tomography document its shape and internal cellular organization, but all of these observations come from one specimen.
text.zh: 磷酸盐化正模为毫米级，保存了三根相连的管道；作者将开口与漏斗和出水孔（osculum）作比较。扫描电镜（SEM）和断层成像记录了它的形状及内部细胞组织，但这些观察都来自同一件标本。

title.en: The sponge interpretation has clear limits
title.zh: 海绵解释的明确边界

text.en: The authors propose sponge-grade anatomy, but the specimen lacks spicules, a replicated canal system and corroborating fossils. Sessile life and suspension feeding are inferences from that proposed body plan, not directly observed states.
text.zh: 作者提出海绵级的解剖解释，但这件标本没有骨针、重复出现的水道系统，也没有其他化石印证。固着生活和悬浮摄食是根据所提出的体型方案作出的推断，并非直接观察到的状态。

title.en: Sponge grade body fossil with cellular resolution dating 60 Myr before the Cambrian
title.zh: Sponge grade body fossil with cellular resolution dating 60 Myr before the Cambrian

scope.en: Yin et al. (2015), pp. E1453?E1460, Figures 1?4 and Supplementary Movies: the single phosphatized holotype, tubes and openings, SEM/tomography and the bounded sponge-grade interpretation.

readerLimitations.en: The Weng’an Doushantuo occurrence is one fossil in marine phosphorite. Its depositional setting does not establish living position, and one specimen cannot define a global range or directly reveal feeding or locomotion.
readerLimitations.zh: Weng’an 陡山沱组的这一产出记录是一件形成于海相磷块岩中的化石。沉积环境不能确定它生前的位置；单件标本也无法界定全球分布范围，或直接揭示摄食与运动方式。

traitsZh: 三个彼此相连的管。
具有被比作漏斗和出水口的开口。
断层成像显示其内部细胞组织结构。

title.en: Research overview
title.zh: 研究概述

text.en: Helicolocellus cantori is known from goblet-shaped fossils with nested square grids. Researchers use that preserved framework to test an organic-skeleton body plan and a possible placement among crown sponges; the placement comes from a morphology matrix.
text.zh: Helicolocellus cantori 已知于杯状化石，其骨架保存嵌套的方格网。研究者用这些保存结构检验有机骨架的身体构型，并以形态矩阵分析其是否接近海绵动物冠群。

title.en: A grid in a goblet-shaped fossil
title.zh: 杯状化石中的网格骨架

text.en:
The fossil has a goblet-shaped body. Its skeletal framework contains nested square grids.

The organic skeleton follows a helical arrangement.
text.zh:
杯状身体。

骨架结构中有嵌套的方格网。

有机骨架呈螺旋排列。

title.en: Inferences from the preserved framework
title.zh: 从保存的骨架结构作出的推断

text.en: The fossils are centimetre-scale and come from the marine Shibantan setting. Suspension feeding and sessile life are inferred from the sponge-body interpretation and morphology; they do not directly record physiology.
text.zh: 化石身体为厘米尺度，来自海相石板滩沉积环境。悬浮摄食和固着生活是根据海绵体构型解释与形态作出的推断，并非生理过程的直接记录。

title.en: What this evidence can establish
title.zh: 证据能说明什么

text.en: The holotype and referred specimens preserve the gridded framework. Its material composition, physiology and exact position near Hexactinellida remain interpretations.
text.zh: 正模和归入标本保存了网格骨架。其物质组成、生理功能以及在六放海绵纲附近的确切位置仍属于解释。

title.en: A late-Ediacaran crown-group sponge animal
title.zh: A late-Ediacaran crown-group sponge animal

scope.en: Describes Helicolocellus and a morphology-matrix placement near Hexactinellida; organic-skeleton homology remains an interpretation.
scope.zh: 描述 Helicolocellus 化石并以形态矩阵分析其接近六放海绵纲的位置；有机骨架同源解释仍未确定。

traitsZh: 杯状身体。
骨骼框架中的嵌套方格网。
有机骨架呈螺旋排列。

commonNameZh: 查恩伍德分叉水螅体化石
overview: BGS GSM 105875 preserves two branching, polyp-like tubes in a rigid organic skeleton, with impressions around their openings interpreted as tentacles. A morphology analysis tested whether Auroralumina belongs within crown Cnidaria; that placement remains an interpretation of one fossil.

ecology.diet: Tentacle impressions support a prey-capture interpretation, but no prey is preserved.
ecology.habitat: The Bradgate Formation and fossil surface are documented; a preferred habitat is not established here.
ecology.locomotion: The study interprets the organism as attached or sessile; this is inferred from the preserved form.
ecology.bodySize: The fossil is centimetre-scale and preserves a branching, colonial form.
ecology.guild: The study interprets it as a sessile feeder from its tentacle-bearing form; prey and feeding behaviour are not observed.
ecology.dietZh: 触手印痕支持其具有捕获猎物的解释，但没有保存下来的猎物。
ecology.locomotionZh: 研究将该生物解释为附着或固着生活；这是根据保存形态作出的推断。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 这件化石为厘米级，保存了分枝的群体形态。

traits: Paired bifurcating polyps
Rigid organic skeleton
Tentacle impressions around apertures
evidenceSummary: The specimen and Bradgate Formation context are documented. Crown-cnidarian placement, tentacle function and feeding mode are interpretations of its anatomy.

title.en: A branching fossil with tentacle impressions
title.zh: 带有触手印痕的分叉化石

text.en: The specimen BGS GSM 105875 comes from the Bradgate Formation in Charnwood Forest, England. It preserves two bifurcating, polyp-like tubes inside a rigid organic skeleton, with tentacle impressions around the openings. These structures are observations in one centimetre-scale fossil; their role as feeding polyps is an interpretation, and the specimen does not preserve prey or colony physiology.
text.zh: 标本 BGS GSM 105875 出自英格兰查恩伍德森林的 Bradgate 组。它在刚性有机骨骼内保存了两个分叉的水螅体样管，开口周围可见触手印痕。这些结构来自一件厘米级化石；将其解释为摄食水螅体属于形态推断，标本没有保存猎物或群体生理信息。

title.en: What a branching body plan can suggest
title.zh: 分叉体形可以提示什么？

text.en: The study's morphology analysis places Auroralumina within crown Cnidaria, but this is a hypothesis based on anatomical characters, not proof that it was a direct ancestor of living cnidarians. The tentative sessile-feeder interpretation follows the tentacle-bearing form; prey, exact habitat preference and feeding behaviour remain unknown. The 562–557 Ma interval describes the Bradgate Formation context of this specimen, not the age of the cnidarian crown or a global range for the genus.
text.zh: 研究的形态分析将 Auroralumina 置于刺胞动物冠群内，但这是基于解剖性状的假说，并不能证明它是现生刺胞动物的直接祖先。固着摄食的暂定解释来自带触手的形态；猎物、确切栖息偏好和摄食行为仍未知。562–557 Ma 是这件标本的 Bradgate 组地层背景，不是刺胞动物冠群的年代或该属的全球分布。

title.en: Dunn et al. (2022), Charnwood Forest cnidarian fossil
title.zh: Dunn 等（2022），查恩伍德森林刺胞动物化石

scope.en: Specimen BGS GSM 105875, its Bradgate Formation setting, Figures 1–4 and Extended Data Figures 1–8. The study describes the branching tubes and tentacle impressions, then tests a crown-cnidarian placement in a morphology matrix; ecology and direct ancestry are not observations from the specimen.
scope.zh: 标本 BGS GSM 105875、Bradgate 组地层背景、图 1–4 及扩展数据图 1–8。研究描述了分叉管和触手印痕，并在形态矩阵中检验冠群刺胞动物位置；生态和直系祖先关系不是标本的直接观察。

commonNameZh: 埃迪卡拉纪肌肉印痕刺胞动物候选
overview: Holotype NFM F-994 and plastotype OUM ÁT.424/p preserve a quadrate Ediacaran impression with repeated aligned internal structures. These have been interpreted as muscle-like, but later studies dispute orientation and the strength of a staurozoan comparison.

ecology.diet: Feeding structures are not directly preserved, so diet remains unresolved.
ecology.habitat: The impression is from a marine Fermeuse Formation setting; its life position is uncertain.
ecology.locomotion: A sessile or attached life position has been proposed, but movement was not observed.
ecology.bodySize: The holotype impression is centimetre-scale; no full-body measurement is available.
ecology.guild: Both cnidarian affinity and feeding role remain contested.
ecology.dietZh: 化石没有直接保存取食结构，因此食性尚不明确。
ecology.habitatZh: 印痕来自海相 Fermeuse 组环境；生前所处位置不确定。
ecology.locomotionZh: 有研究提出它可能固着或附着生活，但没有观察到运动。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 正模印痕为厘米尺度；没有可测的完整体长。
ecology.guildZh: 其刺胞动物亲缘关系及取食角色均有争议。

traits: The body impression is quadrate.
Repeated aligned structures appear inside the impression.
A muscle-like interpretation has been tested against comparisons with staurozoans.
evidenceSummary: The holotype and locality are documented. Tissue identity, orientation and precise cnidarian placement remain contested across the original description, critical reassessment and later re-examination.
overviewZh: 正模 NFM F-994 与塑模 OUM ÁT.424/p 保存了埃迪卡拉纪的方形印痕，内部有重复排列的结构。这些结构曾被解释为肌肉样组织，但后续研究对印痕方向及其与十字水母类比较的说服力提出异议。
traitsZh: 身体印痕呈方形。
印痕内部可见重复排列的结构。
肌肉样组织的解释曾与十字水母类进行比较检验。
evidenceSummaryZh: 正模和产地有记录。原始描述、批判性重评和后续研究对组织身份、印痕方向及其具体刺胞动物位置仍有争议。

overview: Ou et al. describe 85 additional Chengjiang specimens plus type material and reconstruct Xianguangia as a tentaculate suspension feeder with stem-cnidarian affinity. Zhao et al. reinterpret the column-like feature as tentacle-sheath complexes and place Dinomischidae on the ctenophore stem in their main Bayesian analysis; alternative coding yields an unresolved polytomy. The body's reconstruction and its evolutionary placement remain contested.

ecology.diet: Suspension feeding is inferred from the reconstructed tentacle-bearing body; feeding was not directly observed.
ecology.habitat: The sampled fossils come from the marine Chengjiang deposit in Yunnan. This setting does not establish the species' full habitat or geographic range.
ecology.locomotion: An attached or sessile life habit has been proposed, but movement is not directly preserved.
ecology.bodySize: The reconstructed fossil body is centimetre-scale; these specimens do not establish a population-wide size range.
ecology.guild: A suspension-feeding role is proposed from reconstructed anatomy, not directly observed.
ecology.habitatZh: 取样化石来自云南的海相澄江生物群沉积层。这一地质环境不能确定该物种完整的栖息地或地理分布范围。
ecology.locomotionZh: 有人提出其具有附着或固着的生活方式，但运动并未被直接保存。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 重建的化石个体为厘米级；这些标本无法确定整个种群的体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 根据重建的解剖结构，有研究提出其具有悬浮摄食功能；这并非直接观察所得。

traits: A tentacle-bearing oral crown appears in the published reconstruction.
A central column-like region is reinterpreted in later work as tentacle-sheath anatomy.
The expanded sample includes 85 new specimens and type material.
evidenceSummary: Ou et al. use the expanded sample to support a stem-cnidarian interpretation. Zhao et al. reinterpret the central structure and recover Xianguangia, Daihua, and Dinomischus as Dinomischidae on the ctenophore stem in their main Bayesian analysis; sensitivity analyses produce an unresolved polytomy. Neither placement is definitive, and the Chengjiang sample is not a global first appearance.
overviewZh: Ou 等人描述了 85 件新增澄江标本及模式材料，并将 Xianguangia 重建为具触手的悬浮摄食者，认为其与刺胞动物干群有亲缘关系。Zhao 等人将柱状结构重新解释为触手鞘复合体，并在主要贝叶斯分析中把 Dinomischidae 置于栉水母干群；替代编码则得到未解析的多分叉。身体重建及其演化位置仍有争议。
evidenceSummaryZh: Ou 等人利用扩大的样本支持刺胞动物干群解释。Zhao 等人重新解释中央结构，并在主要贝叶斯分析中将 Xianguangia、Daihua 和 Dinomischus 恢复为栉水母干群上的 Dinomischidae；敏感性分析则得到未解析的多分叉。两种位置都非定论，澄江样本也不是全球首现记录。

readerSources.title: Three Cambrian fossils assembled into an extinct body plan of cnidarian affinity

scope.en: Ou et al. (2017), pp. 8835–8840, Figures 1–4 and supplementary figures: 85 additional specimens plus type material and the proposed tentaculate, stem-cnidarian reconstruction.
scope.zh: Ou 等（2017），第 8835–8840 页、图 1–4 与补充图：85 件新增标本及模式材料，以及具触手、刺胞动物干群解释的重建。

readerSources.title: Tentacular nature of the “column” of the Cambrian diploblastic Xianguangia sinica

scope.en: Zhao et al. (2023), Article 2215787, Figures 1–6, Figure 4 and Supplementary Figure S1: tentacle-sheath reinterpretation, the main Bayesian ctenophore-stem result and alternative-coding polytomy.
scope.zh: Zhao 等（2023），文章 2215787，图 1–6、图 4 与补充图 S1：触手鞘重新解释、主要贝叶斯栉水母干群结果，以及替代编码下的多分叉。

title.en: Eighty-five specimens and a reinterpreted central column
title.zh: 85 件标本与重新解释的中央柱状结构

text.en: Ou et al. describe 85 additional Chengjiang specimens plus type material and reconstruct Xianguangia as a tentaculate suspension feeder with stem-cnidarian affinity. Zhao et al. reinterpret the column-like feature as tentacle-sheath complexes and place Dinomischidae on the ctenophore stem in their main Bayesian analysis; alternative coding yields an unresolved polytomy. The body's reconstruction and its evolutionary placement remain contested.
text.zh: Ou 等人描述了 85 件新增澄江标本及模式材料，并将 Xianguangia 重建为具触手的悬浮摄食者，认为其与刺胞动物干群有亲缘关系。Zhao 等人将柱状结构重新解释为触手鞘复合体，并在主要贝叶斯分析中把 Dinomischidae 置于栉水母干群；替代编码则得到未解析的多分叉。身体重建及其演化位置仍有争议。

title.en: Competing cnidarian-stem and ctenophore-stem placements
title.zh: 相竞争的刺胞动物干群与栉水母干群位置

text.en: Ou et al. use the expanded sample to support a stem-cnidarian interpretation. Zhao et al. reinterpret the central structure and recover Xianguangia, Daihua, and Dinomischus as Dinomischidae on the ctenophore stem in their main Bayesian analysis; sensitivity analyses produce an unresolved polytomy. Neither placement is definitive, and the Chengjiang sample is not a global first appearance.
text.zh: Ou 等人利用扩大的样本支持刺胞动物干群解释。Zhao 等人重新解释中央结构，并在主要贝叶斯分析中将 Xianguangia、Daihua 和 Dinomischus 恢复为栉水母干群上的 Dinomischidae；敏感性分析则得到未解析的多分叉。两种位置都非定论，澄江样本也不是全球首现记录。

traitsZh: 已发表的重建图中呈现了带触手的口部冠状结构。
后续研究将中央柱状区域重新解释为触手鞘结构。
扩大的样本包括 85 件新标本和模式材料。

overview: The Raymond Quarry sample contains 182 compressed middle-Cambrian fossils of Burgessomedusa phasmiformis, with a large bell and many marginal tentacles. The authors support a medusozoan affinity, while its precise position changes with the analysis.
overviewZh: 雷蒙德采石场的中寒武世材料包括 182 件压扁保存的 Burgessomedusa phasmiformis 化石。化石显示较大的伞体和许多边缘触手；作者支持它属于刺胞动物亚门的水母类群（Medusozoa），但具体位置会随分析而变化。

ecology.diet: Predation is inferred by comparison with living medusozoans; no gut contents establish a meal.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from the Raymond Quarry Burgess Shale setting. A position near the sea floor is inferred from preservation.
ecology.locomotion: Free swimming is inferred from the bell and comparison with medusozoans.
ecology.bodySize: The umbrella reaches about 20 cm in height.
ecology.guild: A swimming predator near the seafloor is a possible ecological interpretation; prey capture is unknown.
ecology.dietZh: 捕食性是通过与现生水母类比较推断的；没有胃肠内容物可以确认其摄食对象。
ecology.locomotionZh: 根据伞体结构并与刺胞动物亚门的水母类比较，推断其能够自由游泳。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 伞部高度约可达 20 厘米。
ecology.guildZh: 生活在近海底水域的游泳捕食者是一种可能的生态解释；其捕获猎物的情况未知。

traits: A cuboidal umbrella
More than 90 short tentacles around the margin
Radial internal features visible in compressed fossils
evidenceSummary: Figures 1–2 document the holotype and referred fossils. The analysis supports Medusozoa, but stem-cubozoan, stem-acraspedan and alternative placements depend on character coding.
evidenceSummaryZh: 图 1–2 展示了正模和归入化石。分析支持 Medusozoa 亲缘关系，但将它放在立方水母干群、Acraspeda 干群或其他位置，取决于性状如何编码。

title.en: A large bell, many tentacles, an uncertain branch
title.zh: 大型伞部、众多触手与尚不确定的分支位置

text.en: The Raymond Quarry sample contains 182 compressed middle-Cambrian fossils of Burgessomedusa phasmiformis, with a large bell and many marginal tentacles. The authors support a medusozoan affinity, while its precise position changes with the analysis.
text.zh: 雷蒙德采石场的中寒武世材料包括 182 件压扁保存的 Burgessomedusa phasmiformis 化石。化石显示较大的伞体和许多边缘触手；作者支持它属于刺胞动物亚门的水母类群（Medusozoa），但具体位置会随分析而变化。

title.en: Anatomy in the compressed fossils
title.zh: 压缩化石中的形态

text.en: The Raymond Quarry sample includes 182 compressed fossils. The umbrella is cuboidal and reaches about 20 cm in height, with more than 90 short marginal tentacles; radial internal features are visible in the compressed material.
text.zh: Raymond Quarry 样本包含 182 件压缩化石。伞部呈立方形，高度可达约 20 cm，边缘短触手超过 90 条；压缩材料中还能看到内部放射状结构。

title.en: Medusozoan affinity, model-sensitive placement
title.zh: 水母亚门亲缘较明确，具体位置依赖模型

text.en: The analysis supports a medusozoan affinity, while stem-cubozoan, stem-Acraspeda or alternative placements depend on character coding. The broad affinity is therefore clearer than the exact branch.
text.zh: 分析支持其与水母亚门（Medusozoa）有亲缘关系，但将它置于箱水母干群、水母类干群（Acraspeda）或其他分支，取决于特征编码。因此，宽泛的亲缘判断比精确分支位置更明确。

title.en: Swimming and feeding remain interpretations
title.zh: 游泳与摄食仍属解释

text.en: Bell shape and specimen associations support free swimming and a possible nektobenthic predatory habit. A near-seafloor position and prey capture are inferred; no gut contents document a meal.
text.zh: 伞部形状和标本间的关联支持其能够自由游动，并可能具有近底层捕食习性。近海底生活和捕食猎物都是推断；没有肠内容物记录到一次取食。

title.en: A macroscopic free-swimming medusa from the middle Cambrian Burgess Shale
title.zh: A macroscopic free-swimming medusa from the middle Cambrian Burgess Shale

scope.en: Moon et al. (2023), pp. 290:20222490, Figures 1?5 and Supplementary Figures S17?S21: Raymond Quarry anatomy, size, tentacles, medusozoan affinity, character-coding sensitivity and conditional ecological interpretation.

readerLimitations.en: The described fossils come from Raymond Quarry and define a locality-bounded sample, not a global range. Neither prey capture nor measured swimming performance is directly recorded.
readerLimitations.zh: 已描述的化石都来自 Raymond Quarry，构成受地点限定的样本，不能代表全球分布。捕食行为和游泳性能均未被直接记录或测量。

traitsZh: 立方形伞体。
边缘周围有 90 多条短触手。
压扁化石中可见的辐射状内部构造。

overview: Amphimedon queenslandica is a living demosponge sampled from the Great Barrier Reef for a draft genome. It offers comparisons among animal gene families; it is one living species, not a literal ancestral animal or a stand-in for every sponge.
overviewZh: Amphimedon queenslandica 是现生寻常海绵，研究样本来自大堡礁，用于建立草图基因组并比较动物基因家族。它代表一个现生物种，不是直接保存下来的祖先动物，也不能代替所有海绵类群。

ecology.diet: Flagellated collar cells filter microbes and particulate organic matter from water.
ecology.habitat: The sample represents a living marine sponge from the Great Barrier Reef.
ecology.bodySize: The adult is shown with a 5 cm scale bar; embryos and larvae are also figured.
ecology.dietZh: 带鞭毛的领细胞从水中过滤微生物和颗粒有机物。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 成体图中附有 5 cm 比例尺；图中还展示了胚胎和幼体。
ecology.guildZh: 现生的悬浮摄食者。

traits: A draft genome of about 167 Mb
Gene families involved in metazoan signalling and cell adhesion
Figures include adult, embryo and larval stages
evidenceSummary: The published assembly and comparisons report sequence content. Ancestral genomic toolkits are inferred by comparison; the work does not reconstruct a Precambrian individual, date a species origin or represent all Porifera.
evidenceSummaryZh: 论文报告了组装序列及其比较结果；对祖先基因工具箱的判断来自不同现生类群之间的比较。研究没有复原一只前寒武纪动物、确定物种起源时间，或代表整个 Porifera。

title.en: A living sponge genome, not a preserved ancestor
title.zh: 现生海绵的基因组，不是保存下来的祖先

text.en: Amphimedon queenslandica is a living demosponge sampled from the Great Barrier Reef for a draft genome. It offers comparisons among animal gene families; it is one living species, not a literal ancestral animal or a stand-in for every sponge.
text.zh: Amphimedon queenslandica 是现生寻常海绵，研究样本来自大堡礁，用于建立草图基因组并比较动物基因家族。它代表一个现生物种，不是直接保存下来的祖先动物，也不能代替所有海绵类群。

title.en: How the living sponge feeds
title.zh: 现生海绵如何摄食

text.en: Flagellated collar cells filter microbes and particulate organic matter from water, and the adult sponge is sessile. The study concerns living Amphimedon queenslandica sampled on the Great Barrier Reef; these observations describe that species, not an early-animal fossil.
text.zh: 领细胞以鞭毛驱动水流，从水中过滤微生物和颗粒有机物；成体海绵固着不动。研究对象是采自大堡礁的现生 Amphimedon queenslandica；这些观察描述的是该物种，不是早期动物化石。

title.en: Genome comparisons support bounded inferences
title.zh: 基因组比较支持有限范围的推断

text.en: The draft assembly is about 167 Mb, and the paper compares gene families involved in metazoan signalling and cell adhesion. Figures show the adult with a 5 cm scale bar, along with embryo and larval stages; ancestral genomic toolkits are comparative inferences, not a reconstructed Precambrian animal.
text.zh: 草图组装约为 167 Mb；论文比较了参与后生动物信号传导和细胞黏附的基因家族。图中成体带有 5 cm 比例尺，并展示胚胎和幼体阶段；祖先基因工具箱是通过比较得出的推断，不是复原出的前寒武纪动物。

title.en: The Amphimedon queenslandica genome and the evolution of animal complexity
title.zh: The Amphimedon queenslandica genome and the evolution of animal complexity

scope.en: Srivastava et al. (2010), pp. 466:720?726, Figures 1?5 and Supplementary Note 7: Great Barrier Reef sample, adult organization, 167 Mb draft genome and comparative gene-family analyses.

readerLimitations.en: This is one living demosponge sample from the Great Barrier Reef. It does not represent all Porifera, establish the species' origin date or supply a scalar fossil range.
readerLimitations.zh: 这是采自大堡礁的一个现生寻常海绵样本。它不能代表整个 Porifera，也不能确定该物种的起源年代，或为其提供单一数值的化石年代范围。

traitsZh: 一份约 167 Mb 的基因组草图。
参与后生动物信号传导和细胞黏附的基因家族。
图中包括成体、胚胎和幼体阶段。

overview: More than 35 fossils from the White Sea region preserve a bilateral, soft-bodied animal with a broad foot-like area and a non-mineralized cover on its back. The sample lets researchers reconstruct a distinctive body plan; it does not settle whether Kimberella belongs within crown Mollusca.
overviewZh: 白海地区 35 件以上化石保存了一种两侧对称的软体动物：身体下方有宽阔、近似足部的区域，背面覆盖物没有矿化。样本足以帮助重建独特的身体结构，但还不能确定 Kimberella 是否属于冠群软体动物。

ecology.diet: A surface-feeding interpretation is inferred from the body form and associated traces. No radula is preserved, so the feeding mechanism remains unknown.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from a shallow-marine seafloor in the White Sea region. This is a sampled setting, not a map of the animal’s full geographic range.
ecology.locomotion: The broad foot-like region is consistent with crawling across the seafloor, but the movement itself is inferred from preserved anatomy.
ecology.bodySize: The fossils represent a centimetre-scale soft-bodied animal; the available description does not define a broader size range.
ecology.guild: A mobile benthic feeder is a reconstruction based on the body plan and associated traces, not a preserved behavior or direct gut-content record.
ecology.bodySizeZh: 化石记录的是厘米级软体动物；现有描述没有界定更广的体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 对其为可移动的底栖摄食者的重建，依据是身体构型和相关遗迹；化石没有保存这种行为，也没有直接的胃内容物记录。

traits: The fossil bodies are bilaterally organized, with a recognizable front-to-back axis.
A broad, foot-like ventral region is central to the proposed crawling reconstruction.
The dorsal cover was non-mineralized, so the fossil preserves its outline and impressions rather than a shell of hard plates.
evidenceSummary: The White Sea sample supports a reconstruction of body form and likely seafloor activity. It preserves no radula, does not establish membership in crown Mollusca or direct ancestry, and cannot stand for a complete geographic range.
evidenceSummaryZh: 白海样本支持对身体结构和可能海底活动方式的重建。化石没有保存齿舌，不能确定其属于冠群软体动物或是现生类群的直接祖先，也不能代表完整的地理分布。

readerLimitations.en: The White Sea sample preserves body form, but no radula. Crawling and surface feeding are reconstructions from anatomy and associated traces; the fossils do not establish crown-Mollusca membership, direct ancestry or the full species range.
readerLimitations.zh: 白海样本保存了身体轮廓，却没有齿舌。爬行和表层摄食是根据解剖与相关痕迹作出的复原；这些化石不能确定其属于冠群软体动物、构成直系祖先或代表完整物种分布。

traitsZh: 化石个体呈两侧对称的体制，前后轴清晰可辨。
宽阔、似足的腹侧区域，是拟议爬行方式重建的关键依据。
背侧覆盖物未矿化，因此化石保存的是其轮廓和印痕，而非由坚硬板片构成的壳。

commonNameZh: 布尔吉斯页岩齿谜虫样本
overview: Across 189 specimens, transverse tooth rows, a broad foot and mantle-groove structures recur. Whether the rows are homologous to a molluscan radula remains an interpretation.

ecology.diet: A benthic feeding role is inferred from the tooth rows and body plan; the fossils do not preserve a meal.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from the marine Burgess Shale seafloor.
ecology.locomotion: Crawling is inferred from the broad foot, not directly observed.
ecology.bodySize: The soft-bodied animal is centimetre-scale; no more precise size estimate is given here.
ecology.guild: A mobile benthic feeder is an anatomical inference.
ecology.dietZh: 根据齿列和身体构造推测其在海底取食；化石没有保存具体食物。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自海相布尔吉斯页岩海底沉积。
ecology.locomotionZh: 宽大的足部支持其可能爬行的解释，但并非直接观察结果。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 这种软体动物体长为厘米尺度；这里没有更精确的体型估计。
ecology.guildZh: 依据身体构造推测其为能移动的底栖取食者。

traits: Paired transverse tooth rows are preserved.
The tooth rows show posterior replacement.
A broad foot and mantle-groove structures recur in the sample.
evidenceSummary: Repeated preservation supports the anatomical observations. Radula homology and phylogenetic placement remain interpretations rather than direct observations.
overviewZh: 在 189 件标本中，横向排列的齿列、宽大的足部和外套沟结构反复出现。齿列是否与软体动物齿舌同源，仍是解释。
traitsZh: 化石保存有成对的横向齿列。
齿列显示出向后替换的现象。
样本反复保存宽足部和外套沟结构。
evidenceSummaryZh: 反复出现的标本支持这些解剖观察。齿列与齿舌的同源关系及系统位置仍属解释，并非直接观察。

overview: Ninety newly prepared specimens preserve paired eyes, two tentacles, lateral fins and a funnel-like structure. The study interprets Nectocaris as a cephalopod, but that placement remains contested.

ecology.diet: Predation is inferred from the eyes and tentacles; prey and feeding behavior are not directly observed.
ecology.habitat: The marine water column is inferred from the fins and funnel-like structure rather than directly recorded.
ecology.locomotion: Swimming is inferred from the lateral fins and funnel-like anatomy; the fossil does not record performance.
ecology.bodySize: The described material is centimetre-scale and soft-bodied; a broader size range is not established here.
ecology.guild: Calling Nectocaris a free-swimming predator is a functional interpretation, not a directly observed role.
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所述材料为厘米级软体动物；这里没有确定更广的体型范围。

traits: Paired camera-like eyes
Two frontal tentacles
Lateral fins and ventral funnel-like structure
evidenceSummary: The repeated preservation of soft anatomy does not resolve the placement. The cited study reports no diagnostic shell, siphuncle, beak or radula, so cephalopod affinity remains contested.

title.en: What the soft-bodied specimens preserve
title.zh: 软躯体标本保存了什么

text.en: The study describes 90 specimens with paired eyes, two tentacles, lateral fins and a ventral funnel-like structure. The authors interpret the anatomy as that of a swimming, predatory cephalopod. Because the specimens lack a diagnostic shell, siphuncle, beak or radula, the classification remains disputed; swimming and predation are interpretations rather than directly observed behavior.
text.zh: 研究描述了 90 件标本，保存有成对的眼、两条触手、侧鳍和腹侧漏斗状结构。作者把这些解剖特征解释为游泳、捕食型头足类。由于标本没有诊断性的壳、体管、喙或齿舌，这一分类仍有争议；游泳与捕食是解释，不是直接观察到的行为。

title.en: Primitive soft-bodied cephalopods from the Cambrian
title.zh: Primitive soft-bodied cephalopods from the Cambrian

scope.zh: 读者段落的原始定位：supports; pages: 469–472; Figures 1–4; Supplementary Information

commonNameZh: 晚阿特达班期小米克里纳虫骨片组合样本
overview: Micrina is represented by separated hard plates, not an articulated animal. Sellate plates preserve paired muscle scars; projections on mitral plates are interpreted as muscle platforms. Together they support a testable reconstruction of a sessile, two-valved body, but the proposed articulation and valve homology are not preserved.

ecology.diet: The isolated plates do not record diet or feeding mode.
ecology.habitat: The reconstructed animal is sessile in a marine carbonate setting; attachment and habitat are interpretations, not direct observations of a living animal.
ecology.locomotion: The proposed body plan is sessile. The fossils do not preserve observed movement.
ecology.bodySize: The preserved phosphatic plates are millimetre-scale; the reconstructed animal's full size is not established.
ecology.guild: An attached seafloor life is inferred from the reconstruction, not directly observed.
ecology.dietZh: 这些孤立的壳板没有记录食性或摄食方式。
ecology.habitatZh: 重建结果显示该动物固着生活于海相碳酸盐环境中；附着方式和栖息环境属于解释，并非对活体的直接观察。
ecology.locomotionZh: 提出的身体构型为固着型；化石没有保存可观察到的运动。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 保存下来的磷酸盐壳板为毫米级；重建动物的整体大小尚未确定。
ecology.guildZh: 根据重建结果推断其附着于海底生活，并非直接观察所得。

traits: Mitral phosphatic sclerites with apophyses interpreted as muscle platforms
Sellate phosphatic sclerites with paired muscle scars
Near-bilateral bivalved reconstruction
evidenceSummary: The study covers four localities in three broadly synchronous late Atdabanian carbonate units, including the Wilkawillina Limestone of South Australia. The 521–514.5 Ma interval is a conservative envelope for that sample, not a global genus range or a brachiopod origin date. Muscle platforms, whole-body assembly, valve homology and stem-brachiopod placement remain interpretations.

title.en: How the plates support a reconstruction
title.zh: 骨片如何支持体制复原

text.en: The fossil record contains separate mitral and sellate sclerites. Paired muscle scars are visible on the sellate plates; the mitral projections are interpreted as muscle platforms. Researchers assembled the pieces into a near-bilateral, sessile animal with two valves. That model is testable, but no fossil preserves the proposed valves joined together, and their homology or a position on the brachiopod stem remains a comparative hypothesis.
text.zh: 化石中分离保存着 mitral 与 sellate 两类骨片。sellate 骨片上可见成对肌痕；mitral 骨片的突起被解释为肌肉平台。研究者据此把骨片组合为近两侧对称、固着生活的双瓣动物。这个模型可检验，但没有化石直接保存相连的两片壳瓣；壳瓣同源性及其腕足动物干群位置仍是比较假说。

title.en: Four localities bound this study sample
title.zh: 四个地点限定了这组研究材料

text.en: The material comes from four localities in three broadly synchronous late Atdabanian carbonate units. One named locality is the Wilkawillina Limestone in the Arrowie Basin, South Australia. The conservative 521–514.5 Ma envelope is tied to these studied units; it is not the genus's full duration, a place of origin, or a sequence of direct ancestors.
text.zh: 研究材料来自三个大致同期的晚阿特达班期碳酸盐岩单元中的四个地点，其中一处是澳大利亚南部 Arrowie 盆地的 Wilkawillina 石灰岩。521–514.5 Ma 是这些研究层位的保守年代包络，不是该属的完整延限、起源地点或直系祖先序列。

title.en: The Early Cambrian tommotiid Micrina, a sessile bivalved stem group brachiopod

commonNameZh: 澄江管状触手冠动物样本
overview: No single Yuganotheca fossil shows the whole animal. The reconstruction brings together 710 fossils referred to Yuganotheca elegans from the Yu’anshan Member at Chengjiang: paired valves built from grains, a lophophore, a two-part tube and a pedicle. That combination is useful for comparing forms near the brachiopod–phoronid stem, but it does not settle the homology of each structure or identify an ancestor.
overviewZh: 没有一件 Yuganotheca 化石展示了完整身体。研究把澄江玉案山段归入 Yuganotheca elegans 的 710 件化石合在一起复原：成对壳瓣由颗粒黏结而成，样本还分别保存触手冠、两段式管状结构和肉茎。这组特征可用于比较腕足动物—帚虫动物干群附近的形态，却不能确定每个结构的同源关系或祖先身份。

ecology.diet: The preserved lophophore supports a suspension-feeding interpretation; feeding itself is not observed.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from the marine Chengjiang depositional setting.
ecology.locomotion: The pedicle suggests attachment, but the fossils do not record movement.
ecology.bodySize: The reconstructed tubular body is measured on the millimetre scale.
ecology.guild: Suspension feeding is inferred from the reconstructed anatomy, not established for every fossil.
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自海相澄江沉积环境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 肉茎暗示其附着生活，但化石没有记录移动情况。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 重建的管状身体以毫米为尺度进行测量。
ecology.guildZh: 根据重建的解剖结构推断其悬浮摄食，但不能将这一结论套用于每件化石。

traits: Paired grain-built valves surround a chamber for the lophophore.
The tube is divided into two parts by a median collar.
A long pedicle is preserved; its internal space is interpreted as coelomic.
evidenceSummary: Read together, the Chengjiang fossils supply the anatomy and formal stratigraphic context, but not a complete body in one specimen. Whether the valves and tube match structures in other groups, and where Yuganotheca belongs near the brachiopod–phoronid stem, depend on comparative interpretation and the tree tested. The sample is not a global range or proof of direct ancestry.
evidenceSummaryZh: 合看澄江样本，才能得到相应解剖和正式地层背景；没有单件化石保存完整身体。壳瓣和管状结构是否与其他类群的结构同源，以及 Yuganotheca 在腕足动物—帚虫动物干群附近的位置，都取决于比较解释与所检验的树。本样本不代表全球分布，也不证明直系祖先关系。

readerLimitations.en: The body plan is reconstructed across referred fossils rather than from one complete specimen. Suspension feeding and attachment are functional interpretations; structural homology and the precise brachiopod–phoronid stem position remain interpretive, not evidence of direct ancestry.
readerLimitations.zh: 身体结构是由归入样本综合复原的，并非来自一件完整化石。悬浮摄食与附着属于功能解释；结构同源和腕足动物—帚虫动物干群中的精确位置仍有解释空间，不能据此认定直系祖先关系。

traitsZh: 一对由颗粒构成的壳瓣围绕着容纳腕肢的腔室。
中部领状结构将管分为两部分。
保存有一条长柄；其内部空间被解释为体腔。

commonNameZh: 寒武纪波杰塔贝壳样本
overview: More than fifty Pojetaia runnegari shell specimens from probably Botomian Ajax Limestone and lowermost Botomian Erkeket Formation preserve a laminar inner fabric comparable to foliated aragonite; the paper does not identify undisputed Cambrian nacre.

ecology.diet: Feeding mode is not directly preserved; shell microstructure does not identify diet
ecology.habitat: Shallow-marine Cambrian carbonate setting inferred from the sampled formations
ecology.locomotion: Not directly observable from shell sections
ecology.bodySize: Millimetre-scale shell material; whole-animal size is not established here
ecology.guild: Ecological guild is unresolved from isolated shell sections

traits: Laminar inner shell microstructure
Foliated-aragonite comparison
More than fifty studied shell specimens
evidenceSummary: Shell sections directly document the sampled laminar fabric; comparison to foliated aragonite and any precursor relationship to nacre remain interpretive, and the sample is not a global bivalve range or ancestor claim.

title.en: A shell interior, not an animal in full
title.zh: 贝壳内部结构，不是完整动物

text.en: The cited study examines more than fifty Pojetaia specimens, including shell sections from South Australia. Those sections preserve a layered inner fabric that the authors compare with foliated aragonite. They discuss how the material bears on the history of nacre, but do not claim undisputed Cambrian nacre in these specimens. Shell sections reveal structure; they do not preserve this animal's feeding or movement.
text.zh: 所引研究检查了 50 多件 Pojetaia 标本，包括来自南澳大利亚的贝壳切片。切片保存了层状内织构，作者将其与叶片状霰石作比较。论文讨论这些材料对珍珠层演化史的意义，但没有声称这些标本已无争议地保存寒武纪珍珠层。贝壳切片能显示结构，却不能保存该动物如何摄食或运动。

title.en: A regional sample with a bounded age
title.zh: 有界的区域样本与年代范围

text.en: The paper places the sampled shells in the Ajax Limestone and the lowermost Erkeket Formation of South Australia. Their correlations are described as probably Botomian and lowermost Botomian, respectively. Using the Cambrian Stage 4 boundaries in the International Chronostratigraphic Chart v2026/06 gives a 514.5–506.5-million-year sample envelope. It is a dated window for the cited material, not a complete global first or last appearance for the species or genus.
text.zh: 论文将所研究的贝壳置于南澳大利亚的 Ajax 石灰岩和 Erkeket 组最下部。两处地层的对比分别被表述为“可能属于 Botomian”和“最下部 Botomian”。按照《国际年代地层表》v2026/06 的寒武纪第 4 期界线，所引材料的样本年代包络为 5.145–5.065 亿年前。这只是该批材料的年代窗口，并非该物种或属的完整全球首现或末现。

title.en: What the shells cannot establish
title.zh: 贝壳证据无法回答什么

text.en: The shell material supports a species-level account of the studied specimens and a comparison of their mineralized layers. Isolated sections do not establish whole-animal size, diet, locomotion or ecological role. The higher evolutionary position of early bivalves and any relationship to later nacre remain comparative questions, not evidence that Pojetaia was a direct ancestor of living bivalves.
text.zh: 这些材料支持对所研究标本作物种级记录，并比较其矿化层。孤立切片不能确定完整动物的体型、食性、运动方式或生态角色。早期双壳类的更高阶演化位置以及它们与后来的珍珠层之间的关系仍是比较研究问题；这并不证明 Pojetaia 是现生双壳类的直接祖先。

title.en: Vendrasco et al. (2011), Pojetaia shell microstructure
title.zh: Vendrasco 等（2011），Pojetaia 贝壳微结构

scope.en: The paper documents Pojetaia shell sections and their inner laminar fabrics. Its comparison with foliated aragonite and discussion of nacre evolution are interpretations tied to the examined material, not a direct record of feeding or a complete bivalve history.
scope.zh: 该论文记录 Pojetaia 贝壳切片及其层状内织构。与叶片状霰石的比较和有关珍珠层演化的讨论都限于所检材料，是解释而非摄食行为或双壳类完整演化史的直接记录。

title.en: International Chronostratigraphic Chart v2026/06
title.zh: 国际年代地层表 v2026/06

scope.en: The v2026/06 chart supplies numerical boundaries for the named Cambrian interval. It bounds the cited shell sample under its qualified Botomian correlations; it does not turn that regional sample into a global first or last appearance.
scope.zh: v2026/06 年代地层表为所用寒武纪时段提供数值界线。它依据带有限定语的 Botomian 对比界定所引贝壳样本的年代范围，并不会将区域样本转化为全球首现或末现。

overview: Articulated Kutorgina chengjiangensis fossils from the Chengjiang Lagerstätte preserve paired valves alongside a lophophore, digestive tract and pedicle. This formation-scale sample makes early brachiopod anatomy unusually tangible, while feeding function and ancestry remain interpretations.

ecology.diet: Suspension feeding inferred from the preserved lophophore
ecology.habitat: Marine Chengjiang depositional setting
ecology.locomotion: Pedicle attachment inferred from the preserved pedicle; movement is not observed
ecology.bodySize: Millimetre-scale shell and soft-body material
ecology.guild: Sessile suspension feeder is inferred from lophophore and pedicle anatomy

traits: Articulated calcareous valves
Early spirolophe lophophore
Digestive tract and pedicle
evidenceSummary: The Chengjiang material preserves valves and associated soft anatomy. The lophophore and pedicle support an attached, suspension-feeding interpretation, but behavior is inferred and this local sample does not establish the origin or full range of Brachiopoda.

title.en: A feeding organ is preserved with the valves
title.zh: 壳瓣旁还保存了摄食器官

text.en: The described specimens preserve paired calcareous valves with an associated lophophore, digestive tract and pedicle. A lophophore is the tentacle-bearing organ used by brachiopods in suspension feeding; the described form has an early spirolophe arrangement. The fossils let researchers compare this soft anatomy with the shell, while attachment and feeding remain functional interpretations rather than behavior observed in life.
text.zh: 描述的标本保存了成对钙质壳瓣，以及与之相连的腕冠、消化道和肉茎。腕冠是腕足动物用于悬浮摄食、带有触手的器官；该化石呈现一种早期螺旋腕冠形态。化石让研究者能把软组织结构与壳瓣放在一起比较，但固着方式和摄食仍属功能解释，并非对活体行为的直接观察。

title.en: One Chengjiang sample is not an ancestor ladder
title.zh: 澄江的一组材料不是祖先序列

text.en: The material comes from the Chengjiang Lagerstätte in Yunnan, South China, within an Early Cambrian study window of about 520–518 Ma. It records a particular species and formation, not the complete geographic range of that species or the global first appearance of brachiopods. The anatomy can inform comparisons among early body plans without making Kutorgina a direct ancestor of later brachiopods.
text.zh: 这组材料来自中国云南南部的澄江生物群，研究所用的寒武纪早期年代窗口约为 520–518 Ma。它记录的是一个特定物种和地层，不是该物种的完整地理分布，也不是腕足动物在全球的首现时间。其解剖结构可用于比较早期体制，但不能据此把顾脱贝视为后世腕足动物的直接祖先。

commonNameZh: 保存肠内容物的三叶虫标本
overview: Synchrotron microtomography maps an alimentary tract in Bohemolichas incola inventory specimen 8, with identifiable ostracods, hyoliths and stylophorans preserved as one meal.

ecology.diet: Ostracods, hyoliths and stylophorans preserved in the gut
ecology.habitat: Marine benthos inferred from formation and prey
ecology.bodySize: Centimetre-scale trilobite
ecology.guild: Opportunistic benthic feeder inferred from one meal

traits: Three-dimensionally preserved gut
Identifiable shelly prey remains
Synchrotron-mapped digestive tract
evidenceSummary: The prey remains are direct evidence from a single Šárka Formation specimen. They do not establish prey choice, feeding rate or a genus-wide diet, and the 466–463 Ma interval is formation context rather than a global range.

title.en: The gut preserves an identifiable meal
title.zh: 肠道中保存了一餐可辨认的食物

text.en: Synchrotron microtomography, a three-dimensional X-ray imaging method, reveals the alimentary tract in inventory specimen 8. Inside it are remains identified as ostracods, hyoliths and stylophorans. These fossils record what was present in this one meal and make a rare specimen-level dietary observation; they do not show how often the trilobite fed or which prey it usually selected.
text.zh: 同步辐射显微断层成像是一种三维 X 射线成像方法，它显示了馆藏编号 8 标本的消化道。其内部保存着被鉴定为介形虫、软舌螺和腕足形动物的残骸。这是一次罕见的个体层面食性观察，记录了这一餐中的内容；它没有说明三叶虫多久进食一次或通常选择哪些猎物。

title.en: One specimen has a narrow geographic and taxonomic scope
title.zh: 一个标本的地理与分类范围有限

text.en: The animal comes from the Šárka Formation in the Prague Basin, with a formation-level interval of 466–463 Ma. The profile retains the specimen’s identification as Bohemolichas incola while noting that PBDB treats Bohemolichas as a subjective synonym of Uralichas. The gut contents do not settle that broader naming question or establish a genus-wide distribution.
text.zh: 这件标本来自布拉格盆地的 Šárka 组，地层背景年代为 466–463 Ma。本页保留标本鉴定为 Bohemolichas incola，同时说明 PBDB 将 Bohemolichas 视作 Uralichas 的主观异名。肠道内容物无法裁决更广的命名问题，也不能确定整个属的分布。

evidenceSummaryZh: 猎物残留是来自一件 Šárka 组标本的直接证据。它们不能确定猎物选择、摄食率或属级食性；466–463 Ma 是该组的地层背景，不代表全球分布时段。

commonNameZh: 布尔吉斯页岩鳃支样本
overview: A partly preserved upper branch of the Olenoides serratus limb lets researchers compare its attachment and filaments with structures proposed to have respiratory roles in trilobites.

ecology.diet: Diet is not resolved by the cited appendage sample
ecology.habitat: Marine Burgess Shale setting
ecology.bodySize: Body size is not reconstructed by the cited appendage study
ecology.guild: Respiratory function is inferred; ecological guild remains unresolved

traits: Partly preserved upper limb branch
Body-wall attachment comparable to lamellate respiratory branches
Filament-bearing branch included in an ESEM and micro-CT comparison
evidenceSummary: The fossil preserves the branch and its body-wall attachment. Gill function, haemolymph flow and homology with other limb branches are interpretations from morphology and imaging; gas exchange was not measured, and the comparison does not establish ancestry.

title.en: Research overview
title.zh: 研究概述

text.en: A partly preserved upper branch of the Olenoides serratus limb lets researchers compare its attachment and filaments with structures proposed to have respiratory roles in trilobites.
text.zh: 一段保存不完整的 Olenoides serratus 肢体上支，使研究者能够比较其连接方式和丝状结构，并与三叶虫中被提出具有呼吸作用的结构对照。

title.en: A branch examined in images
title.zh: 成像研究中的肢体上支

text.en:
The upper limb branch is incompletely preserved. Its attachment to the body wall can be compared with lamellate respiratory branches.

The filament-bearing branch was included in comparisons using environmental scanning electron microscopy (ESEM) and micro-CT.
text.zh:
保存不完整的肢体上支。

体壁连接方式可与片状呼吸支作比较。

带丝状结构的肢支纳入环境扫描电镜和微型 CT 比较。

title.en: A marine deposit is not a full life record
title.zh: 海相沉积记录不等于完整生活史

text.en: The appendage comes from a marine Burgess Shale setting. The cited limb study does not resolve diet, locomotor performance or body size; its respiratory interpretation comes from morphology and imaging rather than a measurement of gas exchange.
text.zh: 这件附肢材料来自海相布尔吉斯页岩沉积环境。所引研究没有确定食性、运动表现或体型；其呼吸功能解释来自形态与成像，而非气体交换测量。

title.en: What this evidence can establish
title.zh: 证据能说明什么

text.en: The fossil preserves the branch and its body-wall attachment. Gill function, haemolymph flow and homology with other limb branches are interpretations from morphology and imaging; gas exchange was not measured, and the comparison does not establish ancestry.
text.zh: 化石保存了肢支及其与体壁的连接。鳃功能、血淋巴流动和肢支同源关系均由形态与成像作出解释；研究没有测量气体交换，也没有证明祖先关系。

title.en: The trilobite upper limb branch is a well-developed gill
title.zh: The trilobite upper limb branch is a well-developed gill

scope.en: ESEM and micro-CT compare trilobite upper limb branches; respiratory function is inferred from structure, not measured as gas exchange.
scope.zh: 研究通过环境扫描电镜与微型 CT 比较三叶虫肢体上支；呼吸功能由结构推断，并非气体交换实测。

commonNameZh: 澄江螯肢干群检验标本
overview: Micro-CT reconstructions of the Chengjiang fossil show short, pincer-like great appendages, overlapping exite flaps and a head interpreted as seven segments. Researchers use these features to test a stem-chelicerate placement; segment count and anatomical homologies are comparative interpretations.

ecology.diet: The pincers are preserved, but the fossils do not establish what Urokodia ate.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from the marine Chengjiang setting. Depositional context does not by itself show how the animal lived.
ecology.locomotion: The available anatomy does not measure walking or swimming performance.
ecology.bodySize: The material preserves a small, articulated arthropod; no precise body-size estimate is provided.
ecology.dietZh: 钳状结构有保存，但现有化石没有表明 Urokodia 吃什么。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自澄江海相沉积环境；沉积背景不能单独说明动物生前如何生活。
ecology.locomotionZh: 现有形态资料不足以测定它的行走或游泳能力。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 材料保存了一种小型、关节连接的节肢动物；现有记录没有提供精确体型估计。
ecology.guildZh: 现有证据尚不能确定它在生态系统中的角色。

traits: The short great appendages end in pincer-like structures.
Overlapping exite flaps are preserved along the appendages.
A seven-segmented head is an interpretation of the preserved anatomy.
evidenceSummary: Tomography documents the structures; chelicera and book-gill homologies and an upper stem-chelicerate position come from comparative analyses. These findings do not identify a direct ancestor of living chelicerates.
overviewZh: 对澄江化石进行微型 CT 重建，显示短而钳状的大附肢、相互覆盖的外肢片（exite），以及被解释为由七节组成的头部。研究者用这些特征检验其在螯肢动物干群中的位置；头节数和解剖同源关系仍是形态比较的解释。
traitsZh: 短小的大附肢末端呈钳状。
附肢上保存有彼此覆盖的外肢片。
将头部划分为七节，是对保存形态的解释。
evidenceSummaryZh: 断层成像直接显示了这些结构；螯肢和书鳃的同源关系，以及其位于螯肢动物干群较上部的位置，来自比较分析。这些结果没有证明它是现生螯肢动物的直接祖先。

overview: Holotype KUMIP 314091a,b preserves massive three-segmented chelicerae and a pseudobiramous body plan in a middle Cambrian stem-chelicerate analysis.

ecology.diet: Predatory feeding is inferred from massive chelicerae; prey is not preserved
ecology.habitat: Marine Drumian Wheeler Formation setting
ecology.locomotion: Locomotor performance is not measured from the flattened holotype
ecology.bodySize: Large soft-bodied arthropod; total body length is not treated as a precise measurement
ecology.guild: Large predator inferred from morphology, not directly observed behaviour

traits: Massive three-segmented chelicerae
Five pairs of pseudobiramous post-cheliceral prosomal limbs
Plate-like lamellae-bearing opisthosomal appendages
evidenceSummary: Part and counterpart directly preserve named anatomy; stem placement and a bridge between habeliids and synziphosurines are matrix results, not a direct ancestor–descendant sequence.

title.en: What the large chelicerae show
title.zh: 大型螯肢展示了哪些结构？

text.en:
Part and counterpart KUMIP 314091a,b from Utah’s Drumian Wheeler Formation preserve the paired front appendages, or chelicerae, with three segments each. Behind them are five pairs of prosomal limbs with two branches, followed by posterior appendages carrying plate-like lamellae. Read together, these parts make the holotype’s body plan more concrete than the label “Cambrian arthropod.”

The massive chelicerae support a predatory interpretation, but the holotype preserves no prey and does not record an attack. Published matrices place Megachelicerax among stem chelicerates, between sampled habeliid and synziphosurine groups; that is a conditional tree position, not a demonstrated ancestor–descendant sequence.
text.zh:
来自犹他州鼓阶惠勒组的正反模 KUMIP 314091a、b，保存了一对各分为三节的前部附肢，即螯肢。其后有五对分为两支的前体附肢，再往后则是带片状薄片的后体附肢。把这些部位合起来看，才能具体理解这件寒武纪正模的身体结构。

巨大的螯肢支持捕食者这一解释，但正模没有保存猎物，也没有记录攻击行为。已发表的矩阵把 Megachelicerax 放在螯肢类干群，位于所取样的 habeliid 与 synziphosurine 类群之间；这是依赖分析的系统位置，并非已证实的祖先—后代序列。

title.en: A chelicera-bearing arthropod reveals the Cambrian origin of chelicerates
title.zh: A chelicera-bearing arthropod reveals the Cambrian origin of chelicerates
