commonNameZh: 莫里逊虫神经解剖样本
overview: Two Burgess Shale specimens preserve optic nerves, a possible compact head ganglion and a segmented ventral nerve cord. Elemental mapping supports a nervous-tissue interpretation, while the animal's broader arthropod placement remains disputed.

ecology.diet: Not established for the profiled M. symmetrica. Micropredation is supported for the separate species M. plenovenatrix and should not be transferred to this sample.
ecology.habitat: The cited specimens come from the marine Burgess Shale setting.
ecology.locomotion: Locomotor performance is unknown for M. symmetrica. Walking legs are documented in M. plenovenatrix, a different species.
ecology.bodySize: The cited fossil samples are centimetre-scale; this does not provide a complete body-size range for the genus.
ecology.guild: Unresolved for M. symmetrica. The benthic-micropredator interpretation applies to M. plenovenatrix only.
ecology.dietZh: 对所描述的 M. symmetrica 而言，食性尚未确定。微型捕食的证据针对另一物种 M. plenovenatrix，不应移用于该样本。
ecology.locomotionZh: M. symmetrica 的运动能力未知。不同种 M. plenovenatrix 有行走足的记录。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所引化石标本为厘米级；这不能提供该属完整的体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: M. symmetrica 的生态类群尚未确定。底栖微型捕食者的解释仅适用于 M. plenovenatrix。

traits: Preserved optic nerves
Possible compact cephalic synganglion
Segmental ventral nerve cord
evidenceSummary: Elemental maps support identifying the carbon films as nervous tissue. The remains are incomplete, and other anatomical signals have led to competing placement hypotheses; these specimens do not establish an ancestral chelicerate nervous system.

title.en: Nervous tissue preserved as carbon films
title.zh: 碳质薄膜保存的神经组织

text.en: Two Burgess Shale specimens, MCZ 1811 and USNM 305093, preserve carbonaceous films interpreted as optic nerves, a possible compact synganglion in the head, and a segmented ventral nerve cord. Elemental mapping supports identifying the films as nervous tissue. The possible head ganglion is an interpretation, so it is useful to keep that qualification beside the anatomical description.
text.zh: 两件布尔吉斯页岩标本 MCZ 1811 和 USNM 305093 保存了碳质薄膜，研究者将其解释为视神经、可能的紧凑头部联合神经节，以及分节的腹神经索。元素分布分析支持这些薄膜属于神经组织；头部神经节仍是可能的解释，因此描述中需要保留这一限定。

title.en: A specimen-level result, not a complete life history
title.zh: 标本证据的范围

text.en: The neural fossils and appendicular evidence have supported competing views of Mollisonia's position among arthropods, so this material does not settle the ancestral organization of chelicerates. It also does not establish diet or locomotion for M. symmetrica: a benthic-micropredator interpretation comes from the separate species M. plenovenatrix. The 508.1–505 Ma interval describes the cited Burgess Shale sample, not the genus's full duration or a chelicerate divergence date.
text.zh: 神经化石与附肢证据曾支持不同的节肢动物位置解释，因此这些材料没有解决螯肢动物祖先的神经组织方式。它们也不能确定 M. symmetrica 的食性或运动方式：底栖微型捕食者的解释来自另一个物种 M. plenovenatrix。508.1–505 Ma 是所引布尔吉斯页岩样本的年代包络，不是该属的完整延续时间，也不是螯肢类分化年代。

title.en: Ortega-Hernández et al. (2022), Mollisonia nervous tissues
title.zh: Ortega-Hernández 等（2022），莫里逊虫神经组织

scope.en: MCZ 1811 and USNM 305093, carbon films, elemental mapping, Figures 1–5 and supplementary figures. The source supports the described neural structures and discusses competing neuroanatomical and appendicular signals; it does not establish a direct ancestor or genus-wide life history.
scope.zh: MCZ 1811 与 USNM 305093、碳质薄膜、元素分析、图 1–5 及补充图版。该来源支持所述神经结构，并讨论相互竞争的神经解剖与附肢信号；它不能确立直系祖先或该属完整的生活史。

title.en: Aria and Caron (2019), Mollisonia plenovenatrix anatomy
title.zh: Aria 与 Caron（2019），Mollisonia plenovenatrix 解剖

scope.en: The anatomy and ecological interpretation of M. plenovenatrix, Figures 1–4 and pages 586–589. Its benthic-micropredator interpretation applies to that species, not to the M. symmetrica neuroanatomy sample.
scope.zh: M. plenovenatrix 的解剖与生态解释，图 1–4 及第 586–589 页。底栖微型捕食者的解释只适用于该物种，不适用于 M. symmetrica 神经解剖样本。

evidenceSummaryZh: 元素分布图支持将碳质薄膜鉴定为神经组织。遗骸并不完整，其他解剖信号也引出了相互竞争的系统位置假说；这些标本不能确定螯肢动物祖先的神经系统。

geography: Carboniferous and younger spider fossil localities reviewed by Selden and Penney
Broad living-spider target-gene sampling in Wheeler et al.
overview: Three kinds of evidence shape this account of spiders: a review of the fossil record, a Carboniferous arachnid comparison, and a broad target-gene study of living species. Each addresses a different part of spider history, so together they remain a sampled picture rather than one complete, final tree.

ecology.diet: Not assigned by the cited phylogenetic and fossil-origin studies
ecology.habitat: Fossil localities and living samples provide context, not a complete habitat map
ecology.locomotion: Spinnerets and appendages are discussed, but locomotor performance is not measured
ecology.bodySize: Not assigned as a complete comparative body-size dataset
ecology.guild: No order-wide ecological guild is assigned from the cited evidence

traits: Abdominal spinnerets controlling silk deployment
Carboniferous Idmonarachne comparison lacking true-spider spinnerets
Extensive target-gene sampling of living spiders
evidenceSummary: Wheeler et al. infer relationships among the living spiders included in their gene sample. Garwood et al. and the fossil-origin review help define what the early fossil record can support; none of these sources supplies a complete ecological account of the order.

title.en: Research overview
title.zh: 研究概述

text.en: Three kinds of evidence shape this account of spiders: a review of the fossil record, a Carboniferous arachnid comparison, and a broad target-gene study of living species. Each addresses a different part of spider history, so together they remain a sampled picture rather than one complete, final tree.
text.zh: 三类证据共同构成这份蜘蛛目记录：化石记录综述、对石炭纪蛛形类的比较，以及对现生种类开展的广泛目标基因研究。每类材料回答的问题不同；合起来仍是受取样限制的图景，不是完整且最终定论的系统树。

title.en: Spinnerets, fossils and sampled relationships
title.zh: 纺器、化石与取样到的亲缘关系

text.en:
Abdominal spinnerets control how spiders deploy silk.

The Carboniferous arachnid *Idmonarachne* provides a comparison relevant to spider origins, but its preserved underside lacks the spinnerets that distinguish true spiders. Its spider-like appearance alone does not place it within Araneae.

Wheeler et al.'s extensive target-gene sampling supports relationships among the living spiders represented in their study. Selden and Penney's fossil review addresses a different part of the record; with Garwood et al.'s *Idmonarachne* comparison, these sources give a sampled, revisable picture rather than a complete, final tree of Araneae.
text.zh:
腹部纺器控制丝的释放。

石炭纪 Idmonarachne 的比较材料没有保存真蜘蛛具有的纺器。

现生蜘蛛的目标基因取样范围广。

title.en: What this evidence can establish
title.zh: 证据能说明什么

text.en: Wheeler et al. infer relationships among the living spiders included in their gene sample. Garwood et al. and the fossil-origin review help define what the early fossil record can support; none of these sources supplies a complete ecological account of the order.
text.zh: Wheeler 等人推断其基因样本中现生蜘蛛之间的关系。Garwood 等人及化石起源综述有助于界定早期化石记录能支持什么；这些来源都没有提供蜘蛛目完整的生态描述。

title.en: The spider tree of life: phylogeny of Araneae based on target-gene analyses from an extensive taxon sampling
title.zh: The spider tree of life: phylogeny of Araneae based on target-gene analyses from an extensive taxon sampling

scope.en: The study infers relationships among living spiders in its target-gene sample; it does not establish fossil ages or direct ancestry.
scope.zh: 该研究依据目标基因样本推断现生蜘蛛之间的关系；不能由此确定化石年代或直接祖先关系。

title.en: Almost a spider: a 305-million-year-old fossil arachnid and spider origins
title.zh: Almost a spider: a 305-million-year-old fossil arachnid and spider origins

scope.en: The paper distinguishes the 305 Ma stem-like Idmonarachne from true spiders and discusses an approximately 315 Ma origin for Araneae.
scope.zh: 研究将约 3.05 亿年前的干群蛛形动物 Idmonarachne 与真蜘蛛区分，并讨论蜘蛛目约 3.15 亿年前的起源。

title.en: Fossil spiders
title.zh: Fossil spiders

scope.en: The review supports a Carboniferous spider fossil record while retaining taxonomic and sampling limits.
scope.zh: 化石记录综述支持石炭纪蜘蛛记录，同时保留分类鉴定与取样方面的限制。

geography: Siluro-Devonian Phacopidae material and ontogenetic series in Crônier et al.
Sampled trilobite systematics reviewed by Fortey
overview: The evidence here centres on a Silurian–Devonian Phacopidae sample: researchers compare morphology and growth stages to delimit species, alongside a broader review of trilobite systematics. That family-level sample cannot resolve every phacopid lineage or set global endpoints for Phacopida.
overviewZh: 这里的证据集中于志留纪—泥盆纪的 Phacopidae（镜眼虫科）样本：研究者比较形态与生长阶段以区分物种，并结合更广泛的三叶虫系统分类综述。这个科级样本不能厘清镜眼目每条谱系，也不能确定全目的全球首末现时间。

ecology.diet: The cited taxonomic studies do not assign a feeding mode to the order.
ecology.habitat: Regional fossil localities provide context, not a complete distribution of habitats.
ecology.locomotion: Exoskeletal form is described; locomotor performance was not measured.
ecology.bodySize: No complete comparative body-size dataset is supplied.
ecology.guild: No order-wide ecological guild is assigned by these sources.
ecology.dietZh: 所引分类学研究没有为该目指定摄食方式。
ecology.habitatZh: 区域化石地点提供背景信息，并不构成完整的生境分布。
ecology.locomotionZh: 研究描述了外骨骼形态，但未测量运动能力。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 未提供完整的比较性体型数据集。
ecology.guildZh: 这些来源没有为整个目指定统一的生态类群。

traits: Morphological criteria used to distinguish phacopid species
Ontogenetic series compared across Siluro-Devonian material
Facial and exoskeletal characters used in trilobite systematics
evidenceSummary: Crônier and colleagues document a bounded Phacopidae morphology and ontogeny sample, while Fortey reviews broader trilobite systematics. These sources do not establish order-wide first and last occurrences, a complete geographic range or a uniform ecology.

readerLimitations.en: The evidence is taxonomic and morphological, not a survey of all Phacopida. It leaves diet, habitat use, locomotion, body-size variation, global range and order-wide temporal endpoints unassigned.
readerLimitations.zh: 证据侧重分类与形态，并未覆盖全部镜眼目。现有材料无法确定食性、生境利用、运动方式、体型变化、全球分布或全目的时间端点。

evidenceSummaryZh: Crônier 等人记录了范围有限的 Phacopidae 形态与个体发育样本，Fortey 则综述了更广泛的三叶虫系统学。这些来源无法确定整个目级类群的最早和最晚出现时间、完整地理分布或统一的生态特征。
traitsZh: 用于区分 Phacopida 各物种的形态学标准。
比较了志留纪—泥盆纪材料中的个体发育序列。
用于三叶虫系统学研究的面部及外骨骼特征。

geography: Upper Tremadocian Fezouata Formation, Morocco (Van Roy et al.)
Late Permian Russian occurrence reviewed by Tetlie
overview: The sampled record spans about 479–250 Ma, from unequivocal Fezouata eurypterids to a reviewed late Permian occurrence. It combines local fossil records with morphology matrices; these endpoints describe the material assembled here, not the order’s exact origin and extinction.
overviewZh: 这里汇集的化石记录约跨 479–250 Ma：从明确的 Fezouata（费祖阿塔）海蝎材料，到经综述确认的晚二叠世记录。资料结合了不同地点的化石和形态矩阵；这些端点描述的是当前汇集到的样本，并非该目的精确起源或灭绝时间。

ecology.diet: The cited studies do not establish one feeding mode for the order; predation is not assigned as a shared observation.
ecology.habitat: Fezouata and Russian deposits provide settings for particular samples, not a complete habitat map.
ecology.locomotion: Appendages are described in sampled fossils, but locomotor performance is not measured.
ecology.bodySize: The cited material is not a complete comparative body-size dataset.
ecology.guild: These occurrence and morphology studies do not support an order-wide ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: 所引研究未能确定该目统一的摄食方式；掠食也未被列为该目成员共有的观察结果。
ecology.habitatZh: Fezouata 和俄罗斯的沉积层为特定样本提供环境背景，并非完整的生境图谱。
ecology.locomotionZh: 研究描述了所取样化石的附肢，但未测量其运动能力。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所引材料并非完整的比较性体型数据集。
ecology.guildZh: 这些分布与形态研究不足以支持为整个目指定统一的生态类群。

traits: Fezouata specimens included in a eurypterid morphology matrix
Chelicerae and prosomal appendages documented in sampled fossils
Fossil distribution reviewed across Ordovician-to-Permian records
evidenceSummary: Van Roy and colleagues document an unequivocal Fezouata occurrence and score sampled morphology; Tetlie reviews later distribution. The combined 479–250 Ma envelope is a reviewed fossil record, not an exact biological lifespan or a complete tree.

readerLimitations.en: The anatomical and geographic claims apply to the cited samples. The evidence does not provide an order-wide diet, habitat map, locomotor-performance dataset or complete body-size comparison.
readerLimitations.zh: 解剖与地理结论只适用于所引样本。现有证据没有提供整个目的统一食性、完整生境分布图、运动表现数据或全面体型比较。

evidenceSummaryZh: Van Roy 等人记录了明确无疑的 Fezouata 产出，并对取样形态进行编码；Tetlie 综述了之后的分布记录。合并所得的 479–250 Ma 时间范围来自经综述的化石记录，并非精确的生物存续期，也不代表完整的系统树。
traitsZh: 纳入广翅鲎形态矩阵分析的 Fezouata 标本。
取样化石中记录了螯肢和前体部附肢。
对奥陶纪至二叠纪化石记录中分布的综述。

overview: The Burgess Shale fossils of Tokummia katalepsis preserve paired jaws and several kinds of limb appendages. A morphology analysis places it among stem mandibulates, close to but outside the living lineages represented by insects, myriapods and crustaceans.

ecology.diet: Feeding inferred from mandibles; prey not preserved
ecology.habitat: Marine Burgess Shale setting
ecology.locomotion: Benthic or swimming mode inferred from appendages
ecology.bodySize: Centimetre-scale bivalved arthropod

traits: Paired mandibles
Maxillipeds
Subdivided basipods
evidenceSummary: ROM 63823 and paratypes preserve the anatomy used in the published analysis. Its position is a tree-based interpretation, not evidence that Tokummia was a direct ancestor.

title.en: Jaws and limbs preserved together
title.zh: 保存下来的大颚与附肢

text.en: The holotype ROM 63823 and paratypes preserve paired mandibles, maxillipeds and subdivided basipods—the basal parts of the limbs. These appendages provide the evidence for comparing Tokummia with other early arthropods.
text.zh: 正模 ROM 63823 和副模保存了成对的大颚、颚足和分节的基肢（附肢基部）。这些结构为比较 Tokummia 与其他早期节肢动物提供了形态依据。

title.en: A position on the mandibulate stem
title.zh: 有颚类干群上的位置

text.en: A morphology matrix places Tokummia on the stem leading toward mandibulates, including insects, myriapods and crustaceans. This is a branching relationship, not direct ancestry. Diet and movement are inferred from the jaws and limbs, not directly observed.
text.zh: 形态矩阵将 Tokummia 放在通向有颚类的干群上；有颚类包括昆虫、多足类和甲壳类。这是分支关系，不表示直系祖先。食性和运动方式是根据大颚与附肢推断的，并非直接观察。

overview: More than 1,800 specimens document a bivalved mandibulate body plan with mandibles and serial appendages; pancrustacean placement remains analytical.

ecology.diet: Small-particle or prey feeding inferred from mandibles
ecology.habitat: Marine water column and seafloor
ecology.bodySize: Centimetre-scale bivalved arthropod

traits: Bivalved carapace
Mandibles
Serial trunk appendages
evidenceSummary: The large museum series supports repeatable anatomy; pancrustacean placement and swimming-predator ecology remain topology and functional interpretations.

title.en: A large fossil series, one anatomical pattern
title.zh: 大量化石呈现出怎样的身体结构？

text.en:
More than 1,800 Waptia specimens let researchers compare a recurring body plan rather than rely on a single compressed fossil. The preserved combination includes a two-valved carapace, mandibles and repeated trunk appendages. A bivalved carapace has two shell-like halves; the mandibles are paired feeding appendages, while the serial limbs show how much of the trunk is represented in the sample.

These repeated structures support anatomical comparison and the study’s mandibulate interpretation. The number of specimens strengthens the record of this form, but it does not by itself settle every branch of the early pancrustacean tree or make Waptia a direct ancestor of living crustaceans.
text.zh:
一千八百多件 Waptia 标本让研究者能够比较反复出现的身体结构，而不是只依赖一件受压化石。保存的组合包括双瓣甲壳、大颚和连续排列的躯干附肢。双瓣甲壳由两片壳状结构组成；大颚是一对用于取食的附肢，成列的肢体则显示化石记录了多少躯干部分。

这些重复出现的结构支持解剖比较，也支持研究中的大颚类解释。标本数量丰富了该形态的记录，却不能单独解决早期泛甲壳动物系统树的所有分支，也不能证明 Waptia 是现生甲壳类的直系祖先。

title.en: Waptia fieldensis Walcott, a mandibulate arthropod from the middle Cambrian Burgess Shale
title.zh: Waptia fieldensis Walcott, a mandibulate arthropod from the middle Cambrian Burgess Shale

scope.en: Waptia fieldensis: 1–34; Figures 2, 8–10 and 23–24. Limited to the cited specimens, samples or analyses.
scope.zh: Waptia fieldensis：原文定位 1–34; Figures 2, 8–10 and 23–24。本文仅使用所引标本、样本或分析的对应结果。

commonNameZh: 滇虫甲壳幼体发育系列
overview: Phosphatized fossils from the Lower Cambrian Chiungchussu Formation in Yunnan preserve *Yicaris dianensis* at several growth stages. Its limbs include leaf-shaped exites, or outer lobes, and resemble those of eucrustaceans. A character analysis placed *Yicaris* near crown Eucrustacea, but that is a phylogenetic interpretation, not evidence that it was a direct ancestor or a date for the group's origin.
overviewZh: 云南筇竹寺组下寒武统海相沉积中，磷酸盐化的 *Yicaris dianensis* 化石保存了多个生长阶段。其附肢上有叶片状外叶（exites），肢体组织方式也与真甲壳类相似。性状分析把 *Yicaris* 放在冠群真甲壳类附近；这属于系统发育解释，并不表示它是直接祖先，也不能据此确定该类群的起源年代。

ecology.diet: Diet is not directly preserved.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from a marine deposit; the animal's preferred habitat is not established.
ecology.locomotion: Swimming or crawling with the limbs has been proposed, but performance is unknown.
ecology.bodySize: The described growth stages range from below one millimetre to about one millimetre.
ecology.guild: The material is a developmental sample; ecological role is unresolved.
ecology.dietZh: 化石没有直接保存食性信息。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自海相沉积层；尚不能确定该动物偏好的栖息环境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 有人提出其可能用附肢游泳或爬行，但运动能力尚不清楚。
ecology.guildZh: 现有材料是发育阶段样本；其生态作用尚未明确。

traits: Individuals from several growth stages
Leaf-shaped exites (outer limb lobes)
Eucrustacean-like limb organization
evidenceSummary: Multiple growth stages preserve appendage structure in phosphatized fossils. The 521–514 Ma interval is a broad formation context, not a species duration; placement near crown Eucrustacea and the homology of the exites remain interpretations of anatomical characters.
evidenceSummaryZh: 磷酸盐化标本直接记录多个生长阶段和附肢构造。521–514 Ma 是发育样本所处地层的大致背景，并非物种延续时长；其在真甲壳类树中的位置及外叶的同源关系仍取决于性状解释。
traitsZh: 来自多个生长阶段的个体。
叶片状外肢（肢体外侧的叶状突起）。
类似真甲壳类的肢体结构。

commonName: Contested Late Devonian arthropod (originally interpreted as an insect)
commonNameZh: 有争议的晚泥盆世节肢动物（原被解释为昆虫）
overview: The nearly complete Strud fossil was first described as a Late Devonian insect. A later re-examination rejected that identification, leaving its place among arthropods uncertain. The specimen preserves a small segmented body with antennae, legs and contested mouthpart evidence.
overviewZh: Strud 地点出土的近乎完整化石最初被描述为晚泥盆世昆虫，后来的重新研究则否定了这一鉴定，使它在节肢动物中的位置仍有争议。标本保存了小型、分节的身体、触角和足；支持昆虫判断的口器特征仍是讨论焦点。

ecology.diet: One study read the mandibles as orthopteroid and proposed omnivory. No meal or feeding event is preserved.
ecology.habitat: The Strud sediments point to a terrestrial or freshwater-margin setting. That setting does not by itself identify where the animal lived.
ecology.locomotion: The preserved legs support a walking-arthropod interpretation; speed and gait are not established.
ecology.bodySize: The nearly complete specimen is millimetre-scale.
ecology.guild: Its place in a terrestrial arthropod guild remains unresolved.
ecology.habitatZh: Strud 沉积物指向陆地或淡水边缘环境；仅凭这一环境不能确定动物实际生活于何处。
ecology.locomotionZh: 保存下来的足支持其为行走节肢动物的解释，但速度和步态尚未确定。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 近乎完整的标本为毫米级。
ecology.guildZh: 它在陆生节肢动物生态类群中的位置仍未确定。

traits: A nearly complete, segmented body
Preserved antennae and legs
Mandibles with a disputed orthopteroid interpretation
evidenceSummary: Garrouste and colleagues described Strudiella as an insect. Hörnschemeyer and colleagues later rejected that identification after re-examining the specimen. Its arthropod affinity remains contested, so it is not a secure insect calibration.
evidenceSummaryZh: Garrouste 等人最初将 Strudiella 描述为昆虫；Hörnschemeyer 等人重新检查同一标本后否定了这一归属。它在节肢动物中的亲缘位置仍有争议，因此不适合作为可靠的昆虫年代校准化石。

title.en: Why is Strudiella's insect identity disputed?
title.zh: Strudiella 的昆虫身份为何有争议？

text.en: The nearly complete Strud fossil was first described as a Late Devonian insect. A later re-examination rejected that identification, leaving its place among arthropods uncertain. The specimen preserves a small segmented body with antennae, legs and contested mouthpart evidence.
text.zh: Strud 地点出土的近乎完整化石最初被描述为晚泥盆世昆虫，后来的重新研究则否定了这一鉴定，使它在节肢动物中的位置仍有争议。标本保存了小型、分节的身体、触角和足；支持昆虫判断的口器特征仍是讨论焦点。

title.en: What the specimen preserves
title.zh: 标本保存了什么

text.en: The nearly complete, millimetre-scale specimen preserves a segmented body, antennae and legs. Its mouthparts helped support the original insect diagnosis, but the proposed orthopteroid and other insect characters were challenged when the same material was re-examined.
text.zh: 这件近乎完整、毫米级的标本保存了分节的身体、触角和足。其口器曾支持最初的昆虫鉴定，但后来重新检查同一材料时，对其直翅类及其他昆虫特征提出了质疑。

title.en: Ecology follows a disputed reading
title.zh: 生态解释取决于有争议的鉴定

text.en: The original study inferred a terrestrial animal and possible omnivory from its mandibles. No feeding event is preserved, and the later reassessment weakens ecological conclusions that depend on calling those structures insect-like.
text.zh: 原研究根据下颌推断其为陆生动物，并提出可能杂食。化石未保存取食事件；后来的重新评估削弱了那些依赖将这些结构判作昆虫特征的生态结论。

title.en: A complete insect from the Late Devonian period
title.zh: A complete insect from the Late Devonian period

scope.en: Garrouste et al. (2012), pp. 82?85, Figures 1?4: original diagnosis and specimen description, body and mandible anatomy, Strud locality and the original ecological interpretation.

title.en: Is Strudiella a Devonian insect?
title.zh: Is Strudiella a Devonian insect?

scope.en: H?rnschemeyer et al. (2013), pp. E3?E4 and Figure 1: re-examination of the same specimen, rejection of the insect interpretation and caution about ecological claims.

readerLimitations.en: The record is one contested specimen from Upper Devonian freshwater deposits at Strud. The deposit alone does not establish its usual habitat or gait, and it cannot define a population-wide ecological guild or a genus-wide range.
readerLimitations.zh: 这是一件来自 Strud 上泥盆统淡水沉积的有争议标本。沉积环境本身不能确定其通常栖息地或步态，也不能界定种群层面的生态类群或属级分布范围。

traitsZh: 近乎完整、具有分节结构的身体。
触角和足部保存下来。
颚部具有有争议的直翅类解释。

overview: One female and two male specimens from the Yixian Formation were described as a stem stick insect. The female preserves an abdominal operculum and the forewings a shoulder pad; dark longitudinal veins prompted a separate, tentative leaf-mimicry hypothesis.

ecology.diet: The proposed plant association comes from comparing wing pattern with a plant organ; the fossils do not preserve feeding.
ecology.habitat: All three described specimens come from the Yixian Formation of the Jehol biota in Inner Mongolia, China. This records their deposit, not the species' complete habitat range.
ecology.locomotion: Long forewings support describing a winged insect; flight capability is inferred from anatomy rather than observed.
ecology.bodySize: The described female is about 56 mm long; the two males are about 47–51 mm.
ecology.guild: Dark wing veins were proposed as possible leaf mimicry. A plant-associated crypsis guild is not directly observed.
ecology.dietZh: 植物关联假说来自将翅纹与植物器官进行比较；化石并未保存摄食行为。
ecology.habitatZh: 所描述的三件标本均来自中国内蒙古热河生物群的义县组。这记录的是化石埋藏地点，并非该物种完整的生境分布。
ecology.locomotionZh: 长前翅支持将其描述为有翅昆虫；飞行能力是根据解剖结构推断的，并未被直接观察。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所述雌体长约 56 毫米；两只雄体约 47–51 毫米。
ecology.guildZh: 研究者提出，深色翅脉可能具有拟叶作用。尚未直接观察到其属于与植物相关的隐蔽生态类群。

traits: Female abdominal operculum
Forewing shoulder pad
Dark longitudinal wing veins
evidenceSummary: The study dates the Yixian Formation to about 126 ± 4 Ma; the displayed 130–122 Ma window applies to these three specimens, not a global species range. The insect diagnosis uses preserved structures, while leaf mimicry remains a functional interpretation.

title.en: A diagnosis from three specimens
title.zh: 三件标本构成的诊断

text.en: The female and two male fossils come from the Yixian Formation in the Jehol biota of Inner Mongolia. The female abdominal operculum and forewing shoulder pad support the published stem-Phasmatodea diagnosis. Their formation is dated to about 126 ± 4 Ma; the 130–122 Ma display converts that deposit age and applies only to this sample.
text.zh: 一件雌性和两件雄性化石均来自内蒙古热河生物群的义县组。雌性腹部的腹盖和前翅肩垫，支持论文将该种归入枝叶虫类干群。研究将义县组定年为约 126 ± 4 Ma；显示的 130–122 Ma 是该沉积样本的换算窗口，不是全球物种延限。

title.en: A wing pattern and a mimicry hypothesis
title.zh: 翅纹提出拟叶假说

text.en: The described wings have dark longitudinal veins. The study compared this pattern with a contemporaneous plant organ and proposed possible leaf mimicry. That is a functional interpretation: the fossils do not show camouflage in action or directly record diet, and three specimens cannot establish a species-wide ecological guild.
text.zh: 已描述的翅上有深色纵脉。研究将这种图案与同期植物器官比较，提出它可能具有拟叶作用。这是功能解释：化石没有直接显示伪装行为，也没有记录摄食；三件标本不足以概括整个物种的生态功能群。

title.en: Under cover at pre-angiosperm times: A cloaked phasmatodean insect from the Early Cretaceous Jehol biota
title.zh: Under cover at pre-angiosperm times: A cloaked phasmatodean insect from the Early Cretaceous Jehol biota

overviewZh: 描述中包括一件雌性和两件雄性标本，均产自义县组；研究者将其归为干群竹节虫。雌性保存有腹部盖板，前翅保存有肩板；纵向深色翅脉则引出了另一项暂定假说，即可能存在拟叶现象。
evidenceSummaryZh: 研究将义县组的年代定为约 126 ± 4 Ma；图示的 130–122 Ma 时段适用于这三件标本，并非该物种的全球分布时段。昆虫鉴定依据保存下来的结构，而拟叶行为仍属功能性解释。

overview: Four head capsules and roughly ten further body specimens from the Rhynie Chert in Scotland include an abdomen with a springtail-like furcula, a fork-shaped structure. Together, they support treating this sample as *Rhyniella praecursor* and its affinity with springtails (Collembola); they do not establish a complete species history or global range.
overviewZh: Rhyniella praecursor 在此指苏格兰阿伯丁郡莱尼燧石中的一小组化石，而非完整物种史。1981 年重新评估报道了四个头壳和约十件身体标本，其中一件腹部保存了类似弹尾类叉状尾器（furcula）的结构，可支持弹尾类亲缘判断；它不能告诉我们食物、真实生活环境或运动方式，也不足以估计种群体型或完整分布。411–407 Ma 的普拉吉期年代是现代显示区间，原论文采用的是较早的数值年代换算。

ecology.diet: Diet is not recorded by these fossils.
ecology.habitat: The material comes from the Rhynie Chert; the animal's living habitat is not directly established.
ecology.locomotion: A furcula is preserved, but how the animal moved is not observed.
ecology.bodySize: This sample does not support a species-wide body-size estimate.
ecology.guild: The fossils do not establish an ecological role.
ecology.dietZh: 这些化石没有记录其食性。
ecology.locomotionZh: 化石保存了弹器，但动物如何移动并未被观察到。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 该样本不足以支持对整个物种体型的估计。
ecology.guildZh: 这些化石不能确定其生态作用。

traits: Four head capsules in the described sample
Roughly ten additional body specimens, including an abdomen
A springtail-like furcula on an abdomen
evidenceSummary: The 1981 reassessment reports four head capsules and roughly ten additional specimens from one locality; the furcula supports collembolan affinity. These fossils do not document ecology or distribution beyond the Rhynie Chert. The 411–407 Ma Pragian envelope is a modern display conversion; the paper used older numerical correlations.
evidenceSummaryZh: 具名证据限于一个地点的四个头壳和约十件附加标本。弹尾类亲缘是基于保存结构作出的判断；食性、生境、运动表现及其他地区的分布都没有由这批化石记录。
traitsZh: 所描述样本中有四个头壳。
另有约十件身体标本，包括腹部。
腹部具有类似弹尾虫的弹器。

commonNameZh: 蜻蜓与豆娘的采样分类
geography: Saxonagrion type locality: Salagou Formation, Lodève Basin, France
Targeted-genomics sample: 136 living species representing 46 of 48 families
overview: A targeted-genomics study compared 136 living species from 46 of 48 odonate families using 478 loci. It updated relationships among sampled dragonflies and damselflies, while several backbone branches remained uncertain. A separate fossil review identifies Saxonagrion minutus at about 268 Ma as the earliest recognized modern odonate; neither result dates the order’s origin or supplies a complete fossil history.

ecology.diet: Diet was not measured in the classification study.
ecology.habitat: Habitat use was not measured in the classification study.
ecology.locomotion: The study did not measure wing use or flight performance.
ecology.bodySize: The study did not compile comparative body-size measurements.
ecology.guild: No ecological guild can be assigned from this phylogenetic sample.
ecology.dietZh: 分类研究没有测定其食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 分类研究未测量栖息地利用。
ecology.locomotionZh: 该研究没有测量翅的使用方式或飞行能力。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 该研究没有汇编比较性体型测量数据。
ecology.guildZh: 根据这一系统发育样本，无法指定生态类群。

traits: The Upper Permian fossil Saxonagrion minutus preserves forewing venation.
Its description assigns the fossil to Panodonata from wing venation; this is one fossil’s placement, not a diagnosis for all Odonata.
The living classification uses 478 targeted genomic loci across 136 sampled species.
evidenceSummary: The living gene sample and the Upper Permian wing fossil answer different questions. The sample leaves backbone relationships unresolved; the fossil is a single locality and does not establish a global range or the order’s origin.
overviewZh: 一项靶向基因组研究使用 478 个位点，比较了蜻蜓目 48 个科中的 46 科、共 136 个现生物种。研究更新了所取样蜻蜓和豆娘之间的关系，但若干主干分支仍不确定。另一项化石综述将约 268 Ma 的 Saxonagrion minutus 认作已知最早的现代蜻蜓类记录；这两项结果都不能确定蜻蜓目的起源，也不构成完整的化石史。
evidenceSummaryZh: 现生基因样本与晚二叠世的翼化石回答的是不同问题。基因样本未能解决主干关系；这件化石来自单一地点，不能确定全球分布或蜻蜓目的起源。

readerSources.title: Phylogeny and classification of Odonata using targeted genomics

readerSources.title: Odonata (dragonflies and damselflies) as a bridge between ecology and evolutionary genomics

scope.zh: Bybee 等（2016），文章 46，图 2：化石记录综述将约 268 Ma 的 Saxonagrion minutus 认作已知最早的现代蜻蜓类。

title.en: 478 loci and a Permian wing fossil
title.zh: 478 个位点与一件二叠纪翼化石

text.en: A targeted-genomics study compared 136 living species from 46 of 48 odonate families using 478 loci. It updated relationships among sampled dragonflies and damselflies, while several backbone branches remained uncertain. A separate fossil review identifies Saxonagrion minutus at about 268 Ma as the earliest recognized modern odonate; neither result dates the order’s origin or supplies a complete fossil history.
text.zh: 一项靶向基因组研究使用 478 个位点，比较了蜻蜓目 48 个科中的 46 科、共 136 个现生物种。研究更新了所取样蜻蜓和豆娘之间的关系，但若干主干分支仍不确定。另一项化石综述将约 268 Ma 的 Saxonagrion minutus 认作已知最早的现代蜻蜓类记录；这两项结果都不能确定蜻蜓目的起源，也不构成完整的化石史。

title.en: Living-genome sampling and one fossil locality
title.zh: 现生基因取样与单一化石地点

text.en: The living gene sample and the Upper Permian wing fossil answer different questions. The sample leaves backbone relationships unresolved; the fossil is a single locality and does not establish a global range or the order’s origin.
text.zh: 现生基因样本与晚二叠世的翼化石回答的是不同问题。基因样本未能解决主干关系；这件化石来自单一地点，不能确定全球分布或蜻蜓目的起源。

traitsZh: 二叠纪晚期化石 Saxonagrion minutus 保存了前翅翅脉。
其描述依据翅脉将该化石归入 Panodonata；这是对一件化石系统位置的判断，并非对整个蜻蜓目的诊断。
现生分类采用 478 个目标基因组位点，覆盖 136 个取样物种。

geography: Permian–Triassic beetle fossil localities sampled by Zhao et al.
McKenna et al. phylogenomic sample: 373 beetle species spanning approximately 67% of families
overview: What can fossil wings and living genomes each tell us about beetles? Hardened forewings, or elytra, preserve a record of changing form: Zhao and colleagues compare Permian and Triassic elytra across a major vegetation transition. A separate genomic tree samples 373 living beetle species, spanning about 67% of families. The fossil and living studies illuminate different parts of the order’s history; neither supplies a complete account.
overviewZh: 化石翅和现生基因组分别能告诉我们多少甲虫历史？硬化的前翅称为鞘翅，能够留下形态变化的化石记录：Zhao 等人比较了二叠纪和三叠纪鞘翅，并将其置于植被转变背景下。另一项基因组系统树采样 373 个现生甲虫种，覆盖约 67% 的科。两项研究照亮的是目级历史的不同片段，都不是完整的鞘翅目综述。

ecology.diet: The fossil study discusses plant associations and herbivory in its sampled lineages; it does not assign one diet to all beetles.
ecology.habitat: Permian–Triassic vegetation settings and the living genomic sample provide context, not a map of every beetle habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Elytra are hardened forewings that protect the hindwings; the cited studies do not measure flight performance.
ecology.bodySize: The two studies do not provide a complete, comparable body-size dataset for Coleoptera.
ecology.guild: Vegetation-linked ecological change is inferred for the fossil sample; no guild is assigned across the order.
ecology.dietZh: 化石研究讨论了所取样谱系与植物的关联及植食性，但没有为所有甲虫指定一种共同食性。
ecology.locomotionZh: 鞘翅是硬化的前翅，可保护后翅；所引研究没有测量飞行表现。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 这两项研究没有提供完整且可比较的鞘翅目体型数据集。
ecology.guildZh: 研究根据化石样本推断了与植被相关的生态变化，但未将一种生态类群归于整个鞘翅目。

traits: Elytra: hardened forewings that cover and protect the hindwings
Fossil elytra compared across the Permian–Triassic vegetation transition
Living genomic sample: 373 species across about 67% of beetle families
evidenceSummary: Zhao et al. connect changes in fossil elytral form with end-Permian vegetation turnover; McKenna et al. infer relationships from a broad but incomplete living sample. The two studies do not settle beetle ecology, the full order-wide tree or its complete range.
evidenceSummaryZh: Zhao 等人将化石鞘翅形态变化与二叠纪末的植被转替联系起来；McKenna 等人依据广泛但不完整的现生样本推断亲缘关系。两项研究都不能单独解决全目生态、完整系统树或全球分布。

readerLimitations.en: The fossil study discusses plant associations only in its sampled Permian–Triassic lineages; the living genomic tree is a partial sample. Together, these studies do not define an order-wide ecology, flight performance, or a comparable body-size and distribution record.
readerLimitations.zh: 化石研究只在所取样的二叠纪—三叠纪谱系中讨论植物关联，现生基因组树也只覆盖部分类群。两项研究合起来仍不能概括全目的生态、飞行表现，或提供可比较的体型与分布记录。

traitsZh: 鞘翅：硬化的前翅，覆盖并保护后翅。
对比二叠纪—三叠纪植被转变时期的化石鞘翅。
现生基因组样本：373 个物种，覆盖约 67% 的甲虫科。

geography: Triassic xyelid and other hymenopteran fossil localities compiled by Zhang et al.
Peters et al. transcriptomic sample across major hymenopteran lineages
overview: Ants, bees and wasps appear here through a transcriptome-based study of relationships and a review of early fossils. These complementary samples illuminate parts of the order’s history; neither is a census of every living or fossil lineage.

ecology.diet: Parasitoid, predatory and pollinating contexts occur among sampled lineages; no order-wide diet is assigned
ecology.habitat: The cited fossil and genomic studies do not provide a complete habitat distribution
ecology.locomotion: Winged adult anatomy is represented in fossil discussions, but locomotor performance is not measured
ecology.bodySize: Not assigned as a complete comparative body-size dataset
ecology.guild: Parasitoid, predator and pollinator guilds are sample-level ecological contexts, not universal traits

traits: Xyelid fossil body and wing characters
Transcriptomic sampling across major hymenopteran lineages
Fossil-calibrated divergence framework
evidenceSummary: The oldest undisputed xyelid fossils fall at about 242–237 Ma, a fossil minimum rather than an estimate of when Hymenoptera began. Molecular divergence estimates depend on sampled taxa, loci, fossil calibrations and clock models.

title.en: A tree built from sampled lineages
title.zh: 转录组研究怎样比较已取样谱系

text.en: Peters and colleagues used transcriptomes, the expressed RNA copied from genes, to compare relationships across major hymenopteran lineages. The analysis supports many relationships and supplies fossil-calibrated divergence estimates. A calibration helps set a time scale for a tree, but the estimate remains tied to the included lineages, loci, fossil choices and clock model; it is not a measured first appearance for the whole order.
text.zh: Peters 等人利用转录组——由基因转录而来的 RNA——比较膜翅目多个主要谱系的关系。分析支持了多项亲缘关系判断，也给出化石校准的分化时间估计。校准有助于为系统树建立时间尺度，但估计仍取决于纳入的谱系、位点、化石选择和分子钟模型；它不是整个目已测得的首现时间。

title.en: Triassic fossils set a minimum age
title.zh: 三叠纪化石提供最低年代界限

text.en: A systematic review identifies the oldest undisputed xyelid fossils at approximately 242–237 Ma, based on preserved body and wing characters. The older edge of that interval is a fossil minimum: it shows that the lineage existed by then, not when the entire order originated. Other early fossil assignments and molecular estimates answer different questions and should not be collapsed into one date.
text.zh: 系统综述根据保存的身体与翅部特征，将最早无争议的木蜂类化石置于约 242–237 Ma。这个区间的较老端是化石最低界限：它说明该支系到那时已经存在，并不表示整个目恰在那时起源。其他早期化石归属与分子估计回答的是不同问题，不宜合并成一个起源日期。

overviewZh: 蚂蚁、蜜蜂和胡蜂在此分别通过一项基于转录组的亲缘关系研究和一篇早期化石综述呈现。这些互补的样本揭示了该目历史的若干片段；两者都不是对所有现生或化石支系的全面清查。

overview: The atlas begins the robust echinoderm body-fossil record with articulated faunas by about 510 Ma, where several distinct body plans are already present. Older isolated skeletal pieces and a contested Fortunian fossil remain separate evidence.

ecology.diet: Diverse across the phylum; no ancestral diet inferred
ecology.habitat: Marine
ecology.locomotion: Sessile to mobile across sampled body plans
ecology.bodySize: Microscopic ossicles to large articulated bodies

traits: Stereom skeletal microstructure
Multiple differentiated pentaradial and non-pentaradial body plans
Water-vascular-system context in crown members
evidenceSummary: Articulated faunas, isolated stereom ossicles and Yanjiahella answer different questions. None alone fixes the phylum’s origin, a global centre of origin or one ancestral ecology.

title.en: Do not merge three different fossil signals
title.zh: 三种不同化石信号不能合并

text.en: Isolated stereom ossicles, tiny pieces of diagnostic echinoderm skeletal microstructure, occur earlier than articulated bodies. By about 510 Ma, articulated faunas include at least four differentiated body plans. The Fortunian fossil Yanjiahella has been proposed as a stem echinoderm, but it lacks unambiguous echinoderm synapomorphies and stereom, so its placement remains contested.
text.zh: 更早的材料是孤立 stereom 骨片，即可诊断的棘皮动物骨骼微观结构的小碎片；它们并不是相连的完整身体。到约 510 Ma，已经有至少四种分化明显的相连体制。寒武纪幸运期的 Yanjiahella 曾被提议为棘皮动物干群成员，但它没有明确的棘皮动物共有衍征或 stereom，因此位置仍有争议。

title.en: An early record is not an origin date
title.zh: 早期记录不等于起源日期

text.en: The robust endpoint used here is the articulated fauna, not the older microscopic skeletal pieces or the contested Yanjiahella assignment. Highlighted articulated records come from Gondwanan regions, but they do not locate a global origin or map the full Cambrian distribution. Echinoderms also span different body plans and ways of life, so one diet or mode of movement is not assigned to the phylum’s ancestor.
text.zh: 本页采用的可靠界限是相连的化石群，而不是更早的微小骨骼碎片或有争议的 Yanjiahella 归属。重点介绍的相连化石来自冈瓦纳地区，但它们不能定位全球起源中心，也不能绘出完整寒武纪分布。棘皮动物具有多种体制与生活方式，因此不为该门的祖先指定单一食性或运动方式。

overview: Sea urchins and sand dollars belong to Echinoidea, but its deep history is not read from one clock. Darriwilian plates assigned to the total group show echinoid relatives in the Ordovician; a phylogenomic analysis instead estimates the crown group’s origin near the Carboniferous–Permian boundary. The fossil records an occurrence, while the model estimates a divergence under its assumptions.
overviewZh: 海胆和沙钱都属于 Echinoidea，但它的深时历史不能由同一种“时钟”读出。达瑞威尔期骨板表明海胆总群的近缘支系已见于奥陶纪；一项系统基因组分析则把冠群起源估在更晚的石炭纪—二叠纪交界附近。前者是化石出现，后者是在模型假设下估计的分化时间。

ecology.diet: Living echinoids include omnivores and detritivores. Those present-day feeding modes do not yet resolve the diet of the class ancestor.
ecology.habitat: The class occupies marine seafloors from shallow settings to deep water; the cited global record does not reduce that span to one habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Some species live on the sediment surface and others within it. Neither epifaunal nor infaunal life describes the entire class.
ecology.bodySize: The cited global occurrence analysis does not estimate a class-wide body-size range.
ecology.guild: Echinoidea spans several feeding and living modes, so the evidence supports no single guild assignment for the class.
ecology.habitatZh: 本纲生活于从浅水到深水的海底；所引全球记录并未将这一范围归结为单一生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 有些物种生活在沉积物表面，有些则生活在沉积物内部。表栖或内栖都不能描述整个海胆纲。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所引全球分布记录分析没有估算海胆纲整体的体型范围。

traits: The test is assembled from calcitic plates; these durable pieces are among the evidence used to trace the group’s fossil history.
Living crown echinoids bear spines and tube feet, structures that help describe the body plan of familiar sea urchins and sand dollars.
Ordovician bothriocidaroid plates document an early part of the echinoid total-group record, without by themselves dating the crown group’s origin.
evidenceSummary: The Ordovician bothriocidaroid plates and the modelled crown-group date are different kinds of evidence, not competing measurements of the same event. Living species vary in diet and position on the seafloor, and the global occurrence study supplies no general body-size range. These records therefore do not support one ecological profile for all echinoids.
evidenceSummaryZh: 奥陶纪 Bothriocidaroida 骨板与模型估算的冠群年代属于不同证据，不能当作对同一事件的两次测量。现生海胆的食性和海底生活方式也不相同，全球出现记录研究未给出总体体型范围。因此，这些资料不能支持一个适用于全纲的生态画像。

readerLimitations.en: Darriwilian plates document stem-group material, while the crown-group date comes from a separate phylogenomic model. Living species occupy varied depths and feeding modes; these samples support no single ancestral ecology or class-wide body-size envelope.
readerLimitations.zh: 达瑞威尔期骨板记录的是干群材料，冠群年代则来自另一项系统基因组模型。现生种跨越不同水深和取食方式；这些样本不能确定单一祖先生态或全纲体型范围。

traitsZh: 海胆的壳由方解石板组成；这些耐久构件是追溯该类群化石历史的证据之一。
现生海胆冠群具有棘刺和管足；这些结构有助于描述常见海胆和沙钱的身体构型。
奥陶纪 Bothriocidaroida 类群的骨板记录了海胆总群演化记录的早期部分，但仅凭这些骨板无法确定冠群的起源时间。

overview: Crinoidea—the crinoids, including sea lilies and feather stars—is a class of echinoderms. The cited systematic study describes named early crinoid taxa and identifies the middle Tremadocian as the start of the unproblematic fossil record. It treats Middle Cambrian Echmatocrinus as a problematic assignment, so this profile does not use it to move the class’s secure record earlier.
overviewZh:
海百合纲（Crinoidea）包括海百合和海羊齿，是棘皮动物的一纲。所引系统分类研究描述了具名的早期海百合类群，并指出无争议的化石记录始于特马豆克期中期。研究将中寒武世 Echmatocrinus 的归属视为有问题，因此本档案不以它提前可靠记录的起点。

## 生态与解剖的证据范围

这项早期分类研究不能确定全纲统一的食性、栖地偏好、运动方式、体型范围或生态功能群；其化石材料提供海生背景，但不足以推断整个海百合纲的生态。解剖性状仅限于研究涉及的具名早期类群，不作为全纲不变特征，也不据此建立直系祖先关系。

title.en: Two fossil records, two different time bounds
title.zh: 两条化石记录，界定两个不同的时间界限

text.en:
The profile brings together a late Sandbian Macurdablastus record and a separately sourced Wuchiapingian last occurrence. They are observations from different studies, not the first and last points of a fully sampled, continuous history. The difference matters: a named fossil record can anchor a local time bound without fixing the class’s global origin or extinction moment.

A second source examines blastoid hydrospires, an internal anatomical feature. That morphology can be discussed without assigning one diet or habitat to the whole class. The selected fossils and structures provide bounded evidence; they do not recover a complete ecology or turn a Permian–Triassic boundary into the exact instant of blastoid extinction.
text.zh:
本档案并列晚桑比期的 Macurdablastus 记录，以及另一项研究提供的吴家坪期末次出现记录。它们来自不同研究中的实际化石记录，并非经过连续、完整取样后得到的最早点和最晚点。这个区别很重要：具名化石可以约束一个地方的时间界限，却不能确定整个纲的全球起源或灭绝时刻。

另一项来源讨论海蕾体内的水螅沟这一解剖结构。描述这种形态，并不需要把单一食性或生境归给整个纲。这里选取的化石和结构只支持有边界的结论；它们不能复原完整生态，也不能把二叠纪—三叠纪界线等同于海蕾纲灭绝的精确时刻。

title.en: A class name anchored by one named fossil sample
title.zh: 以一份具名化石样本锚定纲级名称

text.en: Ophiuroidea includes brittle stars and basket stars, but the fossil evidence summarized here is narrower: the systematic study identifies Stenaster material as an ophiuran at class level. A database occurrence independently places the sample in Utah's Wah Wah Formation. This supports the group's presence in that documented setting; it does not describe every branch of the class or identify a direct ancestor.
text.zh: Ophiuroidea 包括蛇尾类和筐蛇尾类，但本页总结的化石证据范围更窄：系统研究将 Stenaster 材料鉴定为蛇尾类纲级化石。数据库出现记录另将样本定位在美国犹他州 Wah Wah 组。这支持该类群曾出现在这一具名地层，却没有描述整个纲的所有支系，也没有指定直接祖先。

title.en: The Floian age is a stage ceiling
title.zh: 弗洛期年代是一个阶级上限

text.en: The Wah Wah sample is assigned to the Floian, whose older boundary supplies the displayed 477.1 Ma ceiling. That boundary is not a point date on Stenaster or a measured first appearance of all brittle stars. The study does not establish class-wide diet, habitat preference, body size or locomotion, so ecology is kept at the level of the named marine formation rather than filled in from living relatives.
text.zh: Wah Wah 样本被定为弗洛期；该阶较早边界给出页面显示的 477.1 Ma 上限。这个边界不是 Stenaster 标本的点定年，也不是全部蛇尾类的实测首次出现。系统研究没有确定整个纲的食性、栖地偏好、体型或运动方式，因此生态描述只保留具名海相地层背景，不从现生近缘类群直接套用。

title.en: Two specimens and a preserved body outline

text.en: The holotype and paratype, FMNH PF15373 and PF8472, measure about 62.5–73.3 mm in the represented material. They preserve an elongated, scaleless body outline and soft-tissue traces from the Francis Creek Shale.

text.en: The revised description compares the fossils with cyclostomes—lampreys and hagfishes—and identifies specializations resembling hagfish anatomy. The authors place Myxinikela on the stem, or possibly within the total group, of hagfishes. Some features remain equivocal, so this is not a crown-hagfish record.

title.en: A whole hagfish preserved in the Cretaceous
title.zh: 白垩纪保存的完整盲鳗

text.en: The holotype BHI 6445 is a complete soft-bodied hagfish from the Cenomanian Hâdjoula Lagerstätte of Lebanon, in the eastern Tethys. Its feeding apparatus and body characters were included in a published morphology-based phylogenetic analysis. That analysis places Tethymyxine tapirostrum within crown Myxini, the group containing living hagfishes, though the exact branch changes with the matrix. The 100.5–93.9 Ma interval is the sampled fossil envelope for this specimen, not a global origin date.
text.zh: 正模 BHI 6445 是一具来自黎巴嫩 Hâdjoula 特异埋藏群的完整软体盲鳗，地点位于东特提斯。研究者把它的取食器官和身体性状纳入形态系统发育分析；该分析将 Tethymyxine tapirostrum 置于包含现生盲鳗的盲鳗纲冠群内，但具体分支位置会随矩阵变化。100.5–93.9 Ma 是这件标本的化石年代包络，不是全球起源日期。

title.en: A fossil is not a record of modern hagfish behaviour
title.zh: 化石没有记录现生盲鳗的行为

text.en: The marine deposit documents where BHI 6445 was buried, but the specimen does not directly establish diet, scavenging, preferred depth or the ecology of living hagfishes. One locality also cannot define the group's global distribution. The fossil therefore supports a bounded anatomical and phylogenetic comparison, not a complete ecological profile or a continuous history of the crown group.
text.zh: 海相沉积记录说明 BHI 6445 埋藏于何种地质背景，却不能直接确定它的食性、食腐行为或偏好水深，也不能代替对现生盲鳗生态的研究。一个地点同样无法定义该类群的全球分布。因此，这件化石支持范围有限的解剖与系统发育比较，而不是完整的生态画像或冠群连续历史。

title.en: Miyashita et al. (2019), Cretaceous Tethys hagfish
title.zh: Miyashita 等（2019），特提斯海白垩纪盲鳗

scope.en: BHI 6445, its Hâdjoula horizon and locality, Figures 1–3, Supplementary Figures S1–S4 and the morphology-based phylogenetic analysis. This source supports the specimen-scoped Cenomanian bound; it does not provide a global hagfish origin date or direct behavioural observations.
scope.zh: BHI 6445、Hâdjoula 层位与地点、图 1–3、补充图 S1–S4 及形态系统发育分析。该来源支持限定于标本的森诺曼期年代包络；它不提供盲鳗全球起源日期或直接行为观察。

overviewZh: 一条保存完整软体的盲鳗，标本 BHI 6445，来自黎巴嫩塞诺曼期 Hâdjoula 特异埋藏化石库。基于形态的分析将其置于盲鳗冠群内，但其确切分支位置取决于矩阵。
evidenceSummaryZh: BHI 6445 提供了完整的解剖样本，并为冠群盲鳗提供了一个森诺曼期化石年代界限。一件标本无法确定其全球最早出现时间、生态或连续分布范围。

geography: Lianghe village, Yongdong town, Xiushan County, Chongqing Municipality
Kapeng Reservoir, Baojing County, Xiangxi, Hunan
overview: Articulated Tujiaaspis vividus specimens from the Huixingshao Formation preserve three unpaired dorsal fins, a near-symmetrical hypochordal tail and ventrolateral fins extending from the branchial region toward the tail. A model tests passive lift from those fins, but does not measure swimming performance or establish the fish’s life habitat.

ecology.diet: Diet is not determined by the articulated specimens.
ecology.habitat: The Huixingshao Formation records the fossils’ depositional setting, not a resolved living habitat.
ecology.locomotion: A model estimates passive lift from reconstructed ventrolateral fins; swimming performance was not measured.
ecology.bodySize: The cited material does not support a single genus-wide body-length estimate.
ecology.guild: The cited study does not resolve an ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: 关节相连的标本不能确定食性。
ecology.locomotionZh: 模型根据重建的腹外侧鳍估算了被动升力；研究未测量游泳能力。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所引材料不足以支持该属统一的体长估计。
ecology.guildZh: 所引研究未能确定生态类群。

traits: The specimens preserve three unpaired dorsal fins.
The tail is described as approximately symmetrical and hypochordal.
Ventrolateral fins form a continuous outline from the branchial region toward the caudal region.
evidenceSummary: Holotype IVPP V26668 and paratypes IVPP V27410–V27411 anchor the postcranial observations. The 438.6–432.9 Ma interval belongs to the sampled Huixingshao Formation horizon; it is not a global range, direct ancestry date or universal fin-evolution sequence.
overviewZh: 来自 Huixingshao 组的 Tujiaaspis vividus 关节相连标本保存了三枚不成对背鳍、近乎对称的下脊索尾，以及从鳃区向尾部延伸的腹外侧鳍。一项模型检验这些鳍能否产生被动升力，但没有测量游泳表现，也不能确定鱼生活时的栖地。
evidenceSummaryZh: 正模 IVPP V26668 和副模 IVPP V27410–V27411 是后躯观察的依据。438.6–432.9 Ma 属于所取样的 Huixingshao 组层位；它不是全球分布范围、直接祖先年代或普遍的鳍演化序列。

readerSources.title: Galeaspid anatomy and the origin of vertebrate paired appendages

scope.en: Gai et al. (2022), pp. 959–963, Figures 1–4 and Extended Data Figures 1–6: articulated specimens, fin anatomy, sampled localities and a computed passive-lift model; no swimming performance was measured.
scope.zh: Gai 等（2022），第 959–963 页、图 1–4 与扩展数据图 1–6：关节相连标本、鳍的解剖、取样地点及被动升力计算模型；研究未测量游泳表现。

title.en: Ventral fins and a passive-lift model
title.zh: 腹外侧鳍与被动升力模型

text.en: Articulated Tujiaaspis vividus specimens from the Huixingshao Formation preserve three unpaired dorsal fins, a near-symmetrical hypochordal tail and ventrolateral fins extending from the branchial region toward the tail. A model tests passive lift from those fins, but does not measure swimming performance or establish the fish’s life habitat.
text.zh: 来自 Huixingshao 组的 Tujiaaspis vividus 关节相连标本保存了三枚不成对背鳍、近乎对称的下脊索尾，以及从鳃区向尾部延伸的腹外侧鳍。一项模型检验这些鳍能否产生被动升力，但没有测量游泳表现，也不能确定鱼生活时的栖地。

title.en: The Huixingshao sample and its age window
title.zh: Huixingshao 样本及其年代区间

text.en: Holotype IVPP V26668 and paratypes IVPP V27410–V27411 anchor the postcranial observations. The 438.6–432.9 Ma interval belongs to the sampled Huixingshao Formation horizon; it is not a global range, direct ancestry date or universal fin-evolution sequence.
text.zh: 正模 IVPP V26668 和副模 IVPP V27410–V27411 是后躯观察的依据。438.6–432.9 Ma 属于所取样的 Huixingshao 组层位；它不是全球分布范围、直接祖先年代或普遍的鳍演化序列。

traitsZh: 标本保存了三枚不成对的背鳍。
其尾部被描述为近似对称且具下脊索。
腹外侧鳍形成一条连续轮廓，从鳃区延伸至尾区。

overview: Xiushanosteus mirabilis is anchored by an articulated holotype and more than twenty referred bodies from the Chongqing Lagerstätte. Its small, armoured body and mosaic skull roof contribute to a Telychian record of early jawed vertebrates.

ecology.diet: Undetermined from the articulated fossils
ecology.habitat: Huixingshao Formation depositional setting; life habitat remains unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Aquatic body preservation; swimming performance was not measured
ecology.bodySize: Approximately 30 mm in the figured articulated material

traits: Articulated cranial armour
Mosaic skull-roof character combination
Approximately 30 mm body preservation
evidenceSummary: IVPP V300001 and referred IVPP V300002–V300021 preserve articulated anatomy. The sample does not establish a global first appearance, direct ancestry or a complete history of placoderms.

title.en: Armour preserved in articulated fossils
title.zh: 关节相连化石中的甲胄

text.en: Holotype IVPP V300001 and referred specimens IVPP V300002–V300021 preserve articulated bodies about 30 mm long, including cranial armour. Their skull roofs combine character states described as a mosaic in the study.
text.zh: 正模 IVPP V300001 和归入标本 IVPP V300002–V300021 保存了约 30 毫米长的关节相连身体，其中包括头部甲胄。研究将其头顶骨组合描述为兼有不同类型特征的镶嵌。

title.en: A window onto an early jawed-vertebrate sample
title.zh: 早期有颌脊椎动物样本的一扇窗口

text.en: The fossils come from the Telychian Huixingshao Formation and are interpreted as a jawed stem gnathostome. A Lagerstätte can preserve many individuals from one setting; that concentration does not make Xiushanosteus a direct ancestor or the first jawed vertebrate worldwide. The formation’s depositional setting is not a direct measure of preferred habitat.
text.zh: 这些化石来自特列奇期的 Huixingshao 组，研究将其解释为有颌类干群成员。化石库可以在一个地点保存许多个体，但这种集中保存不表示 Xiushanosteus 是直系祖先或全球最早的有颌脊椎动物。地层的沉积环境也不能直接说明它偏好的栖地。

overviewZh: Xiushanosteus mirabilis 的依据包括一件关节相连的正模和重庆生物群中的二十多件归入标本。其小型披甲身体和呈镶嵌状的头顶骨，为特列奇期早期有颌脊椎动物记录增添了材料。
evidenceSummaryZh: IVPP V300001 及归入该种的 IVPP V300002–V300021 保存了关节相连的解剖结构。这批样本不能确定全球最早出现时间、直接祖先关系或盾皮鱼类的完整历史。

commonNameZh: 志留纪齿旋软骨鱼干群
overview: Qianodus duplicis is a late Aeronian stem chondrichthyan known from 23 isolated tooth whorls, including IVPP V26641. The fossils preserve dentition and histology at about 439 Ma, but no associated jaw or articulated body.
overviewZh: Qianodus duplicis 是约 4.39 亿年前、阿伦期晚期的软骨鱼干群成员，目前依据 23 个彼此分离的牙轮记录，其中包括 IVPP V26641。牙轮是牙齿呈轮状排列的化石结构；这些材料保留了牙齿形态和组织学特征，却没有与之相连的颌骨或关节连接的身体。

ecology.diet: The tooth whorls do not preserve a feeding event, so diet is undetermined.
ecology.habitat: The Rongxi Formation records the depositional setting; the animal’s living habitat is not established.
ecology.locomotion: The isolated tooth whorls provide no evidence of locomotion.
ecology.bodySize: Body size cannot be estimated from isolated tooth whorls.
ecology.guildZh: 其生态角色仍未确定。

traits: Teeth were retained rather than shed
New teeth were added in offset lingual rows
The material is preserved as isolated tooth whorls
evidenceSummary: IVPP V26641 and the referred whorls directly preserve tooth form and histology at roughly 439 Ma. No associated body anatomy establishes its full jaw structure, crown-group membership or global range.
evidenceSummaryZh: IVPP V26641 和归入的牙轮在约 4.39 亿年前保存的牙齿形态与组织学特征有直接记录。由于没有相连的身体解剖，完整颌部结构、冠群归属和全球分布都不能由这些材料确定。

title.en: What can a tooth whorl reveal?
title.zh: 牙轮齿能揭示什么？

text.en: Qianodus duplicis is a late Aeronian stem chondrichthyan known from 23 isolated tooth whorls, including IVPP V26641. The fossils preserve dentition and histology at about 439 Ma, but no associated jaw or articulated body.
text.zh: Qianodus duplicis 是约 4.39 亿年前、阿伦期晚期的软骨鱼干群成员，目前依据 23 个彼此分离的牙轮记录，其中包括 IVPP V26641。牙轮是牙齿呈轮状排列的化石结构；这些材料保留了牙齿形态和组织学特征，却没有与之相连的颌骨或关节连接的身体。

title.en: New teeth in offset lingual rows
title.zh: 舌侧错列的新牙

text.en: The whorls preserve teeth that were retained rather than shed, with new teeth added in offset rows on the lingual side. Histology was examined in named material including IVPP V26641, so the study traces tooth development without a complete jaw or body.
text.zh: 这些牙轮保存了未脱落的牙齿，新的牙齿从舌侧以错列的行添加。组织学检查了包括 IVPP V26641 在内的具名材料，因此研究追踪了牙齿发育，但没有完整的颌骨或身体。

title.en: The oldest gnathostome teeth
title.zh: The oldest gnathostome teeth

scope.en: Andreev et al. (2022), pp. 964?968, especially 965?967, Figures 1?2 and Extended Data Figures 1?3: named tooth whorls, tooth addition, histology and the Rongxi Formation sample.

readerLimitations.en: The 23 isolated whorls come from the late Aeronian Rongxi Formation at Leijiatun. This records a depositional sample, not a known living habitat; the material does not establish a feeding event, locomotion, body size or ecological role.
readerLimitations.zh: 这 23 个分离的牙轮来自 Leijiatun 晚 Aeronian 阶段的 Rongxi 组。它记录的是沉积样本，而非已知的生活环境；这些材料不能确定取食事件、运动方式、身体大小或生态角色。

traitsZh: 牙齿会保留，而非脱落更替。
新牙沿着舌侧错列成行地添加。
材料以孤立的螺旋齿列形式保存。

overview: The nearly complete holotype IVPP V300000 combines a scale-covered body and a chondrichthyan-like rear branchial region with large plates of thoracic armour. That unusual character mix makes its evolutionary placement an open question.

ecology.diet: Undetermined
ecology.habitat: Huixingshao Formation depositional setting; life habitat unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Aquatic body form preserved; performance not measured
ecology.bodySize: Small near-complete holotype

traits: Minute body scales
Chondrichthyan-like posterior branchial region
Large thoracic armour plates
evidenceSummary: One holotype provides an unusually detailed body plan, but it cannot show the species’ population variation. Its exact position among early jawed vertebrates and its ecology remain uncertain.

title.en: Research overview
title.zh: 研究概述

text.en: The nearly complete holotype IVPP V300000 combines a scale-covered body and a chondrichthyan-like rear branchial region with large plates of thoracic armour. That unusual character mix makes its evolutionary placement an open question.
text.zh: 近乎完整的正模 IVPP V300000 同时保存覆有细小鳞片的身体、类似软骨鱼的后部鳃区和大型胸甲。这种少见的性状组合使其演化位置仍有待检验。

title.en: A character mix in one holotype
title.zh: 一件正模中的性状组合

text.en: The described specimen has minute scales across its body and large armour plates over its thorax. Its posterior branchial region—the rear of the gill region—has chondrichthyan-like features.
text.zh:
身体覆有细小鳞片。

后部鳃区具有软骨鱼类样特征。

胸部有大型甲板。

title.en: What one holotype can and cannot show
title.zh: 一件正模能显示什么、不能显示什么

text.en: The Huixingshao Formation provides depositional context, not a resolved habitat preference. Its preserved aquatic body form does not measure locomotion, and a small, nearly complete holotype cannot define population-wide body size, diet or ecological role.
text.zh: 惠兴绍组提供沉积环境背景，但没有确定动物生前的栖地偏好。保存的水生体形并非运动能力测量；一件体型较小且近乎完整的正模，也不能确定全种体型、食性或生态角色。

title.en: What this evidence can establish
title.zh: 证据能说明什么

text.en: One holotype provides an unusually detailed body plan, but it cannot show the species’ population variation. Its exact position among early jawed vertebrates and its ecology remain uncertain.
text.zh: 一件正模提供了细节丰富的身体构型，但不能显示种群内变异。它在早期有颌脊椎动物中的确切位置及生态仍不确定。

title.en: The oldest complete jawed vertebrates from the early Silurian of China
title.zh: The oldest complete jawed vertebrates from the early Silurian of China

scope.en: The study describes articulated early jawed-vertebrate material; Shenacanthus is represented by one holotype.
scope.zh: 研究描述重庆地区关节相连的早期有颌脊椎动物材料；Shenacanthus 仅有一件正模。

commonNameZh: 泥盆纪镶嵌型软骨鱼干群
overview: The only known specimen, UMZC 2000.32, preserves several skull and body systems in one compressed slab. Its mixed anatomy supports a stem-chondrichthyan placement in the cited analysis, while the missing tail and single-individual sample limit broader conclusions.

ecology.diet: Undetermined
ecology.habitat: The fossil comes from the Lower Plattenkalk depositional setting; its living habitat is unresolved.
ecology.locomotion: It was an aquatic fish, but this specimen does not measure swimming performance.
ecology.bodySize: One compressed specimen preserves an incomplete body outline, so total size is not established here.
ecology.locomotionZh: 它是一种水生鱼类，但这件标本不能测量其游泳表现。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 一件压扁标本保存的身体轮廓不完整，因此这里无法确定整体大小。

traits: Mineralized and unmineralized cartilage
Mosaic neurocranial and jaw characters
Scales and teeth preserved in one slab
evidenceSummary: CT and histology document several systems in UMZC 2000.32. The fossil's compressed, incomplete outline and a matrix-dependent placement keep these findings specific to one specimen and analysis.

title.en: One compressed fossil preserves many systems
title.zh: 一件受压化石保存的多套解剖系统

text.en: UMZC 2000.32, from the Upper Givetian Lower Plattenkalk at Unterthal near Bergisch Gladbach, is the single specimen in this account. CT imaging and histology reveal parts of the neurocranium, jaws, gill skeleton and pectoral girdle, along with cartilage, scales and teeth. The combination makes the slab informative, but it remains one dorsoventrally compressed individual with its tail missing.
text.zh: 来自上吉维特阶 Lower Plattenkalk、Unterthal（贝吉施格拉德巴赫）附近的 UMZC 2000.32，是本档案唯一标本。CT 成像与组织学揭示脑颅、颌、鳃骨架和胸带的部分结构，也显示软骨、鳞片与牙齿。这种组合让石板化石具有研究价值，但它仍是一件背腹压扁、尾部缺失的个体。

title.en: What the fossil can and cannot establish
title.zh: 这件化石能说明什么？

text.en: The cited phylogenetic analysis places Gladbachus on the chondrichthyan stem, outside the crown group of living sharks and rays; that result depends on the character matrix. The fossil does not directly reveal diet, habitat preference or swimming performance, and the missing tail prevents a complete body reconstruction. Its roughly 385-million-year-old occurrence is a record for this specimen and locality, not a global first appearance for chondrichthyans.
text.zh: 所引系统发育分析将格拉德巴赫鱼置于软骨鱼干群、现生鲨和鳐的冠群之外；这一结果取决于所用性状矩阵。化石没有直接记录食性、栖息地偏好或游泳性能，尾部缺失也无法完整复原全身。约 3.85 亿年前的年代是这件标本及其地点的记录，不是软骨鱼类的全球首现。

title.en: Coates et al. (2018), Gladbachus specimen anatomy and phylogenetic analysis
title.zh: Coates 等（2018），格拉德巴赫鱼标本解剖与系统发育分析

scope.en: The single specimen UMZC 2000.32, its CT and histological description, Figures 1–4 and Supplementary Figure S1. The study supports the anatomical observations and reports a matrix-based chondrichthyan-stem placement; it does not provide a complete outline, direct ecology or a global first appearance.
scope.zh: 唯一标本 UMZC 2000.32、CT 与组织学描述、图 1–4 及补充图 S1。该研究支持解剖观察并报告基于矩阵的软骨鱼干群位置；它没有提供完整体形、直接生态记录或全球首现。

overviewZh: 唯一已知标本 UMZC 2000.32 在一块压扁的岩板上保存了多个头骨和身体系统。其混合解剖特征支持所引分析将其置于软骨鱼干群；但尾部缺失且样本仅含一个个体，限制了更广泛的结论。
evidenceSummaryZh: CT 扫描和组织学记录了 UMZC 2000.32 的若干器官系统。化石轮廓受压且不完整，其系统位置又取决于所用矩阵，因此这些发现仅适用于这一件标本和这项分析。

commonNameZh: 宽吻泥盆纪对称鳍鲨形软骨鱼
overview: Several partly articulated Famennian skeletons preserve body proportions, and specimens AA.MEM.DS.12 and PIMUZ A/I 5159 retain three-dimensional neurocrania with a broad rostrum and widely spaced nasal capsules. PIMUZ A/I 5155 contains one small actinopterygian as stomach content.

ecology.diet: One specimen records a more or less articulated actinopterygian about 40 mm long in the stomach. It documents a feeding event, not the species’ full diet.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from the marine Famennian Thylacocephalan Layer; preferred habitat in life is unresolved.
ecology.locomotion: A high-aspect-ratio tail and large pectoral fins are preserved, but swimming performance was not measured.
ecology.bodySize: Proportions of the studied specimens yield estimated in-life lengths of 0.8–2.5 m; this is a specimen-based range, not a complete genus-wide envelope.
ecology.dietZh: 一件标本的胃内保存了一条长约 40 毫米、近乎关节连接的辐鳍鱼。这记录了一次取食事件，并不代表该种的完整食谱。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自法门期海相 Thylacocephalan 层；其生前偏好的栖地尚不明确。
ecology.locomotionZh: 化石保存了高纵横比的尾部和大型胸鳍，但没有测定游泳表现。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 根据所研究标本的比例，推算其生前体长约为 0.8–2.5 米；这是标本范围估计，不是全属完整体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 生态功能群尚未确定。

traits: The snout is broad and enclosed in cartilage.
The large nasal capsules are widely separated.
The tail is high-aspect-ratio and lunate.
Strap-like pectoral-fin radials are preserved.
evidenceSummary: Specimens document articulated bodies and cranial anatomy. Published character matrices place the genus among early symmoriiforms, while alternative stem-holocephalan and stem-elasmobranch placements remain in discussion.
overviewZh: 数件法门期部分关节连接的骨架保存了身体比例；AA.MEM.DS.12 和 PIMUZ A/I 5159 还保存了三维脑颅，其吻部宽阔，鼻囊间距较大。PIMUZ A/I 5155 的胃内容物中有一条小型辐鳍鱼。
traitsZh: 吻部宽阔，外有软骨包围。
大型鼻囊彼此间隔较远。
尾部呈高纵横比的镰形。
胸鳍保存有带状辐骨。
evidenceSummaryZh: 标本直接显示了关节连接的身体和颅部解剖。已发表的特征矩阵将其置于早期对称软骨鱼类之中，但其究竟更接近全头类干群还是板鳃类干群，仍有不同解释.

commonNameZh: 具鳃盖的密西西比世对称鳍鲨形软骨鱼
overview: Cosmoselachus mehlingi is known from the partial holotype AMNH FF 20509. CT reconstruction reveals an unusual gill-cover structure formed by elongated, fused branchial rays, alongside jaws, teeth and partial fins.

ecology.diet: Undetermined; tooth arrangement is preserved but prey use is not observed
ecology.habitat: Fayetteville Shale marine depositional setting; life-habitat preference unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Partial pectoral fins are preserved; locomotor performance was not measured
ecology.bodySize: Unavailable from the partial holotype

traits: Elongate fused pharyngeal-arch rays forming an operculum
Small cladodont teeth in widely spaced families
Scalloped Meckel cartilages
Fifteen to eighteen distal fin radials
evidenceSummary: The CT reconstruction and phylogenetic analysis support a falcatid symmoriiform interpretation, but the anatomy comes from one damaged partial specimen.

title.en: A gill-cover structure reconstructed from CT
title.zh: 由 CT 重建的鳃区覆盖结构

text.en: AMNH FF 20509 preserves jaws, part of the skull base, gill supports, pectoral cartilage, fins and teeth. CT imaging shows elongated, fused branchial rays forming an operculum over the gill region.
text.zh: AMNH FF 20509 保存了颌部、部分颅底、鳃支撑结构、胸鳍软骨、鳍与牙齿。CT 成像显示，细长且融合的鳃条形成了覆盖鳃区的结构。

title.en: A shark relative known from one partial fossil
title.zh: 仅由一件不完整化石认识的鲨类近亲

text.en: A phylogenetic analysis supports placing the fossil among falcatid symmoriiforms. The sample does not reveal prey or measured swimming performance, and its damaged state limits what can be said about the whole animal.

title.en: Scales and fin supports in an early ray-finned fish
title.zh: 早期辐鳍鱼的鳞片与鳍支撑结构

text.en:
Eifelian Cheirolepis material from Scotland preserves a combination of internal and external features. The named specimens show peg-and-socket scales, an imperforate propterygium—the leading basal support of the pectoral fin—and an imperforate hyomandibular shaft in the skull’s jaw-supporting region. These details let the study compare the fish’s endoskeleton as well as its outer covering.

The fossils document an early actinopterygian anatomical combination; they do not make Cheirolepis a fixed blueprint for all later ray-finned fishes. The value of the sample lies in the specific structures preserved and the comparisons they permit, not in treating one early genus as a direct ancestor of the whole radiation.
text.zh:
苏格兰的埃菲尔期 Cheirolepis 材料同时保存了内部和外部结构。具名标本显示了嵌合式鳞片、无穿孔的前鳍基板——也就是胸鳍前缘的基部支撑结构——以及头骨中无穿孔的舌颌骨骨干；舌颌骨位于支撑颌部的区域。这些细节使研究者既能比较鱼体内骨骼，也能观察外部覆盖。

化石记录的是早期辐鳍鱼的一组解剖特征，并未把 Cheirolepis 定为所有后期辐鳍鱼的固定蓝图。样本的价值在于具体保存了哪些结构，以及这些结构允许怎样比较，而不是把一个早期属当作整个辐射演化的直系祖先。

title.en: What the type sample preserves
title.zh: 模式材料保存了什么

text.en: Holotype MB.f.18641 and paratypes MB.f.19904–19906 establish the species. The diagnosis describes a fused skull roof with a short triangular nasal region, large near-square scutes before the upper tail lobe, fewer than 18 principal tail rays and no lower-side procurrent rays. One described specimen is about 55 mm in total length and 36 mm in standard length.
text.zh: 正模 MB.f.18641 和副模 MB.f.19904–19906 构成该种的模式样本。诊断描述了融合的头盖及短三角形鼻区、尾鳍上轴叶前的大型近方形盾片、少于 18 条主要尾鳍条，以及缺少下侧前行鳍条。一件描述个体全长约 55 毫米，标准体长约 36 毫米。

overview: Barschichthys ruedersdorfensis is a lower Anisian stem teleosteomorph known from skull-roof specimens and a partial head and trunk from Rüdersdorf, around 244 Ma. The remains preserve a broad lobed skull-roof margin, cranial ornament, ganoid scales and a long lower jaw with small conical teeth. A partial trunk is about 50 mm standard length; the diagnosis estimates about 80 mm total length.
overviewZh: Barschichthys ruedersdorfensis 是安尼期早期的真骨鱼形类干群鱼，依据约 244 Ma 的 Rüdersdorf（吕德斯多夫）头骨顶材料及一件不完整头部和躯干标本建立。化石保存宽阔的叶状头顶前缘、头骨饰纹、硬鳞和带小圆锥齿的长下颌。部分躯干标本标准体长约 50 毫米；物种诊断给出的全长约 80 毫米。

evidenceSummary: The type and referred skull roofs document a fused, ornamented skull with a diagnostic feature combination. The taxon remains Teleosteomorpha incertae sedis, an uncertain placement within that broader fish lineage; ecology and global range are not established.

title.en: A skull roof supplies the diagnosis
title.zh: 诊断依据来自头顶骨盖

text.en: The holotype MB.f.19910 and paratypes MB.f.14888 and MB.f.19911 are skull roofs, not complete fish skeletons. Their fused roof has an orbital region nearly as long as the postorbital region, a short nasal area and middle pitline, and distinctive surface ornament. These features form a combination used to recognize Ruedersdorfia berlinensis; they do not reveal its full body shape, diet or swimming style.
text.zh: 正模 MB.f.19910 与副模 MB.f.14888、MB.f.19911 都是头顶骨盖，并非完整鱼类骨架。融合的骨盖具有近乎等长的眼眶区与眼后区、较短的鼻区和中部感觉沟，以及独特表面纹饰。这组特征用于识别 Ruedersdorfia berlinensis，却不能揭示全身轮廓、食性或游泳方式。

title.en: The fossils have a place and an uncertain branch
title.zh: 化石有产地，支系位置仍不确定

text.en: The skull roofs come from the Rüdersdorf mine in Germany’s Central European Basin and are placed in the Lower Anisian, at about 244 Ma in the cited study. The authors place the fish within Teleosteomorpha but leave its more exact position uncertain. This local sample neither defines a global range nor establishes an early member as an ancestor of later teleosts.
text.zh: 这些头骨材料来自德国鲁德斯多夫矿区，属于中欧盆地，论文将其置于安尼期早段、约 244 Ma。作者把该鱼归入真骨形类，但更精确的位置尚不确定。这一处地方材料既不能划定全球分布，也不能证明较早的成员是后世真骨鱼的祖先。

overviewZh: Ruedersdorfia berlinensis 由三件带饰纹的头顶骨标本代表，产自鲁德斯多夫下安尼期的穆舍尔卡克灰岩。化石支持其头骨具有独特形态，但没有保存可用于重建整条鱼身体轮廓的材料。
evidenceSummaryZh: 正模和归入标本的头顶骨片记录了融合、具纹饰的头骨及一组诊断性特征。该分类单元仍被列为 Teleosteomorpha incertae sedis，即在这一较大的鱼类支系中的系统位置尚不确定；其生态和全球分布范围也未确定。

overview: Frasnian Tiktaalik roseae is documented by NUFV 108 and other Fram Formation material from southern Ellesmere Island. Its preserved body combines scales and fin rays with a mobile neck, robust ribs and wrist-like joints within a pectoral fin. The combination informs comparisons of fins and limbs; it does not identify a direct ancestor.
overviewZh: Frasnian 期的 Tiktaalik roseae 由加拿大努纳武特埃尔斯米尔岛南部 Fram 组的 NUFV 108 等材料记录。化石显示鳞片与鳍条、可活动颈部、粗壮肋骨，以及仍带鳍条的胸鳍内腕状关节并存。这种组合有助于比较鱼鳍与四肢的演化，但不能据此认定它是后世动物的直接祖先。

scope.zh: 用于本文选取的解剖、关系或时间估计材料，不由此推断完整物种史或分布。

title.en: A fin with a distinctive combination
title.zh: 具有独特组合的胸鳍

text.zh: 具名标本既保留鳞片和鳍条，也显示腕状关节、可活动的颈部与粗壮肋骨。这些结构共同出现在一具身体上，使研究者能够比较早期四足形类的解剖组合。
text.en: The named specimens retain scales and fin rays while also preserving wrist-like joints, a mobile neck and robust ribs. These structures occur together in one body, letting researchers compare anatomical combinations across early tetrapodomorphs.

title.zh: 从保存的骨骼推测运动
title.en: From preserved bones to movement

text.zh: 关节或肋骨形态可以约束可能的运动方式，却不会直接记录日常行为。胸鳍是否承重、是否经常在陆地上行走，仍是解释而非直接观察。
text.en: A joint or rib constrains what movements may have been possible, but it does not record a daily action. Load-bearing use of the fin and routine walking on land remain interpretations rather than direct observations.

title.zh: 标本样本有明确的地理边界
title.en: The sample has a geographic boundary

text.zh: 这里讨论的材料来自埃尔斯米尔岛南部的 Fram 组。这组具名化石支持一个局部产出记录，但并未描绘 Tiktaalik 的完整分布范围。
text.en: The material discussed here comes from the Fram Formation on southern Ellesmere Island. That named fossil sample supports a local occurrence; it does not map the full range of Tiktaalik.

title.zh: 解剖亲缘不等于祖先关系
title.en: Anatomical affinity is not ancestry

text.zh: 研究中的性状组合为系统发育比较提供信息，但不能证明 Tiktaalik 是后期四足动物的直接祖先。
text.en: The studied character combination informs a phylogenetic comparison. It does not make Tiktaalik a demonstrated direct ancestor of later tetrapods.

readerLimitations.en: The shallow-water setting, predatory role and possible load-bearing function are interpretations tied to the specimens and depositional context. Fossils preserve anatomy, not habitual land walking or a complete range.
readerLimitations.zh: 浅水环境、捕食者身份和可能的承重功能，都是结合标本与沉积背景作出的解释。化石保存的是解剖结构，不能直接证明经常在陆地行走，也不能给出完整分布范围。

evidenceSummaryZh: 具名的 Fram 组标本和原始描述支持这一解剖特征组合。所取样的化石记录不代表该属的全球分布范围；研究也未主张直接祖先关系或习惯性陆地行走。
traitsZh: 胸鳍附肢上仍保存鳞片和鳍条。
同一身体上兼有可活动的颈部和粗壮的肋骨。
胸鳍具有类似腕部的关节。

ecology.diet: Unavailable from the cited pectoral-fin study

ecology.locomotion: Fin propulsion; load-bearing or digit-assisted use remains an inference

traits: Four proximodistal radial rows in the pectoral fin
Branched carpals and distal elements interpreted as digits or putative digits
Lepidotrichia retained, confirming the appendage remained a fin
evidenceSummary: Specimen MHNM 06-2067 and its CT reconstruction document the fin’s internal structure. Digit homology and the animal’s position among close relatives depend on anatomical interpretation and phylogenetic analysis; this profile does not identify Elpistostege as a direct tetrapod ancestor.

title.en: Research overview
title.zh: 研究概述

text.en: An exceptionally complete Miguasha fossil of Elpistostege preserves a pectoral fin with both fin rays and a complex internal skeleton. Some distal bones have been interpreted as digits or digit-like elements, but the appendage remained a fin.
text.zh: Miguasha 一件保存极完整的 Elpistostege 化石显示，胸鳍同时保留鳍条和复杂的内部骨骼。远端一些骨骼被解释为趾或类似趾的结构，但这个附肢仍然是鳍。

title.en: Bones inside a fin
title.zh: 鳍内的骨骼

text.en:
The pectoral fin of articulated specimen MHNM 06-2067 contains four rows of radial bones arranged from the proximal end toward the tip. Its carpals, or wrist bones, branch in a complex pattern, and bones nearer the fin tip have been interpreted as digits or possible digits.

Fin rays, or lepidotrichia, remain present in the appendage, confirming that this is still a fin.
text.zh:
胸鳍内部骨骼有四列沿近端至远端排列的辐状骨。

腕骨分支复杂，远端骨骼被解释为趾或可能的趾。

仍保留鳍条，即 lepidotrichia，确认该附肢仍是鳍。

title.en: A fin, its setting and movement limits
title.zh: 鳍、沉积背景与运动推断边界

text.en: Miguasha’s aquatic depositional setting frames this fossil. The fin is described as a propulsive appendage, while load-bearing or digit-assisted use remains an inference; the large-bodied description does not define a genus-wide size range.
text.zh: 化石来自 Miguasha 的水生沉积环境。胸鳍被解释为推进附肢，而承重或借助趾状结构活动仍属推断；“体型较大”的描述不代表全属体型范围。

title.en: What this evidence can establish
title.zh: 证据能说明什么

text.en: Specimen MHNM 06-2067 and its CT reconstruction document the fin’s internal structure. Digit homology and the animal’s position among close relatives depend on anatomical interpretation and phylogenetic analysis; this profile does not identify Elpistostege as a direct tetrapod ancestor.
text.zh: 标本 MHNM 06-2067 及其 CT 重建记录了胸鳍内部结构。趾的同源判断和 Elpistostege 在近缘类群中的位置取决于解剖解释与系统发育分析；本档案不把它称为四足动物的直接祖先。

title.en: Elpistostege and the origin of the vertebrate hand
title.zh: Elpistostege and the origin of the vertebrate hand

scope.en: CT and anatomical analysis document an Elpistostege fin with fin rays; digit homology and placement depend on interpretation and analysis.
scope.zh: CT 与解剖分析记录 Elpistostege 胸鳍及其鳍条；趾的同源判断和系统位置取决于解释与分析。

regionalRanges.label: East Greenland Famennian limb sample
regionalRanges.basis: The described East Greenland limb specimens provide a bounded occurrence context.

overview: A Devonian tetrapod represented by East Greenland limb material that documents an eight-digit forelimb and preserves the distinction between digit-bearing limbs and evidence for terrestrial walking.

ecology.diet: Unavailable from the cited limb study
ecology.habitat: Aquatic or marginal-water setting inferred from the study context; preference unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Digit-bearing limb; terrestrial walking is not inferred from digit count alone
ecology.bodySize: Small to medium-sized early tetrapod; a study-wide mass estimate is not provided here

traits: Eight digits documented in the forelimb
Limb anatomy retains a non-pentadactyl Devonian condition
Digit-bearing limbs do not by themselves demonstrate habitual terrestrial walking
evidenceSummary: The described East Greenland limb specimens directly support eight-digit anatomy; ecological and locomotor implications remain bounded, and the profile does not infer a universal ancestral digit number or direct ancestry.

title.en: Eight digits, without a walking trace
title.zh: 八个指趾，并不等于陆地行走

text.en:
The East Greenland limb specimens described for Acanthostega preserve an eight-digit forelimb. That count differs from the five-digit pattern familiar in living tetrapods and shows that digit number varied during Devonian limb evolution. The evidence here is the anatomy of described limb material, compared with other Devonian forms.

A hand with eight digits does not record how often the animal moved on land. The cited study does not directly establish diet, habitat preference or observed gait, so the profile keeps those ecological questions open rather than converting limb anatomy into a lifestyle claim.
text.zh:
Acanthostega 在东格陵兰出土的已描述肢体材料保存了一只八指前肢。这个数量不同于现生四足动物常见的五指模式，显示泥盆纪肢体演化期间指趾数并不固定。这里的证据是所描述肢体的解剖结构及其与其他泥盆纪类群的比较。

八指的手并没有记录这种动物多常在陆地上活动。所引研究没有直接确定食性、生境偏好或实际步态，因此本档案保留这些生态问题，不把肢体结构直接转换成生活方式结论。
