overview: Ichthyostega is a Devonian tetrapod whose reconstructed limb joints let researchers test how much rotation the limbs could achieve. One study compared that model with the mechanics of a typical lateral-sequence walk; the result concerns possible joint motion, not observed behavior.
overviewZh: 泥盆纪四足动物 Ichthyostega 的肢体关节经三维重建后，研究者可以测试肢体可能达到的转动范围，并与典型侧序步态的力学要求比较。结果说明的是重建骨骼在模型中允许怎样的关节运动，不是化石直接记录了动物如何行走。

ecology.diet: The cited joint-mobility study does not establish diet.
ecology.habitat: East Greenland fossils come from an aquatic or marginal-water setting. The animal’s preferred habitat remains uncertain.
ecology.locomotion: In the tested reconstruction, the limbs have restricted long-axis rotation. This is a model result, not a direct record of walking.
ecology.bodySize: Ichthyostega was a large-bodied early tetrapod; the cited study does not establish a broader body-size range.
ecology.guild: Its ecological role is unresolved by this locomotion study.
ecology.dietZh: 所引关节活动度研究不能确定食性。
ecology.locomotionZh: 在所测试的重建模型中，肢体沿长轴旋转的幅度受限。这是模型结果，并非直接记录的行走行为。
ecology.bodySizeZh: Ichthyostega 是一种体型较大的早期四足动物；所引研究没有确定更广泛的体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 这项运动研究未能确定其生态角色。

traits: Three-dimensional reconstruction of limb joints
A typical lateral-sequence walk in the tested model required no long-axis limb rotation
The mobility result may be specific to Ichthyostega, not all early tetrapods
evidenceSummary: Micro-CT reconstruction and comparison with five living analogues constrain which joint movements are mechanically feasible. The result depends on the reconstruction and does not turn feasible motion into observed behavior.
evidenceSummaryZh: 微型 CT 关节重建与五种现生类比动物的比较，限制了哪些关节运动在力学上可行。结果取决于骨骼重建和比较方式；可行运动不等于实际行为记录。

title.en: How far can a joint model take us?
title.zh: 关节模型能将推断推进到什么程度？

text.en: Ichthyostega is a Devonian tetrapod whose reconstructed limb joints let researchers test how much rotation the limbs could achieve. One study compared that model with the mechanics of a typical lateral-sequence walk; the result concerns possible joint motion, not observed behavior.
text.zh: 泥盆纪四足动物 Ichthyostega 的肢体关节经三维重建后，研究者可以测试肢体可能达到的转动范围，并与典型侧序步态的力学要求比较。结果说明的是重建骨骼在模型中允许怎样的关节运动，不是化石直接记录了动物如何行走。

title.en: A feasible gait is not an observed gait
title.zh: 模型可行的步态不等于观察到的步态

text.en: Micro-CT joint reconstructions were compared with five living analogues. In the tested model, a typical lateral-sequence walk required no long-axis limb rotation; that result describes what the reconstruction permits, not how the fossil animal was seen to walk.
text.zh: 研究将微型 CT 重建的关节与五种现生类比动物进行比较。在所测试的模型中，典型的侧序步行无需肢体沿长轴旋转；这说明重建模型允许这种运动，并非观察到化石动物实际如此行走。

title.en: The model is tied to East Greenland material
title.zh: 模型依据东格陵兰材料

text.en: The analysed Ichthyostega specimens come from Famennian Upper Devonian deposits of East Greenland. This is the study's sample context, not a complete geographic or habitat range.
text.zh: 分析的 Ichthyostega 标本来自东格陵兰法门期晚泥盆世沉积层。这是该研究的取样背景，不代表完整地理分布或栖息地范围。

title.en: Three-dimensional limb joint mobility in the early tetrapod Ichthyostega
title.zh: Three-dimensional limb joint mobility in the early tetrapod Ichthyostega

scope.en: Pierce et al. (2012), pp. 523?526, Figures 1?3 and Supplementary Figures 1?6: East Greenland specimen context, micro-CT joint reconstruction, five living analogues and modeled gait results.

readerLimitations.en: The specimens come from Famennian East Greenland deposits described as aquatic or marginal-water; that setting does not establish preferred habitat. Ichthyostega is a large-bodied early tetrapod, but this study does not establish a broader body-size range, diet, observed locomotion or a general rule for all early tetrapods. Its modeled motion result may be specific to Ichthyostega.
readerLimitations.zh: 这些标本来自东格陵兰法门期沉积层，相关环境被描述为水生或近水环境；这一背景不能证明其偏好的栖息地。Ichthyostega 是体型较大的早期四足动物，但本研究没有确定更广泛的体型范围、食性、直接观察到的运动方式，也没有提出适用于所有早期四足动物的一般规则。模型中的运动结果可能仅适用于 Ichthyostega。

traitsZh: 肢体关节的三维重建。
在所测试的模型中，典型的侧序步态无需肢体绕身体长轴旋转。
这一运动能力结果可能仅适用于 Ichthyostega，而非所有早期四足动物。

overview: The only known specimen, articulated holotype USNM 489135, combines frog-like and salamander-like features. The original character analysis placed it on the batrachian stem, outside crown Batrachia; that is a matrix result, not a direct-ancestor claim.

ecology.diet: The anatomy permits functional discussion, but the specimen does not preserve a directly observed diet or prey choice.
ecology.habitat: The holotype comes from the Clear Fork Group in Baylor County, Texas. The cited study does not establish a preferred habitat or detailed niche.
ecology.locomotion: The articulated skeleton does not measure terrestrial or semiaquatic performance.
ecology.bodySize: The holotype is described as a small articulated tetrapod; no species-wide size estimate follows from this sole specimen.
ecology.guild: The study does not establish a predator guild from direct feeding evidence.
ecology.dietZh: 其解剖结构可用于功能讨论，但标本没有保存直接观察到的食性或猎物选择。
ecology.locomotionZh: 关节相连的骨骼不能测量其陆地或半水生运动表现。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 正模被描述为一只小型、骨骼相连的四足动物；仅凭这一件标本不能推定物种整体的体型。
ecology.guildZh: 该研究没有依据直接摄食证据确定其所属的捕食者生态类群。

traits: Frog-like and salamander-like cranial mosaic
Articulated postcranium
Batrachian-like character combination
evidenceSummary: USNM 489135 is a single specimen from the Kungurian Clear Fork Group. The displayed 283.3–274.4 Ma interval bounds that occurrence, not the global first appearance of batrachians or lissamphibians. The stem placement depends on the original character analysis and does not settle lissamphibian origins.

title.en: Frog-like and salamander-like features
title.zh: 蛙类与蝾螈类特征并存

text.en: The articulated holotype USNM 489135 is the sole known specimen of Gerobatrachus hottoni. Its preserved skeleton combines features compared with frogs and salamanders. The study describes a small tetrapod, but the fossil does not directly record diet, prey choice, habitat preference, or locomotor performance.
text.zh: 关节连接的正模 USNM 489135 是目前唯一已知标本。其骨架同时具有曾与蛙类和蝾螈类比较的特征。论文将它描述为小型四足动物，但化石没有直接记录食性、猎物选择、栖息偏好或运动性能。

title.en: A matrix placement, not ancestry
title.zh: 矩阵位置不等于祖先关系

text.en: The original character analysis recovered Gerobatrachus as a stem batrachian: a fossil branch outside crown Batrachia, the living frog-and-salamander group. Its specimen comes from the Clear Fork Group at a named locality in Baylor County, Texas. The 283.3–274.4 Ma Kungurian envelope applies to this occurrence only; one fossil does not establish a global first appearance or direct ancestry.
text.zh: 原始性状分析将 Gerobatrachus 恢复为蛙螈干群成员：位于现生蛙类与蝾螈类冠群之外的化石支系。标本来自得克萨斯州贝勒县的 Clear Fork 群。283.3–274.4 Ma 的空谷期包络只适用于这件标本；单一化石不能确立全球首现或直系祖先关系。

title.en: A stem batrachian from the Early Permian of Texas and the origin of frogs and salamanders
title.zh: A stem batrachian from the Early Permian of Texas and the origin of frogs and salamanders

scope.zh: 读者段落的原始定位：supports; pages: 515–518; figure: Figures 1–4; quoteLocator: Systematic palaeontology; locality; anatomical description and phylogenetic analysis

overview: Only one specimen is known: split-nodule holotype MNHN.F.MAE.126 from Sakamena-equivalent beds near Betsiaka, Madagascar. Micro-CT imaging revealed 15 vertebrae before the sacrum, a retained tail and possible mentomeckelian elements. The cited analysis treats *Triadobatrachus* as a stem salientian—near frogs but outside the crown group of living frogs (Anura). The broad 251.902–247 Ma interval is an Early Triassic envelope for the specimen's locality, not a direct date on the fossil or a crown-frog first appearance. The skeleton does not establish diet or habitat preference, and does not support specialized frog-like jumping.
overviewZh: 目前只知一件标本：来自马达加斯加 Betsiaka 附近 Sakamena 相当地层的正模 MNHN.F.MAE.126，以劈开结核的正模和反模保存。微型 CT 显示了 15 枚荐前椎、保留的尾椎，以及可能的颏麦氏骨构件。所引分析将 *Triadobatrachus* 视为无尾类干群成员——接近蛙类，但位于现生蛙类（Anura）冠群之外。251.902–247 Ma 是标本产地的宽泛早三叠世时间包络，并非化石的直接定年或冠群蛙类首现。骨架不能确定食性或栖地偏好，也不支持特化的蛙式跳跃。

ecology.diet: The skeleton does not establish its diet.
ecology.habitat: Found in Sakamena-equivalent deposits; preferred habitat is not established.
ecology.locomotion: The long trunk and retained tail do not support specialized frog-like jumping.
ecology.bodySize: The unique holotype is preserved as matching part and counterpart; a whole-body size estimate is not established here.
ecology.guild: Ecological role is not established by this skeleton.
ecology.dietZh: 该骨骼不能确定其食性。
ecology.locomotionZh: 长躯干和保留的尾部不支持其具有特化的类蛙跳跃能力。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 唯一的正模以对应的正模面和负模面形式保存；此处没有确定整个身体的体型估计。
ecology.guildZh: 该骨骼不能确定其生态作用。

traits: Fifteen vertebrae before the sacrum
Retained caudal vertebrae
Possible mentomeckelian jaw elements
evidenceSummary: MNHN.F.MAE.126 is the only specimen and provides the anatomy seen in micro-CT. The 251.902–247 Ma range is a broad locality-level window; provenance is historical, and ecology and jumping behaviour are not directly preserved.
evidenceSummaryZh: MNHN.F.MAE.126 是唯一已知标本，微型 CT 揭示了其中的解剖结构。251.902–247 Ma 是地点尺度的宽泛年代区间；产地记录较早，生态与跳跃行为也未由化石直接保存。
traitsZh: 骶骨前有十五节椎骨。
尾椎仍然保留。
可能存在颏骨内侧软骨骨化成分。

overview: Beiyanerpeton is represented by one holotype and five referred articulated skeletons from the Tiaojishan Formation. The series supports salamandroid placement and includes larval structures that the authors used to discuss development.

ecology.diet: Undetermined
ecology.habitat: Tiaojishan Formation depositional setting; niche unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Aquatic or semiaquatic inference remains specimen-dependent
ecology.bodySize: Small articulated salamanders

traits: Salamandroid character combination
Articulated skeletons
Larval structures in referred material
evidenceSummary: The six specimens come from Hengdaozi in western Liaoning. Their Oxfordian age is bounded at about 160–154 Ma; a 157 ± 3 Ma zircon date comes from overlying rock, not a skeleton. Placement and neoteny remain analysis-dependent interpretations.

title.en: Articulated skeletons preserve a developmental clue
title.zh: 相连骨架保留了发育线索

text.en: The holotype PKUP V0601 and referred specimens PKUP V0602–V0606 preserve articulated salamandroid anatomy, including structures interpreted as larval. The authors discuss these features as possible neoteny, the retention of juvenile traits into a later life stage. That interpretation is not a direct record of age or reproduction, and the specimens do not supply a complete growth series.
text.zh: 正模 PKUP V0601 与归入标本 PKUP V0602–V0606 保存了相连的有尾类骨架，其中包括被解释为幼体特征的结构。作者据此讨论可能的幼态持续，即较晚生命阶段仍保留幼体性状。这一解释不是对年龄或繁殖状态的直接记录，现有标本也没有构成完整成长序列。

title.en: The rock dates the sample, not a skeleton
title.zh: 岩层给样本定界，不是给骨骼直接测年

text.en: The specimens come from Hengdaozi in western Liaoning, China, in the Tiaojishan Formation. The profile uses an Oxfordian sample interval of about 160–154 Ma. The reported zircon age of 157 ± 3 Ma is from rock above the fossil-bearing horizon, not from the skeleton itself. The published character matrix places Beiyanerpeton within Salamandroidea, but that result depends on the study’s sampled taxa and characters.
text.zh: 这些标本来自中国辽宁西部横道子地区的髫髻山组。本页采用约 160–154 Ma 的牛津期样本区间。论文报告的 157 ± 3 Ma 锆石年龄来自含化石层位上方的岩石，并非直接测自骨骼。已发表的特征矩阵将 Beiyanerpeton 置于有尾目中的蝾螈总科，但这一结果取决于该研究纳入的类群与性状。

overview: At one Norian bonebed, three-dimensional jaws and vertebrae of Funcusvermis gilmorei represent at least 76 individuals, though the bones are isolated rather than joined into skeletons. Their jaw characters place the fossil on the caecilian total-group line; a separate analysis links living amphibian origins to dissorophoids. These are distinct results: the bonebed does not date crown Gymnophiona, and one origin model does not settle every account of lissamphibian relationships.
overviewZh: 诺利期一处骨层中的三维下颌和椎骨来自至少 76 个 Funcusvermis gilmorei 个体，但骨骼彼此散离，没有组成完整骨架。下颌性状将这件化石放在蚓螈总群演化线上；另一项分析则把现生两栖类起源与离片椎类联系起来。这是两个不同层次的结果：骨层不能给蚓螈冠群定年，一种起源模型也不能解决所有现生两栖类亲缘假说。

ecology.diet: Small-prey feeding is inferred from anatomy; no feeding event is preserved.
ecology.habitat: The bonebed records a depositional setting, not a burrow; burrowing and niche remain hypotheses.
ecology.locomotion: Disarticulated jaws and vertebrae do not establish a locomotor mode.
ecology.bodySize: Isolated elements represent small-bodied individuals, without complete body measurements.
ecology.guild: The sample has been interpreted as a small predator, but its ecological role remains unresolved.
ecology.habitatZh: 骨床记录的是沉积环境，并非洞穴；穴居习性和生态位仍是假说。
ecology.locomotionZh: 分散的颌骨与椎骨不足以确定运动方式。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 孤立骨骼部件代表体型较小的个体，但缺乏完整的身体测量数据。
ecology.guildZh: 这批样本被解释为一种小型捕食者，但其生态作用仍未确定。

traits: Jaw characters support placement on the caecilian total-group line
Three-dimensional preservation of isolated jaws and vertebrae
The separate origin analysis uses a dissorophoid-like cranial character combination
evidenceSummary: The U–Pb-bracketed locality and disarticulated fossils document a caecilian total-group occurrence; one phylogenetic analysis separately favors a dissorophoid origin for living amphibians. Neither the fossil nor that model dates crown Gymnophiona or resolves all lissamphibian-origin hypotheses.
evidenceSummaryZh: 经 U–Pb 定年限定的地点和散离化石记录了蚓螈总群；一项系统发育分析则另行支持现生两栖类起源于离片椎类。无论化石还是该模型，都不能给蚓螈冠群定年，也不能在所有现生两栖类起源假说中作出定论。

readerLimitations.en: The jaws and vertebrae come from one bonebed as isolated elements, so they do not preserve a complete skeleton or locomotor sequence. Feeding and burrowing remain anatomical interpretations, and one living-amphibian origin model does not date crown Gymnophiona or resolve every lissamphibian hypothesis.
readerLimitations.zh: 下颌和椎骨来自一处骨床，彼此散离，未保存完整骨架或运动序列。摄食与掘穴仍是依据解剖作出的推断；一种现生两栖类起源模型既不能给蚓螈冠群定年，也不能解决所有现生两栖类亲缘假说。

traitsZh: 颌部特征支持将其置于蚓螈总群演化支上。
孤立颌骨和椎骨的三维保存。
另项起源分析使用了类似离片椎类的颅骨特征组合。

geography: Tiaojishan Formation, western Liaoning, China (Beiyanerpeton sample)
Living salamander lineages sampled by Shen et al.
overview: Two kinds of evidence anchor this profile. Shen et al. used 102 nuclear markers to test relationships among sampled living salamanders; Gao and Shubin described articulated Jurassic skeletons of Beiyanerpeton from Liaoning. Together they illuminate parts of salamander history, not a complete tree or ancestor sequence.
overviewZh:
这份有尾目档案由两类证据构成。Shen 等人用 102 个核标记检验所抽样现生蝾螈之间的高阶关系；Gao 与 Shubin 则描述了来自辽宁的侏罗纪北燕螈关节连接标本。两项研究分别呈现系统发育与化石解剖的一部分，不能拼成完整的蝾螈演化树或祖先序列。

北燕螈的标本系列包括六件头颅及躯后骨骼保存良好的标本，并记录了颊部附近的骨质鳃结构。其所在上覆火山岩单元的锆石年龄为 1.57±0.03 亿年；这是地层约束，并非直接测得骨骼年龄。所引研究未确定食性、运动表现、全目体型范围或统一生态功能群。

ecology.diet: The cited marker and fossil studies do not establish what these salamanders ate.
ecology.habitat: The Tiaojishan Formation provides the geological setting for Beiyanerpeton, while the molecular study samples living lineages. These are research contexts, not a full map of salamander habitats.
ecology.locomotion: The fossil paper describes bones, but the cited studies do not measure how salamanders moved.
ecology.bodySize: These studies do not provide a complete comparative body-size dataset for Caudata.
ecology.guild: The cited evidence is not enough to assign a single ecological guild to the order.
ecology.dietZh: 所引分子标记和化石研究没有确定这些蝾螈吃什么。
ecology.locomotionZh: 化石论文描述了骨骼，但所引研究没有测量蝾螈如何移动。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 这些研究没有提供适用于整个有尾目、完整且可比较的体型数据集。
ecology.guildZh: 所引证据不足以为该目指定单一的生态功能类群。

traits: Shen et al. tested higher-level relationships with 102 nuclear markers and the living salamander taxa sampled in that study.
The Beiyanerpeton sample includes articulated skulls and skeletons behind the skull, preserving anatomy in place.
Gao and Shubin describe bony gill structures near the cheek in the Beiyanerpeton specimens.
evidenceSummary: The marker analysis tests relationships among its sampled living salamanders; the fossil account describes six Beiyanerpeton specimens from western Liaoning. Their overlying volcanic unit is dated to 157 ± 3 million years ago, a geological constraint rather than a direct date on the skeletons. Neither line of evidence establishes the full Caudata range, ecology or ancestry.
evidenceSummaryZh: 102 个核标记分析检验的是被抽样现生有尾类的关系；北燕螈则提供了来自中国辽西的六件侏罗纪标本。地层年代不能作为有尾目的全球首现时间，这些有限样本也不代表全目的分布、生态或直系祖先关系。
traitsZh: Shen 等人利用 102 个核标记和该研究取样的现生蝾螈类群，检验较高阶元之间的关系。
Beiyanerpeton 样本包括关节相连的头骨和头骨之后的骨骼，解剖结构以原位状态保存。
Gao 和 Shubin 描述了 Beiyanerpeton 标本颊部附近的骨质鳃结构。

geography: Archer City, Mount Barry, Briar Creek, Rattlesnake Canyon and Craddock bonebed
Texas and New Mexico, United States
overview: Named Dimetrodon and cf. Dimetrodon teeth preserve differences in tooth edges and cusps. A separate character-matrix study compares sphenacodontid relationships; neither the isolated teeth nor the sampled tree identifies a direct mammalian ancestor.

ecology.diet: Predatory feeding inferred from sphenacodontid tooth anatomy; individual prey is not preserved
ecology.habitat: Fully terrestrial apex-predator interpretation for the sampled sphenacodontids; habitat breadth is unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Not measured by the dental sample
ecology.bodySize: The profile does not infer a genus-wide mass or body-length range
ecology.guild: Terrestrial predator inference bounded to the source's sampled ecological interpretation
ecology.dietZh: 所取样的楔齿龙类牙齿支持研究中的捕食性解释。这些标本没有保存可识别的猎物。
ecology.habitatZh: 所引样本来自得克萨斯州和新墨西哥州的早二叠世产地。它不能说明该属完整的栖地范围。
ecology.locomotionZh: 牙齿研究没有测量其运动方式或运动表现。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 这份牙齿档案没有推算该属整体的体重或体长范围。
ecology.guildZh: 陆生顶级捕食者是研究对所取样楔齿龙类的解释，并非直接观察到的摄食行为，也不是该属完整的生态功能群判定。

traits: MCZ 2779 snout with enlarged anterior maxillary tooth
MCZ 2028 and UMMP 9722 dentary teeth with lingual cusp variation
Carina and denticle character changes optimized in the sampled phylogeny
evidenceSummary: The study sample comes from Texas and New Mexico and spans 290.1–273 Ma. Predatory feeding and repeated dental-character change are interpretations of the sampled material, not records of particular prey or the genus's complete history.

title.en: Named teeth show differences in edges and cusps
title.zh: 具名牙齿显示齿缘与齿尖差异

text.en: Brink and Reisz describe skull and tooth material from named Dimetrodon species and cf. Dimetrodon, including an enlarged anterior maxillary tooth and variation in lingual cusps. Their matrix compares carinae, the sharp tooth edges, and denticles, the small serrations. Tooth form supports a predatory interpretation, but no prey is preserved with these specimens.
text.zh: Brink 和 Reisz 描述了具名 Dimetrodon 物种及 cf. Dimetrodon 的头骨和牙齿材料，包括增大的前部上颌牙与舌侧齿尖差异。矩阵比较齿刃（牙齿的锐利边缘）和小锯齿。牙齿形态支持捕食性解释，但这些标本没有保存猎物。

title.en: A character matrix tests sampled relationships
title.zh: 特征矩阵检验取样类群之间的关系

text.en: The sampled matrix places the included Dimetrodon species within Sphenacodontidae and optimizes repeated dental-character changes. It tests relationships among included forms, not direct mammalian ancestry. The 290.1–273 Ma interval is the Early Permian Texas and New Mexico sample window, not a complete global genus range.
text.zh: 取样矩阵将纳入的 Dimetrodon 物种置于楔齿龙科，并优化牙齿性状的反复变化。它检验的是纳入类群之间的关系，不是哺乳动物的直系祖先关系。290.1–273 Ma 是得克萨斯州和新墨西哥州样本的早二叠世时间窗口，并非该属完整的全球分布年代。

overviewZh: 具名 Dimetrodon 和 cf. Dimetrodon 牙齿显示齿缘与齿尖存在差异。另一项特征矩阵研究比较楔齿龙类的亲缘关系；孤立牙齿和取样树都不能确定哺乳动物的直系祖先。
evidenceSummaryZh: 研究样本来自得克萨斯州和新墨西哥州，年代跨度为 290.1–273 Ma。捕食性摄食和牙齿性状的反复变化是对样本的解释，并非具体猎物记录或该属的完整历史。
traitsZh: 所描述的 MCZ 2779 吻部保存了一枚增大的前部上颌牙。这项观察只适用于该标本。
MCZ 2028 和 UMMP 9722 保存的齿骨牙齿显示舌侧齿尖形态有差异；这不能用于诊断每个 Dimetrodon 物种或个体。
取样系统树对齿刃和小锯齿的变化进行优化。这一矩阵结果描述纳入分析的类群，不是祖先序列。

commonNameZh: 达善沟基干兽孔类标本
overview: IVPP V15424 is a partial snout, not a complete skeleton; its 71-character matrix placement is sample-dependent, and the cited account reports no reliable direct formation date.
overviewZh: 这里的早期兽孔类记录是一段吻部，而非完整骨架。正模 IVPP V15424 来自中二叠世大山口地点，吻部长约 100 mm。一项已发表分析编码 71 个解剖性状，并在该矩阵中将 *Raranimus dashankouensis* 放在兽孔类基部附近。犬齿组合和其他头部性状可用于检验这一矩阵位置，但化石不是已证实的祖先；所引研究指出大山口组缺少可靠的直接放射性定年。

ecology.diet: Carnivory is inferred from the snout’s cranial and dental morphology.
ecology.habitat: The Xidagou Formation provides a continental depositional context; the animal’s exact habitat is unresolved.
ecology.locomotion: The partial snout does not preserve evidence of locomotion.
ecology.bodySize: The only described holotype is an approximately 100 mm snout fragment; this is not a body-length estimate.
ecology.guild: The dentition has been interpreted as that of a small terrestrial predator; this remains an inference.
ecology.dietZh: 食肉性是根据吻部的头骨与牙齿形态推断的。
ecology.habitatZh: 西大沟组提供了大陆沉积环境背景；该动物的确切生境仍未确定。
ecology.locomotionZh: 部分吻部没有保存可用于判断运动方式的证据。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 唯一描述过的正模是一段约 100 毫米长的吻部碎片；这不是体长估计。
ecology.guildZh: 其齿列被解释为属于小型陆生捕食者；这仍是推断。

traits: Partial snout combining cranial and dental characters used in the diagnosis
The diagnosis discusses a double-canine condition
The matrix places Raranimus near the base of sampled Therapsida
evidenceSummary: The 71-character matrix tests placement from a partial snout; the cited account reports no reliable direct Dashankou date, and the result does not establish ancestry.
evidenceSummaryZh: 具名正模和 71 性状矩阵为检验早期兽孔类亲缘关系提供材料，但结果受这段不完整吻部及其编码方式限制。所引研究没有给大山口组提供可靠的直接放射性定年；矩阵位置与吻部残片都不证明祖先关系。

readerLimitations.en: The placement comes from a 71-character analysis of a partial snout; the cited account reports no reliable direct radiometric date for the Dashankou sequence. The matrix position and broad stage-based display do not demonstrate direct ancestry or a precise lineage duration.
readerLimitations.zh: 其位置来自对一段吻部残片编码的 71 项性状分析；所引记述没有给大山口层序提供可靠的直接放射性定年。矩阵中的位置和按阶估算的宽泛展示范围，都不能证明直系祖先关系或精确谱系延续时间。

traitsZh: 部分吻部材料结合了用于鉴定的颅骨和牙齿特征。
鉴别描述讨论了双犬齿状态。
在所取样的兽孔类中，矩阵分析将 Raranimus 置于接近基部的位置。

overview: CT data from the named jaws MCZ7/95A–B and MCZ10/G95 show tooth-bearing dentaries, a trough behind the dentary, and rows of teeth with wear surfaces. The cited matrix places sampled Late Triassic haramiyids outside crown Mammalia; tooth form and wear also support plant processing and a backward jaw stroke, but these are interpretations rather than direct records of diet, movement or ancestry.
overviewZh: 具名颌骨 MCZ7/95A–B 和 MCZ10/G95 的 CT 数据显示了承齿齿骨、齿骨后方的沟槽，以及带有磨耗面的多排牙齿。所引矩阵将取样的晚三叠世哈拉米亚类置于哺乳动物冠群之外；牙齿形态和磨耗还支持植物加工及下颌后移的解释，但它们并非食性、运动或祖先关系的直接记录。

ecology.diet: Complex teeth and wear facets support plant processing; actual diet is not observed.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from continental deposits of the Fleming Fjord Formation; the animal's living habitat is not established by the jaws.
ecology.locomotion: Movement is not preserved by the jaw material.
ecology.bodySize: Described as a small mammaliaform; the jaw sample does not establish whole-body mass.
ecology.guild: Plant processing is inferred from the teeth; an ecological role is not directly observed.
ecology.dietZh: 复杂牙齿和磨耗面支持其能够处理植物；实际食物并未被直接观察。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自 Fleming Fjord 组的陆相沉积；仅凭颌骨无法确定动物的生活生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 颌部材料没有保存移动信息。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 它被描述为一种小型哺乳形类；下颌样本不能确定全身质量。
ecology.guildZh: 根据牙齿推断其处理植物；其生态角色并未被直接观察。

traits: Jaw-joint condyle and a trough behind the dentary
Rows of complex teeth behind the front of the jaw
Backward jaw movement inferred from tooth-wear geometry
evidenceSummary: The Greenland jaws support anatomical and tooth-wear observations; placement outside crown Mammalia and plant processing are interpretations. The 205.7–201.4 Ma Rhaetian interval translates the formation context, not the full range of Haramiyida or the age of crown Mammalia.
evidenceSummaryZh: 格陵兰具名颌骨支持解剖和牙齿磨耗观察；哺乳动物冠群之外的位置及植物加工都属于解释。205.7–201.4 Ma 的瑞替期区间是地层背景的换算，不代表哈拉米亚目的完整延限，也不是哺乳动物冠群的年代。
traitsZh: 颌关节髁突，以及齿骨后方的沟槽。
下颌前部之后排列着数列复杂牙齿。
根据齿面磨耗几何形态推断下颌可向后移动。

commonNameZh: 摩尔根兽类颅骨标本组
overview: In the Lower Jurassic skull comparison, Morganucodon watsoni from Wales and M. oehleri from China share a described mosaic: the squamosal contacts the dentary while the articular–quadrate joint remains. The 26 mm measurement belongs to the M. watsoni skull, not to body size across the order.

ecology.diet: The skulls preserve distinct incisors, canines, premolars, and molars. That dental differentiation is anatomical evidence, but the study does not directly observe diet.
ecology.habitat: The described specimens come from Lower Jurassic deposits in Wales and China. These localities are representative material, not a complete geographic range or proof of a single life habitat.
ecology.locomotion: The skull comparison does not establish how Morganucodontans moved.
ecology.bodySize: The described M. watsoni skull is 26 mm long; the M. oehleri skull is slightly larger. These skull measurements do not establish body size across the order.
ecology.guild: Two skull samples do not support an order-wide ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: 头骨保存了形态有别的门齿、犬齿、前臼齿和臼齿。这种牙齿分化是解剖证据，但研究没有直接观察食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 所描述的标本来自威尔士和中国的下侏罗统沉积层。这些地点仅代表已研究的材料，既不构成完整地理分布范围，也不能证明其只有一种生活环境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 头骨比较不能确定 Morganucodontans 如何移动。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所描述的 M. watsoni 头骨长 26 mm；M. oehleri 的头骨略大。这些头骨测量值无法确定整个目级类群的体型。
ecology.guildZh: 两组头骨样本不足以支持为整个目指定生态功能类群。

traits: The described M. watsoni skull measures 26 mm; the M. oehleri skull is slightly larger.
The teeth are differentiated into incisors, canines, premolars, and molars.
The described jaw shows squamosal–dentary contact while retaining the articular–quadrate joint.
evidenceSummary: Kermack and colleagues describe the two Morganucodon skulls and their jaw anatomy. Luo and colleagues include Morganucodontans in a mammaliaform character analysis. The skull observations and the matrix placement answer different questions; neither establishes a complete order history or a direct ancestor.
overviewZh: 下侏罗统头骨比较中，来自威尔士的 Morganucodon watsoni 与来自中国的 M. oehleri 呈现所述镶嵌特征：鳞骨与齿骨相接，同时保留关节骨—方骨关节。26 mm 是 M. watsoni 头骨的测量值，不代表整个目级类群的体型。
evidenceSummaryZh: Kermack 等人描述了两件 Morganucodon 头骨及其颌部解剖；Luo 等人在哺乳形类特征分析中纳入摩根齿兽类。头骨观察和矩阵位置回答的是不同问题；两者都没有建立完整的目级历史或直系祖先关系。

scope.en: Kermack et al. (1981), pp. 1–158, especially 1–8: Morganucodon watsoni and M. oehleri skull samples, the 26 mm skull, jaw articulation and dentition.
scope.zh: Kermack 等（1981），第 1–158 页，尤其第 1–8 页：Morganucodon watsoni 与 M. oehleri 头骨样本、26 毫米头骨、颌关节及牙列。

readerSources.title: In quest for a phylogeny of Mesozoic mammals

scope.en: Luo et al. (2002), pp. 1–78: mammaliaform taxon sampling, Morganucodontan relationships and the stated crown Mammalia boundary.
scope.zh: Luo 等（2002），第 1–78 页：哺乳形类取样、摩根齿兽类关系及文中采用的冠群哺乳动物边界。

title.en: Contact between jaw bones beside an older joint
title.zh: 较早的颌关节仍在，邻骨已相接

text.en: In the Lower Jurassic skull comparison, Morganucodon watsoni from Wales and M. oehleri from China share a described mosaic: the squamosal contacts the dentary while the articular–quadrate joint remains. The 26 mm measurement belongs to the M. watsoni skull, not to body size across the order.
text.zh: 下侏罗统头骨比较中，来自威尔士的 Morganucodon watsoni 与来自中国的 M. oehleri 呈现所述镶嵌特征：鳞骨与齿骨相接，同时保留关节骨—方骨关节。26 mm 是 M. watsoni 头骨的测量值，不代表整个目级类群的体型。

title.en: Named skulls and a sampled mammaliaform analysis
title.zh: 具名头骨与取样的哺乳形类分析

text.en: Kermack and colleagues describe the two Morganucodon skulls and their jaw anatomy. Luo and colleagues include Morganucodontans in a mammaliaform character analysis. The skull observations and the matrix placement answer different questions; neither establishes a complete order history or a direct ancestor.
text.zh: Kermack 等人描述了两件 Morganucodon 头骨及其颌部解剖；Luo 等人在哺乳形类特征分析中纳入摩根齿兽类。头骨观察和矩阵位置回答的是不同问题；两者都没有建立完整的目级历史或直系祖先关系。

traitsZh: 所描述的 M. watsoni 头骨长 26 毫米；M. oehleri 的头骨稍大。
牙齿分化为门齿、犬齿、前臼齿和臼齿。
所描述的下颌显示鳞骨与齿骨相接，同时保留关节骨—方骨关节。

overview: Near-complete holotype IVPP V16051 preserves a detached ectotympanic and malleus beside ossified Meckel's cartilage. The combination records separated ear bones and a remaining connection to the dentary in one fossil; it does not directly show soft-tissue motion or prove direct ancestry.

ecology.diet: Animal-feeding diet inferred from eutriconodont dentition
ecology.habitat: Jiufotang lacustrine depositional setting; exact life habitat unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Terrestrial locomotion inferred; performance not measured
ecology.bodySize: Small-bodied mammal known from a near-complete skeleton
ecology.guild: Small terrestrial faunivore inferred from dentition
ecology.dietZh: 所引研究根据真三尖齿兽类牙齿推断其取食动物性食物。正模没有保存食物或直接摄食观察。
ecology.habitatZh: 标本来自九佛堂组的湖相沉积环境。这一沉积背景不能确定动物的确切生活栖地。
ecology.locomotionZh: 陆地运动方式是根据保存的解剖结构推断的；研究没有测量运动表现。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 资料将 Liaoconodon 描述为小型哺乳动物，并提到近完整骨架；没有给出量化的体型或体重范围。
ecology.guildZh: 本页根据牙齿推断其为小型陆生食虫或食肉动物，并非报告直接观察到的生态角色。

traits: Detached ectotympanic and malleus
Ossified Meckel’s cartilage linking ear and dentary
Near-complete articulated postcranial skeleton
evidenceSummary: IVPP V16051 directly supports the described ear and jaw anatomy. A stabilizing function for the ossified cartilage and its evolutionary significance remain interpretations, not observed performance or ancestry.

title.en: A detached middle-ear element beside jaw cartilage
title.zh: 分离的中耳骨旁仍有颌部软骨

text.en: Near-complete holotype IVPP V16051 preserves a detached ectotympanic and malleus alongside ossified Meckel's cartilage. The ectotympanic forms part of the middle ear, the malleus transmits sound, and Meckel's cartilage runs along the lower jaw in mammals. Their preserved arrangement documents an ear–jaw connection in this specimen, not soft-tissue motion or a universal transition stage.
text.zh: 近完整正模 IVPP V16051 保存了分离的鼓骨和锤骨，也保存了骨化的麦氏软骨。鼓骨是中耳的一部分，锤骨传递声音；哺乳动物的麦氏软骨沿下颌延伸。该标本保存的组合记录了耳—颌联系，但不能直接显示软组织运动，也不是普遍过渡阶段的证明。

title.en: Transitional mammalian middle ear from a new Cretaceous Jehol eutriconodont
title.zh: Transitional mammalian middle ear from a new Cretaceous Jehol eutriconodont

scope.en: Liaoconodon hui: 181–185; Figures 1–4. Limited to the cited specimens, samples or analyses.
scope.zh: Liaoconodon hui：原文定位 181–185; Figures 1–4。本文仅使用所引标本、样本或分析的对应结果。

overviewZh: 正模 IVPP V16051 保存分离的鼓骨、锤骨及与齿骨相连的骨化麦氏软骨。
evidenceSummaryZh: IVPP V16051 支持所述耳部与下颌组合；软骨功能的解释仍有不确定性。
traitsZh: 近完整正模保存了分离的鼓骨和锤骨。
保存的标本中，骨化麦氏软骨将耳部骨骼与齿骨相连。
研究还报告了一具近完整、关节连接的颅后骨架；耳—颌解释仍以正模解剖为依据。

overview: Perissodactyla includes living horses, tapirs and rhinoceroses alongside many extinct branches. Fossils place an early radiation during the Paleocene–Eocene Thermal Maximum (PETM), but the sampled record and analyses do not resolve the order's exact origin.

ecology.diet: Terrestrial herbivory across sampled lineages
ecology.habitat: Lineage-specific terrestrial habitats; no single order-wide habitat
ecology.locomotion: Terrestrial, with strongly divergent limb specializations
ecology.bodySize: Small early forms to giant rhinocerotoids
ecology.guild: Browsers, mixed feeders and grazers in separate lineages
ecology.dietZh: 本页概括所取样支系中的陆生植食性。它不能说明所有后代都具有相同食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 栖地证据因支系而异，所述环境为陆生；现有资料没有为整个奇蹄目指定一种共同栖地。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所引资料将本目成员描述为陆生，但不同支系的肢体特化差异明显。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 记录中的形态从早期小型成员到巨型犀形类不等；这是支系间对比，不是整个目的单一测量值。
ecology.guildZh: 所引支系中有食叶者、混合取食者和放牧者。这些取食角色分布于不同支系，并非本目所有成员共有。

traits: Early branches distinguished by subtle dental and cranial characters
Strong lineage-specific divergence of skull, dentition and limbs
evidenceSummary: The PETM occurrence study and broader fossil synthesis trace branching histories across northern continents. They do not date the order's exact origin or establish one way of life for every branch.

title.en: Earliest perissodactyls reveal large-scale dispersals during the PETM
title.zh: Earliest perissodactyls reveal large-scale dispersals during the PETM

scope.en: The selected anatomical, relationship or time-estimate material described in this account; no complete species history or distribution is inferred.
scope.zh: 用于本文选取的解剖、关系或时间估计材料，不由此推断完整物种史或分布。

title.en: Evolutionary Transitions in the Fossil Record of Terrestrial Hoofed Mammals
title.zh: Evolutionary Transitions in the Fossil Record of Terrestrial Hoofed Mammals

scope.en: The selected anatomical, relationship or time-estimate material described in this account; no complete species history or distribution is inferred.
scope.zh: 用于本文选取的解剖、关系或时间估计材料，不由此推断完整物种史或分布。

title.en: Perissodactyl evolution
title.zh: Perissodactyl evolution

scope.en: The selected anatomical, relationship or time-estimate material described in this account; no complete species history or distribution is inferred.
scope.zh: 用于本文选取的解剖、关系或时间估计材料，不由此推断完整物种史或分布。

title.en: Living forms differ across a branching order
title.zh: 现生成员形态不同，化石记录呈分支

text.zh: 今天的马、貘和犀牛外形差异很大。早期化石常依靠牙齿和头骨的细微特征区分，灭绝支系又呈现更多变化。它们共同组成分支记录，而不是只通向现生类群的连续队列。
text.en: Horses, tapirs and rhinoceroses look very different today. Early fossils are often separated by finer tooth and skull features, and extinct branches add further variation. Together they form a branching record, not a sequence leading only to the living forms.

title.zh: 71 个末端与 102 个性状仍留下基部争议
title.en: 71 terminals and 102 characters leave basal positions open

text.zh: 最早出现记录研究分析了 71 个末端和 102 个形态性状。基部位置存在不同结果，说明最早取样化石并未解决本目的起源。
text.en: The earliest-occurrence study analyzes 71 terminals and 102 morphological characters. Alternative placements near the base show why the first sampled fossils do not settle the order's origin.

title.zh: 不同支系分别改变牙齿、头骨与四肢
title.en: Separate branches changed teeth, skulls and limbs

text.zh: 奇蹄目的分支历史包含许多灭绝类群。牙齿、头骨和四肢沿不同谱系变化；若把化石排成连续祖先队列，就会掩盖分支格局。
text.en: Many extinct groups sit within the order's branching history. Teeth, skulls and limbs changed along different lineages; arranging fossils as successive ancestors would hide that branching pattern.

title.zh: PETM 期间的扩散不能确定本目起源地
title.en: PETM dispersal does not identify the order's origin

text.zh: 最早取样的奇蹄类记录约为距今 5600 万至 5400 万年（56–54 Ma），处于 PETM 期间。分布支持北美、欧洲和亚洲之间发生快速扩散，但没有确定本目的确切起源地。
text.en: The earliest sampled perissodactyl records fall around 56–54 Ma, during the PETM. Their distribution supports rapid dispersal among North America, Europe and Asia, but does not identify the order's exact place of origin.

readerLimitations.en: This early radiation is reconstructed from sampled fossils and comparative anatomy. Basal placements depend on analysis, and the selected records do not identify direct ancestors, a precise origin date or a complete distribution.
readerLimitations.zh: 早期辐射依据取样化石与比较解剖重建。基部位置取决于分析方式；所选记录不能确定直系祖先、精确起源年代或完整分布。

overviewZh: 奇蹄目包括现生马、貘和犀牛，也包括许多灭绝支系。化石将其早期辐射置于古新世—始新世极热事件（PETM）期间，但取样记录和分析没有解决本目的确切起源。
evidenceSummaryZh: PETM 产出研究与更广泛的化石综述追踪了北方大陆上的分支历史，但没有确定本目的确切起源时间，也没有证明每条支系都具有相同生活方式。
traitsZh: 所引比较研究利用细微的牙齿与头骨性状区分早期支系。
化石记录显示头骨、牙齿和四肢沿不同支系发生明显变化。

overview: Brontotheriidae varied widely in form during the Eocene. Members share cranial and upper-molar features, including a shortened face, but early forms were small while some later species reached rhinoceros size. Frontonasal appendages occur in some species, so the family pattern is not a portrait of every member.
overviewZh: Brontotheriidae 在始新世呈现多样形态。成员共享一些头骨和上臼齿特征，包括缩短的吻部；早期类型较小，部分晚期种达到犀牛大小。额鼻部附属突起只见于部分物种，因此科级特征不能代表每个成员。

ecology.diet: Brontotheres were herbivores; leaf browsing is supported by the sampled teeth.
ecology.habitat: The cited records are from terrestrial Eocene localities; they do not define one habitat for the whole family.
ecology.locomotion: The family is terrestrial, but the cited evidence does not establish one gait for every member.
ecology.bodySize: The documented size range runs from small early forms to rhinoceros-sized later taxa.
ecology.guild: The sampled dental evidence contains a leaf-browsing signal.
ecology.dietZh: 雷兽类是草食动物；取样牙齿支持其取食叶片。
ecology.habitatZh: 所引记录来自始新世陆生化石地点；它们不能界定整个雷兽科共同的单一生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 该科为陆生，但所引证据无法确定所有成员共有的一种步态。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 记录的体型范围从早期的小型类型到后期的犀牛大小类群。
ecology.guildZh: 所取样的牙齿证据显示出取食叶片的信号。

traits: The face is shortened from front to back in the family-level diagnosis.
The postorbital part of the skull is elongate.
Upper molars are bunoselenodont, with a W-shaped outer ridge (ectoloph).
Frontonasal appendages occur in some species, not across the family.
evidenceSummary: Mihlbachler's monograph supplies the taxonomy, morphology and distribution summarized here. Size and frontonasal appendages vary among species; dispersal direction and deeper relationships are reconstructions, not shared diagnostic observations.
evidenceSummaryZh: 本页概括的分类、形态和分布依据 Mihlbachler 的专著。体型和额鼻部附属突起因种而异；扩散方向与深层亲缘关系属于重建结果，并非全科共有的诊断观察。

readerLimitations.en: The monograph records smaller early forms, later rhinoceros-sized taxa and appendages present only in some species. Dental browsing signals and terrestrial Eocene localities do not establish one habitat or gait for the whole family.
readerLimitations.zh: 专著记录了早期小型类型、晚期犀牛大小类群，以及只见于部分物种的附属突起。牙齿中的浏览取食信号和始新世陆生地点，不能证明全科共享一种栖地或步态。

traitsZh: 科级鉴定特征包括前后方向缩短的面部。
眼眶之后的颅骨部分较长。
上臼齿呈丘形—月形结构，外侧脊（外脊）呈 W 形。
某些物种具有额鼻部附属结构，但这并非全科共有。

geography: Western Europe (French and British study records)
overview: The Palaeotherium medium sample from La Débruge records wear consistent with leaf browsing and a smaller fruit or abrasive-seed component. British range records describe a separate regional history near the Grande Coupure; they do not turn local losses into a global genus extinction date.

ecology.diet: In sampled Palaeotherium medium, dental wear supports leaf browsing with a smaller fruit or abrasive-seed component.
ecology.habitat: La Débruge is a late Eocene terrestrial locality; tooth wear alone does not reconstruct the animal’s habitat.
ecology.locomotion: The cited dental-wear study does not evaluate gait.
ecology.bodySize: The evidence is for sampled Palaeotherium medium; it does not provide a genus-wide size estimate.
ecology.guild: The sampled Palaeotherium medium population is described as a leaf browser; this is not a genus-wide assignment.
ecology.dietZh: 在取样的 Palaeotherium medium 中，牙齿磨耗支持以浏览取食叶片为主的混合食性，另有较少的果实或具磨蚀性的种子成分。
ecology.habitatZh: La Débruge 是晚始新世陆生化石地点；仅凭齿面磨耗不能重建动物的生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所引牙齿磨损研究没有评估步态。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 证据仅涉及取样的 Palaeotherium medium，不能提供整个属的体型估计。
ecology.guildZh: 所取样的 Palaeotherium medium 种群被描述为食叶者；这一归类不适用于整个属。

traits: The molars have high occlusal relief.
Worn cusps include both sharp and rounded forms.
Wear facets are consistent with both shearing and grinding plant foods.
evidenceSummary: Joomun and colleagues study dental wear in one species and locality. Hooker and colleagues chart British regional occurrences. Together they do not establish a complete global Palaeotherium range or a single extinction boundary.
overviewZh: 来自 La Débruge 的 Palaeotherium medium 样本，其磨耗与以取食叶片为主、少量果实或具磨蚀性种子的混合食性相符。英国分布记录呈现的是 Grande Coupure 附近另一段区域历史，不能将局部消失改写为该属的全球灭绝年代。
evidenceSummaryZh: Joomun 等人研究一个物种和地点的牙齿磨耗；Hooker 等人绘制英国区域产出图。两者合起来仍不能确定 Palaeotherium 的完整全球分布或单一灭绝界线。

readerSources.title: Dental wear variation and implications for diet: An example from Eocene perissodactyls (Mammalia)

scope.en: Joomun et al. (2008), pp. 92–106, Figures 1–8 and Tables 1–4: dental wear in the La Débruge Palaeotherium medium sample and the resulting dietary interpretation.
scope.zh: Joomun 等（2008），第 92–106 页、图 1–8 与表 1–4：La Débruge 的 Palaeotherium medium 样本牙齿磨耗及据此作出的食性解释。

readerSources.title: Eocene–Oligocene mammalian faunal turnover in the Hampshire Basin, UK: calibration to the global time scale and the major cooling event

scope.en: Hooker et al. (2004), pp. 161–172, Figures 2–4 and the mammal range chart: British regional records and losses around the Grande Coupure, not a global extinction date.
scope.zh: Hooker 等（2004），第 161–172 页、图 2–4 与哺乳动物分布图：英国区域记录及 Grande Coupure 前后的消失，不是全球灭绝年代。

title.en: Separate a tooth-wear sample from regional history
title.zh: 把牙齿样本与区域历史分开

text.en: The Palaeotherium medium sample from La Débruge records wear consistent with leaf browsing and a smaller fruit or abrasive-seed component. British range records describe a separate regional history near the Grande Coupure; they do not turn local losses into a global genus extinction date.
text.zh: 来自 La Débruge 的 Palaeotherium medium 样本，其磨耗与以取食叶片为主、少量果实或具磨蚀性种子的混合食性相符。英国分布记录呈现的是 Grande Coupure 附近另一段区域历史，不能将局部消失改写为该属的全球灭绝年代。

title.en: Two sources answer different questions
title.zh: 两项来源回答不同问题

text.en: Joomun and colleagues study dental wear in one species and locality. Hooker and colleagues chart British regional occurrences. Together they do not establish a complete global Palaeotherium range or a single extinction boundary.
text.zh: Joomun 等人研究一个物种和地点的牙齿磨耗；Hooker 等人绘制英国区域产出图。两者合起来仍不能确定 Palaeotherium 的完整全球分布或单一灭绝界线。

traitsZh: 臼齿具有较高的咬合面起伏。
磨耗的齿尖既有尖锐型，也有圆钝型。
磨耗面特征符合对植物性食物同时进行剪切和研磨。

geography: Badlands National Park, South Dakota (sampled M. planifrons)
overview: Metamynodon planifrons is the subject of a comparative test of semi-aquatic locomotion. Its anatomy and depositional setting inform that hypothesis for this species; they do not support a family-wide swamp-rhino label.

ecology.diet: Herbivorous; diet not tested in the locomotor study
ecology.habitat: Associated with Orellan channel sandstones
ecology.locomotion: Semi-aquatic inference from comparative anatomy and deposits
ecology.bodySize: Large M. planifrons sample; genus-wide mass not generalized
ecology.guild: No feeding guild assigned beyond the bounded locomotor inference
ecology.dietZh: 本页将 M. planifrons 描述为植食性，但所引运动研究没有检验食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 所取样的 Metamynodon planifrons 材料与奥雷尔阶河道砂岩有关。这种沉积关联本身不能确定惯常栖地。
ecology.locomotionZh: 对所研究 M. planifrons 材料的解剖比较和沉积背景支持半水生运动推断，但两者都没有直接记录行为。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 本页涉及大型 M. planifrons 材料，并未将体重估计推广到整个属。
ecology.guildZh: 运动比较没有在有限的运动推断之外指定取食功能群。

traits: High-positioned orbits
Reduced thoracic neural spines
Limb-lever proportions differing from more terrestrial amynodontids
evidenceSummary: Wall and Heinbaugh use comparative anatomy and deposits to test semi-aquatic movement. The study does not observe behavior, test diet, assign a feeding guild or estimate mass across the genus.

title.en: One species in a test of semi-aquatic movement
title.zh: 以一个物种检验半水生运动

text.en: Metamynodon planifrons is the subject of a comparative test of semi-aquatic locomotion. Its anatomy and depositional setting inform that hypothesis for this species; they do not support a family-wide swamp-rhino label.
text.zh: Metamynodon planifrons 是一项半水生运动比较研究的对象。其解剖和沉积背景为这个物种的假说提供信息，但不能据此把整个科称为沼泽犀牛。

title.en: Orbits, neural spines and limb proportions
title.zh: 眼眶、神经棘与肢骨比例

text.en: In the studied M. planifrons material, the orbits sit high on the skull and the thoracic neural spines are reduced. Its limb-lever proportions differ from those of the more terrestrial amynodontids included in the comparison.
text.zh: 在所研究的 M. planifrons 材料中，眼眶位于头骨较高处，胸椎神经棘缩短。其肢骨杠杆比例不同于比较中纳入的、更偏陆生的两栖犀类。

title.en: Channel sandstones are depositional context
title.zh: 河道砂岩提供沉积背景

text.en: The sampled material is associated with Orellan channel sandstones. This setting contributes to the movement interpretation but does not directly establish habitual habitat or behavior.
text.zh: 所取样材料与奥雷尔阶河道砂岩有关。这一背景参与运动解释，但不能直接确定惯常栖地或行为。

title.en: A semi-aquatic interpretation, not observed behavior
title.zh: 半水生解释不是观察到的行为

text.en: Wall and Heinbaugh use comparative anatomy and deposits to test semi-aquatic movement. The study does not observe behavior, test diet, assign a feeding guild or estimate mass across the genus.
text.zh: Wall 和 Heinbaugh 通过比较解剖和沉积背景检验半水生运动。研究没有观察行为、检验食性、指定取食功能群，也没有估算全属体重。

title.en: Locomotor adaptations in Metamynodon planifrons compared to other amynodontids (Perissodactyla, Rhinocerotoidea)
title.zh: Locomotor adaptations in Metamynodon planifrons compared to other amynodontids (Perissodactyla, Rhinocerotoidea)

scope.en: Comparative anatomy tests semi-aquatic locomotion in M. planifrons; behaviour is not directly observed.
scope.zh: 比较解剖用于检验 M. planifrons 的半水生运动方式；行为并未直接观察。

title.en: Amynodontidae
title.zh: Amynodontidae

scope.en: Provides family-level amynodont context; it does not replace the comparative locomotor test for M. planifrons.
scope.zh: 提供两栖犀科的一般背景；它不能替代对 M. planifrons 运动方式的比较检验。

overviewZh: M. planifrons 的眼眶、胸椎神经棘和肢骨比例被用于检验半水生运动假说。
evidenceSummaryZh: 解剖比较与河道砂岩背景支持半水生推断；行为未被直接观察，也不提供属级体重估计。
traitsZh: 所取样头骨的眼眶位置较高，这是运动研究比较的特征之一。
研究描述了所取样材料中胸椎区域缩短的神经棘。
所取样的肢骨杠杆比例不同于作为对照的、更偏陆生的两栖犀类。

overview: This Oligocene Asian account samples six Paraceratherium species. A 155-character analysis places the approximately 26.5 Ma specimen LX1808 within a monophyletic genus, although finer relationships depend on the matrix. Its skull, mandible and neck vertebrae support a giant animal with a long neck and long limbs.
overviewZh: 本页介绍渐新世亚洲副巨犀属，分析取样了六个物种。155 项性状分析将年代约为 26.5 Ma 的 LX1808 标本置于单系属内，但更细的亲缘关系取决于矩阵。其头骨、下颌和颈椎支持其体型巨大、颈部与四肢较长。

ecology.diet: A large terrestrial herbivore; feeding height is inferred from neck and body form, not measured.
ecology.habitat: Oligocene Asian woodland–grassland mosaics are reported for sampled localities; settings vary by locality.
ecology.locomotion: The long limbs do not fit the elephant-like, short-limbed graviportal analogy rejected in the cited study.
ecology.bodySize: Giant-bodied; the profile does not infer a more precise mass.
ecology.guild: A large browser is an anatomical inference; diet was not directly measured.
ecology.dietZh: 一种大型陆生草食动物；其取食高度是根据颈部和身体形态推断的，并未测量。
ecology.habitatZh: 所取样地点记录了渐新世亚洲林地—草地镶嵌景观；不同地点的环境各异。
ecology.locomotionZh: 其长肢与象类短肢、重型承重动物式的类比不符；所引研究也否定了这种类比。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 体型巨大；该简介没有推算更精确的体重。
ecology.guildZh: 大型食叶者是根据解剖特征作出的推断；并未直接测量其食性。

traits: Giant skull and body size
Long, flexible neck supported by cervical anatomy
Long limbs rather than stubby graviportal limbs
Species diagnoses use cranial and dental characters
evidenceSummary: Deng and colleagues document LX1808, its diagnosis, a 155-character analysis and an occurrence map. The analysis samples six species and supports a monophyletic genus; dispersal through the Tibetan region, palaeoelevation and feeding height remain inferences.

readerLimitations.en: LX1808 is one point occurrence, not a global first or last appearance. Localities span the Mongolian Plateau, northwestern China, Kazakhstan and Pakistan; a route through the Tibetan region and palaeoelevation are reconstructed. Herbivory is supported, but browsing height and one habitat for all species are not established.
readerLimitations.zh: LX1808 是一个地点的产出记录，不是全球首现或末现。地点横跨蒙古高原、中国西北、哈萨克斯坦和巴基斯坦；经由青藏地区的路线和古海拔属于重建。食草解释有依据，但取食高度及全属共同栖地尚未确定。

evidenceSummaryZh: Deng 等人记录了 LX1808、其鉴定特征、155 项性状分析和产出分布图。分析取样六个物种并支持该属为单系群；经由青藏地区的扩散、古海拔和取食高度仍属推断。
traitsZh: 头骨和身体体型巨大。
颈椎解剖特征支持其具有长而灵活的颈部。
肢体较长，而非粗短的重型承重型肢体。
物种鉴定依据颅骨和牙齿特征。

overview: The dental-wear sample labels include Chalicotherium goldfussi and the historical combination Chalicotherium (Anisodon) grande. Keeping those source names visible prevents material identified under different names from being treated as one undifferentiated species.
overviewZh: 牙齿磨耗样本标签包括 Chalicotherium goldfussi 和历史组合 Chalicotherium (Anisodon) grande。保留来源名称，可避免把不同名称下的材料当作同一个未经区分的物种。

ecology.diet: Wear evidence supports browsing, with abrasive bark or twig material among the proposed foods.
ecology.habitat: The samples come from Miocene sites in southern Germany. Diet alone does not identify the habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Posture is reconstructed from limb anatomy, not observed directly.
ecology.bodySize: The sampled animals are large chalicotheriines; the cited study does not give a genus-wide mass estimate.
ecology.guild: The dietary evidence suggests a browser with mixed food textures; the full feeding guild remains an interpretation.
ecology.dietZh: 磨耗证据支持其取食叶片、枝条等；被提出的食物中包括带磨蚀性的树皮或细枝材料。
ecology.habitatZh: 样本来自德国南部的中新世遗址。仅凭食性不能确定生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 姿势是根据肢骨解剖结构重建的，并非直接观察所得。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所取样的动物属于大型爪兽亚科；所引研究没有给出该属整体的体重估计。
ecology.guildZh: 食性证据提示其为取食多种不同质地食物的食叶动物；完整的摄食生态类群仍属解释。

traits: Large terminal toe bones interpreted as claws
Short hind limbs in the sampled chalicotheriines
Posture and claw use are functional reconstructions
evidenceSummary: The primary study combines mesowear and microwear and states the historical names attached to its samples. Tooth wear supports dietary interpretations; posture and claw function depend on anatomical reconstruction.
evidenceSummaryZh: 主研究结合中磨耗和微磨耗，并说明样本所用的历史名称。牙齿磨耗支持食性解释；姿势与爪的功能则依赖解剖重建。

title.en: Two sample names stay distinct in this genus account
title.zh: 这份属级档案保留两种样本名称

text.en: The dental-wear sample labels include Chalicotherium goldfussi and the historical combination Chalicotherium (Anisodon) grande. Keeping those source names visible prevents material identified under different names from being treated as one undifferentiated species.
text.zh: 牙齿磨耗样本标签包括 Chalicotherium goldfussi 和历史组合 Chalicotherium (Anisodon) grande。保留来源名称，可避免把不同名称下的材料当作同一个未经区分的物种。

title.en: Wear supports browse-dominated mixed feeding
title.zh: 磨耗支持以浏览取食为主的混合食性

text.en: Mesowear and microwear in the studied southern German Miocene samples support browse-dominated feeding with mixed food textures. Bark or twigs are among the proposed abrasive foods. This is an inference from tooth wear, not a directly observed meal.
text.zh: 德国南部中新世样本的中磨耗和微磨耗支持以浏览取食为主、食物质地混合的解释。树皮或嫩枝是提出的磨蚀性食物之一。这是牙齿磨耗推断，并非直接观察到的一餐。

title.en: Claws and posture are functional reconstructions
title.zh: 爪与姿势属于功能重建

text.en: The studied large chalicotheriines preserve large terminal toe bones interpreted as claws and shortened hind limbs. Upright posture and claw use are reconstructions from anatomy, not observed behavior.
text.zh: 所研究的大型爪兽亚科材料保存了被解释为爪的大型趾末端骨和较短后肢。直立姿势与爪的用途是根据解剖作出的重建，并非观察到的行为。

title.en: Feeding ecology of the Chalicotheriidae (Mammalia, Perissodactyla, Ancylopoda): results from dental micro- and mesowear analyses
title.zh: Feeding ecology of the Chalicotheriidae (Mammalia, Perissodactyla, Ancylopoda): results from dental micro- and mesowear analyses

scope.en: Schulz et al. (2007), pp. 5?23, Figures 1, 5 and 6 and Tables 2?7: sample names, dental-wear evidence, browse and bark/twig interpretation, ungual phalanges and reconstructed posture.

readerLimitations.en: These conclusions are tied to sampled Miocene localities in southern Germany and the names used in the study. They do not establish a genus-wide mass estimate, global range or complete feeding guild.
readerLimitations.zh: 这些结论仅适用于德国南部中新世取样地点及研究采用的名称，不能据此确定整个属的体重估计、全球分布或完整取食功能群。

traitsZh: 末端趾骨较大，被解释为爪。
所取样爪兽亚科成员的后肢较短。
姿势和爪的用途属于功能性重建。

geography: Central and western Europe (MN3–MN9 record discussed)
overview: Kaiser analyzed 35 cheek teeth of Anchitherium aurelianense from Sandelzhausen; their mesowear supports browse-dominated mixed feeding, not a uniform pure-browser model. The separate MN3–MN9 record describes a European biochronological sample, not the genus's complete global ecology or range.

ecology.diet: Mesowear on 35 cheek teeth supports browse-dominated mixed feeding rather than a uniform pure-browser model at this locality.
ecology.habitat: The dietary sample comes from Sandelzhausen in a warm-temperate woodland context; it does not summarize habitat across the genus.
ecology.locomotion: The cited diagnosis records a three-toed manus and reduced fifth metacarpal; running performance is not tested.
ecology.bodySize: The selected evidence provides no single genus-wide mass estimate.
ecology.guild: The sampled teeth support browse-dominated mixed feeding; they do not assign one feeding guild to every Anchitherium population.
ecology.dietZh: 对 35 颗颊齿的中齿磨损分析支持其以取食树叶为主的混合食性；在该地点，这不支持所有个体都为纯食叶者的统一模式。
ecology.habitatZh: 摄食研究样本来自 Sandelzhausen，当地处于暖温带林地环境；它不能概括整个属的栖息环境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所引鉴别描述记录了三趾的前足和缩小的第五掌骨；研究未检验其奔跑能力。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所选证据没有提供适用于整个属的单一体重估计。
ecology.guildZh: 取样牙齿支持以浏览取食树叶为主的混合食性；据此不能为每个 Anchitherium 种群都指定同一种摄食功能类群。

traits: Low-crowned lophodont cheek teeth
Tridactyl manus with reduced fifth metacarpal
Dental wear more abrasive than a pure-browser model predicts
evidenceSummary: Kaiser analyzes 35 Anchitherium aurelianense cheek teeth from Sandelzhausen. The study's dietary result is local to that species and sample; the European MN3–MN9 record supplies regional biochronological context, not complete global endpoints or a precise date for every fossil.

title.en: Thirty-five cheek teeth show mixed wear signals
title.zh: 35 枚颊齿呈现混合磨耗信号

text.en: Kaiser measured mesowear on 35 cheek teeth from Anchitherium aurelianense at Sandelzhausen. The pattern supports browse-dominated mixed feeding rather than a uniform pure-browser model. It applies to one species at one locality; the study does not separate every influence on diet or generalize the result to the genus.
text.zh: Kaiser 对 Sandelzhausen 的 35 枚 Anchitherium aurelianense 颊齿测量了中观磨耗。结果支持以浏览取食为主的混合食性，而非统一的纯食叶者模式。结论仅适用于一个地点的一个物种；研究没有分离食性的所有影响，也未将结果推广到整个属。

title.en: Hand anatomy and European MN3–MN9 context
title.zh: 手部解剖与欧洲 MN3–MN9 背景

text.en: The cited diagnosis records low-crowned lophodont cheek teeth and a three-toed manus with a reduced fifth metacarpal. MN3–MN9 supplies a European biochronological context, not a direct date for each fossil or a complete global Anchitherium range.
text.zh: 所引鉴别描述记录了低冠脊褶型颊齿，以及三趾、第五掌骨缩小的前足。MN3–MN9 提供欧洲生物年代背景，并非每件化石的直接定年或 Anchitherium 的完整全球分布。

title.en: Anchitherium aurelianense (Equidae, Mammalia): a brachydont “dirty browser” in the community of herbivorous large mammals from Sandelzhausen (Miocene, Germany)
title.zh: Anchitherium aurelianense (Equidae, Mammalia): a brachydont “dirty browser” in the community of herbivorous large mammals from Sandelzhausen (Miocene, Germany)

scope.en: Recorded reader-passage locators: supports; pages: 131–140; figure: Figures 1–3; Table 1; quoteLocator: Diagnosis and European MN3–MN9 context (pp. 131–132); 35-tooth mesowear result and discussion (pp. 133–139)
scope.zh: 读者段落的原始定位：supports; pages: 131–140; figure: Figures 1–3; Table 1; quoteLocator: Diagnosis and European MN3–MN9 context (pp. 131–132); 35-tooth mesowear result and discussion (pp. 133–139)

overviewZh: Kaiser 分析了 Sandelzhausen 的 35 枚 Anchitherium aurelianense 颊齿；中观磨耗支持以浏览取食为主的混合食性，不支持统一的纯食叶者模式。另列的 MN3–MN9 记录描述欧洲生物年代学样本，并非该属完整的全球生态或分布。
evidenceSummaryZh: Kaiser 分析了 Sandelzhausen 的 35 枚 Anchitherium aurelianense 颊齿。食性结果仅适用于该物种和样本；欧洲 MN3–MN9 提供区域生物年代背景，并非完整的全球端点或每件化石的精确年代。
traitsZh: 所引鉴别描述记录了低冠、脊褶型颊齿。
所描述的前足为三趾，第五掌骨缩小。
牙齿磨耗比纯食叶者模型的预期更具磨蚀性，与样本所支持的混合取食相符。

regionalRanges.label: North American tribe-level range
regionalRanges.basis: The North American review and its tribe-level figure place the represented hipparionin record from approximately 17 to 2 Ma; this remains a regional review-matrix envelope.

regionalRanges.label: Old World first dispersal
regionalRanges.basis: The oldest well-supported Old World dispersal window is represented by early Hippotherium records in the Vienna Basin.

regionalRanges.label: Latest Old World regional records
regionalRanges.basis: Terminal records vary by lineage and region; the review places the latest Chinese and African hipparionins around or below 1 Ma rather than at the Holocene boundary.

overview: Hipparionini is an extinct horse tribe whose members retained three toes while diversifying into several Old World genus-level groups. Diet, body size and habitat vary among lineages and through time, so no one species profile represents the tribe.

ecology.diet: Browse-dominated, mixed-feeding and grazing lineages
ecology.habitat: Forest, woodland and open settings depending on lineage and time
ecology.locomotion: Terrestrial equine locomotion with persistent side toes
ecology.bodySize: Small to large lineage-level variation
ecology.dietZh: 旧世界综述记录了以浏览取食为主、混合取食和放牧的支系。这些食性对应不同的样本与分支。
ecology.habitatZh: 本页记录不同支系和时期的森林、林地及开阔环境，没有为整个族指定一种栖地。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所述三趾马类为陆生马科动物，并保留侧趾；这不表示每条支系的足部比例都相同。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 综述材料记录了支系间明显的体型差异，从小型到大型形态均有。
ecology.guildZh: 现有比较显示植食性支系具有生态多样性，并非共享同一种功能群。

traits: Persistent tridactyly
Hypsodont teeth in many lineages
Substantial body-size and dietary variation
evidenceSummary: The record separates a broad North American tribe-level history from an Old World dispersal interval of 11.4–11.0 Ma and later Eurasian and African occurrences. The underlying sources retain narrower windows; they do not make one continuous timeline or prove a single migration route.

title.en: Three toes persisted while diets diversified
title.zh: 三趾延续，食性却不断分化

text.en: Hipparionins retained three toes, while many lineages evolved high-crowned teeth. The reviewed Old World forms range from browsing to mixed feeding and grazing, and body size and foot proportions also vary. These traits belong to different branches and settings, not one fixed lifestyle for every member.
text.zh: Hipparionini 保留三趾特征，许多支系则演化出高冠齿。旧世界综述中的类群从浏览取食到混合取食、放牧均有记录，体型和足部比例也有差异。这些性状属于不同支系与环境，并非所有成员共有的固定生活方式。

title.en: Keep North American and Old World windows separate
title.zh: 分别看待北美与旧大陆的时间窗口

text.en: The atlas distinguishes a broad North American tribe-level history from the Old World dispersal interval of 11.4–11.0 Ma and later Eurasian and African records. Separate, narrower windows remain in the underlying evidence. These sampled records do not form one continuous range or establish a single migration route.
text.zh: 图谱将较广的北美族级历史，与 11.4–11.0 Ma 的旧大陆扩散区间及其后欧亚、非洲记录分开。底层证据保留了更窄的独立时间窗口。这些取样记录既不构成连续分布，也没有确定单一迁徙路线。

overviewZh: Hipparionini 是已灭绝的马族，成员在分化为若干旧大陆属级类群时保留了三趾特征。食性、体型和生境随支系与时期而异，不能用一个物种画像代表全族。
evidenceSummaryZh: 资料将较广的北美族级历史，与 11.4–11.0 Ma 的旧大陆扩散区间及其后欧亚、非洲产出分开呈现。底层来源还保留更窄的时间窗口；这些记录不构成一条连续时间线，也不能证明唯一迁徙路线。
traitsZh: 三趾（tridactyly）特征在所取样的三趾马记录中持续出现。
许多支系演化出高冠齿；本页没有把这一性状赋予所有成员。
综述中的分支在体型和食性上各有差异，不应将它们压成全族统一的生活方式。

overview: Florida isotope studies portray sampled Teleoceras populations mainly as terrestrial, while a limited-mobility, wet-habitat signal is strongest for T. major at Ashfall. The evidence differs by locality and does not support one behavior for every population.

ecology.diet: Dental and isotope evidence supports grazing or mixed feeding depending on locality; no single diet describes all samples.
ecology.habitat: Evidence includes open Florida settings and the Ashfall watering-hole landscape, which are distinct local records.
ecology.locomotion: Shortened limb and foot bones are preserved, but semi-aquatic interpretation is restricted to the Ashfall evidence rather than assigned genus-wide.
ecology.bodySize: Ashfall estimates for T. major are near 785–1,110 kg; they are population- and site-specific estimates.
ecology.guild: Grazer or mixed-feeder roles are inferred locally from teeth and isotopes.
ecology.dietZh: 牙齿和同位素证据显示，取食可能因地点而为食草或混合食；没有一种食谱能概括所有样本。
ecology.habitatZh: 证据分别来自佛罗里达的开阔环境和 Ashfall 的水塘景观，二者属于不同地点记录。
ecology.locomotionZh: 化石保存了缩短的肢骨和足骨，但半水生解释限于 Ashfall 的证据，不能推广到整个属。
ecology.bodySizeZh: Ashfall 的 T. major 体重估计约为 785–1,110 千克；这是特定种群和地点的估值。
ecology.guildZh: 根据不同地点的牙齿和同位素，局部推测其生态角色为食草或混合取食。

traits: Shortened limb and foot bones are preserved.
T. major at Ashfall is described as barrel-bodied.
Hypsodont molars are present.
Lower second incisors show sexual dimorphism.
evidenceSummary: Florida and Ashfall studies yield different ecological signals. Body shape alone does not decide behavior, and the strongest Ashfall interpretation remains bounded to T. major at that locality.
overviewZh: 佛罗里达同位素研究显示，所取样的 Teleoceras 种群主要为陆生；活动范围有限、偏湿地环境的信号则在 Ashfall 的 T. major 中最强。证据因地点而异，不支持把一种行为套用于所有种群。
traitsZh: 标本保存有缩短的肢骨和足骨。
Ashfall 的 T. major 被描述为桶状身躯。
具有高冠齿臼齿。
下颌第二门齿存在雌雄差异。
evidenceSummaryZh: 佛罗里达与 Ashfall 的研究得出不同生态信号。仅凭体形不能确定行为；最强的 Ashfall 解释仍限于该地点的 T. major。

overview: Coelodonta includes species recorded from the Tibetan Plateau and East Asia to northern Eurasia, but its ecology was not uniform. Evidence about C. antiquitatis remains separate from isotope results for other species, including C. nihowanensis.

ecology.diet: Typical grazing in C. antiquitatis; mixed feeding in some C. nihowanensis samples
ecology.habitat: Cold dry steppe for C. antiquitatis; other species and regions vary
ecology.bodySize: Large; about 2900 kg reviewed for C. antiquitatis
ecology.guild: Cold-steppe grazer in C. antiquitatis, not a genus-wide constant
ecology.dietZh: 综述将 C. antiquitatis 描述为典型放牧者；部分 C. nihowanensis 种群的同位素样本则指向混合取食。两项结果都不能套用于该属所有物种。
ecology.habitatZh: 寒冷、干燥草原的解释针对 C. antiquitatis。其他 Coelodonta 物种和地区有所不同。
ecology.locomotionZh: 本页将 Coelodonta 描述为陆生、重型承重型。这种体型描述不能确定全属行为完全相同。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 综述给出的 C. antiquitatis 体重估值约为 2,900 kg。这是物种层面的估值，不是全属体重。
ecology.guildZh: 所引综述中的寒冷草原放牧画像适用于 C. antiquitatis，不代表所有 Coelodonta 物种。

traits: Long hair and dense underwool in C. antiquitatis
Low head posture and long nasal horn in C. antiquitatis
High-crowned teeth associated with abrasive grazing
evidenceSummary: The ecological review compares species and regions; a separate genomic study directly dates one C. antiquitatis individual to 14.4 ka. These sources do not establish a continuous genus-wide history or an exact global extinction boundary.

title.en: Cold-steppe traits belong to C. antiquitatis
title.zh: 寒冷草原特征属于 C. antiquitatis

text.en: The review describes C. antiquitatis as cold-adapted and grazing, with long hair, dense underwool, a low head posture, a long nasal horn and high-crowned teeth. Isotope samples from some C. nihowanensis populations instead indicate mixed feeding. These findings vary by species and place.
text.zh: 综述将 C. antiquitatis 描述为适应寒冷环境的放牧者，并列出长毛、浓密底绒、低头姿态、长鼻角和高冠齿。部分 C. nihowanensis 种群的同位素样本则指向混合取食。结果随物种和地点而异。

title.en: Two dated records do not make a continuous range
title.zh: 两个有年代的记录不构成连续分布

text.en: The review identifies C. thibetana at 5.08 million years ago (5.08 Ma) as the earliest known genus record. A separate genomic study directly dates one C. antiquitatis individual to 14.4 thousand years ago (14.4 ka). These are one reviewed early occurrence and one dated late individual, not proof of continuous presence or the genus’s global last appearance.
text.zh: 综述将距今 508 万年（5.08 Ma）的 C. thibetana 列为目前已知最早的属级记录。另一项基因组研究直接测定了一只距今 1.44 万年（14.4 ka）的 C. antiquitatis 个体。这分别是一条经综述的早期产出和一只直接测年的晚期个体，并非连续存在的证据，也不能确定该属的全球末次出现。

title.en: Ma et al. (2024), Coelodonta paleoecology across Eurasia
title.zh: Ma 等（2024），欧亚披毛犀属古生态综述

scope.en: Species-level ecology and geography across the genus, including morphology and isotope comparisons of C. antiquitatis and C. nihowanensis; Figures 1–6 and Tables 1–2. The review supports regional variation, not one ecology shared by every species.
scope.zh: 属内物种层级的生态与地理综述，包括 C. antiquitatis 和 C. nihowanensis 的形态及同位素比较；图 1–6、表 1–2。该综述支持区域差异，不支持所有物种共享同一生态。

title.en: Guðjónsdóttir et al. (2026), one directly dated woolly rhinoceros genome
title.zh: Guðjónsdóttir 等（2026），一只直接测年的披毛犀基因组

scope.en: One directly dated 14.4 ka C. antiquitatis individual, its genome-wide diversity and runs-of-homozygosity analysis, Figures 1–3 and supplementary tables. This late individual is not a genus-wide global last appearance.
scope.zh: 一只直接测年为 14.4 ka 的 C. antiquitatis 个体、其全基因组多样性与纯合片段分析、图 1–3 和补充表格。这只晚期个体不能代表该属的全球末次出现。

overviewZh: Coelodonta 包括见于青藏高原、东亚至欧亚大陆北部的物种，但其生态并不一致。有关 C. antiquitatis 的证据应与其他物种（包括 C. nihowanensis）的同位素结果分开看待。
evidenceSummaryZh: 综述比较不同物种和地区；基因组研究直接测定一只 C. antiquitatis 个体，年代为 14.4 ka。
traitsZh: 综述描述 C. antiquitatis 具有长毛和浓密底绒。
低头姿态和长鼻角属于 C. antiquitatis 的描述。
综述将高冠齿与所讨论物种的磨蚀性放牧联系起来。

overview: Indohyus is known from disarticulated Sindkhatudi material; bone density and tooth isotopes support aquatic use, while Raoellidae—not Indohyus—is sister to Cetacea.
overviewZh: Indohyus 来自 Sindkhatudi 骨层中分别编目的头骨、肢骨和牙齿；致密肢骨与牙齿同位素支持水域利用，系统树将 Raoellidae 而非 Indohyus 置于鲸类姐妹群位置。

ecology.diet: Diet remains unresolved; the tooth isotopes speak more directly to water use than to food choice.
ecology.habitat: Bone density and tooth isotopes support aquatic or riparian use, but do not record a complete habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Wading is an interpretation; the separately catalogued bones do not preserve a complete gait.
ecology.bodySize: The material represents a small raoellid, on the scale of other small artiodactyls.
ecology.guild: An aquatic or wading ecology is inferred; diet is not resolved.
ecology.dietZh: 食性仍未确定；牙齿同位素更直接反映其用水情况，而非食物选择。
ecology.habitatZh: 骨骼密度和牙齿同位素支持其利用水生或河岸环境，但没有记录完整的生境信息。
ecology.locomotionZh: 涉水是一种解释；另行编目的骨骼没有保存完整步态。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 这些材料代表一种小型饶氏兽科动物，体型与其他小型偶蹄动物相当。
ecology.guildZh: 研究推断其可能具有水生或涉水生态；其食性尚未确定。

traits: Skull material preserves an involucrum, an ear-region thickening compared with cetaceans.
Sections through the long bones show dense bone tissue.
Stable-isotope measurements come from several teeth.
evidenceSummary: The Sindkhatudi sample supports aquatic or wading use and a Raoellidae–Cetacea sister relationship, but leaves diet, gait and direct ancestry unresolved.
evidenceSummaryZh: Sindkhatudi 的记录由散离的头骨、肢骨和牙齿材料组成。致密肢骨与牙齿同位素支持水生或涉水解释；发表的系统树则将 Raoellidae 放在 Cetacea 的姐妹群位置。食性、完整步态和直系祖先关系仍未解决。

readerLimitations.en: Skulls, limb bones and teeth were catalogued separately rather than as an associated skeleton. Bone density and tooth isotopes support aquatic or wading use, but do not settle diet or a complete gait.
readerLimitations.zh: 头骨、肢骨和牙齿分别编目，并非一具相连骨架。骨密度与牙齿同位素支持水生或涉水解释，却不能确定食性或完整步态。

traitsZh: 颅骨材料保存了鼓泡骨，即鲸类相较之下具有的一种耳区骨性增厚。
长骨切片显示骨组织密度较高。
稳定同位素测量来自多颗牙齿。

overview: Holotype H-GSP 18507 of *Ambulocetus natans* preserves a partial skull and vertebral column, plus substantial fore- and hind-limb material. The limbs could bear weight. Researchers used the combined vertebral and hind-limb anatomy to compare movement on land and in water; no gait or swimming performance was observed.
overviewZh: Ambulocetus natans 正模 H-GSP 18507 保存了部分头骨和脊柱，以及较多前肢与后肢材料。肢体能够承重。研究者依据脊柱和后肢的组合解剖特征比较陆地与水中运动；这些功能模型不是直接观察到的步态或游泳表现。

ecology.diet: Teeth and skull support an inference of aquatic predation, but no prey item is directly documented.
ecology.habitat: An amphibious way of life is inferred from the anatomy and formation context.
ecology.locomotion: Dorsoventral swimming and movement on land are functional models based on preserved anatomy.
ecology.bodySize: The partial skeleton represents a large-bodied early cetacean; it does not establish a full size range.
ecology.guild: The predator interpretation is anatomical inference, not an observed feeding event.
ecology.dietZh: 牙齿和头骨支持其在水中捕食的推断，但没有直接记录到猎物。
ecology.habitatZh: 根据解剖特征和地层背景推断其具有两栖生活方式。
ecology.locomotionZh: 根据保存的解剖特征建立了背腹向游泳和陆上移动的功能模型。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 这具部分骨架代表一种体型较大的早期鲸类；它不能确定完整的体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 捕食者的解释来自解剖特征推断，并非观察到的摄食事件。

traits: A partial skull and vertebral column
Substantial forelimbs and hind limbs that could bear weight
A mix of vertebral and limb features used in locomotor comparisons
evidenceSummary: The holotype preserves an anatomical mosaic used to infer amphibious movement. Otter-like swimming and sea-lion-like movement on land are comparisons with living animals, not observed behavior or proof of ancestry.
evidenceSummaryZh: 正模保存的骨骼组合被用于推断两栖运动。类似水獭的游泳和类似海狮的陆上移动，是与现生动物的比较，不是实际行为观察，也不证明祖先关系。

title.en: H-GSP 18507: bones behind the amphibious model
title.zh: H-GSP 18507 的骨骼与两栖运动模型

text.en: Holotype H-GSP 18507 of *Ambulocetus natans* preserves a partial skull and vertebral column, plus substantial fore- and hind-limb material. The limbs could bear weight. Researchers used the combined vertebral and hind-limb anatomy to compare movement on land and in water; no gait or swimming performance was observed.
text.zh: Ambulocetus natans 正模 H-GSP 18507 保存了部分头骨和脊柱，以及较多前肢与后肢材料。肢体能够承重。研究者依据脊柱和后肢的组合解剖特征比较陆地与水中运动；这些功能模型不是直接观察到的步态或游泳表现。

title.en: H-GSP 18507 preserves spine and limb material
title.zh: 脊柱和肢骨材料

text.en: The holotype preserves a partial skull and vertebral column together with substantial fore- and hind-limb material. This large-bodied early cetacean has limbs that could bear weight. Researchers used the vertebral and hind-limb anatomy together to compare movement on land and in water.
text.zh: 正模保存了部分头骨和脊柱，并包含相当数量的前肢与后肢材料。肢体能够支撑体重；研究者依据脊柱与后肢的组合解剖特征比较其在陆地和水中的运动。

title.en: Swimming and land movement are reconstructions
title.zh: 游泳与陆地移动是重建结果

text.en: The study infers amphibious movement from anatomy and formation context. Teeth and skull support an aquatic-predation interpretation, but no prey item is directly documented. Dorsoventral swimming, otter-like motion in water and sea-lion-like movement on land are comparisons with living animals, not observed performance.
text.zh: 研究依据解剖结构和地层背景推断其具有两栖运动能力。牙齿和头骨支持水生捕食的解释，但没有直接记录具体猎物。上下摆动游泳、类似水獭的水中运动以及类似海狮的陆上运动，都是与现生动物作出的比较，并非对化石动物运动表现的观察。

title.en: Fossil evidence for the origin of aquatic locomotion in archaeocete whales
title.zh: Fossil evidence for the origin of aquatic locomotion in archaeocete whales

scope.en: Thewissen et al. (1994), pp. 210?212, Figures 1?3: H-GSP 18507 anatomy, Kuldana Formation context and functional comparisons of terrestrial and aquatic movement.

readerLimitations.en: These interpretations rest on the partial holotype from the Kuldana Formation in Pakistan. The cited material does not define a full body-size range, exact swimming style, land performance or a genus-wide feeding pattern.
readerLimitations.zh: 这些解释依据的是巴基斯坦库尔达纳组出土的部分正模。所引材料未能确定完整体型范围、确切游泳方式、陆地运动表现或整个属的取食模式。

traitsZh: 部分头骨和脊柱。
前肢和后肢发达，能够承重。
用于运动比较的椎骨与四肢特征组合。

overview: CGM 60584 preserves an elongate posterior trunk, unfused sacrum and reduced limbs used to model tail-driven swimming; no fluke is securely preserved.
overviewZh: CGM 60584 保存较长后躯干、未融合骶椎与缩小四肢，为尾部推进增强的游泳模型提供依据；尾鳍和游泳表现并未可靠保存。

ecology.diet: Marine predation is inferred from cetacean teeth; prey is not preserved.
ecology.habitat: The known material comes from a marine lower Gehannam depositional setting at Wadi Al Hitan.
ecology.locomotion: Mid-body and tail undulation is inferred; a tail fluke is not preserved.
ecology.bodySize: A large protocetid represented by substantial associated remains; no exact body length is assigned here.
ecology.guild: Marine predation is inferred from anatomy rather than observed feeding.
ecology.dietZh: 根据鲸类牙齿推断其在海洋中捕食；未保存猎物。
ecology.habitatZh: 已知材料来自 Wadi Al Hitan 的海相下 Gehannam 沉积环境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 研究推断其中段身体和尾部会摆动；化石未保存尾鳍。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 一种由较完整关联遗骸代表的大型原鲸科成员；此处未给出确切体长。
ecology.guildZh: 海洋捕食是根据解剖特征推断，并非观察到摄食行为。

traits: Elongate posterior trunk
Unfused sacrals without a weight-bearing sacroiliac joint
Reduced limbs; a tail fluke is not securely preserved
evidenceSummary: CGM 60584 supplies locomotor anatomy, while 37.71 Ma falls amid competing stratigraphic interpretations; neither date nor performance is exact observation.

readerLimitations.en: The 37.71 Ma point is a display value amid competing stratigraphic interpretations, not an exact date for CGM 60584 or a genus endpoint. Predation and tail-driven swimming are anatomical hypotheses; prey, performance and a tail fluke are not directly documented.
readerLimitations.zh: 37.71 Ma 是在存在相互竞争的地层解释时采用的展示点，不是 CGM 60584 的精确年代，也不是该属的首末现时间。捕食与尾部推进游泳属于解剖学假说；猎物、游泳表现和尾鳍都未被直接记录。

evidenceSummaryZh: CGM 60584 记录了运动模型所用的解剖特征。图示的 37.71 Ma 位于竞争性的地层解释之间，并非标本精确年代或实际游泳记录。
traitsZh: 后躯躯干较长。
骶椎未融合，也没有承重的骶髂关节。
肢体退化；尾鳍是否存在尚无可靠保存证据。

commonNameZh: 地点组合的陆生早期鲸
geography: H-GSP Locality 62, Ganda Kas, Kala Chitta Hills, Punjab, Pakistan
overview: The cited account of *Pakicetus attocki* combines skull H-GSP 96231 with vertebrae and limb bones catalogued separately from H-GSP Locality 62 at Ganda Kas. These are unassociated specimens, not a single “wolf-sized” skeleton. Cetacean-like features in the skull’s ear region and weight-bearing, running-associated postcrania support a terrestrial early-whale interpretation.

ecology.diet: Diet is unresolved from the described skeleton and teeth; the study does not attribute prey remains to the sample
ecology.habitat: Terrestrial use is inferred from the locomotor skeleton; the locality and formation do not prove a shoreline microhabitat
ecology.locomotion: Running and terrestrial locomotion are inferred from limb proportions and osteology; performance was not observed
ecology.bodySize: Wolf-sized pakicetid in the authors' comparison
ecology.guild: Terrestrial early-cetacean interpretation with ecological guild bounded to the named sample

traits: Cetacean-like basicranial ear region in skull H-GSP 96231
Weight-bearing limbs and running adaptations in separately catalogued postcrania
Locality-composite reconstruction combining multiple individuals
evidenceSummary: The skull and postcranial bones from H-GSP Locality 62 are not one associated skeleton. Their anatomy supports a terrestrial body-plan interpretation, but does not establish a shoreline habitat or make *Pakicetus* a direct ancestor.

title.en: A locality composite of skull and postcrania
title.zh: H-GSP 62 号地点的组合复原

text.en: The cited account of *Pakicetus attocki* combines skull H-GSP 96231 with vertebrae and limb bones catalogued separately from H-GSP Locality 62 at Ganda Kas. These are unassociated specimens, not a single “wolf-sized” skeleton. Cetacean-like features in the skull’s ear region and weight-bearing, running-associated postcrania support a terrestrial early-whale interpretation.
text.zh: Pakicetus attocki 的复原把头骨 H-GSP 96231 与 H-GSP 62 号地点分别编目的椎骨和肢骨组合起来。它们来自同一地点，却不是同一具关联骨架。头骨耳区的鲸类样特征，以及颅后材料中的承重肢骨和奔跑相关特征，支持其具有显著陆地运动能力的早期鲸类解释。

title.en: The ear region and load-bearing postcrania
title.zh: 耳区头骨与分别编目的肢骨

text.en: Skull H-GSP 96231 has cetacean-like features in its basicranial ear region. Separately catalogued postcranial material from the locality preserves weight-bearing limb bones and features associated with running. The reconstruction combines these unassociated specimens rather than one skeleton.
text.zh: 头骨 H-GSP 96231 的基底颅区具有鲸类样耳部特征。分别编目的颅后材料保存了承重肢骨及与奔跑相关的特征。身体复原组合了同一地点的多件标本，而非一具彼此关联的骨架。

title.en: What the locality composite can support
title.zh: 陆地运动解释的边界

text.en: Limb proportions and osteology support a terrestrial, running-adapted interpretation, but gait and performance were not observed. The locality and formation do not establish a shoreline microhabitat, and the cited study does not assign prey remains to the sample. “Wolf-sized” is an author comparison for this composite, not a mass measurement.
text.zh: 肢骨比例和骨骼结构支持陆地运动及奔跑适应的解释，却不是步态或运动表现的直接观察。地点和地层不能确定岸边微栖地，所引研究也没有把猎物遗骸归入这些材料。“狼大小”是作者对地点组合样本的比较描述，并非体重测量。

title.en: Same locality, separate specimens
title.zh: 同一地点不等于同一具骨架

text.en: The skull and postcranial bones from H-GSP Locality 62 are not one associated skeleton. Their anatomy supports a terrestrial body-plan interpretation, but does not establish a shoreline habitat or make *Pakicetus* a direct ancestor.
text.zh: 头骨和颅后骨骼来自 H-GSP 62 号地点，却不是一具关联骨架。它们的解剖结构支持陆地型身体构型的解释，但不能确定具体岸边栖地；本页也不把 *Pakicetus* 写成直接祖先。

title.en: Skeletons of terrestrial cetaceans and the relationship of whales to artiodactyls
title.zh: Skeletons of terrestrial cetaceans and the relationship of whales to artiodactyls

scope.en: The Pakicetus reconstruction combines a skull and separately catalogued postcranial bones from one locality, not one associated skeleton.
scope.zh: Pakicetus 复原组合了同一地点的头骨与分别编目的颅后骨骼，并非一具关联骨架。

geography: Lowest Yumaque Member, Paracas Formation, Playa Media Luna, Pisco Basin, Peru
overview: MUSM 3580 preserves hind-limb anatomy consistent with weight bearing alongside aquatic adaptations; its ~42.6 Ma age is locality context, not a direct specimen date.

ecology.diet: Carnivory is inferred from cetacean dentition; prey and feeding behaviour are not preserved
ecology.habitat: Marine depositional context is documented, while amphibious habitat use is inferred from the skeleton
ecology.locomotion: Quadrupedal swimming and terrestrial weight bearing are functional reconstructions; no gait or swimming performance was observed
ecology.bodySize: Approximately 4 m long according to the reported skeletal dimensions
ecology.guild: Amphibious quadrupedal cetacean interpretation with route and behaviour unresolved

traits: Partial articulated holotype MUSM 3580 preserving mandibles and most major postcranial regions
Two fused sacrals, defined femoral head and hoof-like distal phalanges
Functional hind limbs alongside aquatic cetacean adaptations
evidenceSummary: MUSM 3580 anchors a Peruvian occurrence near 42.6 Ma; locomotion and westward dispersal are reconstructions, not observed activity.

title.en: MUSM 3580: hind limbs alongside aquatic adaptations
title.zh: 后足结构与水生适应并存

text.en: Holotype MUSM 3580 is a partial, articulated skeleton from Peru’s middle Eocene Yumaque Member, assigned in the dossier an age of about 42.6 million years. It preserves the jaws, much of the axial skeleton and portions of the limbs. Two fused sacrals, a defined femoral head and hoof-like toe bones make the hind-limb anatomy available for comparison alongside cetacean aquatic adaptations. The fossils support a mixed functional reconstruction, not a witnessed walk or swim; protocetid placement does not establish direct ancestry of later whales.
text.zh:
正模 MUSM 3580 是来自秘鲁中始新世 Yumaque 段的一具部分关节相连骨架，档案记录其年代约为 4,260 万年前。标本保存了下颌、相当部分的中轴骨骼及部分肢体。两块愈合的骶椎、明确的股骨头和蹄状趾骨，使后肢结构仍可供比较。

这些结构与鲸类的水生适应同时出现，因此 Peregocetus 记录了一种尚保留承重肢体解剖的身体构型。化石支持的是混合功能的复原，而非直接观察到行走或游泳；它在原鲸科中的位置也不能证明它是后期鲸类的直系祖先。

title.en: An amphibious whale from the middle Eocene of Peru reveals early South Pacific dispersal of quadrupedal cetaceans
title.zh: An amphibious whale from the middle Eocene of Peru reveals early South Pacific dispersal of quadrupedal cetaceans
