readerLimitations.en: These examples cover only the specified fossils and datasets. They do not describe all living populations, full life history, present range or species origin. Sediment estimates, direct fossil dates and genomic comparisons have different meanings.
readerLimitations.zh: 这些例子只覆盖所列化石和数据集，不能代表所有现生人群，也不是完整生活史、现今分布或物种起源的叙述。沉积年代估计、化石直接测年和基因组比较含义不同。

overview: About 280 early Eocene teeth, jaws and ankle bones expand the material used to interpret Dormaalocyon, replacing the older picture of “Miacis” latouri based on only two teeth. The larger sample supports dental, ankle and matrix observations, but does not by itself establish crown Carnivora membership or direct ancestry.

ecology.diet: Dentition supports an inference of small-prey or insect eating; stomach contents are not preserved.
ecology.habitat: A warm woodland is inferred from the locality context, not directly recorded as the animal’s preferred habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Tarsal anatomy suggests climbing ability, but movement was not observed.
ecology.bodySize: The sample documents a small carnivoraform; it does not provide a precise body-mass estimate.
ecology.guild: A small, climbing-capable faunivore is an anatomical inference, not a directly observed ecological role.
ecology.dietZh: 牙齿支持其取食小型猎物或昆虫的推断；没有保存胃内容物。
ecology.habitatZh: 根据地点背景推测当地曾有温暖林地，但不能据此断定这是该动物偏好的栖地。
ecology.locomotionZh: 跗骨形态提示其可能具有攀爬能力，但没有直接观察到运动方式。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 材料显示这是一种小型食肉形类，但没有给出精确体重估计。
ecology.guildZh: 把它描述为小型、可能善于攀爬的食虫或食肉动物，是基于解剖的推断，并非直接观察到的生态角色。

traits: The expanded sample supports a reconstructed permanent dentition.
Ankle bones include astragali and a calcaneum.
A sampled character matrix places it among basal carnivoraforms.
evidenceSummary: The fossils support observations of teeth, ankles and a sampled character matrix. They do not establish membership in crown Carnivora, direct ancestry or a global first carnivoramorphan.
overviewZh: 约 280 件早始新世牙齿、颌骨和踝骨材料扩展了对 Dormaalocyon 的认识，修正了过去仅凭两枚牙齿理解“Miacis” latouri 的图景。较大的样本支持牙齿、踝部和矩阵分析中的观察，但本身不能证明其属于冠群食肉目或是直系祖先。
traitsZh: 扩大的标本组合支持重建其恒齿列。
踝部材料包括距骨和跟骨。
一项取样的特征矩阵将其置于基础食肉形类中。
evidenceSummaryZh: 化石支持牙齿、踝部和取样特征矩阵中的观察，但不能证明其属于冠群食肉目、是直系祖先或为全球最早的食肉形类。

commonNameZh: 西藏化石豹亚科（原始归属）
overview: The original combined fossil–molecular analysis assigned three cranial fragments from the Zanda Basin to Panthera blytheae and placed it near snow leopards. Both the genus assignment and that relationship are revisable analytical results.

ecology.diet: Felid dentition supports a meat-eating diet, but the partial skull does not reveal prey choice.
ecology.habitat: The Zanda Basin's high-elevation environment is inferred from regional evidence, not directly measured from this skull.
ecology.locomotion: The cranial sample does not preserve how the animal moved.
ecology.bodySize: Body size was inferred from partial cranial material, not measured from a complete skeleton.
ecology.guild: The study inferred a large terrestrial carnivore from the teeth; prey and behaviour are not preserved.
ecology.dietZh: 猫科动物的齿列支持肉食性判断，但不完整的头骨无法揭示其猎物选择。
ecology.habitatZh: 根据区域证据推断 Zanda 盆地属于高海拔环境；这一点并非直接从该头骨测得。
ecology.locomotionZh: 颅骨样本没有保存其运动方式的信息。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 体型是根据部分头骨材料推断，而非依据完整骨架测量。
ecology.guildZh: 研究根据牙齿推断其为大型陆生食肉动物；化石没有保存猎物或行为信息。

traits: Adult partial cranium
Associated ramus and premaxilla fragments
Characters used in a combined total-evidence analysis
evidenceSummary: The study documents IVPP V18788.1–3 and its original magnetostratigraphic age model. The taxonomic assignment and proposed snow-leopard affinity remain revisable; one Zanda sample does not establish an Asian origin for all pantherines.

title.en: Three fragments and a 5.95–4.10 million-year envelope
title.zh: 三件碎片与 5.95–4.10 百万年的年代包络

text.en: The original study describes IVPP V18788.1 as an adult partial cranium, with IVPP V18788.2–3 adding associated jaw and premaxilla fragments from China's Zanda Basin. The 5.95–4.10 million-year envelope follows the study's original magnetostratigraphic framework; it is not a species-wide first or last appearance.
text.zh: 原研究将 IVPP V18788.1 描述为成年个体的局部颅骨，IVPP V18788.2–3 补充了相关下颌支和前颌骨碎片，材料来自中国札达盆地。5.95–4.10 百万年的年代包络遵循原研究的磁性地层框架，并非该物种的首现或末现。

title.en: A proposed snow-leopard affinity, not a settled ancestor
title.zh: 提出的雪豹亲缘关系，不是已定论的祖先

text.en: The combined analysis assigned the fragments to Panthera and recovered an affinity with snow leopards. These are analytical placements, not facts visible in the fossil itself. Felid teeth support carnivory, but this cranial sample does not identify prey, movement or habitual habitat, and one Tibetan locality cannot establish the geographic origin of all pantherines.
text.zh: 综合分析将这些碎片归入 Panthera，并恢复出与雪豹的亲缘关系。这些是分析位置，不能直接从化石本身看出。猫科牙齿支持肉食性，但这组颅骨材料不能确定猎物、运动方式或惯常栖地；西藏一个地点也不能确定整个豹亚科的地理起源。

title.en: Tseng et al. (2014), Zanda Basin pantherine fossils
title.zh: Tseng 等（2014），札达盆地豹亚科化石

scope.en: IVPP V18788.1–3, the Zanda Basin locality, original magnetostratigraphic framework, Figures 1–4, Table S1 and Data S1–S3. The study supports its combined-analysis placement; it does not make the snow-leopard affinity or a pantherine origin in Asia uncontested.
scope.zh: IVPP V18788.1–3、札达盆地地点、原始磁性地层年代框架、图 1–4、表 S1 与数据 S1–S3。该研究支持综合分析中的位置，但不能使雪豹亲缘关系或豹亚科起源于亚洲成为无争议结论。

overviewZh: 综合分析将札达盆地三件头骨碎片归入 Panthera blytheae，并提出其与雪豹近缘；分类位置仍可修订。
evidenceSummaryZh: IVPP V18788.1–3 沿用原研究的磁性地层年代框架；单一地点样本不能判定豹亚科起源于亚洲。
traitsZh: 原研究将 IVPP V18788.1 描述为成年个体的局部颅骨。
IVPP V18788.2–3 补充了相关下颌支和前颌骨碎片。
具名材料的性状用于化石与分子综合证据分析；分类位置仍取决于分析。

overview: Holotype NUFV 405 preserves about 65% of one skeleton. Its weight-bearing limbs occur with traits used to infer freshwater swimming, a combination relevant to hypotheses about pinnipedimorph transitions but not proof of a direct ancestor.

ecology.diet: Dentition supports a carnivorous diet; prey are not directly preserved.
ecology.habitat: The fossil occurs in a freshwater-lake deposit. A habitual freshwater habitat is inferred rather than observed.
ecology.locomotion: Limb and body proportions support both terrestrial and semiaquatic capability as interpretations, not measured performance.
ecology.bodySize: The animal is described as medium musteloid-sized; the available account does not give a complete population range.
ecology.guild: A semiaquatic predatory role is inferred from anatomy and setting.
ecology.dietZh: 牙齿支持肉食性推断；没有直接保存猎物。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石出自淡水湖沉积层。长期利用淡水栖地是推断，并非直接观察。
ecology.locomotionZh: 肢体和身体比例支持其既能陆行、又可能半水生的解释，但运动表现没有经过测量。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 资料将其描述为中等鼬科动物大小；现有叙述没有给出完整的种群体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 依据解剖和沉积背景推测其为半水生捕食者。

traits: The holotype includes substantial cranial and postcranial material.
Its limbs could bear weight and also show proportions used to infer swimming.
A long tail and freshwater depositional context contribute to the semiaquatic interpretation.
evidenceSummary: The associated skeleton supports an anatomical mosaic. Semiaquatic locomotion, pinnipedimorph placement and a freshwater transition remain interpretations, not a direct-ancestor sequence or observed behavior.
overviewZh: 正模 NUFV 405 保存了约 65% 的一具骨架。可承重的四肢与用于推断淡水游泳能力的特征并存；这一组合与鳍足类演化过渡假说有关，但不能证明直系祖先关系。
traitsZh: 正模保存了较多颅后和头骨材料。
四肢可支撑身体，也具有被用于推断游泳能力的比例特征。
长尾及淡水湖沉积背景共同参与半水生生活方式的解释。
evidenceSummaryZh: 关节连接的骨架支持一种解剖镶嵌组合。半水生运动、鳍足类位置和淡水环境转变仍属解释，并非直系祖先序列或观察到的行为。

geography: North American Hesperocyoninae localities sampled by Wang
overview: Wang's monograph studies named Hesperocyon fossils within the extinct hesperocyonine canid radiation. A morphology matrix scores cranial and dental characters to test relationships among sampled species; it does not identify Hesperocyon as a direct ancestor of later canids.

ecology.diet: The systematic monograph does not directly establish diet.
ecology.habitat: The monograph's fossil localities do not establish a genus-wide habitat.
ecology.locomotion: The cited monograph does not establish postcranial locomotor performance.
ecology.bodySize: The sampled material is not used here to estimate a genus-wide body-size range.
ecology.guild: The cited systematic evidence does not assign a single ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: 系统分类专著没有直接确定其食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 专著列出的化石地点不能确定该属整体的生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所引专著没有确定其头后骨骼所反映的运动能力。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 此处未利用取样材料估算该属整体的体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 所引系统学证据未指定单一生态类群。

traits: Named Hesperocyon specimens revised in a fossil canid monograph
Dental and cranial characters scored in a morphology matrix
Species-level relationships tested within sampled Hesperocyoninae
evidenceSummary: The 40–29 Ma display refers only to Hesperocyon material sampled in Wang's monograph and its North American localities. It is not a complete genus range, a global origination or extinction estimate, or a continuous-occupancy claim. The systematic sample does not directly establish ecology or direct ancestry.

title.en: Named fossils and a cranial–dental matrix
title.zh: 具名化石与头骨—牙齿矩阵

text.en: Wang's revision assembles named fossil material and scores cranial and dental characters to test species-level relationships within Hesperocyoninae, an extinct canid subfamily. The results describe the sampled fossils and analysis; they do not make Hesperocyon a demonstrated direct ancestor of later dogs.
text.zh: Wang 的修订汇集具名化石，并编码头骨和牙齿性状，检验已灭绝犬科亚科黄昏犬亚科内部的物种关系。结果描述所取样化石及分析，并未证明 Hesperocyon 是后期犬类的直系祖先。

title.en: The 40–29 Ma window has limited scope
title.zh: 40–29 Ma 窗口的范围有限

text.en: The monograph's Hesperocyon sample comes from North American Hesperocyoninae localities. The 40–29 Ma display is a source-bounded window, not a global species duration, exact origin or extinction date, or claim of continuous presence. The cited systematic work does not directly establish diet, habitat, movement, body-size range or one ecological guild.
text.zh: 专著中的 Hesperocyon 样本来自北美黄昏犬亚科地点。40–29 Ma 是来源限定的窗口，不是全球物种延限、精确起源或灭绝年代，也不表示连续存在。所引系统研究没有直接确定食性、栖地、运动方式、体型范围或单一生态功能群。

title.zh: Phylogenetic systematics of the Hesperocyoninae (Carnivora: Canidae)

overviewZh: Wang 的专著以头骨和牙齿矩阵检验灭绝黄昏犬亚科中 Hesperocyon 的种间关系；未将其认定为后期犬类的直系祖先。
evidenceSummaryZh: 40–29 Ma 仅对应专著所取样的北美 Hesperocyon 材料，不表示全球分布或连续的属级历史。
traitsZh: 专著修订了具名 Hesperocyon 化石材料；本页没有将这些标本合并为范围不明的属级样本。
形态矩阵对取样化石的头骨与牙齿性状进行编码。
分析检验取样黄昏犬亚科内部的物种关系，并未证明祖先序列。

geography: Pyramid Hill Sandstone Member, Jewett Sand
overview: The virtually complete Enaliarctos mealsi skeleton LACM 4321 anchors a study of early pinniped locomotor anatomy. Its vertebrae and limbs support comparisons of aquatic and terrestrial capability, not a direct-ancestor claim or a complete genus history.

ecology.diet: Not resolved by the cited skeletal locomotor study
ecology.habitat: Jewett Sand depositional setting; habitual ecology is not directly observed
ecology.locomotion: Aquatic and terrestrial locomotor capacities inferred comparatively from axial and limb anatomy
ecology.bodySize: Not projected as a genus-wide body-size estimate from one skeleton
ecology.guild: No feeding guild is assigned from the cited skeletal evidence
ecology.dietZh: 所引骨骼运动研究没有确定食性。
ecology.habitatZh: LACM 4321 出自 Jewett Sand 沉积环境；这一记录没有直接观察动物的惯常栖地。
ecology.locomotionZh: 轴骨和肢体解剖支持对水生及陆生运动能力的比较推断，并非运动表现测量。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 本页没有根据一具骨架推算全属体型。
ecology.guildZh: 所引骨骼证据没有指定取食功能群。

traits: Virtually complete LACM 4321 skeleton
Flexible lumbar vertebral morphology in the comparative interpretation
Flipper-like limbs with developed bony processes and muscle-attachment areas
evidenceSummary: LACM 4321 comes from the Pyramid Hill Sandstone Member of California's Jewett Sand and is dated to approximately 23 Ma. Swimming strokes, habitual habitat, diet and a universal pinniped history are not directly observed in this specimen.

title.en: One skeleton preserves spine and limbs together
title.zh: 一具骨架同时保存脊柱与四肢

text.en: LACM 4321 is a virtually complete skeleton of Enaliarctos mealsi. The study draws on lumbar vertebrae, flipper-like limbs and developed bony processes with muscle-attachment areas to compare locomotor anatomy. These are observations on one fossil, not measurements of every Enaliarctos species or a population-wide size range.
text.zh: LACM 4321 是一具近乎完整的 Enaliarctos mealsi 骨架。研究利用其腰椎、鳍状四肢，以及发达的骨突和肌肉附着区比较运动解剖。这些是对一件化石的观察，不是对所有 Enaliarctos 物种的测量，也不能给出种群体型范围。

title.en: Anatomy suggests capability, not observed behavior
title.zh: 解剖提示能力，不等于观察到行为

text.en: Comparisons of the spine and limbs are used to infer how this animal may have moved in water and on land. A skeletal model can test anatomical capability, but it does not preserve a swimming stroke, daily habitat or feeding event. The roughly 23 Ma occurrence is one central California record, not a route of pinniped dispersal.
text.zh: 研究通过比较脊柱与四肢，推断这只动物可能如何在水中和陆地上移动。骨骼模型可以检验解剖能力，却不会保存游泳动作、日常栖地或摄食事件。约 23 Ma 的产出记录来自加利福尼亚中部一处地点，不是鳍足类扩散路线。

overviewZh: 近乎完整的 Enaliarctos mealsi 骨架 LACM 4321 保存脊柱与四肢，是早期鳍足类运动解剖比较的核心样本。
evidenceSummaryZh: LACM 4321 出自 Jewett Sand 的 Pyramid Hill Sandstone Member，约 23 Ma；运动能力来自比较推断。
traitsZh: LACM 4321 保存了一具近乎完整的 Enaliarctos mealsi 骨架。
比较解释利用了灵活的腰椎形态。
四肢呈鳍状，并保存发达的骨突和肌肉附着区域。

overview: Holotype cranium UCMP 85202 is associated with skull, jaw and postcranial material from southern California, dated about 46.2–42 Ma. A broad morphology analysis leaves nearby carnivoramorphan relationships unresolved; a Paleogene-only subset places the genus among caniforms outside crown Canoidea.

ecology.diet: A six-variable discriminant model predicts carnivory for the holotype with 83% posterior probability; this is a model result, not observed feeding.
ecology.habitat: The specimens come from member C of the Santiago Formation; this depositional context does not establish habitual habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Postcranial elements are known, but the cited studies do not establish locomotor performance.
ecology.bodySize: A tooth-based regression estimates about 6 kg for the holotype; the estimate is not generalized across the genus.
ecology.guild: No broader ecological guild is assigned from a dietary classifier.
ecology.dietZh: 一个包含六个变量的判别模型以 83% 的后验概率预测正模为食肉性；这是模型结果，并非观察到的摄食行为。
ecology.habitatZh: 标本来自圣地亚哥组 C 段；这一沉积背景不能确定其惯常栖息环境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 已知有后颅骨材料，但所引研究未能确定其运动能力。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 基于牙齿的回归估计正模体重约为 6 kg；这一估计未推广到整个属。
ecology.guildZh: 根据摄食分类器结果，没有为其指定更广泛的生态功能类群。

traits: The holotype UCMP 85202 preserves the cranium and dentition.
Associated SDSNH specimens add cranial, mandibular and selected postcranial bones.
The phylogenetic sample combines named cranial and postcranial material.
evidenceSummary: A six-variable discriminant model predicts carnivory for the holotype with 83% posterior probability, and a tooth-based regression estimates about 6 kg. Both are model outputs. The broader placement depends on the sampled morphology matrix; these results do not establish observed feeding, direct ancestry or a complete genus range.
overviewZh: 正模头骨 UCMP 85202 与南加州头骨、颌骨和颅后材料相关，年代约为 46.2–42 Ma。广泛形态分析未解决近缘食肉形类关系；仅含古近纪类群的子集将该属置于冠群犬总科之外的犬形类中。
evidenceSummaryZh: 六变量判别模型以 83% 的后验概率预测正模为食肉性，基于牙齿的回归估计其体重约为 6 kg；两者都是模型结果。较广的分类位置取决于取样形态矩阵，这些结果不能证明实际摄食、直系祖先关系或完整属级分布。

readerSources.title: A new basal caniform (Mammalia: Carnivora) from the middle Eocene of North America and remarks on the phylogeny of early carnivorans

scope.en: Tomiya (2011), pp. 2–3 and 13–16, Figures 2–8, Table 3 and Appendix S3: type and referred material, local horizon, matrix-based placements, and the 83% dietary classifier for the holotype.
scope.zh: Tomiya（2011），第 2–3、13–16 页，图 2–8、表 3 与附录 S3：正模及归入标本、局部层位、矩阵分析位置，以及正模的 83% 食性分类器结果。

title.en: UCMP 85202 and a bounded southern California sample
title.zh: UCMP 85202 与范围有限的南加州样本

text.en: Holotype cranium UCMP 85202 is associated with skull, jaw and postcranial material from southern California, dated about 46.2–42 Ma. A broad morphology analysis leaves nearby carnivoramorphan relationships unresolved; a Paleogene-only subset places the genus among caniforms outside crown Canoidea.
text.zh: 正模头骨 UCMP 85202 与南加州头骨、颌骨和颅后材料相关，年代约为 46.2–42 Ma。广泛形态分析未解决近缘食肉形类关系；仅含古近纪类群的子集将该属置于冠群犬总科之外的犬形类中。

title.en: A model and a matrix answer different questions
title.zh: 模型与矩阵回答不同问题

text.en: A six-variable discriminant model predicts carnivory for the holotype with 83% posterior probability, and a tooth-based regression estimates about 6 kg. Both are model outputs. The broader placement depends on the sampled morphology matrix; these results do not establish observed feeding, direct ancestry or a complete genus range.
text.zh: 六变量判别模型以 83% 的后验概率预测正模为食肉性，基于牙齿的回归估计其体重约为 6 kg；两者都是模型结果。较广的分类位置取决于取样形态矩阵，这些结果不能证明实际摄食、直系祖先关系或完整属级分布。

traitsZh: 正模 UCMP 85202 保存了头骨和齿列。
关联的 SDSNH 标本补充了颅骨、下颌和部分头后骨骼。
系统发育样本结合了具名的头骨和后颅骨材料。

overview: Kretzoiarctos beatrix is described from left fourth premolar MNCN-CSIC NV-2-42, right first molar NV-2-40 and partial mandible IPS 46473 from two Spanish middle Miocene localities. A fossil-and-living bear matrix places the genus within Ailuropodinae; that placement is an analytical result.

ecology.diet: Dental comparisons suggest a more herbivorous tendency; feeding was not observed
ecology.habitat: Spanish locality records only; habitual habitat is not directly observed
ecology.locomotion: Not resolved by the cited dental and mandibular material
ecology.bodySize: Small-sized ailuropodine in the published diagnosis; no population estimate is projected
ecology.guild: No ecological guild is assigned from the available dental sample
ecology.dietZh: 牙齿比较提示其食性可能更偏植食。所研究牙齿没有直接记录摄食行为。
ecology.habitatZh: 本页记录了西班牙地点，但没有直接观察或重建其偏好栖地。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所引牙齿和下颌材料不能确定运动方式。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 已发表的鉴定将其描述为小型熊猫亚科成员；本页没有从样本推算种群体型。
ecology.guildZh: 现有牙齿与下颌材料不足以指定生态功能群。

traits: Holotype left P4 MNCN-CSIC NV-2-42
Paratype right M1 NV-2-40 and partial mandible IPS 46473
Published dental and mandibular morphology documented from the named specimens
evidenceSummary: The named dental specimens and localities are direct records. Subfamily placement and a more herbivorous tendency come from comparative analyses; they do not establish direct ancestry, an origin centre or a global first appearance.

title.en: A bear represented by teeth and a partial jaw
title.zh: 由牙齿和部分下颌代表的熊类

text.en: The account centers on holotype left P4 MNCN-CSIC NV-2-42, paratype right M1 NV-2-40 and partial mandible IPS 46473 from two Spanish localities. These named teeth and jaw define the described anatomical sample.
text.zh: 本页材料包括正模左侧第四前臼齿 MNCN-CSIC NV-2-42、副模右侧第一臼齿 NV-2-40 和部分下颌 IPS 46473，来自西班牙两个地点。这些具名牙齿和下颌构成所描述的形态样本。

title.en: A comparative placement, not a panda ancestor
title.zh: 比较分析的位置，不是大熊猫祖先

text.en: A matrix combining living and fossil bears places Kretzoiarctos within Ailuropodinae. Dental comparisons suggest a more herbivorous tendency, but feeding was not observed. The sample does not identify a direct ancestor of the giant panda or prove identical ecology.
text.zh: 结合现生与化石熊类的矩阵将 Kretzoiarctos 置于熊猫亚科。牙齿比较提示其食性可能更偏植食，但研究没有观察进食。现有样本不能确认它是大熊猫的直系祖先，也不能证明生态完全相同。

evidenceSummaryZh: 列出的牙齿标本和地点是直接记录。亚科归属和偏向植食的趋势来自比较分析；这些分析不能确定直接祖先关系、起源中心或全球最早出现时间。
overviewZh: K. beatrix 依据西班牙两处中中新世地点的三件牙齿及部分下颌描述；形态矩阵将其置于熊猫亚科 Ailuropodinae。
traitsZh: 正模为左侧第四前臼齿 MNCN-CSIC NV-2-42。
副模包括右侧第一臼齿 NV-2-40 和部分下颌 IPS 46473。
已发表的牙齿和下颌形态依据具名标本记录；更广的分类位置来自比较分析。

overview: Holotype AM F66763 is a fragment of right dentary with three molars from the Early Cretaceous Griman Creek Formation at Lightning Ridge, Australia. Comparison with monotreme and tribosphenic tooth patterns supports its identification as Steropodon galmani, while the 110–100 Ma interval remains a broad formation-level envelope rather than a direct specimen date or the full range of monotremes.
overviewZh: 正模 AM F66763 是一块带三枚臼齿的右侧齿骨碎片，出自澳大利亚 Lightning Ridge 的早白垩世 Griman Creek 组。与单孔类和三尖型牙齿模式的比较支持将其鉴定为 Steropodon galmani；110–100 Ma 仍是宽泛的组级年代包络，不是标本直接定年或单孔类的完整延限。

ecology.diet: Molar form permits a limited feeding inference; no food is preserved.
ecology.habitat: The jaw comes from Griman Creek deposits; its habitual habitat is not established.
ecology.locomotion: Movement is not preserved by the jaw.
ecology.bodySize: Whole-body size cannot be measured from this jaw alone.
ecology.guild: The teeth allow only a limited feeding inference; a broader ecological role is unresolved.
ecology.dietZh: 臼齿形态允许作有限的摄食推断；没有保存食物。
ecology.habitatZh: 颌骨来自 Griman Creek 沉积层；尚未确定其习惯性生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 颌骨没有保存移动信息。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 仅凭这件下颌无法测量全身体型。
ecology.guildZh: 牙齿仅支持有限的摄食推断；更广泛的生态角色仍未确定。

traits: Fragment of the right lower jaw (dentary)
Three preserved molars
Teeth compared with monotreme and tribosphenic patterns
evidenceSummary: AM F66763 directly records a jaw fragment and three molars. Its 110–100 Ma interval is broad formation-level context; monotreme affinity and feeding are dental interpretations, not evidence for direct ancestry or a complete monotreme body plan.
evidenceSummaryZh: AM F66763 直接记录一块下颌碎片和三枚臼齿。110–100 Ma 是宽泛的地层背景；单孔类归属和摄食方式属于牙齿比较所得的解释，并非直系祖先或完整单孔类体制的证据。
traitsZh: 右下颌骨（齿骨）残片。
保存了三颗臼齿。
将牙齿与单孔类和三尖齿型进行比较。

overview: CAGS 01-IG-1a,b preserves an articulated skeleton, but matrix placements vary between basal Eutheria and outside Theria; neither result establishes ancestry.
overviewZh: *Eomaia scansoria* 的关节连接正模 CAGS 01-IG-1a,b 保存了头骨、牙齿和大部分头后骨骼，包括足与爪。原始分析曾将其置于基干真兽类；后来的联合矩阵也可能把 *Eomaia* 放到兽类之外。其位置取决于所取样的性状和分析方法，任何一个矩阵结果都不等于祖先关系。

ecology.diet: Dentition supports a small-prey or faunivorous interpretation; feeding was not observed.
ecology.habitat: The known occurrence is in the Yixian Formation; habitual microhabitat is not established by the lake deposits alone.
ecology.locomotion: Scansoriality is inferred from limb and foot proportions, not observed climbing.
ecology.bodySize: A small mammal represented by one articulated skeleton; population variation is unknown.
ecology.guild: A small scansorial faunivore is an anatomical inference, not an observed guild.
ecology.dietZh: 齿列支持其可能捕食小型猎物或以动物为食的解释；没有观察到摄食行为。
ecology.habitatZh: 已知化石产自义县组；仅凭湖相沉积不能确定其惯常微栖息环境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 根据四肢和足部比例推断其具有攀援适应，而非直接观察到攀爬行为。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 一件关节相连骨架代表的小型哺乳动物；种群内的体型变异未知。
ecology.guildZh: 将其描述为小型、善于攀爬的食动物，是基于解剖结构的推断，并非观察到的生态功能类群。

traits: Articulated skull and postcranial skeleton
Dentition, feet and claws are available for comparison
Therian placement changes across sampled phylogenetic matrices
evidenceSummary: The single holotype supports anatomical study, while later matrices may place Eomaia outside Theria; 125.8–124.1 Ma is Yixian context, not direct specimen dating.

readerLimitations.en: The 125.8–124.1 Ma interval is the Yixian sample context, not a direct date on the holotype or a universal therian first appearance. Small-prey feeding and scansorial movement are anatomical interpretations; this single skeleton cannot establish population variation or habitual microhabitat.
readerLimitations.zh: 125.8–124.1 Ma 是义县组样本背景，不是正模的直接测年，也不是兽类的全球首现时间。小型猎物食性与攀援能力是依据牙齿和四肢作出的解释；单件骨架不能说明种群差异或惯常微栖地。

evidenceSummaryZh: 唯一一件关节相连的正模支持对解剖结构的详细描述，也支持原始的基干真兽类检验。后来的综合分析可能将 *Eomaia* 移出兽类；125.8–124.1 Ma 是所取样的义县组背景，并非兽类普遍的首次出现时间，也不是该标本的直接定年。
traitsZh: 关节相连的头骨和后颅骨。
齿列、足部和爪可供比较。
在不同取样的系统发育特征矩阵中，其兽类位置有所变化。

overview: Holotype ROM 55351A preserves elongated wings, five hand claws and a relatively small cochlea; matrix placement, flight and echolocation remain interpretations.
overviewZh: ROM 55351A 保存加长翼、手部五指上的爪和相对较小的耳蜗；飞行、回声定位及系统位置均为比较或分析结果，52.5–50.3 Ma 仅是地点背景。

ecology.diet: Insect-eating is inferred from the teeth; prey is not preserved.
ecology.habitat: The fossil comes from Green River lake deposits; a roosting site is not known.
ecology.locomotion: Wing anatomy supports powered flight, but performance is not directly observed.
ecology.bodySize: A small bat represented by a nearly complete skeleton; no broader size range is established here.
ecology.guild: An aerial insect-eater is inferred; specialized echolocation remains unresolved.
ecology.dietZh: 根据牙齿推断其食虫；化石未保存猎物。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自 Green River 湖相沉积；其栖息的洞所未知。
ecology.locomotionZh: 翼部解剖结构支持其具备主动飞行能力，但未直接观察飞行表现。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 由近乎完整骨架代表的一种小型蝙蝠；这里没有确定更广的体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 研究推断其为在空中捕食昆虫的动物；是否具有专门化回声定位能力仍未确定。

traits: Elongated wing elements
Claws on all five digits of the hand
Relatively small cochlea compared with the sampled echolocating bats
evidenceSummary: ROM 55351A documents wing and cochlear anatomy; flight, diet and echolocation are inferred, and 52.5–50.3 Ma is locality context, not a global bat origin.
evidenceSummaryZh: ROM 55351A 记录翼和耳蜗结构；飞行、食性和回声定位属推断，52.5–50.3 Ma 是地点背景，不代表蝙蝠全球起源。
traitsZh: 翼部骨骼较长。
手部五指均有爪。
与所取样的回声定位蝙蝠相比，耳蜗相对较小。

geography: Lower bone bed, phosphate bed IIa
overview: The *Eritherium azzouzorum* hypodigm includes holotype skull MNHN PM69 and 14 referred specimens from Sidi Chennane. Their skull and teeth supply characters for a comparative matrix testing the position of this early proboscidean. The matrix result is an analysis of sampled characters, not a direct-ancestry claim.
overviewZh: *Eritherium azzouzorum* 的材料来自 Sidi Chennane，包括正模头骨 MNHN PM69 和 14 件归入标本。研究将其头骨和牙齿特征放入比较性状矩阵，用于检验这类早期长鼻类的位置。矩阵结果来自对取样性状的分析，并非化石直接给出的祖先关系。

ecology.diet: Dental comparisons support a limited functional interpretation of feeding; diet is not directly observed.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from an Early Thanetian phosphate basin. This depositional setting does not establish the animal’s usual habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Cranial and dental fossils do not establish locomotion.
ecology.bodySize: Dental allometry gives an estimated mass of 3–8 kg; this is a calculation, not a direct measurement.
ecology.guild: No feeding guild is directly observed; broad comparisons with ungulates remain interpretive.
ecology.dietZh: 牙齿比较支持对其摄食功能作有限解释；食性并非直接观察所得。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自早塞兰特期的磷酸盐沉积盆地。这一沉积环境不能确定该动物通常生活的栖息地。
ecology.locomotionZh: 头骨和牙齿化石不能确定其运动方式。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 牙齿异速生长关系给出的体重估计为 3–8 kg；这是计算结果，并非直接测量值。
ecology.guildZh: 没有直接观察到其摄食功能类群；与有蹄类的大范围比较仍属解释。

traits: The holotype preserves the rostrum and upper teeth
Fourteen referred specimens add upper and lower teeth and cranial material
A character-matrix analysis proposes a stem-proboscidean position
evidenceSummary: The locality, 15-specimen hypodigm and skull–tooth anatomy are directly described. Stem placement, the 3–8 kg mass estimate and ecological readings depend on comparisons or analysis; the fossil is not identified as a direct ancestor.
evidenceSummaryZh: 研究直接描述了地点、十五件标本组合和头骨—牙齿形态。干群长鼻类位置、3–8 kg 体重估算与生态解释依赖比较或分析；这些化石没有被确定为后续长鼻类的直系祖先。

title.en: MNHN PM69 and the 15-specimen hypodigm
title.zh: MNHN PM69 与十五件标本组合

text.en: The *Eritherium azzouzorum* hypodigm includes holotype skull MNHN PM69 and 14 referred specimens from Sidi Chennane. Their skull and teeth supply characters for a comparative matrix testing the position of this early proboscidean. The matrix result is an analysis of sampled characters, not a direct-ancestry claim.
text.zh: *Eritherium azzouzorum* 的材料来自 Sidi Chennane，包括正模头骨 MNHN PM69 和 14 件归入标本。研究将其头骨和牙齿特征放入比较性状矩阵，用于检验这类早期长鼻类的位置。矩阵结果来自对取样性状的分析，并非化石直接给出的祖先关系。

title.en: The sample extends beyond the holotype
title.zh: 正模之外的十四件归入标本

text.en: Holotype skull MNHN PM69 preserves the rostrum and upper teeth. Fourteen referred specimens add upper and lower teeth and other cranial material, making this a 15-specimen hypodigm rather than a complete skeleton.
text.zh: 正模头骨 MNHN PM69 保存了吻部和上颌牙齿。另有十四件归入标本补充上、下颌牙齿和其他颅骨材料，因此证据来自十五件标本，而非一具完整骨架。

title.en: Dental allometry estimates mass; it does not weigh it
title.zh: 3–8 kg 是牙齿异速生长估值

text.en: Dental comparisons support a limited functional reading of feeding, while dental allometry estimates a mass of 3–8 kg. The value is calculated rather than directly measured, and the material does not identify a specific meal.

overview: A 144-character analysis places plesiopedal Dallasaurus and flipper-limbed hydropedal forms within Mosasauridae; limb grade alone does not define the family or show ancestry.
overviewZh:
沧龙科是生活于海洋的爬行动物，成员的肢体形态并不相同。Bell 与 Polcyn 的 144 性状分析同时纳入步行型肢体较明显的 Dallasaurus 和肢体更呈鳍状的鳍桨型成员；该分析把两种状态都放在沧龙科内。单凭肢体等级不能定义整个科，也不能据此把 Dallasaurus 写成后期成员的直系祖先。

## 食性、觅食和体型证据

五个马斯特里赫特期类群的牙釉质碳同位素支持样本中的海生肉食和资源分化；这组样本不能代表全科统一食谱，也无法完全拆分猎物、潜水和生境的影响。所选研究中的小型形态多为步行型，较大型形态多为鳍桨型；这是研究样本中的适应等级，不是全科精确体型范围。该分析并不显示每种沧龙都占据一个不同生态位。

## 地点和年代只覆盖具名样本

本档案举例的地点包括得州中北部的中土仑期 Dallasaurus 样本，以及马斯特里赫特标准地区最晚马斯特里赫特期的 Mosasaurus hoffmanni 标本。显示的约 9200 万至 6600 万年前范围连接两个局部样本；后一个标本位于当地 K/Pg 界线下方一米以内。它不是沧龙科全球精确的首现、末现或完整分布。

ecology.diet: Mosasaurids were marine carnivores, but their diets were not uniform. Carbon-isotope measurements from tooth enamel in five Maastrichtian taxa support resource partitioning among that sample. The small sample does not establish one family-wide menu or fully separate the effects of prey, diving and habitat.
ecology.habitat: The sampled animals lived in marine settings. Isotope comparisons suggest that foraging differed among the five Maastrichtian taxa, but the signal does not identify a single habitat for every mosasaurid. The Texas and Maastricht localities in this profile are examples, not a map of the family’s full distribution.
ecology.locomotion: The cited analysis compares plesiopedal limbs with the more flipper-shaped hydropedal condition. Its character coding places both within Mosasauridae and supports separate acquisitions of hydropedal limbs in the sampled tree. This is a phylogenetic result, not a simple march from walking to swimming.
ecology.bodySize: In the sampled comparison, smaller forms tend to have plesiopedal limbs and larger forms tend to be hydropedal. These are adaptive grades in the study sample, not a measured size range for every member of Mosasauridae.
ecology.guild: The five-taxon Maastrichtian isotope sample supports resource partitioning among marine carnivores. It does not show that every mosasaurid occupied a distinct niche or reveal the exact diet of each species.
ecology.dietZh: 沧龙科是海生食肉动物，但其食性并不一致。对五个 Maastrichtian 类群牙釉质的碳同位素测量支持该样本中的资源分化。样本量较小，不能据此确定整个科统一的食谱，也无法完全区分猎物、潜水和生境的影响。
ecology.habitatZh: 所取样的动物生活于海洋环境。同位素比较提示，马斯特里赫特期的五个类群觅食方式有所不同，但这些信号无法确定所有沧龙科成员共有的一种生境。本条列出的德克萨斯和马斯特里赫特地点只是实例，并非该科完整分布图。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所引分析比较了原始型四肢与更呈鳍状的水生型四肢。其特征编码将两者都置于沧龙科之内，并支持在所取样的系统树中水生型四肢分别演化。这个结果来自系统发育分析，并非从行走到游泳的简单线性演变。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 在所取样的比较中，体型较小者往往具有原始型四肢，体型较大者往往具有水生特化型四肢。这些是该研究样本中呈现的适应等级，并非沧龙科所有成员的实测体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 马斯特里赫特期五个类群的同位素样本支持海洋食肉动物之间存在资源分化。它没有表明每种沧龙科动物都占据不同生态位，也不能揭示每个物种的确切食谱。

traits: The cited phylogenetic analysis places both plesiopedal and hydropedal members within Mosasauridae.
Two incomplete Dallasaurus skeletons preserve cranial, axial and limb characters for the family-level comparison.
The sampled tree places plesiopedal and hydropedal limb conditions in separate lineages; this pattern is not a direct ancestor sequence.
evidenceSummary: Two Dallasaurus skeletons, five isotope-sampled taxa and one younger Mosasaurus specimen frame a sampled ~92–66 Ma envelope, not family-wide age bounds.
evidenceSummaryZh: 两个不完整 Dallasaurus 骨架和 144 性状系统分析提供形态与肢体演化证据；五个类群的同位素样本用于比较特定马斯特里赫特期动物的觅食差异；一件 Mosasaurus hoffmanni 标本提供较晚的出现记录。三种证据各有不同取样范围，合并后的年代外包区间不能当作全球首现或末现。
traitsZh: 所引系统发育分析将原始型四肢和水生型四肢成员都置于沧龙科之内。
两件不完整的 Dallasaurus 骨架保存了头骨、轴骨骼和四肢特征，可用于科级比较。
所取样的系统树将原始型和水生适应型肢体状态分别置于不同谱系；这种模式不是直接的祖先序列。

overview: Three Odontochelys specimens from southwestern China preserve a developed plastron, expanded ribs and neural plates, but no complete carapace. Pappochelys from Vellberg, Germany, preserves broadened ribs and paired gastralia. These named stem-turtle samples inform comparisons of shell evolution; they do not form a demonstrated ancestor sequence or date the origin of crown turtles.

evidenceSummary: Li et al. describe three Odontochelys specimens from southwestern China; Schoch and Sues describe Pappochelys from Vellberg. The comparison informs shell-evolution hypotheses, while each specimen and the published analyses retain their own limits.

title.en: What the two specimens contribute
title.zh: 两种标本各自记录了甲壳的不同构造

text.en: Odontochelys and Pappochelys preserve different combinations of ribs and shell bones. Researchers compare those named fossils to test how the turtle shell assembled. Their positions in a comparison do not show that one was the direct ancestor of the other, and neither fossil sets the date when crown turtles first appeared.
text.zh: Odontochelys 与 Pappochelys 保存了不同组合的肋骨和甲壳骨。研究者把这两件具名化石放在一起比较，以检验龟壳如何形成。比较中的位置不能证明一者是另一者的直系祖先，两种化石也不能确定冠群龟类首次出现的时间。

evidenceSummary: Named specimens and imaging studies support these matrix-dependent positions, not direct ancestors, crown first appearances or global ecological histories.

title.en: Three scans, three places on the lepidosaur tree
title.zh: 三组影像，三种系统树位置

text.en:
Three imaged fossils anchor this route through early lepidosaur history. Megachirella PZO 628 contributes CT-resolved skull, wrist and shoulder characters; Taytalura PVSJ 698 preserves a three-dimensionally exposed skull examined by CT; Bellairsia NMS G.2022.1.1 was studied with synchrotron tomography. These are complementary specimens, not one continuous lineage.

The cited analyses place Megachirella and Bellairsia on the squamate stem and Taytalura among early-diverging stem lepidosauromorphs. A stem placement means a fossil lies on the branch leading toward a living group, outside that group’s crown; it does not identify a direct ancestor. The route records anatomy and matrix-dependent relationships, not a shared diet or habitat for Lepidosauria.
text.zh:
三件经过成像研究的化石构成这条早期鳞龙类路线的支点。Megachirella PZO 628 提供 CT 解析的头骨、腕部和肩部性状；Taytalura PVSJ 698 保存了经 CT 检查的三维暴露头骨；Bellairsia NMS G.2022.1.1 则接受了同步辐射断层扫描研究。这些是互补样本，不是一条连续谱系。

所引分析把 Megachirella 和 Bellairsia 放在有鳞类干群，把 Taytalura 放在早期分出的鳞龙形类干群。干群位置表示化石位于通向现生类群的分支上、但在其冠群之外；这不等于认定直系祖先。这条路线记录的是解剖结构和依赖矩阵的系统关系，并未说明整个鳞龙类具有共同食性或生境。

overview: Mosasauroidea is branch-defined while Mosasauridae is node-defined; Dallasaurus anatomy and isotope studies address separate samples, not all mosasauroids.
overviewZh: Mosasauroidea 按分支定义，Mosasauridae 则围绕共同祖先及其后代定义。两具不完整的 Dallasaurus 骨架和五个马斯特里赫特期分类群的同位素研究回答不同问题，不能代表全部沧龙类。

ecology.diet: Tooth-enamel isotope values, considered alongside body-size estimates, distinguish resource use among five mosasaur taxa from the Maastrichtian type area. This is evidence for partitioning within that sample, not a single diet that can be assigned across Mosasauroidea.
ecology.habitat: The fossils and isotope comparisons come from marine settings: the Dallasaurus material is from middle Turonian north-central Texas, and the feeding comparison is from the Maastrichtian type area in the Netherlands. These local study settings do not map the group's full habitat range.
ecology.locomotion: The two Dallasaurus skeletons retain plesiopedal limbs. In the cited analysis, that limb grade is compared with hydropedal forms; the contrast describes sampled anatomy and does not by itself define family membership.
ecology.bodySize: Size estimates accompany the isotope sample for five named taxa from the Maastrichtian type area. They help interpret those comparisons but do not constitute a size range for Mosasauroidea worldwide.
ecology.guild: The five-taxon comparison supports resource partitioning in one Maastrichtian community. It does not place every mosasauroid in a fixed ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: 结合体型估计考察牙釉质同位素值，可区分马斯特里赫特阶模式产地五种沧龙类群的资源利用。这是该批样本中资源分化的证据，不能据此为沧龙超科整体指定单一食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石与同位素比较均来自海相环境：Dallasaurus 材料来自德克萨斯州中北部的中土仑期地层，食性比较则取自荷兰 Maastrichtian 型区。这些局部研究环境不能描绘该类群完整的生境范围。
ecology.locomotionZh: 两具 Dallasaurus 骨架都保留了原始型肢体。在所引分析中，这种肢体等级与水生适应型进行比较；这种差异描述的是样本中的解剖形态，本身不能界定科级归属。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 来自马斯特里赫特阶模式产地的五个具名类群，其同位素样本同时包含体型估计。这些估计有助于解释样本间比较，但不构成沧龙超科在全球范围内的体型区间。
ecology.guildZh: 对五个分类单元的比较支持某个 Maastrichtian 群落中的资源分化；这并不意味着可以为所有沧龙超科成员指定固定的生态类群。

traits: The cited nomenclatural analysis defines Mosasauroidea by a branch and Mosasauridae by a node, so the names need not cover identical sets on every phylogenetic tree.
Two incomplete Dallasaurus skeletons preserve skull and axial anatomy together with plesiopedal limbs, linking the taxon's position to more than isolated teeth.
The analysis compares plesiopedal and hydropedal limb grades as anatomical conditions; it treats those grades separately from the definition of a family.
evidenceSummary: Name definitions, two incomplete Dallasaurus skeletons and isotope data from five Maastrichtian taxa answer separate questions, not universal ecology.
evidenceSummaryZh: 类群定义的区分来自命名学分析；Dallasaurus 解剖和五类群马斯特里赫特期同位素样本回答的是不同问题。生态陈述仅适用于所研究的标本和地点，不据此指定所有沧龙类共有的食性、栖地或生态功能群。

readerLimitations.en: The page combines different evidence: name definitions, two incomplete Dallasaurus skeletons and isotope data from five Maastrichtian taxa. These samples inform specific clade, anatomy and resource-use questions; they do not establish one ecology or body-size range for all mosasauroids.
readerLimitations.zh: 本页并列的是不同证据：名称定义、两具不完整 Dallasaurus 骨架，以及五个马斯特里赫特期分类群的同位素数据。这些样本分别支持分支、解剖和资源利用方面的讨论，不能建立适用于全部沧龙类的统一生态或体型范围。

traitsZh: 所引命名学分析将 Mosasauroidea 定义为一个分支，将 Mosasauridae 定义为一个节点，因此在不同系统发育树上，这两个名称涵盖的类群未必完全相同。
两具不完整的 Dallasaurus 骨架共同保存了头骨、中轴骨骼和原始型四肢，使其系统位置的判断不只依赖孤立牙齿。
分析将原始型和水生特化型四肢等级作为解剖状态进行比较，并将这些等级与科的定义区分开来。

title.en: Character combinations in the Somerset sample
title.zh: 萨默塞特样本中的性状组合

text.en: The selected Hettangian Somerset specimens have cranial and postcranial character combinations used to distinguish the included species. The account records a streamlined body, large orbit, elongated rostrum and paddle-like limbs in this material; these observations remain sample-bounded.
text.zh: 所选赫塘期萨默塞特标本的颅骨与颅后性状组合用于鉴别纳入的物种。流线型体形、大眼眶、细长吻部和桨状肢体均是这批材料中的记录，不外推为整个属的特征。

title.en: Possible fish remains in one gullet
title.zh: 一具个体的消化道中可能有鱼类遗骸

text.en: One Ichthyosaurus communis individual preserves probable fish remains in its gullet. This documents feeding evidence for that specimen; it does not describe the diet of every species or the genus as a whole.
text.zh: 一具 Ichthyosaurus communis 个体的消化道内保存了可能属于鱼类的遗骸。这是该标本的取食证据，并不描述每个物种或整个属的食性。

title.en: Flippers and body proportions in the sample
title.zh: 鳍肢水下运动与样本中的身体差异

text.en:
Researchers interpret four flippers as hydrofoil-like paddles and test that idea with water-channel models using prescribed movements; the experiment does not observe a plesiosaur swimming.

The compared fossils also show a compact trunk, while neck and skull proportions differ among forms.
text.zh: 研究者把四个鳍肢解释为水下推进结构，并用预设鳍肢运动的水槽模型检验这一假说；实验没有观察蛇颈龙游泳。相关化石显示躯干紧凑，所比较形态间的颈部和头骨比例则有所不同。

title.en: Marine life and modelled swimming
title.zh: 海洋生活与模型化游泳方式

geography: Every continent; fossil record extremely patchy
overview: Pterosaurs are extinct flying archosaurs often placed near dinosaurs; their precise origin and flight performance depend on phylogenetic and biomechanical analyses.
overviewZh: 翼龙是已灭绝的飞行主龙类，通常被置于鸟跖类、靠近恐龙；其精确起源和近亲取决于系统发育分析。具名化石记录蛋、体表组织和翼部骨骼，飞行与起飞表现则来自模型。

ecology.diet: Pterosaur lineages did not share one diet. The available profile evidence describes varied feeding guilds, so a diet proposed for one form should not be applied to the entire order.
ecology.habitat: Pterosaur fossils are reported from every continent, but the record is very patchy. The evidence includes aerial and coastal settings; a fossil locality or depositional label does not by itself identify where an animal fed or spent most of its life.
ecology.locomotion: Pterosaur anatomy supports powered flight, and biomechanical studies test how animals could launch from the ground. Those studies model performance from preserved proportions and stated assumptions; fossils do not preserve the motion of a takeoff.
ecology.bodySize: The radiation ranged from very small forms to giants. This order-wide span is not a size estimate for any particular species.
ecology.guild: Pterosaurs occupied varied aerial feeding roles. “Aerial consumer” describes a broad ecological grouping, not one diet or way of life shared by every lineage.
ecology.dietZh: 翼龙各谱系并非共享一种食性。现有档案证据描述了多种摄食生态类群，因此不能把为某一类群提出的食性套用于整个翼龙目。
ecology.habitatZh: 翼龙化石见于各大洲，但化石记录十分零散。证据涵盖空中和海岸环境；化石产地或沉积环境标签本身不能指出动物在哪里觅食或度过大部分生命。
ecology.locomotionZh: 翼龙解剖特征支持其具有主动飞行能力；生物力学研究则检验动物可能如何从地面起飞。这些研究依据保存下来的身体比例及明示的假设建立模型；化石并未保存起飞动作本身。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 翼龙演化辐射中既有极小型，也有巨型类群。这个目级范围并非任何特定物种的体型估计。
ecology.guildZh: 翼龙占据多种空中取食生态位。“空中取食者”是宽泛的生态分组，并非所有支系共有的单一食性或生活方式。

traits: The flight membrane was supported mainly by an elongated fourth finger. This is a distinctive skeletal support for the wing; the membrane itself is rarely preserved.
Many pterosaurs had pneumatic bones containing air spaces. The extent and distribution of this feature varied among skeletons.
Quadrupedal ground launch has been tested with biomechanical models. It is a reconstruction from anatomy and assumptions, not a preserved behavior.
evidenceSummary: Fossils document eggs, integument and wing anatomy; flight and launch results are models bounded by specimens and assumptions.
evidenceSummaryZh: 具名化石记录蛋、体表组织和翼部骨骼；飞行与起飞结果来自受标本和假设限制的模型，并非保存下来的运动。

traitsZh: 翼膜主要由延长的第四指支撑。这是翼部独特的骨骼支撑结构；翼膜本身极少保存。
许多翼龙具有内部含气腔的气腔化骨骼；这一特征的程度和分布因骨骼而异。
研究通过生物力学模型检验了四足起跳。这是依据解剖结构和模型假设所作的重建，并非保存下来的行为。

title.en: An archosaur branch near dinosaurs
title.zh: 主龙类中接近恐龙的一支

text.en: Expanded anatomical analyses place pterosaurs within Ornithodira, on the archosaur branch close to dinosaurs. Their exact origin and closest relatives remain dependent on the characters and analyses used; this placement does not identify a direct dinosaur ancestor.
text.zh: 扩展解剖特征的系统分析将翼龙置于鸟跖类，属于接近恐龙的主龙类支系。但其确切起源和最近亲仍随所选特征与分析方法而变化；这种位置判断并未指出某个恐龙是翼龙的直接祖先。

title.en: A worldwide record with large gaps
title.zh: 全球都有记录，但缺口很大

text.en: The redescription of Carniadactylus documents a Norian pterosaur sample from the Late Triassic, but one dated locality does not establish the group’s first global appearance. A separate analysis of 108 pterosaur taxa reported remains from every continent while emphasizing severe gaps in where and when fossils are known. Geographic patterns therefore depend on an uneven, time-sensitive record.
text.zh: Carniadactylus 的重新描述记录了晚三叠世诺利期的翼龙材料，但一个有年代依据的地点不能确定翼龙类在全球的最早出现。另一项包含 108 个翼龙分类单元的分析报告称各大洲均有化石，同时强调已知记录在空间与时间上都有严重缺口。因此，地理格局解释受不均匀且随时间变化的化石记录影响。

title.en: What particular fossils preserve
title.zh: 特定化石究竟保存了什么

text.en: One Hamipterus block preserves many eggs, including embryo-bearing eggs, giving a direct fossil record of reproduction in that deposit. In a separate Crato Formation specimen, melanosome geometry in preserved integument was used to assess a possible signalling role. These are specific fossil cases; behavioral readings and feather-homology claims remain interpretations, not observations of living pterosaurs.
text.zh: 一块 Hamipterus 化石板保存了多枚卵，其中有些含胚胎，为该沉积地点提供了直接的翼龙繁殖化石记录。另一件来自 Crato 组的标本，其保存体表组织中的黑素体形态被用于评估可能的信号展示功能。这些结论属于特定化石案例；行为解释和“羽毛”同源判断仍是研究者的解释，不是对活体翼龙的直接观察。

title.en: Testing flight with explicit assumptions
title.zh: 用明确假设检验飞行能力

text.en: Biomechanical studies use reconstructed body mass, wing dimensions, muscle power and launch kinematics to test whether giant pterosaurs could fly and launch quadrupedally. Their outputs are feasibility results conditioned on those inputs, not preserved motions or measurements that apply uniformly across the pterosaur radiation.
text.zh: 生物力学研究以重建的体重、翼部尺寸、肌肉功率和起飞运动学为输入，检验巨型翼龙能否飞行及以四足方式起飞。其结论是在这些输入条件下得到的可行性结果，不是保存下来的动作，也不能一概推广到所有翼龙类群。

title.zh: Haliskia：骨骼观察与重建的界线
title.en: Haliskia: observations and reconstruction

text.zh: Haliskia peterseni 的 KK F1426 部分骨架提供一个比较入口：先看地层与保存部位，再看牙列和细长舌骨；约 4.6 米翼展是比较估计，摄食解释缺少直接内容物证据。属级导读把这些证据类型分开。它可与本页既有卵、体表和飞行模型研究对读，但不能把其他翼龙的观察移作 Haliskia 的事实；PBDB 补充目录路径也不代表唯一系统树。
text.en: Partial skeleton KK F1426 of Haliskia peterseni offers a comparison route: read the horizon and preserved elements before the teeth and elongated hyoid bones. Its approximately 4.6 m span is estimated comparatively, while feeding interpretations lack direct preserved contents. The genus guide separates these evidence types. Compare them with the egg, integument and flight-model studies already introduced here, retaining taxon-specific observations. A supplementary PBDB directory path does not represent a uniquely resolved phylogeny.

title.en: Organize fossil records by source classification
title.zh: 按来源分类组织化石记录

text.zh: Pterosauria 是本批 PBDB 路径中的 order 分类名称。其下本批可读 252 个固定工作名录物种的出现导读；这里使用数据库记录的父级路径编排资料，不以资料条目数量评定类群演化重要性，也不把这一路径视为唯一系统发育方案。
text.en: Pterosauria is recorded at rank order in this batch’s PBDB path. This route offers occurrence guides for 252 species in the fixed working roster. Recorded database parents organize the material; entry counts do not establish evolutionary importance, and this path is not treated as the only phylogenetic scheme.

title.en: Compare collections, strata and age brackets
title.zh: 从采集地、地层和年代对读

text.zh: 可以从 Seazzadactylus venieri、Kunpengopterus sinensis、Kunpengopterus antipollicatus、Eotephradactylus mcintireae、Ikrandraco avatar 开始，对照各页具名采集记录和原引文。本路线所含的全部本批物种合计有 405 条所选出现记录、277 个采集记录，地层名示例为 Dolomia di Forni、Tiaojishan、Chinle、Jiufotang。先读每个采集地自己的年代区间和鉴定限定，再看不同地点之间是否可比；出现、采集和物种数量不能混用为古种群规模。
text.en: Start with Seazzadactylus venieri, Kunpengopterus sinensis, Kunpengopterus antipollicatus, Eotephradactylus mcintireae, Ikrandraco avatar and compare each page’s named collections and original reference links. Across all species included in this group’s guide, there are 405 selected occurrences from 277 collections; example stratum names are Dolomia di Forni, Tiaojishan, Chinle, Jiufotang. Read each collection’s age bracket and identification qualifications before comparing sites. Occurrence, collection and species counts cannot be exchanged for ancient population size.

title.en: Baron (2021), The origin of Pterosaurs
title.zh: Baron（2021），翼龙的起源

scope.en: Systematic review and expanded anatomical phylogenetic analyses; supports an ornithodiran placement while retaining uncertainty over pterosaur origins and closest relatives.
scope.zh: 系统综述与扩展解剖系统分析支持将翼龙置于鸟跖类，同时保留其起源和最近亲的不确定性。

title.en: Dalla Vecchia (2009), Carniadactylus anatomy and systematics
title.zh: Dalla Vecchia（2009），Carniadactylus 的解剖与系统分类

scope.en: Detailed redescription and phylogenetic analysis of Norian pterosaur holotype MFSN 1797 and referred specimen MPUM 6009; this locality does not establish a global first appearance.
scope.zh: 对诺利期翼龙正模 MFSN 1797 与归入标本 MPUM 6009 的详细再描述和系统分析；该地点不能确定全球最早出现时间。

title.en: Upchurch et al. (2015), pterosaurian biogeography
title.zh: Upchurch 等（2015），翼龙地理分布分析

scope.en: Quantitative analysis of 108 pterosaur taxa; reports an every-continent record while emphasizing severe spatial and temporal patchiness and sampling-sensitive biogeographic inference.
scope.zh: 对 108 个翼龙分类单元进行定量分析；报告各大洲均有记录，同时指出时空分布极不均匀，地理推断受采样影响。

title.en: Wang et al. (2017), Hamipterus eggs and embryos
title.zh: Wang 等（2017），Hamipterus 的卵与胚胎

scope.en: Reports exposed Hamipterus eggs and embryo-bearing specimens from one fossil block; behavioral and hatchling-flight interpretations remain distinct from preserved evidence.
scope.zh: 报告一块化石板上的 Hamipterus 卵及含胚胎标本；行为和幼体飞行解释须与直接保存的证据区分。

title.en: Cincotta et al. (2022), pterosaur melanosomes and signalling
title.zh: Cincotta 等（2022），翼龙黑素体与信号展示

scope.en: Analyzes preserved integument and melanosome geometry in a Crato Formation pterosaur specimen; signalling function and exact colour are interpretive conclusions.
scope.zh: 分析 Crato 组一件翼龙标本保存的体表组织与黑素体形态；信号展示功能与确切颜色均属解释性结论。

title.en: Witton and Habib (2010), giant pterosaur flight models
title.zh: Witton 与 Habib（2010），巨型翼龙飞行模型

scope.en: Comparative scaling and biomechanical feasibility study; reconstructed mass, wing planform, muscle power and launch kinematics are model inputs, not direct observations.
scope.zh: 比较尺度与生物力学可行性研究；重建体重、翼面积、肌肉功率和起飞运动学均为模型输入，并非直接观察。

title.zh: Pentland 等（2024），Haliskia peterseni 的原始描述
title.en: Pentland et al. (2024), original description of Haliskia peterseni

scope.zh: KK F1426 描述与论文内比较、估计和假说；不扩展为种群或行为实测。
scope.en: KK F1426 description and the paper’s comparisons, estimates and hypotheses; not population or behavioral observations.

title.en: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02
title.zh: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02

scope.zh: 仅来源所述材料和数据库记录范围。
scope.en: Only material and database-record scope described by this source.

title.en: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02
title.zh: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02

scope.zh: 本批物种出现记录的阅读路径，不是整个类群的生态总结。
scope.en: Reading path through this batch’s species occurrence records, not a whole-group ecological summary.

title.en: Paleobiology Database Data Service 1.2 — occurrence field documentation
title.zh: Paleobiology Database Data Service 1.2 — occurrence field documentation

scope.zh: 解释数据库出现、采集、年代与层位字段，不替代原论文或标本复核。
scope.en: Interpret database occurrence, collection, age and strata fields; not a substitute for original papers or specimen review.

title.en: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02
title.zh: Paleobiology Database — Pterosauria occurrences and accepted hierarchy, 2026-10-02

scope.zh: PBDB 接受名、外部 OID 和记录父链；不与 COL 概念等同，不裁决系统发育。
scope.en: PBDB accepted name, external OID and recorded parent chain; no equivalence with COL or phylogenetic adjudication.

readerLimitations.en: This is a selective route through studies of pterosaur relationships, fossils, geography and flight biomechanics. The fossil record remains uneven: one dated locality or specimen cannot set the order’s complete range or life history. The cited studies do not establish a uniform diet or flight capability for all pterosaurs, and modelled launch results depend on each study’s specimens, inputs and assumptions.
readerLimitations.zh: 本页精选了翼龙亲缘关系、具名化石、地理记录和飞行力学研究。化石记录分布不均；单一地点或标本不能确定翼龙目的完整年代范围或生活史。所引研究不能为全目建立统一食性或飞行能力，模型结果受各研究所用材料、数据和假设限制。

geography: South Majiashan Quarry, Chaohu, Anhui, China
overview: Early Triassic maternal specimen AGM I-1 from south Majiashan Quarry preserves two embryos and an adjacent neonate. Its delayed ossification, dental and vertebral characters, and hypophalangeal flippers support assignment to Chaohusaurus, though species-level taxonomy can change.

ecology.diet: Diet is not preserved by this maternal specimen.
ecology.habitat: The animal is associated with the marine Majiashan depositional setting; its habitual habitat is not directly resolved.
ecology.locomotion: Paddle-like flippers are preserved, but gait and swimming performance were not measured.
ecology.bodySize: AGM I-1 records an adult with embryos; it does not establish a genus-wide size range.
ecology.guild: Predatory role is not directly observed in this specimen.
ecology.dietZh: 这件孕体标本没有保存食性证据。
ecology.habitatZh: 该动物与马家山海相沉积环境相关，但其惯常栖地没有被直接确定。
ecology.locomotionZh: 化石保存了桨状鳍肢，但没有测定步态或游泳表现。
ecology.bodySizeZh: AGM I-1 记录了一只带胚胎的成年个体，不能代表全属体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 这件标本没有直接记录捕食角色。

traits: The maternal skeleton preserves two embryos and an adjacent neonate.
Carpals and tarsals are less ossified than the metacarpals, metatarsals and phalanges.
Flipper proportions, teeth and vertebral characters contribute to the genus assignment.
evidenceSummary: The primary study documents AGM I-1 from the Spathian Nanlinghu Formation. Embryo orientation and a terrestrial origin for live birth are comparative interpretations, not observed behavior or an ancestral state for all ichthyosaurs.
overviewZh: 早三叠世的孕体标本 AGM I-1 出自马家山南采石场，保存了两具胚胎和一具相邻的新生个体。骨化延迟、牙齿与椎骨特征，以及指骨数较少的鳍肢支持将其归入 Chaohusaurus；种级分类仍可能修订。
traitsZh: 孕体骨架保存了两具胚胎和一具相邻的新生个体。
腕骨和跗骨的骨化程度低于掌骨、跖骨和指骨。
鳍肢比例、牙齿和椎骨特征共同用于属级鉴定。
evidenceSummaryZh: 原始研究记录了来自斯帕斯期 Nanlinghu 组的 AGM I-1。胚胎朝向及胎生起源于陆地的说法属于比较解释，不是直接观察到的行为，也不能代表所有鱼龙的祖先状态。

geography: Clay pit #3 of Lücking brick company, 1 km north of Bonenburg, Warburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
Rhaetian dark marine mudstones of the Exter Formation
overview: A small-bodied Late Triassic plesiosaurian represented by holotype LWL-MFN P 64047; its articulated anatomy and phylogenetic analysis extend the sampled plesiosaurian record into the Rhaetian without making the specimen a direct ancestor.

ecology.diet: Diet and prey are not directly preserved by the partial holotype
ecology.habitat: Marine mudstone depositional setting in the Rhaetian Exter Formation; habitual microhabitat remains unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Four similar flippers and a short tail support plesiosaurian hydrofoil and paraxial-locomotion comparisons, not a measured gait
ecology.bodySize: The subadult holotype has an estimated total length of 237 cm; a genus-wide size range is not inferred
ecology.guild: Marine predatory ecology is a broad plesiosaurian interpretation, not a directly observed feeding record

traits: Partial articulated skeleton preserving occiput, lower jaw, vertebral column, girdles and left limbs
Ventrally concave V-shaped neurocentral sutures in anterior and middle cervical vertebrae
Foreshortened zeugopodials and highly vascularized humeral and femoral bone tissue
evidenceSummary: The Exter Formation holotype documents anatomy and histology; basal placement and physiological implications remain analysis-dependent.

title.en: One skeleton gives a bounded portrait
title.zh: 一具骨架勾勒出有限的身体画像

text.en: Rhaeticosaurus mertensi is known from the subadult holotype LWL-MFN P 64047, a partly articulated skeleton from a Rhaetian bed in Germany's Exter Formation. It preserves the back of the skull, lower jaw, spine, shoulder and hip girdles, and left limbs. The published total-length estimate is 237 cm; it describes this individual, not a size range for the genus. The specimen extends the sampled plesiosaur record into the Rhaetian, but it is not identified as an ancestor of later plesiosaurs.
text.zh: Rhaeticosaurus mertensi 目前由亚成体正模 LWL-MFN P 64047 代表。这具部分关节相连的骨架出自德国 Exter 组瑞替期地层，保存枕部、下颌、脊柱、肩带与骨盆，以及左侧肢骨。论文估计该个体全长 237 厘米；这不是整个属的体型范围。它把已采样的蛇颈龙类化石记录延伸到瑞替期，但没有证据表明它是后来蛇颈龙的直接祖先。

title.en: A matrix position and a swimming comparison
title.zh: 矩阵位置与游泳方式比较

text.en: In a published analysis of 35 taxa and 270 characters, the species falls within Plesiosauria as a basal member of Pliosauridae. That is the result of one character matrix, not a visible family relationship in the rock. Four similar flippers and a short tail invite comparisons with underwater hydrofoils and paraxial swimming; neither a swimming gait nor speed is measured from the fossil. The partial skeleton also gives no direct evidence of a particular prey or diet.
text.zh: 在一项包含 35 个分类单元和 270 项性状的分析中，本种被恢复在蛇颈龙目内、作为基干上龙科成员。这是一次性状矩阵分析的结果，并非化石中能直接看到的亲缘关系。四个相似鳍肢和短尾可以与水下水翼及轴旁游泳方式作比较，但化石没有记录实际步态或速度。残缺骨架也没有直接说明特定猎物或食谱。

title.en: What the bone tissue can and cannot show
title.zh: 骨组织能说明什么，又不能说明什么

text.en: The sampled humerus and femur contain highly vascularized bone tissue, which the study uses to discuss growth and physiology. Histology informs an interpretation; it does not directly record metabolism or behavior. The holotype comes from a named clay pit and a specific Exter Formation bed, 21 m below the Triassic–Jurassic boundary. That documented horizon is a locality record, not a complete global range or a precise date for the individual.
text.zh: 研究检查的肱骨和股骨样本具有血管丰富的骨组织，据此讨论生长和生理。组织切片能为解释提供线索，却没有直接记录代谢或行为。正模来自具名黏土坑和 Exter 组特定地层，位置在三叠纪—侏罗纪界线以下 21 米。这个层位证明一处采集记录，不是全球完整分布，也不是对该个体的精确定年。

overview: The 2024 description names Haliskia peterseni from holotype KK F1426, now housed at Kronosaurus Korner in Richmond, Queensland. The partial skeleton preserves the front of the skull, lower jaw, both ceratobranchials of the hyoid apparatus, and parts of the spine, ribs and limbs; the paper lists 43 teeth. Major upper-arm and forearm bones are missing. Its measurements describe this individual, not the full variation of the species. The name honours Kevin Petersen, who recovered and prepared it.

ecology.diet: Not assessed as a complete taxon diet; see specimen-level interpretations.
ecology.habitat: Locality context is described in the reader sections.
ecology.bodySize: Specimen-based estimates are discussed where available.

evidenceSummary:
This account combines the holotype description and its comparative analyses with one PBDB collection. The estimated wingspan and proposed feeding function depend on incomplete bones and comparison; matrix placement is less resolved below Anhangueria. Neither the burial setting nor database occurrence count establishes the species’ full ecology, behaviour or geographic range.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 1 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

title.en: A species anchored by a partial skeleton
title.zh: 一件部分骨架固定的物种

text.zh: 2024 年描述以正模 KK F1426 命名 Haliskia peterseni；标本现存于昆士兰 Richmond 的 Kronosaurus Korner。它是部分骨架，保存头骨前部、下颌、两根角鳃骨及部分脊柱、肋骨和四肢，论文列出 43 枚牙齿。上臂和前臂的主要长骨缺失，因此尺寸首先描述这一件标本，而非整个物种的变异范围。种名纪念发现并清理标本的 Kevin Petersen。
text.en: The 2024 description names Haliskia peterseni from holotype KK F1426, now housed at Kronosaurus Korner in Richmond, Queensland. The partial skeleton preserves the front of the skull, lower jaw, both ceratobranchials of the hyoid apparatus, and parts of the spine, ribs and limbs; the paper lists 43 teeth. Major upper-arm and forearm bones are missing. Its measurements describe this individual, not the full variation of the species. The name honours Kevin Petersen, who recovered and prepared it.

title.en: The marine context of the Toolebuc Formation
title.zh: Toolebuc 组的海相背景

text.zh: 标本于 2021 年 11 月采自 Richmond 西北的 Dig Site 3，来自 Toolebuc 组阿尔布期地层。孢粉生物地层用于约束层位，并非对骨骼直接测年。该 Eromanga 盆地地层的石灰岩和油页岩记录海侵背景，伴生材料包括双壳类及未定种辐鳍鱼类遗骸。埋藏环境说明化石保存背景，不能证明本种终生在海上活动或完整分布范围。
text.en: The fossil was collected in November 2021 at Dig Site 3, northwest of Richmond, from Albian strata of the Toolebuc Formation. Spore and pollen biostratigraphy constrains the horizon; it is not a direct date on the bones. Limestone and oil shale in the Eromanga Basin unit record a marine-transgression setting, and associated remains include bivalves and indeterminate ray-finned fishes. This burial context does not establish lifelong marine activity or the species’ full range.

title.en: Teeth, crests and elongated hyoid bones
title.zh: 牙列、头冠和细长舌骨

text.zh: 鉴别特征来自牙齿组合：第四、第五对小于第三、第六对；第二、第五对齿槽又小于第三至第四对和第六至第八对。前颌和下颌都有冠，但冠形单独不足以区分近缘分类单元；部分结构受挤压或发掘损伤。完整左角鳃骨长 280 mm，下颌长 400 mm，比例为 0.70。论文有时称其为舌骨／头骨比；这里明确采用实际列出的角鳃骨与下颌测量。该比例不直接测量软组织舌长。
text.en: The diagnosis relies on a tooth pattern: the fourth and fifth pairs are smaller than the third and sixth, while the second and fifth alveolar pairs are smaller than pairs three to four and six to eight. Both the premaxilla and lower jaw carry crests, but crest shape alone does not separate related taxa; crushing and excavation damage affect some bones. The complete left ceratobranchial is 280 mm long and the mandible is 400 mm, a ratio of 0.70. Although the paper calls this a hyoid-to-skull ratio in places, these are the two measurements used here; the ratio is not a direct measure of the soft-tissue tongue.

title.en: How the approximately 4.6 m wingspan was estimated
title.zh: 约 4.6 米翼展如何得出

text.zh: 作者将乌喙骨、第四掌骨和第一翼指节等长度与骨骼成熟的近缘种比较，估计翼展约 4.60 m。肱骨、尺骨和桡骨缺失，后续翼指骨也不完整；因此这是针对该标本的比较复原，不是完整翼展的直接测量、个体最大尺寸或物种范围。作者也指出，依据其他澳大利亚翼龙的部分下颌推算巨大翼展，会受到比较对象选择影响。
text.en: The authors estimate a wingspan of about 4.60 m by comparing the coracoid, fourth metacarpal and first wing-finger phalanx with mature relatives. The humerus, ulna and radius are absent, and later wing-finger bones are incomplete. This is a comparative reconstruction for the specimen, not a directly measured full span, a maximum individual size or a species-wide range. Comparator choice also affects large spans proposed for other Australian pterosaurs from partial jaws.

title.en: Relationships depend on matrices and unstable taxa
title.zh: 近缘关系受矩阵和不稳定分类单元影响

text.zh: 两套性状矩阵分别只能编码约 30.7% 和 27.6% 的标本性状。两套分析都将 Haliskia 放在 Anhangueria 内，但更细的关系不同，包括移除不稳定分类单元后的结果。讨论把它与 Ferrodraco 的关系表示为姐妹群，或与 Mythunga 一同构成多分支关系；没有一项结果指定直接祖先。PBDB 2026-10-02 的路径将本种接入 Haliskia 和 Anhangueridae，这是数据库分类，不自动等同于固定的 COL26.8 概念。
text.en: Two character-matrix analyses score about 30.7% and 27.6% of the specimen’s characters. Both place Haliskia within Anhangueria, but finer relationships differ, including results after unstable taxa are removed. The discussion places it near Ferrodraco either as its sister taxon or in a group also containing Mythunga. Neither result names a direct ancestor. PBDB’s 2 October 2026 path connects the species to Haliskia and Anhangueridae; it is a database classification, separate from pinned COL26.8 concepts.

title.en: Feeding hypotheses derived from anatomy
title.zh: 从骨骼提出的摄食假说

text.zh: 标本没有保存能直接说明食物的喉部或胸腔内容物。作者提出，细长舌骨、弯曲牙齿和腭部形态可能帮助控制滑溜猎物；少量牙齿磨耗也被用于讨论头足类等软体猎物。这些是功能与食性解释，不是观察到捕鱼或测得猎物比例。论文提醒，舌骨形态单独不能确定食物偏好；翼龙之间的生态位差异还需要更可靠的年代和独立证据。
text.en: The specimen preserves no throat or chest contents that directly reveal food. The authors propose that elongated hyoid bones, curved teeth and palate shape might help restrain slippery prey; limited tooth wear also informs a hypothesis of soft-bodied prey such as cephalopods. These are functional and dietary interpretations, not observed fishing or measured prey proportions. The paper cautions that hyoid form alone cannot determine food preference; proposed niche differences among pterosaurs also need firmer age control and independent evidence.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:
PBDB 将 Haliskia peterseni 记为 Haliskia 属下的物种。所选样本有 1 条出现记录，来自 1 个采集地并关联 1 条引文；这些是数据库数量，不是化石或动物个体数。

PBDB 出现记录补充:

overview: The holotype of Ferrodraco lentoni is AODF 876, nicknamed Butch, held by the Australian Age of Dinosaurs museum. The 2019 description records the front of the skull and mandible, five incomplete cervical vertebrae, and partial shoulder and wing elements. It is not a complete skeleton. Matching matrix around adjacent bones indicates articulation after fossilization, followed by fragmentation through erosion and soil disturbance before excavation. The genus name’s ferrum refers to ironstone preservation; the species honors Graham Thomas “Butch” Lenton’s support for Winton and the museum.

The collection locality, broad age range, environmental setting and preservation labels describe this record; they do not establish the species full range, exact origin or extinction time, habitat, abundance or the condition of every fossil. The 2019 holotype description supplies specimen anatomy, while the database record and later comparisons retain their own evidence scopes.

title.en: AODF 876: a partial skeleton in ironstone
title.zh: AODF 876：铁质岩中的部分骨架

text.zh: Ferrodraco lentoni 的正模为澳大利亚恐龙时代博物馆收藏的 AODF 876，昵称 Butch。2019 年原始描述记录头骨与下颌前部、五件不完整颈椎、部分肩带及翼肢材料；不是一具完整骨架。若干相邻骨骼的包裹岩石仍能拼接，说明化石形成后曾保持连接，但侵蚀和土壤扰动在发掘前使其碎裂。属名中的 ferrum 指铁，说明铁质岩保存背景；种名纪念支持 Winton 社区与博物馆的 Graham Thomas “Butch” Lenton。
text.en: The holotype of Ferrodraco lentoni is AODF 876, nicknamed Butch, held by the Australian Age of Dinosaurs museum. The 2019 description records the front of the skull and mandible, five incomplete cervical vertebrae, and partial shoulder and wing elements. It is not a complete skeleton. Matching matrix around adjacent bones indicates articulation after fossilization, followed by fragmentation through erosion and soil disturbance before excavation. The genus name’s ferrum refers to ironstone preservation; the species honors Graham Thomas “Butch” Lenton’s support for Winton and the museum.

title.en: The Winton horizon and a possible late survival
title.zh: Winton 组层位与晚存续解释

text.zh: 标本于 2017 年 4 月发现于昆士兰州 Winton 的 Belmont Station，模式地点为 AODL 245。描述将其归入 Winton 组的森诺曼期至早土仑期范围。作者据区域碎屑锆石研究讨论该组北部可能晚至早土仑期的沉积，但同时明确本种模式地点仍缺少精细年龄约束。因此，可能较晚存续是待进一步约束的解释，不是正模直接测得的精确年龄，也不足以单独确认澳大利亚是这一支翼龙的避难所。
text.en: The specimen was found in April 2017 at Belmont Station near Winton, Queensland; the type locality is AODL 245. The description assigns it to the Cenomanian–early Turonian range of the Winton Formation. Regional detrital-zircon studies motivate discussion of potentially early Turonian deposition in the northern formation, but the authors explicitly note that this type locality lacks refined age constraints. Possible late survival remains an interpretation requiring better stratigraphy, rather than a precise date measured directly from the holotype or proof of an Australian refugium.

title.en: Tooth-size combinations and incomplete crests
title.zh: 牙齿大小组合与保存不全的冠

text.zh: 描述的两项主要鉴别特征是：前颌骨与下颌的第一对牙齿小于其他前部牙齿；第四至第七对小于第三与第八对。保存材料还显示头冠、下颌冠的残部以及相对突起的齿槽边缘。头冠后部不完整，下颌冠的完整高度也不能由残部直接量出。CT 数据帮助识别腭脊、下颌沟和位于功能牙远端及舌侧的替换牙；这些观察属于 AODF 876，不能仅凭冠形或单枚离散牙给所有未定种材料重新命名。
text.en: The two principal diagnostic features are first premaxillary and mandibular tooth pairs smaller than the other anterior teeth, and fourth through seventh pairs smaller than the third and eighth. Preserved material also shows a cranial crest, remnants of a mandibular crest and raised alveolar margins. The cranial crest is incomplete posteriorly, and the complete mandibular-crest height cannot be measured from its remnant. CT data reveal a palatal ridge, mandibular groove and replacement teeth distal and lingual to functional teeth. These observations concern AODF 876; a crest or isolated tooth alone cannot rename all indeterminate material.

title.en: The approximately four-metre span is estimated
title.zh: 约四米翼展是比较估计

text.zh: 2019 年论文根据正模测量与其他 Anhangueria 翼龙比较，估计翼展约 4 m。许多表列骨长标有不完整保存符号；部分尺骨、桡骨、第四掌骨和第一翼指节还受挤压或变形。骨架复原的缺失部分依据比较对象补配，因此约四米不是完整翼膜或整翼的直接测量。它也不建立本种最大体型、年龄范围或飞行性能；与其他论文的翼展数字比较时，应先比较保存材料和重建方法。
text.en: The 2019 paper estimates a wingspan of approximately 4 m from holotype measurements and comparison with other anhanguerians. Many tabulated lengths are marked as incomplete; parts of the ulna, radius, fourth metacarpal and first wing phalanx are crushed or distorted. Missing portions in the skeletal reconstruction rely on comparators, so the span is not a direct measurement of a complete wing or membrane. It does not establish maximum species size, an age range or flight performance. Comparisons with estimates in other papers should begin with preservation and reconstruction methods.

title.en: Evidence for skeletal maturity
title.zh: 骨骼成熟判断及其边界

text.zh: 作者依据肩胛骨与喙骨融合，以及第一翼指节伸肌腱突骨化，认为正模个体骨骼发育已成熟；但 CT 显示腕骨尚未缝合。两类状态均保留在描述中，不将某一融合状态转换成精确年龄、性别或繁殖阶段。标本没有覆盖幼体至成体的成长序列，因此也不能用这一件骨架推断本种的发育速度或寿命。
text.en: Fusion of the scapulocoracoid and ossification of the extensor tendon process on the first wing phalanx led the authors to interpret the individual as ontogenetically mature. CT scans nevertheless show unsutured carpals. Both observations remain part of the account; neither is converted into an exact age, sex or reproductive stage. A single skeleton supplies no juvenile-to-adult series from which to infer species growth rate or lifespan.

title.en: Two 2019 analyses and later catalogue names
title.zh: 2019 年两套分析与后来的目录名

text.zh: 2019 年研究采用两套矩阵：一套将 Ferrodraco 与 Mythunga 配成姐妹群，另一套则将 Ferrodraco 放在含 Anhanguera、Coloborhynchus 和 Ornithocheirus 的多分支之外，并因不稳定性剪除 Mythunga。论文沿用 Ornithocheiridae 等名称；本页 PBDB 2026-10-02 目录父链为 Anhangueridae—Tropeognathinae—Ferrodraco。Haliskia 的 2024 年研究另行比较 Ferrodraco，不能把这些有不同样本和定义的结果拼成唯一祖先序列。目录路径用来存放与导航，保留各论文原有分类范围。
text.en: The 2019 study uses two matrices: one pairs Ferrodraco with Mythunga, whereas the other places Ferrodraco outside a polytomy containing Anhanguera, Coloborhynchus and Ornithocheirus, pruning Mythunga because of instability. The paper uses names including Ornithocheiridae; the PBDB directory chain recorded on 2 October 2026 is Anhangueridae–Tropeognathinae–Ferrodraco. The 2024 Haliskia study compares Ferrodraco separately. Results based on different samples and definitions cannot be assembled into a unique ancestor sequence. The directory supports storage and navigation while retaining each publication’s taxonomic scope.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:
PBDB 将 Ferrodraco lentoni 列为 Ferrodraco 属下的一个种。所选种级出现记录关联 1 个采集记录和 1 个引文编号。出现记录、采集记录和引文编号是不同的数据库单位，不代表化石标本或动物个体数。

text.en:
PBDB lists Ferrodraco lentoni under the genus Ferrodraco. The selected species-level occurrence record links it to one collection and one reference. Occurrence, collection and reference counts describe different database units; they are not counts of fossils or animals.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:

This archived guide contains 1 selected occurrence rows, linked to 1 distinct PBDB collection IDs and 1 distinct PBDB reference IDs. An occurrence row and a collection record are different units; neither count is a specimen or individual count. The reading question here is concrete: which recorded localities, age bounds, material notes, and citations are attached to these rows?

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh:
本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 100.5–89.8 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。

text.en:
Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 100.5–89.8 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:

These values are age bounds on named database records, not a continuous record between them and not dates of the species' origin, extinction, or lifespan. Each row keeps its own eag and lag values above.

These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Ferrodraco’s type species and preserved skeleton
title.zh: Ferrodraco 的模式种与保存骨架

text.zh: Ferrodraco lentoni 是模式种，依据为 AODF 876 部分骨架。属名指向铁质岩保存，种名用于纪念一人；名称来源本身不能说明食性或行为。PBDB 所记录的分类层级将 Ferrodraco 置于 Tropeognathinae 之内。
text.en: Ferrodraco lentoni is the type species, based on partial skeleton AODF 876. The genus name refers to ironstone preservation, while the species name honors an individual; neither name establishes diet or behavior. The recorded PBDB hierarchy places Ferrodraco within Tropeognathinae.

title.en: Ferrodraco and Haliskia: preserved material and span estimates
title.zh: Ferrodraco 与 Haliskia：保存材料与翼展估计

text.zh: Ferrodraco lentoni 的翼展估计约为四米，但化石没有保存可直接测量的完整翼。Haliskia peterseni 保存的骨骼不同，翼展同样来自重建，不能据此排列完整体型。2019 年和 2024 年系统发育分析使用不同矩阵和分类定义；分析结果不建立直系祖先关系，也不能把一个物种的舌骨或食性假说套到另一个物种。
text.en: A wingspan of about four metres is reconstructed for Ferrodraco lentoni; the fossil does not preserve a complete wing for direct measurement. Haliskia peterseni has a different set of preserved bones, and its span is also reconstructed, so the two estimates do not rank complete body size. The 2019 and 2024 phylogenetic analyses use different matrices and taxon definitions. Their results do not establish direct ancestry, and one species' hyoid anatomy or feeding hypotheses cannot be assigned to the other.

overview: The PBDB supplementary directory currently places Haliskia and Ferrodraco within Anhangueridae, with Ferrodraco nested in Tropeognathinae. evidenceSummary: This is a selected path through two holotype studies and comparative material, not a complete family review. Published studies use different specimens and taxonomic definitions, and the selected species pages do not form a complete descendant catalogue. Occurrences, collections, and species are different counting units. Database age bounds do not give exact origin or extinction times, and the record set does not supply a shared ecological account for Anhangueridae.

title.zh: 关联比较标本与孤立翼骨
title.en: Associated comparative specimen and isolated wing bones

text.zh: 除澳大利亚材料外，Tropeognathus mesembrinus 的大型比较标本也提供了另一条阅读线索。MN 6594-V 保存相连的头部与身体材料；MCT 1838-R 只有肱骨远端，MPSC R 1395 是部分翼部，后两件仅鉴定为科级归属未定的翼龙。它们是三件保存状态不同的标本，不能视为归入同一物种的三个个体。
text.en: Alongside the Australian material, the large comparative specimen Tropeognathus mesembrinus provides another route into the evidence. MN 6594-V preserves associated skull and body material. MCT 1838-R is a distal humerus, and MPSC R 1395 is part of a wing; both are identified only as pterosaurs of uncertain family. These are three differently preserved specimens, not three individuals assigned to one species.

title.zh: 重建图、组织切片与翼展回答不同问题
title.en: Reconstructions, histology and span estimates answer different questions

text.zh: 比较研究中的照片呈现了头骨碎片，重建图以阴影标出实存部位。翼骨薄片可用于估计生长阶段；翼展数值则通过其他骨架补全缺失部分，是重建估值。不同方法回答不同问题：轮廓图完整不等于头骨保存完整，生长接近停止不等于测得成年最大体型，估算翼展也不能直接说明食性或飞行性能。
text.en: Photographs in the comparative study show preserved skull fragments, while a reconstruction shades the areas that remain. Thin sections from wing bones help estimate growth stage. Wingspan values are estimates that fill missing bones by comparison with other skeletons. Each method answers a different question: a complete drawing does not mean the skull is complete, near cessation of growth does not establish the largest adult size, and an estimated wingspan does not reveal diet or flight performance.

title.en: Taxonomic names, definitions and dates
title.zh: 分类名称、定义与年份

text.zh: PBDB 补充目录目前将 Haliskia 与 Ferrodraco 置于 Anhangueridae，且将 Ferrodraco 归在 Tropeognathinae 下。2019 年 Ferrodraco 描述使用 Ornithocheiridae 等名称；2024 年 Haliskia 研究则讨论采用不同矩阵和支系定义的分析。这些记录反映不同分类选择，并未拼合成一棵无争议的科级系统树。
text.en: The PBDB supplementary directory currently places Haliskia and Ferrodraco within Anhangueridae, with Ferrodraco nested in Tropeognathinae. The 2019 Ferrodraco description uses Ornithocheiridae, while the 2024 Haliskia study discusses analyses with different matrices and clade definitions. These records document distinct classification choices; they do not combine into one uncontested family tree.

title.en: Ferrodraco and Haliskia: two Australian holotypes
title.zh: Ferrodraco 与 Haliskia：两件澳大利亚正模

text.zh: 两个物种展示了证据的差异：本页所述 Ferrodraco lentoni 标本为 AODF 876，Haliskia peterseni 为 KK F1426。比较时可先看保存骨骼、地层、牙齿、生长证据与翼展重建，再看系统发育分析。Haliskia 的舌骨和摄食假说不是关于 Ferrodraco 的直接证据。这些例子不能证明整个科拥有同一种食性或生活方式。
text.en: Two species illustrate how the evidence differs: Ferrodraco lentoni is represented here by AODF 876, and Haliskia peterseni by KK F1426. Compare the bones that survive, the geological horizons, teeth, growth evidence, and reconstructed wingspans before comparing their phylogenetic analyses. Haliskia's hyoid bones and feeding hypotheses are not direct evidence about Ferrodraco. These examples do not establish one diet or way of life for the whole family.

title.en: Anhangueridae: PBDB classification route
title.zh: Anhangueridae：PBDB 分类路径

text.zh: 本 PBDB 路径将 Anhangueridae 记录为科级，并链接到本导读固定名录中的 14 个物种。数据库父级路径用于整理记录；它在目录中的位置不能裁定已发表系统发育分析之间的分歧。
text.en: This PBDB branch records Anhangueridae at family rank and links to 14 species in the fixed roster used for this guide. The parent path helps organize the records; its position in the database does not resolve differences among published phylogenetic analyses.

title.en: Member material linked to Anhangueridae

text.zh: 本导读包括 Haliskia peterseni、Thapunngaka shawi、Mythunga camara、Tropeognathus mesembrinus 和 Ferrodraco lentoni，并链接到各自具名的采集记录与参考文献。所选物种页合计列出 18 条出现记录、15 个采集记录。Toolebuc、Romualdo、Winton 与 Ifezouane 是其中的地层名称示例。每个采集记录有自己的年代区间和鉴定限定；这些总数不是古代动物个体数或种群规模。
text.en: The guide includes Haliskia peterseni, Thapunngaka shawi, Mythunga camara, Tropeognathus mesembrinus, and Ferrodraco lentoni, with links to their named collections and references. Across the selected species pages are 18 occurrence records from 15 collections. Toolebuc, Romualdo, Winton, and Ifezouane are examples of the recorded strata. Each collection has its own age interval and identification limits; the totals are not counts of ancient animals or population size.
