overview: The 2021 description names KKF494 as the holotype: the front portion of a crested lower jaw, with tooth sockets but no teeth preserved in place. The specimen is held at Kronosaurus Korner in Richmond.

ecology.diet: Not assessed as a complete taxon diet.
ecology.habitat: Locality evidence is described in reader sections.
ecology.bodySize: Size estimates and their limitations are discussed in reader sections.

evidenceSummary:
The holotype is a partial lower jaw, the proposed upper-jaw referral is contested, and large size estimates depend on extrapolation. The phylogenetic result is unresolved. Two selected collections do not establish a continuous range or abundance; their age bounds are not exact specimen dates. The available records do not establish diet, reproduction, or behavior.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 2 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

title.en: The holotype preserves part of a mandible
title.zh: 正模保存的是部分下颌

text.zh: 2021 年描述指定 KKF494 为正模：一段带冠下颌的前部，保存齿槽，但没有牙齿留在原位。标本现藏于 Richmond 的 Kronosaurus Korner。
text.en: The 2021 description names KKF494 as the holotype: the front portion of a crested lower jaw, with tooth sockets but no teeth preserved in place. The specimen is held at Kronosaurus Korner in Richmond.

title.en: Formation assignment and exact horizon
title.zh: 地层范围与精确层位

text.zh: 模式地点记为 Richmond 西北的 Wanamara Country，位于 Toolebuc 组上阿尔布期。它在该组内的精确层位未知。
text.en: The type locality is reported from Wanamara Country northwest of Richmond, in the upper Albian Toolebuc Formation. Its exact position within the formation is not known.

title.en: Why a large span is not a direct measurement
title.zh: 为何不把巨大翼展当作直接测量

text.zh: 2024 年 Haliskia 描述重新讨论了 Thapunngaka 的体型估算。较大的翼展值是由残缺下颌材料外推而来，结果会受比较物种以及下颌联合部与头骨比例假设影响。作者认为，按当时可用证据，不能支持称它为澳大利亚已知最大的翼龙。这一有明确时间背景的批评没有补出缺失的翅膀，也不能裁定所有后续标本；有争议的估值不是实测的典型体型或物种最大值。
text.en: A 2024 study describing Haliskia revisited estimates of Thapunngaka's size. The larger wingspans were extrapolated from partial jaw material, so the result depends on the comparison species and the proportions assumed between the jaw symphysis and skull. The authors argued that evidence available at that time did not support calling it Australia's largest known pterosaur. That dated criticism does not supply missing wings or decide every later specimen; the debated estimates are not a measured typical size or species maximum.

title.en: What the second specimen preserves
title.zh: 第二件标本保存了什么

text.zh: 后续论文描述 KKF600（也写作 KKF0600）：两块不完整的上颌前部材料，来自 Richmond 西北的 Cambridge Quarry，属于 Toolebuc 组上阿尔布期。它增加了上颌材料，但不是与正模个体相连的完整头骨或翅膀。
text.en: The later paper describes KKF600, also written KKF0600: two incomplete pieces from the front of an upper jaw. They came from Cambridge Quarry, northwest of Richmond, in the upper Albian Toolebuc Formation. They add upper-jaw material, not a complete skull or wings belonging to the holotype individual.

title.en: Referral evidence and the later objection
title.zh: 归属依据与质疑分别是什么

text.zh: Richards 等依据齿槽的形状和排列，以及相互吻合的咬合面，将 KKF600 归入 Thapunngaka shawi；他们也指出两件标本没有任何重叠的解剖部位。2024 年 Haliskia 研究质疑这一归属，理由包括缺乏重叠、Toolebuc 组至少有三个翼龙分类单元，以及其他地点的古魔翼龙类多样性。这个归属仍有争议，不能作为无争议的种级特征来源。
text.en: Richards and colleagues referred KKF600 to Thapunngaka shawi based on the form and arrangement of its tooth sockets and matching biting surfaces. They also noted that the two specimens share no overlapping anatomical part. The 2024 Haliskia study questioned the referral, citing that gap, at least three pterosaur taxa in the Toolebuc Formation, and anhanguerian diversity at other sites. The referral remains disputed rather than an undisputed source of species-level traits.

title.en: Mythungini as a phylogenetic hypothesis
title.zh: Mythungini 是分析提出的关系假说

text.zh: 后续研究的严格共识树将 Thapunngaka、Mythunga 与 Ferrodraco 放在一个未解析的三分支上，并命名为 Mythungini。这里记录的是该项分析结果，并未确定三者中哪一个与另一个亲缘最近。
text.en: In the later study's strict consensus tree, Thapunngaka, Mythunga, and Ferrodraco form an unresolved three-way branch named Mythungini. The result records that analysis; it does not establish which of the three is the other's closest relative.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:
固定的 PBDB 翼龙名录将 Thapunngaka shawi 作为接受种，父级名称为 Thapunngaka。本导读纳入两条符合条件的种级出现记录、两个采集记录和两个引文编号。每个数字计量不同的数据库记录单位，不等于标本或动物个数。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
Thapunngaka shawi 在 PBDB 快照中对应分类条目 txn:478714。这份存档导读包含 2 条选取的出现记录，关联 2 个不同的 PBDB 采集记录编号和 2 个不同的 PBDB 引文编号。出现记录与采集记录是不同单位；这两个数量都不等于标本数或个体数。此页聚焦一个具体问题：这些记录各自连到哪些地点、年代界、材料说明和引文？
text.en:
The fixed PBDB pterosaur roster accepts Thapunngaka shawi under the parent name Thapunngaka. This guide includes two eligible species-level occurrence records, two collections, and two reference identifiers. Each count measures a different kind of database record, not specimens or animals.

- Occurrence occ:1669831; PBDB collection col:236854. Locality cnm=Free Fossil Hunting Site 1; place fields cc2=AU, stp=Queensland. Recorded age bounds: eag 106.3 Ma; lag 100.5 Ma; PBDB interval fields oei=Late Albian. Stratigraphic fields sfm=Toolebuc. Recorded attribution Richards et al. 2021; PBDB reference ref:89725.

‘Free Fossil Hunting Site 1’ (20°38′49.31′′S, 143°5′58.34′′E), ca. 12 km NW of Richmond, on Wanamara Country, NW Queensland, Australia. Site also known as the ‘water pond’ at the ‘8 mile pits’, orig. developed as a quarry for road dressing.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh:
所选记录合并后的年代外界为 113.2–100.5 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。它由最早的早端边界与最晚的晚端边界组成，不是连续的化石记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。各采集记录保留自身较宽的年代区间；此处不改写原研究的定年解释。

text.en:
Together, the selected records have an outer age envelope of 113.2–100.5 Ma, where Ma means millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound; it is not a continuous fossil record or a measured species origin, extinction, or individual lifespan. Each collection keeps its own broader interval, and this envelope does not revise the original dating interpretations.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Across these selected PBDB rows, the largest recorded eag=113.2 Ma in occ:1638990; the smallest recorded lag=100.5 Ma in occ:1638990. These values are age bounds on named database records, not a continuous record between them and not dates of the species' origin, extinction, or lifespan. Each row keeps its own eag and lag values above.

overview: Holotype QM F18896 preserves an incomplete snout with an adherent mandible. Phillip Gilmore found it in 1991 at Dunluce Station near Hughenden, within a calcareous nodule from the Toolebuc Formation, assigned to the late Albian in the 2007 paper.

ecology.diet: Not assessed as a complete taxon diet.
ecology.habitat: Locality evidence is described in reader sections.
ecology.bodySize: Size estimates and their limitations are discussed in reader sections.

title.en: Start with the holotype and locality
title.zh: 从正模与产地开始

text.zh: 正模 QM F18896 是不完整吻部及相贴的下颌。Phillip Gilmore 于 1991 年在 Hughenden 附近的 Dunluce Station 发现它，材料来自 Toolebuc 组的钙质结核；2007 年论文将该产地归为晚阿尔布期。
text.en: Holotype QM F18896 preserves an incomplete snout with an adherent mandible. Phillip Gilmore found it in 1991 at Dunluce Station near Hughenden, within a calcareous nodule from the Toolebuc Formation, assigned to the late Albian in the 2007 paper.

title.en: Internal chambers do not supply a complete head
title.zh: 空腔结构不等于完整头部

text.zh: 2007 年作者观察到吻部内部的空腔、薄骨壁和支撑结构。吻端及背缘存在缺损，不能仅凭保存片段确定完整头形或骨冠。
text.en: The 2007 authors describe internal chambers, thin bone walls and supports in the snout. Missing anterior and dorsal portions constrain reconstruction of the complete head and any crest.

title.en: The preserved anterior teeth were reinterpreted
title.zh: 前部牙齿的解释后来改变

text.zh: 重描述论文的公开摘要将前部保存结构解释为一颗上颌牙的牙根及其替换牙，而不是左右对应的一对牙。因此不能继续把它们当作吻端最前一对牙。摘要还将鼻眶前孔内的骨块识别为右夹板骨。本批只使用摘要可支持的修订，未取得该论文完整正文。
text.en: The public reappraisal abstract identifies the anterior preserved structures as a maxillary tooth root and its replacement, rather than contralateral teeth. They therefore cannot establish the anteriormost tooth pair. It also identifies the bone in the nasoantorbital fenestra as the right splenial. These are abstract-supported revisions; the complete article was not obtained in this batch.

title.en: Relationships depend on material and matrices
title.zh: 关系假说随材料与矩阵变化

text.zh: 重描述摘要把 Mythunga 置于 Anhangueria，但该支系多数关系未解析。Thapunngaka 第二件标本研究将 Mythunga、Thapunngaka 与 Ferrodraco 置于名为 Mythungini 的未解析三分支。Haliskia 的 2024 年研究在一套分析中把 Mythunga 与 Thapunngaka 识别为不稳定单元并在分析后排除。因此，本页分别记录研究结果，不给 Mythunga 指定一个已获一致确认的最近姐妹群，也不把数据库存储位置当作这些争论的裁决。
text.en: The reappraisal abstract places Mythunga in Anhangueria with much of that clade unresolved. The second-specimen Thapunngaka study groups Mythunga, Thapunngaka and Ferrodraco in an unresolved trichotomy named Mythungini. One analysis in the 2024 Haliskia study identifies Mythunga and Thapunngaka as unstable and excludes them a posteriori. These results are recorded separately; no agreed nearest sister group is assigned, and database storage placement does not adjudicate the debate.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:
Mythunga camara 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Mythunga。本页导读 1 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 1 个采集记录和 1 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
Mythunga camara 在 PBDB 快照中对应分类条目 txn:148341。这份存档导读包含 1 条选取的出现记录，关联 1 个不同的 PBDB 采集记录编号和 1 个不同的 PBDB 引文编号。出现记录与采集记录是不同单位；这两个数量都不等于标本数或个体数。此页聚焦一个具体问题：这些记录各自连到哪些地点、年代界、材料说明和引文？
text.en:
Mythunga camara is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Mythunga. This guide uses 1 eligible species-level occurrence record from 1 collection and 1 reference identifier. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Mythunga camara is listed in the PBDB snapshot under taxon txn:148341. This archived guide contains 1 selected occurrence rows, linked to 1 distinct PBDB collection IDs and 1 distinct PBDB reference IDs. An occurrence row and a collection record are different units; neither count is a specimen or individual count. The reading question here is concrete: which recorded localities, age bounds, material notes, and citations are attached to these rows?

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata

title.zh: 形态证据与名称注册
title.en: Anatomical evidence and name registration

text.zh: I. avatar 是 Ikrandraco 的模式种。2014 年研究描述解剖并提出摄食假说；2020 年更正讨论电子出版物及 ZooBank 注册是否使该名称具备命名可用性。两份出版物分别讨论解剖与命名问题。
text.en: I. avatar is the type species of Ikrandraco. The 2014 study describes anatomy and proposes feeding hypotheses; a 2020 correction addresses whether the electronic work and ZooBank registration make the name available. The two publications address anatomy and nomenclature, respectively.

title.zh: 两件扁压标本与摄食假说
title.en: Two flattened specimens and feeding hypotheses

text.zh: I. avatar 导读 介绍两件标本及其未知的确切层位、下颌骨冠与牙齿，再讨论成熟度、亲缘关系、短暂贴近水面掠水取食的假说和喉囊假说。任何一件标本都不代表完整种群，骨骼解剖也不直接显示摄食行为。同期地层的其他翼龙提供比较背景，但没有据此测出生态位分隔。
text.en: The I. avatar guide describes two specimens, their unknown exact horizons, the mandibular crest and teeth, then considers maturity, phylogeny, a hypothesis of briefly skimming the water surface to feed, and a possible throat pouch. Neither specimen represents a complete population, and skeletal anatomy does not directly show feeding behavior. Other formation-level pterosaurs provide context, not a measured division of niches.

evidenceSummary: The reading path draws on selected text, tables and captions from studies published in 2008, 2021 and 2023. The eleven MIC-V55 histology sections are samples from one specimen. Claims about tooth attachment, replacement generations, diet and sexual maturity remain interpretations with stated limits; the 2021 flight models depend on their published assumptions and correction. This page does not present independent specimen or slide examination, a rerun of the models, or a complete review of original descriptions and later literature. The PBDB occurrence counts, ages and parent chain describe database entries and remain separate from the anatomical studies.

title.zh: 过滤牙齿、成长与飞行模型
title.en: Filtering teeth, growth and flight models

text.zh: 沿 P. guinazui 先读细丝牙齿、MIC-V55 的薄片与附着限制，再读 2008 年多骨生长研究，最后接到已有的 2021 年幼体飞行模型。下颌薄片、生长周期和跨标本飞行输入分别回答不同问题；它们没有直接串成同一只动物从孵化到死亡的记录。
text.en: Follow P. guinazui through filamentous teeth, MIC-V55 sections and attachment limits, then the 2008 multi-bone growth study and existing 2021 hatchling-flight models. Jaw sections, growth cycles and composite flight inputs address different questions; they do not form a record of one animal from hatching to death.

title.zh: 各项研究的材料范围
title.en: Material scope across the studies

text.zh: 本属入口仍只有固定名录中的 P. guinazui 种页。2023 年一件下颌的十一张薄片、2008 年多骨多大小样本，与下方两条数据库出现记录分别保留各自单位。牙齿的特殊组织结构不能推广为所有翼龙的共同特征；生长研究的性成熟推断也不替代直接繁殖证据。
text.en: This genus route retains one species entry, P. guinazui, in the fixed roster. Eleven sections of one jaw in 2023, multiple bones and sizes in 2008, and the two database occurrences below retain their separate units. Specialized dental histology does not describe all pterosaurs, and inferred sexual maturity does not replace direct reproductive evidence.

title.zh: 幼体与成体飞行模型

text.zh: Pterodaustro 当前有 P. guinazui 阅读入口。种页从胚胎、幼体标本与组合测量进入飞行模型，再区分成长生态和照料假说。属级路线不把模型中的成体尺寸或数据库出现数当作全属生物学测量。
text.en: The current Pterodaustro route leads to P. guinazui. Its page moves from embryos, hatchlings and composite measurements to flight models, then distinguishes growth ecology and care hypotheses. Adult model sizes and database occurrence counts are not whole-genus biological measurements.

evidenceSummary: Published accounts differ on whether FSAC-KK 26 is a lower jaw or upper rostrum and on the Xericeps type horizon. Possible synonymy and finer clade placement remain unresolved. Body material without diagnostic association is not treated here as a confirmed Alanqa specimen.

title.zh: 按年份整理正模解释与标本归入
title.en: Type interpretations and specimen referrals by year

text.zh: 已发表的研究对 2010 年正模 FSAC-KK 26 有不同解释：原论文将其视为下颌，2020 年重分析则辨认为上颌吻部。2023 年研究对读成对骨突与单个中央突起，但这些孤立颌骨不能构成完整骨架。
text.en: Published accounts interpret the 2010 type FSAC-KK 26 differently: the original paper treated it as a lower jaw, while a 2020 reanalysis identified it as an upper rostrum. A 2023 study compares the paired projections and single median boss, but these isolated jaw elements do not make a complete skeleton.

title.zh: 一件正模标本的两种形态解释
title.en: Two anatomical interpretations of one type specimen

text.zh: FSAC-KK 26 仍是同一件正模，但 2010 与 2020 年的研究对其颌骨归属不同。这一差异会影响颌部复原和比例比较。归入的颌骨与未定种颈椎仍应分开看待，不能合并成一具关联骨架。
text.en: FSAC-KK 26 remains the same type specimen, but its jaw assignment changes between the 2010 and 2020 accounts. That difference affects jaw reconstruction and proportional comparisons. Referred jaws and undetermined cervical bones remain separate; they do not together form one associated skeleton.

title.zh: 更多颌部材料仍不等于完整生物学
title.en: Additional jaw material does not complete the biology

text.zh: 无齿、笔直颌缘和腭面突起是解剖观察，不能构成完整食谱或飞行模型。与 Xericeps 可能互为异名以及更细的支系位置仍未解决；未定种身体材料不视为已确认的 Alanqa 标本。
text.en: Toothlessness, straight jaw margins and a palatal boss are anatomical observations, not a complete diet or flight model. Possible synonymy with Xericeps and finer clade placements remain unresolved; indeterminate body material is not treated as confirmed Alanqa material.

title.zh: 正模下颌与后续上颌材料
title.en: Type mandible and later upper-jaw material

text.zh: 可先看 B. galaczi 中正模标本和馆藏号的对应关系。该物种页再介绍下颌横嵴、2011 年描述的上颌，以及至今未知的角质覆盖；分离骨骼的归属与翼展估计、食性假说分开讨论。2005 和 2011 年作者将 Bakonydraco 归入 Azhdarchidae，但这里不把这一分类说成对所有后续分析的复核。
text.en: Begin with the type specimen and collection-number links on B. galaczi. That species account follows the jaw ridge, the upper jaw described in 2011 and the still-unknown keratinous covering, then separates isolated-bone referrals from wingspan and feeding hypotheses. The 2005 and 2011 authors place Bakonydraco in Azhdarchidae; that placement is not a review of every later analysis.

title.zh: 山名、类型产地与搬运后的化石
title.en: The mountain name, type locality and transported fossils

text.zh: Bakonydraco 的属名由 Bakony 山地与拉丁语 draco 组成；种加词 galaczi 纪念 András Galácz。正模产地位于匈牙利西部 Iharkút 的 Csehbánya Formation。2005 年论文依据所引孢粉研究将其归入 Santonian，并描述河流洪泛平原沉积：流水把骨骼搬运并集中到化石富集处。PBDB 为一个采集记录给出 85.7–83.6 Ma 的年代范围。这些沉积线索说明埋藏背景，不代表动物全部的生活环境；数据库记录数也不是骨片或个体数。
text.en: Bakonydraco combines the Bakony Mountains with Latin draco; galaczi honours András Galácz. The type locality is the Csehbánya Formation at Iharkút in western Hungary. The 2005 paper assigns it to the Santonian using cited palynological work and describes river floodplain deposits where flowing water carried bones into fossil pockets. PBDB gives one collection an age bracket of 85.7–83.6 Ma. These depositional clues describe how remains were buried, not the animal’s entire habitat; the database count is not a count of fragments or individuals.

A 2019 study interprets Keresdrakon, Caiuajara and Vespersaurus as repeatedly occurring in the same bed. evidenceSummary: This comparison combines selected anatomical and growth evidence from Keresdrakon and other animals found in the same bed. Association has stratigraphic support, while the proposed feeding relationships remain hypotheses. Database counts and parent paths do not supply a complete fauna or a single settled tree.

title.zh: Keresdrakon 与共同骨床
title.en: Keresdrakon and the shared bonebed

text.zh: Keresdrakon 正模与长颌、气腔化骨骼相伴，另有两件组织样本。2019 年研究将 Keresdrakon、Caiuajara 和 Vespersaurus 的重复出现解释为同一骨床中的关联。可分别对读 Keresdrakon vilsoni、Caiuajara dobruskii 和 Vespersaurus paranaensis 的证据。共同埋藏不表示三者是同一物种或同一取食类群。
text.en: The Keresdrakon holotype is associated with long jaws and air-filled (pneumatic) skeletal features, alongside two tissue samples. A 2019 study interprets Keresdrakon, Caiuajara and Vespersaurus as repeatedly occurring in the same bed. Compare the evidence for Keresdrakon vilsoni, Caiuajara dobruskii and Vespersaurus paranaensis. Shared burial does not make the three animals one species or one feeding group.

title.zh: 成长与生态问题各自的材料边界
title.en: Material boundaries across growth and ecology questions

text.zh: 两种翼龙和恐龙没有共用一套完整成长样本，三条所选数据库出现行也不等于三个个体。Vespersaurus 的年龄估计取决于反推假设，不同后肢骨还存在分歧。对翼龙而言，关联证据和捕食假说回答的是不同问题。
text.en: The pterosaurs and dinosaur do not share a complete growth sample, and three selected database occurrence rows do not count three individuals. Vespersaurus age estimates depend on retrocalculation assumptions, with disagreement between hind-limb elements. For the pterosaurs, evidence of association and proposals about predation answer different questions.

title.zh: 关联骨架、成长与共存
title.en: Associated skeleton, growth and coexistence

text.zh: 种页从正模与孤立材料开始，再介绍长而无齿的颌部、气腔化骨骼、骨骼融合及两件组织学样本。一条数据库出现行可以链接到描述多件标本的研究；出现行数量不等于骨骼或动物个体数。
text.en: The species account begins with the holotype and isolated material, then describes long toothless jaws, pneumatic anatomy, skeletal fusion and two histological samples. One database occurrence row can link to research describing multiple specimens; the row count does not count bones or animals.

title.zh: 共同骨床不等于确定食物网
title.en: A shared bonebed does not establish a food web

text.zh: 2019 年研究支持同一骨床中反复关联的解释。食腐、捕食和独居仍是生态假说。与 Caiuajara 和 Vespersaurus 出现在同一地点，不能证明彼此是最近亲。
text.en: The 2019 study supports repeated association in one bed. Scavenging, predation and solitary behavior remain ecological hypotheses. A shared locality with Caiuajara and Vespersaurus does not establish that they were one another’s closest relatives.

text.en: PBDB records Keresdrakon as a genus with one species entry; the original description names Keresdrakon vilsoni as the type species. Database parents organize these records, while the original relationship analysis and later classification schemes have their own scopes.

title.zh: 两段颌骨与探食假说
title.en: Two jaws and the probing hypothesis

text.zh: 从 L. begaaensis 的正模与副模开始：先区分保存段和推算缺失段，再比较上颌中央嵴与下颌沟、截面和骨孔。随后阅读成熟推断、亲缘分析与探食假说；喙尖缺失使远距触觉仍待检验。两件归入同种的材料不等于一个关联个体，也没有提供完整动物复原。
text.en: Start with the holotype and paratype in L. begaaensis: distinguish preserved fragments from estimated missing tips, then compare the upper-jaw ridge, lower-jaw groove, cross sections and foramina. Continue to maturity, relationships and the probing hypothesis. Missing bill tips leave remote touch open to testing. Two fragments referred to one species are not one associated individual or a complete animal reconstruction.

title.zh: 产层、假说与数据库计数
title.en: Horizons, hypotheses and database counts

text.zh: 原始描述把材料来源记为摩洛哥 Aferdou N’Chaft 的上部 Ifezouane Formation，并保留 ?Albian—lower Cenomanian；2023 年介绍仍保留存疑的 Albian—Cenomanian 表述。下方数据库的 100.5–93.9 Ma 是固定采集行的宽范围，不把它当作对正模的精确测年。河流沉积标签与探食假说分别阅读；一条数据库出现记录不能替代文献中的两件类型标本或种群数量。
text.en: The original description records Aferdou N’Chaft, Morocco, upper Ifezouane Formation, retaining ?Albian–lower Cenomanian. The 2023 account likewise retains an uncertain Albian–Cenomanian formulation. The 100.5–93.9 Ma bracket below belongs to the fixed database collection row rather than precise dating of the type. Read the fluvial setting separately from the probing hypothesis; one database occurrence is neither the two type specimens described in the paper nor a population count.

evidenceSummary: The associated skeleton described for T. navigans is one individual, and T. imperator has missing body scores in the cited matrices. The analyses leave branching within Tapejarinae unresolved, and the proposed sexual-dimorphism explanation is not established. The Table 4 wing-phalanx side discrepancy remains unresolved; exact locality coordinates for GP/2E 9266 are not available in the cited collection records.

title.zh: 把骨骼观察与亲缘分析分开读
title.en: Read skeletal observations and relationship analyses separately

text.zh: 先在 [T. navigans](Tupandactylus_navigans/page.zh.md) 阅读关联骨架，再看 64／65 单元矩阵、多棵最简树与严格共识。两套分析都留下 Tapejarinae 内部的未解分叉；[T. imperator](Tupandactylus_imperator/page.zh.md) 的缺失身体编码不能由 navigans 补齐，也不能用来证实性二型。CT 模型帮助观察隐埋骨骼，亲缘树则来自性状矩阵，两者的证据范围不同。
text.en: Start with the associated skeleton in [T. navigans](Tupandactylus_navigans/page.en.md), then read the 64/65-unit matrices, multiple shortest trees and strict consensus. Both analyses retain unresolved branching within Tapejarinae. Missing body scores for [T. imperator](Tupandactylus_imperator/page.en.md) cannot be supplied from navigans or used to confirm sexual dimorphism. CT models help reveal embedded bones; relationship trees derive from character matrices and answer a different question.

title.zh: 先读身体比例，再比较头部估计
title.en: Read body proportions before skull-based estimates

text.zh: [T. navigans](Tupandactylus_navigans/page.zh.md) 的关联骨架研究介绍肩带、骨盆和后肢，并讨论骨架尺寸与保存差异；可对读 [Europejara](../../../../Europejara/Europejara_olcadesorum/page.zh.md) 的头部比例估计。T. imperator 的具名出现记录和属级未定材料分别阅读，不把 navigans 的身体材料归给另一种。
text.en: The [T. navigans](Tupandactylus_navigans/page.en.md) account describes shoulder, pelvic and hindlimb anatomy alongside dimensions and preservation differences in its associated skeleton. Compare skull-based estimates in [Europejara](../../../../Europejara/Europejara_olcadesorum/page.en.md). Read T. imperator occurrences and genus-level material separately; observations from the navigans skeleton do not automatically apply to another species.

title.zh: 从一件关联骨架进入 Tupandactylus
title.en: Enter Tupandactylus through an associated skeleton

text.zh: 2021 年的一项 [T. navigans](Tupandactylus_navigans/page.zh.md) 关联骨架研究描述头冠、喙部角质鞘、颈背骨骼和翼指。先看保存状况与标本归属，再读功能假说；可对照 [T. imperator](Tupandactylus_imperator/page.zh.md) 的出现记录，但不能把前者的骨骼观察直接移给另一种。
text.en: A 2021 study of an associated [T. navigans](Tupandactylus_navigans/page.en.md) skeleton describes its crest, beak sheath, neck and back anatomy, and wing finger. Read preservation and specimen attribution before considering functional hypotheses. Compare the [T. imperator](Tupandactylus_imperator/page.en.md) occurrence guide without extending those skeletal observations to that species.

title.zh: 两种入口与属级材料分别阅读
title.en: Read the two species and genus-level material separately

text.zh: 论文提出但未解决两种的性二型解释；MN 6588-V 也只归属到 Tupandactylus sp.。两种的记录与属级材料应分开阅读：关联骨架、较早的出现记录和未定种材料不合并成一个标本计数。所引采集记录没有 GP/2E 9266 的精确地点坐标。
text.en: The paper raises, but does not resolve, sexual dimorphism as an explanation for the two species; MN 6588-V is assigned only to Tupandactylus sp. Keep species records and genus-level material separate: an associated skeleton, older occurrences and indeterminate material do not form a single specimen count. The cited collection records do not provide exact coordinates for GP/2E 9266.

title.en: Organize fossil records by source classification
title.zh: 按来源分类组织化石记录

text.zh: 古生物学数据库（PBDB）在 Tupandactylus 属下列出两个物种。关联骨架研究与出现记录属于不同证据，各自保留来源；数据库父级路径用于整理记录，不裁决亲缘关系。
text.en: The Paleobiology Database (PBDB) lists two species beneath Tupandactylus. The associated-skeleton study and occurrence records provide different kinds of evidence, each with its own source attribution; the database path organizes records but does not settle relationships.

title.en: Compare collections, strata and age brackets

text.zh: 出现导读涵盖 Tupandactylus navigans 与 Tupandactylus imperator。所选 PBDB 样本有 3 条出现记录、涉及 2 个采集记录，记录的地层包括 Crato 组。各条目保留自己的年代范围和鉴定信息；这些数量不代表古代种群规模。

Each entry keeps its own age bracket and identification; these counts do not measure a prehistoric population.

evidenceSummary: This route brings two catalogue entries together with a 2023 taxonomic revision. The paper proposes that S. gui is a synonym of S. dongi and assigns another morphotype to Huaxiadraco corollatus; these are published interpretations. Juvenile crest size does not establish sex, morphological clustering does not show genealogy, and the very young Nemicolopterus remains unassigned. The guide does not assemble every specimen account, the original 2003 descriptions, all anatomical variation or a complete ecological history. The occurrence totals and broad age bounds do not measure populations or exact origin and extinction times; published matrices and specimens are not independently remeasured here.

title.zh: 两个目录入口与一项修订
title.en: Two catalogue entries and one revision

text.zh: 目录列有 S. dongi 与 S. gui 两项。2023 年修订把 S. gui 视为 S. dongi 的异名，并将另一形态群命名为 Huaxiadraco corollatus。因此，数据库条目数与修订中的分类解释不是同一件事；两行记录本身不能决定认可多少个生物种。
text.en: The catalogue contains entries for S. dongi and S. gui. A 2023 revision treats S. gui as a synonym of S. dongi and names the other morphotype Huaxiadraco corollatus. The database entries and the revision’s interpretation therefore count different things; two catalogue rows do not by themselves settle how many biological species are recognized.

title.zh: 骨骼成长、名称与飞行研究对象
title.en: Skeletal growth, names and flight subjects

text.zh: S. dongi 页面介绍未成熟正模、性状组合和研究方法；S. gui 页面讨论保存情况与异名。幼体冠饰较小不能判定性别，形态聚类也不是亲缘树。Nemicolopterus 的极幼体目前还不能有把握地归入任一物种。
text.en: The S. dongi account follows the immature holotype, its character combination and the study methods; S. gui covers preservation and the proposed synonymy. A small crest in a juvenile does not identify sex, and a cluster of similar measurements is not a family tree. The very young Nemicolopterus specimen cannot yet be assigned confidently to either species.

title.zh: Sinopterus：PBDB 分类路径

text.en: The PBDB parent path lists Sinopterus as a genus with two catalogue entries. The 2023 paper separately interprets those names, including the proposed synonymy and Huaxiadraco assignment.

text.en: The two listed names, Sinopterus dongi and Sinopterus gui, connect to three selected occurrence rows from two collections; Jiufotang is the recorded stratum example. Each row keeps its own collection, age bracket and reference link. The total counts database records, not animals or population size.

title.en: A taxonomic revision of the Sinopterus complex (Pterosauria, Tapejaridae) from the Early Cretaceous Jehol Biota, with the new genus Huaxiadraco

scope.zh: 2023 年修订的正模、成长、形态组合、异名与幼体鉴定边界；固定目录身份单独保留。
scope.en: Holotypes, growth, anatomical combinations, synonymy and juvenile-identification limits in the 2023 revision; fixed catalogue identity remains separate.

readerLimitations.zh: 本路线把两个目录条目与 2023 年分类修订并列。论文提出 S. gui 是 S. dongi 的异名，并将另一形态群归入 Huaxiadraco corollatus；这是已发表的解释。幼体冠饰大小不能判定性别，形态聚类不显示谱系，极幼 Nemicolopterus 仍未能归属。本导读没有汇齐全部标本描述、2003 年原始描述、所有形态变异或完整生态史。出现记录总数和宽年代区间不能说明种群规模或精确起灭时间；这里没有独立复量标本或重算矩阵。
readerLimitations.en: This route brings two catalogue entries together with a 2023 taxonomic revision. The paper proposes that S. gui is a synonym of S. dongi and assigns another morphotype to Huaxiadraco corollatus; these are published interpretations. Juvenile crest size does not establish sex, morphological clustering does not show genealogy, and the very young Nemicolopterus remains unassigned. The guide does not assemble every specimen account, the original 2003 descriptions, all anatomical variation or a complete ecological history. The occurrence totals and broad age bounds do not measure populations or exact origin and extinction times; published matrices and specimens are not independently remeasured here.

Begin with the holotype and skull combination, then compare newer palatal interpretations, conditional referrals and the later Caupedactylia scheme. The database parent chain organizes records; relationship arguments retain their paper-specific scope.

text.en: First distinguish holotype MN 4726-V from possible referred fragments; next separate palatal anatomy from dietary interpretation based on bite-force models; then compare the reported Romualdo horizon with the selected PBDB row classified as Crato. The precise locality remains unknown.

overview: Caiuajara dobruskii is known from a bonebed with multiple individuals and material used to discuss growth, crests, and body proportions. The reading route also points to Keresdrakon and Vespersaurus, two separately studied taxa from the same regional record. A 2019 study reports repeated same-bed association; that does not make the three animals one ecological or anatomical group.

evidenceSummary: Studies of the bonebed, later histology, and the skull address different samples and questions. Growth and behavior claims remain interpretations rather than direct observations. The comparative route also draws on a 2019 shared-bonebed study and a 2020 Vespersaurus histology study; their specimens and models apply to the taxa each examined, and do not complete the site's fauna or all developmental evidence.

title.zh: Caiuajara 与共同骨床
title.en: Caiuajara and the shared bonebed

text.zh: Caiuajara dobruskii 来自包含多只个体材料的骨床，相关研究据此讨论成长、冠饰和身体比例。本阅读路径也链接到 Keresdrakon 与 Vespersaurus；它们是同一区域记录中分别研究的类群。2019 年研究报道了反复出现的同层关联，但这不表示三者属于同一生态或解剖类群。
text.en: Caiuajara dobruskii is known from a bonebed with multiple individuals and material used to discuss growth, crests, and body proportions. The reading route also points to Keresdrakon and Vespersaurus, two separately studied taxa from the same regional record. A 2019 study reports repeated same-bed association; that does not make the three animals one ecological or anatomical group.

title.zh: 成长与生态问题各自的材料边界
title.en: Material boundaries across growth and ecology questions

text.zh: 比较时分开三个问题：骨骼代表一只还是多只个体；哪些组织或形态支持成长估计；哪些行为属于化石推断？Caiuajara 与 Keresdrakon 没有一套共同且完整的成长样本。Vespersaurus 年龄估计取决于反推前提，且不同后肢骨给出的结果有分歧。共同保存本身不能证明捕食关系。
text.en: Keep three questions separate: do the bones represent one individual or several; which tissues or shapes support growth estimates; and which behaviors are inferred from the fossils? Caiuajara and Keresdrakon do not share a complete growth sample. Vespersaurus age estimates depend on retrocalculation assumptions and differ between hind-limb elements. Shared preservation alone does not demonstrate predation.

title.zh: 骨床样本、成长与头骨变异
title.en: Bonebed sample, growth and cranial variation

text.zh: 先读正模与 Caiuajara 骨床样本的范围，再看成长过程中报道的冠饰和身体骨骼变化，最后对照 2022 年头骨研究。骨床关联、成长和幼体飞行假说依据不同证据。
text.en: Begin with the holotype and the limits of the Caiuajara bonebed sample. Then follow reported crest and postcranial changes through growth before comparing the 2022 cranial study. Bonebed association, growth, and proposed juvenile flight behavior rely on different evidence.

title.zh: 数据库行与多标本样本
title.en: Database rows and multi-specimen samples

text.zh: 固定 PBDB 路径为 Caiuajara 保留一个工作名录物种入口和一条所选出现记录。论文中的骨床包含多个标本，但不会因此变成多条数据库出现记录；研究估算的最少个体数又是另一种计数。
text.en: The fixed PBDB route has one working-roster species entry and one selected occurrence row for Caiuajara. The paper's bonebed includes multiple specimens, but those do not become separate database occurrences; its minimum-individual estimate is a different count again.

title.en: Caiuajara: PBDB classification route
title.zh: Caiuajara：PBDB 分类路径

text.zh: PBDB 将 Caiuajara 记录在翼龙分类路径的属级位置，并在此关联一个物种入口。这个数据库父级路径用于定位记录，本身不是系统发育结论。
text.en: PBDB records Caiuajara as a genus in its pterosaur hierarchy and links one species entry here. This database parent route helps locate the record; it is not itself a phylogenetic result.

text.en: The selected PBDB occurrence is tied to one collection, with the stratum name Goio-Erê. Compare that collection record and its cited sources with the bonebed paper's specimens and minimum-individual count; each describes a different unit of evidence.

scope.en: 2020 sampling of five femora and six tibiae, maturity differences and age-retrocalculation assumptions; not transferable as pterosaur growth data.

readerLimitations.zh: 骨床研究、后续组织学和头骨研究涉及不同样本与问题。成长和行为主张仍是解释，不是直接观察。比较路径还参考 2019 年共同骨床研究及 2020 年 Vespersaurus 组织学研究；各自标本与模型只适用于所研究的类群，不能据此补全遗址动物群或全部成长证据。
readerLimitations.en: Studies of the bonebed, later histology, and the skull address different samples and questions. Growth and behavior claims remain interpretations rather than direct observations. The comparative route also draws on a 2019 shared-bonebed study and a 2020 Vespersaurus histology study; their specimens and models apply to the taxa each examined, and do not complete the site's fauna or all developmental evidence.

title.zh: Aymberedactylus 的下颌证据

text.en: The genus is known through its type species, A. cearensis. The described mandible is Y-shaped and preserves a retroarticular process and splenial fossa. The upper jaw and the skeleton behind it remain unknown, so maturity, wingspan and function require separate interpretation.

title.zh: 诊断、功能与亲缘假说
title.en: Diagnosis, function and relationship hypotheses

text.zh: 2016 年性状矩阵与 2025 年综述提出的 Caupedactylia 方案是两项不同的系统发育分析。保存的下颌是描述依据；功能、成熟度和翼展还涉及推断。PBDB 出现记录列出 Crato 采集地，但没有精确坐标。
text.en: The 2016 character matrix and the 2025 review's Caupedactylia scheme are separate phylogenetic analyses. The preserved mandible anchors the description; proposed function, maturity and wingspan involve further inference. The PBDB occurrence row names the Crato collection but provides no precise coordinates.

title.zh: 可比材料与修订后的名称

text.zh: 先将 corollatus 的正模、翼骨及 D2525 归入，与 benxiensis 的肱骨重评和相对成长讨论对读。再看 jii 所述幼体标本、较长的第一掌骨和冠饰，并与 Sinopterus dongi 的异名方案及形态型解释比较。三条出现记录不等于三件标本，也不能证明有三个独立物种。
text.en: Compare the corollatus holotype, wing bones, and D2525 referral with the humeral reassessment and relative-growth discussion for benxiensis. Then read the juvenile specimen, long first metacarpal, and crests described for jii, alongside the synonymy and morphotypes proposed for Sinopterus dongi. Three occurrence rows do not represent three specimens or prove three separate species.

title.zh: 头冠形态、取食模型与标本归入
title.en: Crest anatomy, feeding models and specimen referrals

text.zh: 从 T. sethi 的正模保存长度和头冠构造开始，再对读 2002 年功能假说、2007 年掠水模型与 2018 年重描述。尤其留意旧模型颌骨的归属历史。本路线只包含当前工作名录中的一个种页；2018 年提出 T. oberlii 是另一种，是论文的分类解释，不据此修改固定数据库名单或把两种材料合并。
text.en: Begin with the holotype measurements and crest in T. sethi, then compare the 2002 functional hypotheses, 2007 skimming models and 2018 redescription. text.en: The 2002 paper records the type horizon as the Romualdo Member of the Santana Formation, Albian; the 2018 paper uses Romualdo Formation within the Santana Group. It explicitly notes disputed relationships and uses a framework with Thalassodrominae and Tapejarinae as sisters. The fixed PBDB collection row below retains 119.57–113.2 Ma, Late Aptian and the Thalassodromidae parent chain. Stratigraphic terminology, dating and classification differences remain distinct, without replacing database scope from one older paper or claiming a unified latest consensus.

text.zh: 从 X. curvirostris 的 2018 年正模开始，对读 2020、2023 年的来源。2023 年新增下颌归属，且正模产层记录与 2020 年不同；这两件事分别阅读。再看未知上颌的备选解释与细分亲缘，保留形态型和未定归属，不把数据库的一条出现记录直接等同于文献提及的全部标本。
text.en: Begin with the 2018 type in X. curvirostris and compare the 2020 and 2023 sources. The 2023 paper adds a lower-jaw referral and differs from 2020 on the type horizon; read those as separate issues. Then consider alternatives for the unknown upper jaw and finer relationships, retaining morphotypes and indeterminate attributions. One database occurrence is not all specimens mentioned in the literature.

title.zh: 从下颌正模到分类假说
title.en: From a lower-jaw type to taxonomic hypotheses

text.zh: 从 X. curvirostris 的 FSAC-KK 10700 开始：先区分保存长度与延长颌缘的复原，再读弯曲、腹侧沟及骨表面。随后对读 Alanqa 的正模解释与可能异名，保留归属层次和未决问题；两件正模没有被证实是一个关联个体。
text.en: Start with FSAC-KK 10700 in X. curvirostris: separate preserved length from projected jaw reconstruction, then read curvature, the ventral groove and bone surface. Compare the type interpretation and possible synonymy of Alanqa while retaining attribution levels and unresolved questions. The two type specimens are not demonstrated parts of one associated individual.

title.zh: 一段无齿颌部的证据范围

text.zh: 本属阅读路线补入原始描述与后续比较，不代表完整生物学。无齿、颌沟与骨孔可参与形态比较，尺寸类别和保存环境则不能确定本属的最大体型、固定食谱或古种群数量。更细类群位置与 Alanqa 的异名可能性保留来源之间的限定。
text.en: This route adds the original description and later comparison without claiming complete biology. Toothlessness, jaw grooves and foramina inform morphological comparison. Size categories and preservation settings do not establish maximum genus size, a fixed diet or ancient population size. Finer relationships and possible synonymy with Alanqa retain their source qualifications.

title.zh: 记录分类与大型标本的证据
title.en: Recorded classification and evidence from a large specimen

text.zh: PBDB 目录沿记录父链把 Tropeognathus 放在 Tropeognathinae 下。链接中的 T. mesembrinus 页面讨论 2013 年对 MN 6594-V 的 cf. 鉴定、头部破损、局部组织学和翼展重建。论文的科级鉴定与目录的亚科路径来自不同记录；存放位置本身既不能确定这件标本的亚科归属，也不能解决所有支系定义。
text.en: The PBDB directory places Tropeognathus under Tropeognathinae along its recorded parent path. Its linked T. mesembrinus page examines the 2013 cf. identification of MN 6594-V, cranial damage, sampled histology and a wingspan reconstruction. The paper’s family-level identification and the catalogue’s subfamily route have different provenance: storage position alone neither settles this specimen’s subfamily assignment nor resolves how every clade is defined.

title.zh: 标本身份、成熟度与大小
title.en: Specimen identity, maturity and size

text.zh: MN 6594-V 的组织学显示，其生长可能已经停止或接近停止，尽管部分轴向骨骼尚未完全融合。另一方面，MPSC 材料中未融合的翼指伸肌突被用于讨论未成熟状态。这些观察来自不同标本，且未证明 MPSC 材料属于 Tropeognathinae，不能据此绘出该亚科已经测定的生长曲线。
text.en: Histology from MN 6594-V indicates that growth had stopped or nearly stopped, even though some axial elements were not fully fused. Separately, an unfused wing-finger extensor process in MPSC material informs the authors’ discussion of immaturity. The observations concern different specimens, and the MPSC material is not established as a Tropeognathinae member. They cannot be combined into a measured growth curve for the subfamily.

title.en: Large body specimen and named Tropeognathus species

text.en: The genus route brings database records for named species together with MN 6594-V, a larger body specimen described in 2013. Its identification remains cf. title.zh: 保存的头骨与叶片解释
title.en: Preserved skull and leaf interpretation

text.zh: 从 L. sibbicki 的 SMNK PAL 3828 开始，依次区分头骨与下颌、压扁与头冠切损、产地来源和形态比较。随后读叶片位置、植物类比及误吞死亡假说，再看 2018 年舌骨比较。不同证据不能合成一个已经确定的完整生活史；数据库采集记录与正模标本也分别计数。
text.en: Start with SMNK PAL 3828 in L. sibbicki, separating skull and mandible, compression and crest cutting, provenance and morphology. Continue to leaf position, botanical analogies and the accidental-ingestion hypothesis, then the 2018 hyoid comparison. These different lines of evidence do not combine into a settled complete life history. The database collection record and the type specimen also retain their different counting units.

title.zh: 命名背景与有年份的分类归属
title.en: Naming history and dated classification

text.zh: 2003 年作者用 ludus（游戏、玩耍）与 dactylus（指）解释属名，呼应带牙而又有后方向头冠的玩具形象；种加词纪念画家 John Sibbick。原始描述把该属归入当时使用的 Ornithocheiridae 体系，这是有年代背景的分类，后续方案可能有所修订。
text.en: The 2003 authors explain the genus name through ludus, game or play, and dactylus, finger, referring to toy forms combining teeth with a posterior crest. The species name honors artist John Sibbick. The original description places the genus in its dated Ornithocheiridae framework, a historical classification that later proposals may revise.

evidenceSummary:
The anatomical account and name correction provide selected descriptions and analyses, not a specimen-by-specimen redescription. title.zh: 2014 年形态描述与 2020 年名称更正
title.en: The 2014 anatomical account and 2020 name correction

text.zh: 2014 年论文描述 Ikrandraco avatar 的骨骼。2020 年更正解释，电子论文没有在文中提供规定的 ZooBank 注册证据，因此属名和种名不能从该作品取得命名可用性。更正补上注册并重述模式材料与诊断。形态研究和名称可用性的裁定回答不同问题，因此分别引用。
text.en: The 2014 paper describes Ikrandraco avatar anatomy. A 2020 correction explains that the electronic article did not include the required ZooBank registration evidence, so the genus- and species-group names were unavailable from that work. The correction supplies the registration and restates the type material and diagnosis. The anatomical findings and the correction’s nomenclatural ruling answer different questions and are cited separately.

title.zh: 两件标本保存的身体范围不同
title.en: The two specimens preserve different parts of the body

text.zh: 正模 IVPP V18199 来自辽宁建昌喇嘛洞，保留头颌、部分颈椎、胸骨板、肋骨、双翼和足部；归入标本 IVPP V18406 来自凌源四合当，主要保存头颌与前部颈椎。两者存于北京中国科学院古脊椎动物与古人类研究所。第二件没有与第一件同样的肢骨资料，不能将两者拼成一个测量完整的理想个体。
text.en: Holotype IVPP V18199 from Lamadong, Jianchang, preserves cranial and mandibular material, part of the neck, sternum, ribs, both wings and foot material. Referred specimen IVPP V18406 from Sihedang, Lingyuan, principally preserves the head and anterior cervical vertebrae. Both are housed at the Institute of Vertebrate Paleontology and Paleoanthropology in Beijing. The second does not supply the same limb data as the first, so they cannot be combined into one wholly measured ideal individual.

title.zh: 侧向压扁与未知层位限制比较
title.en: Lateral flattening and unknown horizons limit comparison

text.zh: 两件化石均侧向压扁，正模有裂缝造成头端和部分翼指节错位，第二件部分皮质骨缺失。两个地点相距约 20–25 千米，确切层位未知；论文用九佛堂组约 120 Ma 的地层背景，不能据此确定两件同时死亡。头骨高度与下颌高度的差异部分被作者归因于压缩，尺寸不同也不足以单独证明不同种、性别或生长阶段。
text.en: Both fossils are laterally flattened. Fracturing displaced the cranial tip and some wing phalanges of the holotype; parts of the referred specimen’s cortical bone are missing. Sites are about 20–25 km apart and exact horizons are unknown. The paper’s approximately 120 Ma Jiufotang context does not establish simultaneous deaths. The authors attribute some differences in cranial and jaw height to compression; size differences alone do not establish distinct species, sexes or growth stages.

title.zh: 低长头部与深下颌骨冠
title.en: A low elongated head and deep mandibular crest

text.zh: 头部低而长，没有前上颌骨正中冠，牙骨腹侧却有薄而深、刀片状的骨冠。两件标本都保留骨冠后缘的钩状突起，作者认为并非保存伪影；最深处约在第九与第十下颌牙槽之间。骨冠可能覆角质鞘，但并未直接保存其完整外形或颜色；两件个体也不能证明这一结构只有一种功能。
text.en: The skull is low and elongated without a median premaxillary crest, while the ventral dentary bears a thin, deep blade-shaped crest. Both specimens preserve its posterior hook-like process, interpreted by the authors as genuine rather than an artifact, with greatest depth near the ninth and tenth lower alveoli. A horny covering is possible without a directly preserved complete contour or color; two individuals do not establish a single function for the structure.

title.zh: 小牙列支持比较，不直接记录食谱
title.en: Small teeth support comparisons without recording a diet

text.zh: 论文记每侧上颌至少二十一枚牙、下颌至少十九枚，牙槽小而椭圆，前部排列较紧。牙冠比同地层讨论的 Guidraco 和 Liaoningopterus 小，形状也不同于典型三角形、侧扁的帆翼龙科牙齿。牙列可以比较抓取猎物的假说，却没有胃内容物或直接摄食观察；不能仅以“小牙”确定唯一猎物种类。
text.en: The paper records at least twenty-one teeth per upper-jaw side and nineteen in the lower jaw, with small oval alveoli more closely spaced anteriorly. Crowns are smaller than those of Guidraco and Liaoningopterus discussed from the same formation, and differ from typical triangular, compressed istiodactylid teeth. Dentition informs prey-capture hypotheses without stomach contents or direct feeding observations; small teeth do not establish a unique prey species.

title.zh: 关联双翼与气孔提供骨骼线索
title.en: Associated wings and foramina provide skeletal evidence

text.zh: 正模的双翼虽未完全关节连接，仍紧密关联。肱骨有扭转的三角胸肌嵴，腕骨融合，第二与第三翼指节有气孔；气囊系统参与骨骼气化是作者的解释。部分前臂骨缺失，后肢只有不完整跖骨；不能据现存骨链直接恢复完整翼展、翼膜或腿部功能，更不能把骨孔当作完整软组织气囊的保存。
text.en: The holotype’s wings are closely associated despite incomplete articulation. The humerus has a warped deltopectoral crest, carpals are fused, and wing phalanges two and three have pneumatic foramina. Involvement of an air-sac system in skeletal pneumatization is the authors’ interpretation. Some forearm elements are incomplete and hindlimb material consists only of incomplete metatarsals; these do not directly restore complete span, membrane or leg function, and bone openings do not preserve whole soft-tissue air sacs.

title.zh: 融合支持成体解释，测量仍属于个体
title.en: Fusion supports adult interpretation while measurements remain individual

text.zh: 作者以正模第一翼指节伸肌腱突融合判断其为成体。表 1 记其头骨长 286.5 毫米、肱骨长 78.7 毫米；归入标本头骨长度则以大于 268.3 毫米记录，保留不完整测量的下限。表 2 的肱骨／头骨比例用于跨标本比较，不是全种固定比例或飞行能力指标。成体判断不提供确切年龄、性别或成体最大尺寸。
text.en: The authors infer adulthood from fused extensor tendon processes of the holotype’s first wing phalanges. Table 1 gives skull length as 286.5 mm and humerus length as 78.7 mm; the referred skull is recorded as greater than 268.3 mm, retaining a lower-bound measurement. Table 2 compares humerus/skull proportions across specimens rather than establishing an invariant species ratio or flight-performance measure. Adult interpretation supplies no exact age, sex or maximum adult size.

title.zh: 临时掠水与喉囊都是摄食假说
title.en: Temporary skimming and a throat pouch are feeding hypotheses

text.zh: 作者提出，低长头部和薄下颌骨冠或有利于贴近水面飞行，发现猎物后短暂将下颌浸入水中。后缘钩状突起可能锚定可伸展皮肤，形成类似喉囊的结构。这些是形态功能解释，文中没有保存本种完整喉囊或记录掠水行为；作者也指出其缺少现代剪嘴鸥的广泛适应，不把假说写成持续掠水或已验证的阻力模型。
text.en: The authors propose low flight over water, with brief mandibular immersion after detecting prey, potentially aided by the low head and thin dentary crest. The posterior hook could anchor extensible skin in a throat-pouch-like structure. These are functional interpretations without a preserved complete pouch in this species or recorded skimming behavior. The paper notes the absence of extensive modern skimmer adaptations; the proposal is neither continuous skimming nor a validated drag model.

title.zh: 系统树是 2014 年矩阵的分析结果
title.en: The tree is a result from the 2014 matrix

text.zh: 2014 年研究用修改后的形态矩阵分析无序、等权性状，得到十八棵同等简约树及其严格共识，将 Ikrandraco 放在 Pteranodontoidea 内、Anhangueria 外但近缘的位置。这是基于该研究完整性状矩阵的结果，不能用单一下颌或头冠特征代替。下方 PBDB 父级路径属于另一套数据库分类，并非此系统发育分析的一部分。
text.en: The 2014 study analyzes a modified morphological matrix with unordered, equally weighted characters. It recovers eighteen equally parsimonious trees and a strict consensus, placing Ikrandraco within Pteranodontoidea, outside but close to Anhangueria. That placement is the result of the study’s full character matrix; a single jaw or crest feature cannot stand in for it. The PBDB parent path below serves as a separate database classification, not as part of this phylogenetic analysis.

title.zh: 对读下颌骨冠与大型比较头部
title.en: Compare mandibular crests with a large comparative skull

text.zh: 返回 Ikrandraco 属，区分 2014 年骨骼描述与 2020 年名称更正，再对读 Tropeognathus 比较标本 的头部保存与功能假说。两者的头冠位置、保存完整度和鉴定背景不同；近缘或相似沉积环境不能把食谱、体型或行为相互移用。
text.en: Return to Ikrandraco to distinguish the 2014 anatomical account from the 2020 nomenclatural correction, then compare cranial preservation and functional hypotheses in the Tropeognathus comparative specimen. The database retains its own accepted name, collections and broad ages, separate from the anatomical interpretations.

Remanie fauna - reworked from late Albian into early Cenomanian deposits. Faunal assemblage is late Albian in age (age used here). "Although the deposit itself is generally considered to be of late Cretaceous, Cenomanian age, its macrofossil assemblage is thought to be derived largely from the underlying early Cretaceous, Albian, Gault Formation, on the basis of derived ammonites associated with the vertebrate fossils. An early Cenomanian age for deposition of the Cambridge Greensand is based on an apparently autochthonous foraminiferan assemblage, but Morter and Wood (1983) could not rule out the possibility of a very late Albian age due to the presence of the bivalve Aucinella. The age of the derived vertebrates is now considered to be no older than the Callihoplites auritus ammonite subzone and most likely no younger than upper Stoliczkaia dispar Zone, and they are thus of late Albian age." (Martill & Unwin 2011, Cretaceous Research, 10.1016/j.cretres.2011.09.003).

"Although the deposit itself is generally considered to be of late Cretaceous, Cenomanian age, its macrofossil assemblage is thought to be derived largely from the underlying early Cretaceous, Albian, Gault Formation, on the basis of derived ammonites associated with the vertebrate fossils. An early Cenomanian age for deposition of the Cambridge Greensand is based on an apparently autochthonous foraminiferan assemblage, but Morter and Wood (1983) could not rule out the possibility of a very late Albian age due to the presence of the bivalve Aucinella. The age of the derived vertebrates is now considered to be no older than the Callihoplites auritus ammonite subzone and most likely no younger than upper Stoliczkaia dispar Zone, and they are thus of late Albian age." (Martill & Unwin 2011, Cretaceous Research, 10.1016/j.cretres.2011.09.003).

此页导读的是 2026-10-02 快照中的 1 条 PBDB 选取出现记录，不是物种专论。地点和年代区间描述的是数据库记录，不能据此推出完整地理分布、连续存在的时间范围、生态、行为或种群大小。采集记录编号、出现记录编号、标本说明及来源明确给出的丰度单位彼此区分。地点坐标字段与古坐标／模型字段仍按不同来源字段保留。所列引文署名不代表已完成全文审读。
readerLimitations.en:
The records shown here are selected from PBDB data dated 2 October 2026, not a complete species account. Database names and linked references organize the catalogue but do not settle every specimen identification. Collection locations, age brackets, environmental settings and preservation labels do not establish the full range, exact origin or extinction time, species-wide ecology, abundance or the condition of every fossil.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 1 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

evidenceSummary:
The 2019 embryo study, the 2021 flight-model discussion and correction, and the 2024 palate study answer different questions. The flight calculations use Pterodaustro and Sinopterus, not Hamipterus; embryo staging and a later Sinopterus identification change how far those calculations can be applied. The palate scans describe separate specimens and do not settle age or flight ability. This account does not include the original 2014 description, the full 2017 egg study, supplementary measurements, or direct checks of specimens and images. Exact hatching and flight ages, parental care, diet and a complete growth sequence remain unknown.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 2 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

title.zh: 比较飞行模型时保留幼体鉴定分歧
title.en: Retain juvenile-identification differences when comparing flight models

text.zh: 2021 年模型使用的 IVPP V-14377 被当作 S. dongi 幼体，2023 年修订却认为它不能可靠归到该种或 H. corollatus，保留为 Sinopterinae 未定。见 Sinopterus dongi 的研究对读。这项后续鉴定限制模型的种级解释，没有直接重算或推翻全部力学结果，也不会把模型数值变成 Hamipterus 测量。
text.en: The 2021 models treat IVPP V-14377 as young S. dongi, whereas the 2023 revision cannot confidently refer it to that species or H. corollatus and retains it as indeterminate Sinopterinae. See the study comparison in Sinopterus dongi. This later identification limits species-specific interpretation without directly recalculating or overturning every mechanical result, and does not make model values Hamipterus measurements.

title.zh: 回到实际采用的幼体模型
title.en: Return to the hatchlings actually modeled

text.zh: 本页的飞行争论可与 Pterodaustro guinazui 对读。后者列出 2021 年模型的标本组合、翼面积缩放与肱骨负荷假设；先辨研究对象再比较论证，不能把其速度或抗弯数值改写为 Hamipterus 的性能。
text.en: Compare the flight debate here with Pterodaustro guinazui, which sets out the 2021 model’s specimen composites, wing-area scaling and humeral loading assumptions. Identify the modeled subject before comparing arguments; its speeds and bending values do not measure Hamipterus performance.

title.zh: 蛋与胚胎让成长问题可以分开提问
title.en: Eggs and embryos separate developmental questions

text.zh: Hamipterus 的蛋、胚胎与幼体材料，使出壳阶段成为可研究的问题。蛋内个体并不都接近出壳，后续论文因而重新讨论早期飞行能力；本页原始材料描述仍未齐。
text.en: Hamipterus eggs, embryos and young material permit developmental questions. Embryos need not all be near hatching, prompting later reassessment of early flight. Original material descriptions remain incompletely assembled here.

title.zh: 胚胎分期改变对弱骨化的解释
title.en: Embryonic staging changes the meaning of poor ossification

text.zh: 2019 年研究将胚胎 11–13 解释为较早发育阶段，区别于临近出壳材料。骨化不完全因而不能直接代表出壳幼体的状态；分期为比较推断，不是本种实际孵化日数。
text.en: The 2019 study interprets embryos 11–13 as an earlier developmental stage than near-term material. Incomplete ossification need not describe hatchlings. Comparative staging does not establish actual incubation days for this species.

title.zh: 肱骨冠小不能单独证明幼体不会飞
title.en: A small humeral crest alone does not prove flightlessness

text.zh: 2021 年作者反对以 Hamipterus 胚胎较小的三角胸肌嵴直接推出飞行肌肉不足。他们指出其形态与其他胚胎相近，而且小体型需要的肌肉绝对体积也较小。骨嵴、肌肉体积与飞行能力之间仍隔着推断；这项反驳没有直接记录本种幼体飞行，也没有确定出壳后第几小时起飞。
text.en: The 2021 authors reject inferring inadequate flight musculature solely from smaller deltopectoral crests in Hamipterus embryos. Comparable embryonic morphology and smaller absolute muscle requirements at small size weaken that inference. Crest form, muscle volume and flight ability remain separated by inference: this rebuttal neither observes Hamipterus flying nor identifies the hour after hatching when flight began.

title.zh: 定量飞行模型主要采用另外两个类群
title.en: The quantitative models primarily use two other taxa

text.zh: 2021 年研究用 Pterodaustro 与 Sinopterus 的近出壳或幼体材料建立滑翔与肱骨弯曲强度模型。翼面积由现生鸟类回归估计，体重从翼展关系估计，骨干近似为空心圆管。Hamipterus 是讨论对象，却不是这些定量模型中的本种样本；模型的速度、翼载和相对破坏力数值不能移植为本种测量。
text.en: The 2021 study models gliding and humeral bending using near-hatching or young Pterodaustro and Sinopterus material. Wing area comes from a living-bird regression, mass from wingspan scaling and shafts from hollow circular-tube approximations. Hamipterus is discussed but is not the species represented in those quantitative models. Their speeds, wing loadings and relative failure forces are not Hamipterus measurements.

title.zh: 骨强度模型仍依赖材料与保存假设
title.en: Bone-strength models retain material and preservation assumptions

text.zh: 模型以肱骨尺度与皮质厚度比较负荷承受能力，作者承认圆形截面简化了真实形状，也假定幼体与成体具有相同材料性质。部分输入跨标本组合，缺损和压扁影响可测参数。本页实际读了方法与结果，未重算模型或检查原骨切片；得到的支持是模型证据，不能标为本种飞行性能已实测。
text.en: The models compare loading capacity from humeral dimensions and cortical thickness. Circular sections simplify real shapes, and hatchlings and adults are assumed to share material properties. Some inputs combine specimens, with breakage and compression limiting measurements. Methods and results were read here without recalculation or inspection of original sections. Model support is not a measured flight-performance result for this species.

title.zh: 能早飞与接受亲代照料可以同时成立
title.en: Early flight and parental care can coexist

text.zh: 2021 年讨论明确指出，早成性不必意味着缺少亲代照料：能移动的幼体仍可能跟随亲代、接受保护或协助取食。对 Hamipterus 来说，蛋与不同成长阶段共同埋藏没有直接展示喂食或护幼。本页保留照料为未确定行为，也不把缺少直接证据反写成已经证明完全独立生活。
text.en: The 2021 discussion explicitly distinguishes precociality from an absence of parental care. Mobile offspring may still follow parents or receive protection or feeding assistance. Eggs and different growth stages buried together do not directly show Hamipterus feeding or guarding young. Care remains unresolved, and missing direct evidence does not prove wholly independent life.

title.zh: 成长中的飞行差异不是已知的完整生态史
title.en: Flight changes during growth do not establish a complete ecology

text.zh: 2021 年模型提出小幼体与大成体可能有不同速度、机动性和活动范围，从而可能利用不同环境。作者把生态位分化明确列为需要其他食性与运动资料支持的假说。这里不能据跨类群缩放，给 Hamipterus 幼体指定森林、成体指定开阔区，或列出随年龄改变的确定食谱。
text.en: The 2021 models suggest that size-related differences in speed, maneuverability and travel capacity could permit different ecological roles. The authors identify niche shifts as hypotheses requiring dietary and locomotor support. Cross-taxon scaling does not assign Hamipterus hatchlings to forests, adults to open spaces or establish a known age-dependent menu.

title.zh: 腭部扫描揭示的是融合后的骨结构
title.en: Palatal scans examine fused bone architecture

text.zh: 2024 年研究扫描 IVPP V 18943.3，并比较 V 18943.1 的腭部。扫描未揭示清晰骨缝，作者将其解释为腭骨块融合；背面结构仍提供与其他翼龙比较的线索。没有看到骨缝并不表示腭部只有一块原始骨。本页未查看原始 CT 或图像，也不由腭骨融合确定整件材料的确切岁数、性别或幼体飞行状态。
text.en: The 2024 study scans IVPP V 18943.3 and compares the palate of V 18943.1. No clear sutures were revealed, interpreted as fusion of the palatal elements; dorsal structure still supports comparison. Unseen sutures do not imply a single original palatal bone. Raw CT and images were not examined here, and fusion does not establish exact age, sex or hatchling flight status.

title.zh: 按胚胎、模型和独立腭部材料对读
title.en: Read embryos, models and separate palatal material

text.zh: 先读胚胎阶段争论，再查飞行模型真正使用的类群，最后把腭部扫描作为另一类身体证据。Dsungaripterus weii 页可对读 CT 如何识别骨缝与重新归属腭骨。2021 年论文的作者更正仅修复两处参考文献编号；本页读的是已更正主文，未把更正写成模型数值的变动。
text.en: Begin with embryonic-stage debate, identify the taxa actually modeled, and treat palatal scans as a separate anatomical evidence class. Dsungaripterus weii provides a comparison of CT suture identification and palatal reassignment. The 2021 author correction fixes two reference numbers; the corrected main text was read here, without presenting the correction as a numerical model change.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:
Hamipterus tianshanensis 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Hamipterus。本页导读 2 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 2 个采集记录和 2 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
Hamipterus tianshanensis 在 PBDB 快照中对应分类条目 txn:304280。这份存档导读包含 2 条选取的出现记录，关联 2 个不同的 PBDB 采集记录编号和 2 个不同的 PBDB 引文编号。出现记录与采集记录是不同单位；这两个数量都不等于标本数或个体数。此页聚焦一个具体问题：这些记录各自连到哪些地点、年代界、材料说明和引文？
text.en:
Hamipterus tianshanensis is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Hamipterus. This guide uses 2 eligible species-level occurrence records from 2 collections and 2 reference identifiers. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Hamipterus tianshanensis is listed in the PBDB snapshot under taxon txn:304280. This archived guide contains 2 selected occurrence rows, linked to 2 distinct PBDB collection IDs and 2 distinct PBDB reference IDs. An occurrence row and a collection record are different units; neither count is a specimen or individual count. The reading question here is concrete: which recorded localities, age bounds, material notes, and citations are attached to these rows?

title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh:
本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 137.05–132.6 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
在这组 PBDB 记录中，最大记录 eag=137.05 Ma，见 occ:1225230；最小记录 lag=132.6 Ma，见 occ:1225230。这些数值是具名数据库记录的年代界，不代表两者之间存在连续记录，也不是该物种的起源、灭绝或个体寿命日期。每条记录各自的 eag 与 lag 值见上文。
text.en:
Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 137.05–132.6 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Across these selected PBDB rows, the largest recorded eag=137.05 Ma in occ:1225230; the smallest recorded lag=132.6 Ma in occ:1225230. These values are age bounds on named database records, not a continuous record between them and not dates of the species' origin, extinction, or lifespan. Each row keeps its own eag and lag values above.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh:
Hami 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，类型未定（lacustrine indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石、original calcite（body,original calcite）。Hami (Silutitan type locality) 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，类型未定（lacustrine indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
此页区分出现记录编号、采集记录编号和材料说明。PBDB 采集记录编号不是单件标本编号。来源行提供的鉴定、材料、丰度及坐标／模型字段照录如下；采集层级的说明不被扩展成对每件化石的断言。

- occ:1225230：PBDB 原鉴定字段 idn=Hamipterus tianshanensis n. gen. n. sp.；PBDB 分类名称字段 tna=Hamipterus tianshanensis；材料说明字段 ocm=IVPP V18931–V18941；丰度字段 abv=40，abu=individuals；PBDB 地点坐标字段 lng=93.524918，lat=42.818501；古坐标／模型字段 pm1=gplates，pln=103.87，pla=37.56。
- occ:1569367：PBDB 分类名称字段 tna=Hamipterus tianshanensis；材料说明字段 ocm=incomplete lower jaw；丰度字段 abv=1，abu=specimens；PBDB 地点坐标字段 lng=92.500000，lat=42.750000；古坐标／模型字段 pm1=gplates，pln=102.99，pla=37.28。
text.en:
Hami has collection-environment label lacustrine indet.; collection preservation-mode label body,original calcite. Hami (Silutitan type locality) has collection-environment label lacustrine indet.; collection preservation-mode label body. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh:
Hami 的数据库引文署名为 Wang et al.（2014），编号 ref:52468。Hami (Silutitan type locality) 的数据库引文署名为 Wang et al.（2021），编号 ref:77626。这些是数据库中录入来源的简略署名，不是已经补齐的完整作者表，也不一定是本种原始描述。完整原行、采集 ID、接受与原鉴定名称和引文 ID 留在独立来源档案中；没有宣称已逐篇复核原论文或标本。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
存档导读把这些记录关联到 2 个不同的 PBDB 引文编号，保留外部 ref: 命名空间。下列具名记录各自保留数据库署名、年份和引文编号；这些署名不等于完整文献综述。

- occ:1225230：记录署名 Wang et al. 2014；PBDB 引文编号 ref:52468。
- occ:1569367：记录署名 Wang et al. 2021；PBDB 引文编号 ref:77626。
text.en:
Hami carries database reference attribution Wang et al. (2014), identifier ref:52468. Hami (Silutitan type locality) carries database reference attribution Wang et al. (2021), identifier ref:77626. These are abbreviated database source attributions, not completed author lists or necessarily the original species descriptions. formerly Middle Saurian Bed
Four closely spaced but discrete monodominant bonebeds

Most of the Jehol fossils from the Yixian Formation are preserved in four beds, that is, the Lujiatun bed (recalculated age is 124.0 ± 1.0/1.3 Ma, He et al., 2006), the Jianshangou bed (125.43 ± 0.50/0.88 Ma, Swisher et al., 1999), the Dawangzhangzi bed, and Jinggangshan bed (~122 Ma, Smith et al., 1995).U-Pb dating suggests that the Huangbanjigou section ranges from 124.9 ± 1.7 Ma to 122.8 ± 1.6 Ma (Yang et al., 2007). Chang et al. (2017) obtained Ar/Ar ages of 125.8 ± 1.0 Ma and 126.0 ± 0.8 Ma from the Lujiatun Unit, the lowest part of the Yixian Formation, below the lacustrine shales.
He et al. (2004) reported a 40Ar/39Ar age of 120.3 ± 0.7 Ma for a tuff layer in the lower part of the Jiufotang Formation, and Chang et al. (2009) obtained a 40Ar/39Ar age of 122.1 ± 0.3 Ma for a tuff layer from the lowermost part of the Jiufotang Formation. Yu et al. (2021) dated an ash bed just above the Yixian/Jiufotang formation boundary to 122.0 ± 0.9 Ma and three tuff beds from the Xiaotaizi section  to 118.9 ± 0.8 Ma, 118.8 ± 0.6 Ma, and 118.6 ± 1.1 Ma. These ages suggest that the Jiufotang Formation in Jianchang Basin was deposited at ca. 122.0–118.9 Ma.
Olierrok et al. (2019) used a selection of U-Pb and 40Ar-39Ar geochronology to place the Barremian–Aptian boundary (the base of the Chron M0r) between 123.8 and 121.8 Ma. The GTS 2020 uses an age of 121.4 Ma for the base of the Aptian, and multiproxy orbital tuning gives an age of 120.2 Ma for the Barremian-Aptian boundary (Leandro et al., 2022). Therefore, the Yixian Formation should be entirely Late Barremian, with the Jiufotang Formation deposited in the Early Aptian (or latest Barremian at its base).

readerLimitations.zh:
本页汇集 2026-10-02 固定 276 项翼龙工作名录中的 PBDB 出现记录。旧组合可能对应数据库接受名，但这种对应关系不裁决标本鉴定或所有分类争议。PBDB 父级链用于整理名录名称，与 COL 概念及系统发育树各自有别。地点、年代、沉积环境和集合保存字段描述的是数据库记录，不能单独确定完整分布、精确起源或灭绝时间、物种整体生态、生物数量或每件化石的保存状态。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
此页导读的是 2026-10-02 快照中的 1 条 PBDB 选取出现记录，不是物种专论。地点和年代区间描述的是数据库记录，不能据此推出完整地理分布、连续存在的时间范围、生态、行为或种群大小。采集记录编号、出现记录编号、标本说明及来源明确给出的丰度单位彼此区分。地点坐标字段与古坐标／模型字段仍按不同来源字段保留。所列引文署名不代表已完成全文审读。
readerLimitations.en:
This page summarizes selected PBDB pterosaur occurrences dated 2026-10-02 from the fixed 276-name working roster. Older combinations may appear under database accepted names, but that mapping does not settle specimen identification or every taxonomic dispute. The PBDB parent chain organizes catalogue names; it is separate from COL concepts and phylogenetic trees. Collection location, age, depositional setting and preservation describe database records, not a complete range, exact origin or extinction date, species-wide ecology, abundance or the condition of every fossil.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 1 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

context.zh: 返回记录父级的阅读入口，保留各出现与采集记录的范围。
context.en: Return to the recorded parent reading route, retaining occurrence and collection scope.

overview:
The 2026-10-02 PBDB snapshot uses Ardeadactylus longicollum as the accepted name, with Ardeadactylus as its recorded database parent. This guide selects 3 species-level occurrence records from 3 collections and links them to 2 source-reference identifiers. These are database units, not counts of fossils or individual animals. In 3 records, the original identification or name combination is linked to the accepted name; the original wording remains in the record, and a name change does not create another occurrence.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Ardeadactylus longicollum is listed in the PBDB snapshot under taxon txn:163714. This archived guide contains 3 selected occurrence rows, linked to 3 distinct PBDB collection IDs and 2 distinct PBDB reference IDs. An occurrence row and a collection record are different units; neither count is a specimen or individual count. The reading question here is concrete: which recorded localities, age bounds, material notes, and citations are attached to these rows?

evidenceSummary:
This page summarizes selected pterosaur occurrences in a PBDB snapshot dated 2026-10-02; it is not a complete species monograph. The records use the database accepted name and parent path and include usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. A PBDB link to an older name does not settle specimen identification or all taxonomic disputes, and it does not merge the record with a same-named COL concept. Collection locality, stratigraphic interval, depositional setting, and collection-level preservation mode are distinct fields. They do not by themselves establish a complete range, true origin or extinction time, fixed ecology, abundance, or the preservation of every specimen.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 3 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:

text.en:
The 2026-10-02 PBDB snapshot uses Ardeadactylus longicollum as the accepted name, with Ardeadactylus as its recorded database parent. This guide selects 3 species-level occurrence records from 3 collections and links them to 2 source-reference identifiers. These are database units, not counts of fossils or individual animals. In 3 records, the original identification or name combination is linked to the accepted name; the original wording remains in the record, and a name change does not create another occurrence.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Ardeadactylus longicollum is listed in the PBDB snapshot under taxon txn:163714. This archived guide contains 3 selected occurrence rows, linked to 3 distinct PBDB collection IDs and 2 distinct PBDB reference IDs. An occurrence row and a collection record are different units; neither count is a specimen or individual count. The reading question here is concrete: which recorded localities, age bounds, material notes, and citations are attached to these rows?

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh:
采集记录 Nusplingen Plattenkalk, Liegende Bankkalk Fm.（Baden-Württemberg），地区代码 DE，地层名称 Liegende Bankkalk；数据库年代范围 152.21–149.2 Ma，早端地质时段 Late Kimmeridgian。采集记录 Nusplingen quarry (SMNS collection)（Baden-Württemberg），地区代码 DE；数据库年代范围 152.21–149.2 Ma，早端地质时段 Late Kimmeridgian。采集记录 Eichstätt, Solnhofen (BSPG collection)（Bayern），地区代码 DE，地层名称 Solnhofen；数据库年代范围 149.2–145.06 Ma，早端地质时段 Early Tithonian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
存档导读包含 3 条出现记录，以下列出全部记录。每个 occ: 编号标识一条出现记录；col: 标识其关联的采集记录。

- 出现记录 occ:1192903；PBDB 采集记录 col:154138。 地点字段 cnm=Nusplingen Plattenkalk, Liegende Bankkalk Fm.；地点分区字段 cc2=DE，stp=Baden-Württemberg。 记录年代界：eag 152.21 Ma; lag 149.2 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Late Kimmeridgian。 地层字段 sfm=Liegende Bankkalk。 记录署名 Dietl and Schweigert 2011；PBDB 引文编号 ref:49972。

- 出现记录 occ:1704787；PBDB 采集记录 col:229120。 地点字段 cnm=Nusplingen quarry (SMNS collection)；地点分区字段 cc2=DE，stp=Baden-Württemberg。 记录年代界：eag 152.21 Ma; lag 149.2 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Late Kimmeridgian。 记录署名 Wellnhofer 1970；PBDB 引文编号 ref:32120。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
upper Kimmeridgian, Beckeri Zone, Ulmense Subzone

- 出现记录 occ:2070020；PBDB 采集记录 col:216616。 地点字段 cnm=Eichstätt, Solnhofen (BSPG collection)；地点分区字段 cc2=DE，stp=Bayern。 记录年代界：eag 149.2 Ma; lag 145.06 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Early Tithonian。 地层字段 sfm=Solnhofen。 记录署名 Wellnhofer 1970；PBDB 引文编号 ref:32120。
text.en:
Collection Nusplingen Plattenkalk, Liegende Bankkalk Fm. (Baden-Württemberg), region code DE, stratum name Liegende Bankkalk; database age bracket 152.21–149.2 Ma, early interval Late Kimmeridgian. Collection Nusplingen quarry (SMNS collection) (Baden-Württemberg), region code DE; database age bracket 152.21–149.2 Ma, early interval Late Kimmeridgian. Collection Eichstätt, Solnhofen (BSPG collection) (Bayern), region code DE, stratum name Solnhofen; database age bracket 149.2–145.06 Ma, early interval Early Tithonian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh:
本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 152.21–145.06 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
在这组 PBDB 记录中，最大记录 eag=152.21 Ma，见 occ:1192903；最小记录 lag=145.06 Ma，见 occ:2070020。这些数值是具名数据库记录的年代界，不代表两者之间存在连续记录，也不是该物种的起源、灭绝或个体寿命日期。每条记录各自的 eag 与 lag 值见上文。
text.en:
Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 152.21–145.06 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Across these selected PBDB rows, the largest recorded eag=152.21 Ma in occ:1192903; the smallest recorded lag=145.06 Ma in occ:2070020. These values are age bounds on named database records, not a continuous record between them and not dates of the species' origin, extinction, or lifespan. Each row keeps its own eag and lag values above.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh:
Nusplingen Plattenkalk, Liegende Bankkalk Fm. 的采集环境标签为 潟湖或受限浅潮下沉积环境（lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石、压印保存、trace、软组织（body,adpression,trace,soft parts）。Nusplingen quarry (SMNS collection) 的采集环境标签为 潟湖或受限浅潮下沉积环境（lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。Eichstätt, Solnhofen (BSPG collection) 的采集环境标签为 潟湖或受限浅潮下沉积环境（lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal）；集合保存方式标签为 mold/impression、压印保存（mold/impression,adpression）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
此页区分出现记录编号、采集记录编号和材料说明。PBDB 采集记录编号不是单件标本编号。来源行提供的鉴定、材料、丰度及坐标／模型字段照录如下；采集层级的说明不被扩展成对每件化石的断言。

- occ:1192903：PBDB 原鉴定字段 idn=Pterodactylus longicollum；PBDB 分类名称字段 tna=Ardeadactylus longicollum；PBDB 地点坐标字段 lng=8.866667，lat=48.116669；古坐标／模型字段 pm1=gplates，pln=22.34，pla=31.19。
- occ:1704787：PBDB 原鉴定字段 idn=Pterodactylus longicollum n. sp.；PBDB 分类名称字段 tna=Ardeadactylus longicollum；材料说明字段 ocm=SMNS 5802 (neotype specimen)；丰度字段 abv=1，abu=specimens；PBDB 地点坐标字段 lng=8.875000，lat=48.125000；古坐标／模型字段 pm1=gplates，pln=22.34，pla=31.19。
- occ:2070020：PBDB 原鉴定字段 idn=Pterodactylus longicollum；PBDB 分类名称字段 tna=Ardeadactylus longicollum；材料说明字段 ocm=Specimens lost (formerly Munich)；丰度字段 abv=2，abu=specimens；PBDB 地点坐标字段 lng=11.145000，lat=48.910000；古坐标／模型字段 pm1=gplates，pln=23.87，pla=32.08。
text.en:
Nusplingen Plattenkalk, Liegende Bankkalk Fm. has collection-environment label lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal; collection preservation-mode label body,adpression,trace,soft parts. Nusplingen quarry (SMNS collection) has collection-environment label lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal; collection preservation-mode label body. Eichstätt, Solnhofen (BSPG collection) has collection-environment label lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal; collection preservation-mode label mold/impression,adpression. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
The page keeps occurrence IDs, collection IDs, and material notes distinct. A PBDB collection ID is not an individual specimen ID. Where the source row supplies them, its identification, material, abundance, and coordinate/model fields are transcribed below without turning a collection-level note into a claim about every fossil.

- occ:1192903: PBDB original-identification field idn=Pterodactylus longicollum; PBDB taxon-name field tna=Ardeadactylus longicollum; PBDB locality-coordinate fields lng=8.866667, lat=48.116669; paleocoordinate/model fields pm1=gplates, pln=22.34, pla=31.19.
- occ:1704787: PBDB original-identification field idn=Pterodactylus longicollum n. sp.; PBDB taxon-name field tna=Ardeadactylus longicollum; material note ocm=SMNS 5802 (neotype specimen); abundance fields abv=1, abu=specimens; PBDB locality-coordinate fields lng=8.875000, lat=48.125000; paleocoordinate/model fields pm1=gplates, pln=22.34, pla=31.19.
- occ:2070020: PBDB original-identification field idn=Pterodactylus longicollum; PBDB taxon-name field tna=Ardeadactylus longicollum; material note ocm=Specimens lost (formerly Munich); abundance fields abv=2, abu=specimens; PBDB locality-coordinate fields lng=11.145000, lat=48.910000; paleocoordinate/model fields pm1=gplates, pln=23.87, pla=32.08.

upper part of Morrison, near base of member; 30-45 m below base of overlying Cedar Mountain Fm.
