text.zh: Leptostomia begaaensis 的正模 FSAC-KK 5075 是缺少尖端的前部上颌吻部；副模 FSAC-KK 5076 是前部下颌联合的一段，也缺少尖端。两件材料存于卡萨布兰卡 Université Hassan II 的 Faculté des Sciences Aïn Chock 收藏。原始描述据相近尺寸、长低轮廓、厚壁半圆截面、骨孔分布及相对应的嵴与沟支持同种归属；2023 年明确说没有理由认为它们来自同一个体。这里没有完整头骨或关联身体骨骼。
text.en: Holotype FSAC-KK 5075 is a partial anterior rostrum missing its tip; paratype FSAC-KK 5076 is part of the anterior mandibular symphysis, also missing its tip. Both are held at the Faculté des Sciences Aïn Chock, Université Hassan II, Casablanca. The original description supports referral to one species from similar size, long low outlines, thick-walled semicircular sections, foramina and a corresponding ridge-and-groove complex. The 2023 account explicitly gives no reason to regard them as one individual. Neither a complete skull nor an associated body skeleton is available.

title.zh: 48 与 67 毫米是保存长度
title.en: 48 and 67 mm are preserved lengths

text.zh: 原始稿件与表 1 记录，上颌片段保存长 48 毫米，下颌片段保存长 67 毫米。作者假定颌部均匀收尖，分别推算前方还缺约 70 毫米、35 毫米；这两个数字是缺失段估计，不是保存长度或已经量得的完整喙长。上颌在鼻眶前孔之前折断，下颌后端未达两支分叉。下颌近尖端的弯曲还受到修补影响，不能把全部曲度当作原始形状。
text.en: The manuscript and table 1 record 48 mm of preserved rostrum and 67 mm of preserved mandible. Assuming an evenly tapering tip, the authors estimate about 70 mm and 35 mm missing anteriorly, respectively. Those are missing-length estimates, not preserved lengths or measurements of a complete beak. The rostrum breaks anterior to the nasoantorbital fenestra; the mandible stops before the rami diverge. Repair also accentuates curvature near the mandibular tip, so the entire observed curve cannot be treated as original anatomy.

title.zh: 低夹角、中央嵴与对应的下颌沟
title.en: Low angles, a median ridge and a corresponding groove

text.zh: 上颌咬合面有沿保存段延伸的中央嵴，下颌则由前部较平的表面过渡到后部浅中央沟。作者结合侧面夹角差异区分上下颌；2023 年比较给出约 2.5° 与 2.0°。两者背腹扁平、截面近半圆，厚骨壁包围较小内部空腔，并有细长裂隙状骨孔。这些是一组形态比较依据；嵴沟相配不能证明两段实物曾连接，也不直接保存取食动作。
text.en: A median ridge extends along the preserved upper-jaw occlusal surface. The lower jaw changes from a flatter anterior surface to a shallow posterior median groove. The authors distinguish upper and lower jaws partly by lateral-angle differences, given as about 2.5° and 2.0° in the 2023 comparison. Both are dorsoventrally flattened, approximately semicircular in section, and have thick cortices around reduced cavities with elongate slit-like foramina. This character combination informs comparison; a corresponding ridge and groove do not prove that the fragments were joined or directly preserve feeding behavior.

title.zh: XCT 描述的是骨内空腔与通道
title.en: XCT describes internal cavities and canals

text.zh: 作者对正模 FSAC-KK 5075 进行 X 射线计算机断层成像，并用软件去除基质、构建三维模型。稿件描述沿吻部延伸的扁平中央空腔、局部跨越空腔的薄骨小梁，以及通向外部细长骨孔的通道。图像与模型显示内部构造，不是保存的神经或感受器；骨通道也不能测出感觉表现。
text.en: The authors used X-ray computed tomography on holotype FSAC-KK 5075, digitally removing matrix and constructing a three-dimensional model. The manuscript describes a flattened central void extending along the rostrum, thin trabeculae crossing it locally, and canals opening into elongate external foramina. Imaging and models reveal internal architecture rather than preserved nerves or sensory receptors; the canals do not measure sensory performance.

title.zh: 小尺寸不等于已确定的幼体
title.en: Small size does not establish a juvenile

text.zh: 原始描述认为两件标本较平滑的骨表面支持骨骼成熟的推断。这个判断来自局部表面比较，不是精确年龄测定；材料仍然是两段颌骨，没有生长序列、完整翼部或性别证据。不能仅因保存段只有数厘米便将其写成幼体，也不能把成熟推断延伸为本种完整成年体型或固定翼展。
text.en: The original description interprets the relatively smooth surfaces of both specimens as suggesting osteological maturity. This comes from local surface comparison, not exact age determination. The material remains two jaw fragments, without a growth series, complete wings or sex evidence. Preserved lengths of only a few centimeters do not by themselves establish juveniles, and the maturity inference supplies neither complete adult proportions nor a fixed wingspan.

title.zh: 亲缘分析受少量可编码性状限制
title.en: Relationships are limited by few codable characters

text.zh: 原始稿件把无齿、细长骨孔与厚骨壁的组合视为更支持 Azhdarchoidea，同时保留科级归属未知。其系统发育分析采用既有数据集并增加五个性状；作者报告可编码性状有限、相似性状重复演化，导致无序与不同有序处理的结果未解或相互冲突，另有与 ctenochasmatids、Lonchodectes 接近的结果。2023 年介绍也保留科级位置未定。因此，已发表分析不足以把目录父链视为确定的亲缘关系结论。
text.en: The original manuscript favors Azhdarchoidea from the combination of toothlessness, elongate foramina and thick cortices, while leaving family attribution unknown. Its phylogenetic analysis adds five characters to an existing dataset. The authors report few codable characters and homoplasy, yielding unresolved or conflicting results under unordered and differently ordered treatments, including alternatives near ctenochasmatids and Lonchodectes. The 2023 account also leaves the family position indeterminate. The published analyses therefore do not support treating the directory parent chain as a settled phylogenetic result.

title.zh: 探入沉积物取食是形态支持的假说
title.en: Sediment probing is a morphological hypothesis

text.zh: 原始描述把细长、狭窄、背腹扁平的颌部与加强的骨壁，同现生探食鸟类作功能比较，提出 Leptostomia 可能把喙探入泥土或沉积物获取小型无脊椎动物。作者也认为 Kem Kem 的淡水至半咸水沉积背景与这个假说相容。鸟类类比、骨形与环境的一致性不是本种胃内容物、直接取食观察或专属足迹；文中提到的蠕虫、甲壳类、软体动物是潜在猎物，不能写成已经确认的食谱。
text.en: The original description compares the long, narrow, dorsoventrally flattened jaws and strengthened cortices with probing birds, proposing that Leptostomia inserted its beak into soil or sediment to obtain small invertebrates. The authors consider the freshwater-to-brackish Kem Kem setting compatible with this hypothesis. Bird analogies, bone form and environmental consistency are not stomach contents, direct feeding observations or tracks assigned to this species. Worms, crustaceans and molluscs discussed as potential prey cannot become a confirmed menu.

title.zh: 缺少喙尖，远距触觉仍是可检验预测
title.en: Missing tips leave remote touch as a testable prediction

text.zh: 某些探食鸟类可以借喙尖感受结构察觉隐蔽猎物引起的振动或水压变化。作者讨论这种“远距触觉”作为 Leptostomia 的可能适应，但明确指出正模与副模都没有前端，无法确定喙尖是否有集中骨孔支持这一能力，并提出可用更多标本检验这一预测。保存段的骨孔与内部通道本身不是感受器，因此远距触觉仍未得到证实。
text.en: Some probing birds detect vibrations or pressure changes from hidden prey through sensory structures near the bill tip. The authors discuss this remote-touch ability as a possible adaptation in Leptostomia but explicitly state that both type specimens lack their anterior tips, preventing assessment of concentrated tip foramina that might support it. Additional specimens could test the prediction. The preserved foramina and canals are not themselves sensory receptors, so the proposed touch ability remains unconfirmed.

readerLimitations.zh:
这里展示的是截至 2026-10-02 的 PBDB 精选记录，并非完整物种叙述。数据库名称和关联文献用于整理名录，但不裁定每件标本的鉴定。采集地点、年代区间、环境和保存标签不能单独说明完整分布、精确起源或灭绝时间、物种整体生态、数量或每件化石的保存状况。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
此页导读的是 2026-10-02 快照中的 1 条 PBDB 选取出现记录，不是物种专论。地点和年代区间描述的是数据库记录，不能据此推出完整地理分布、连续存在的时间范围、生态、行为或种群大小。采集记录编号、出现记录编号、标本说明及来源明确给出的丰度单位彼此区分。地点坐标字段与古坐标／模型字段仍按不同来源字段保留。所列引文署名不代表已完成全文审读。
readerLimitations.en:
The records shown here are selected from PBDB data dated 2 October 2026, not a complete species account. Database names and linked references organize the catalogue but do not settle every specimen identification. Collection locations, age brackets, environmental settings and preservation labels do not establish the full range, exact origin or extinction time, species-wide ecology, abundance or the condition of every fossil.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 1 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

overview: Beccari and colleagues’ 2021 description centers on GP/2E 9266, a largely articulated Tupandactylus navigans skeleton with skull, postcranial bones and soft-tissue traces. It is referred material, not the holotype SMNK PAL 2344. At publication, it was the first postcranial specimen unambiguously assigned to the genus, linking body anatomy to the skull-based record. That advance does not mean all referred specimens have since been rechecked.

evidenceSummary:
This page pairs a bilingual guide to selected passages of the 2021 associated-skeleton study with the fixed PBDB occurrence record. The exact specimen locality and horizon remain unknown. The paper calls the geological setting Aptian but labels the systematic horizon Albian; this internal discrepancy is retained rather than harmonized, and PBDB age brackets are not revised. This pass read previously unvisited anatomical subsections and selected headers, relevant taxon rows, character definitions and commands in both official supplements. Original descriptions, images and supplements are not fully assembled or inspected; the specimen, raw CT and matrix were not independently checked, measured or rerun. Diet, flight, sexual dimorphism and maturity remain author interpretations. The guide adds shoulder girdle, forearm, wrist/metacarpus, pelvis, legs/feet and measurement-table coverage, but does not remeasure scans; the Table 4 wing-phalanx side discrepancy remains unresolved and reader-facing delivery is pending. A complete matrix audit and tree rerun are still outstanding, so missing scores and an unresolved branching pattern are not treated as settled species relationships.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 1 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

title.zh: 先区分两次分析的取样
title.en: Separate the samples in the two analyses

text.zh: 2021 年研究先用一套形态矩阵分析 64 个分类单元和 150 个离散性状，并以 GP/2E 9266 补充 T. navigans 的身体解剖。作者先把正模 SMNK PAL 2344 单独编码，称与新标本可比较的性状没有冲突，随后用新标本编码分析物种位置。第二套矩阵再把 MN 6588-V 作为独立单元加入；补充文件表头列出 65 个单元和 150 个性状。这些是用于比较的树末端，不是 T. navigans 化石数量或 Tupandactylus 种数。
text.en: The 2021 study ran a first morphological matrix with 64 taxonomic units and 150 discrete characters, using GP/2E 9266 to add body anatomy for T. navigans. Before analysis, the authors coded holotype SMNK PAL 2344 separately and reported no conflicting scores for characters shared with the new specimen; they then used the new specimen’s coding to place the species. A second matrix added MN 6588-V as its own unit; the supplement header lists 65 units and 150 characters. These are comparative tree terminals, not a count of T. navigans fossils or Tupandactylus species.

title.zh: 多棵最简树与未解分叉
title.en: Multiple shortest trees and unresolved branching

text.zh: 第一轮搜索得到 132 棵最简树，每棵 371 步；加入 MN 6588-V 后为 469 棵、各 373 步。严格共识树将 T. navigans 放在 Tapejarinae 的未解多分叉中，同组还有 T. imperator、Tapejara wellnhoferi、Europejara olcadesorum 和 Caiuajara dobruskii。第二套分析也把 MN 6588-V 放在这组未解关系中。树的数量和步数描述这次矩阵与搜索，不是种数或亲缘概率，也不证明两个 Tupandactylus 种互为最近姐妹群。
text.en: The first search returned 132 most-parsimonious trees, each 371 steps long; with MN 6588-V included, it returned 469 trees of 373 steps. In the strict consensus, T. navigans sits in an unresolved Tapejarinae polytomy with T. imperator, Tapejara wellnhoferi, Europejara olcadesorum and Caiuajara dobruskii. The second analysis adds MN 6588-V to that same unresolved grouping. Tree count and length describe this matrix and search; they are not species counts or probabilities, and they do not show that the two Tupandactylus species are closest sisters.

title.zh: 缺失编码不等于共享解剖
title.en: Missing scores do not establish shared anatomy

text.zh: 补充矩阵分别编码 T. imperator 和 T. navigans，第二套再加入 MN 6588-V。许多性状格缺少资料，尤其是 T. imperator 的头后骨骼。论文指出两个种目前可比较的编码没有差异；但缺失解剖并不能证明整副身体相同，也不能证明它们是同种的不同性别。部分性状还被设为有序，结果会受取样类群、性状定义、可编码材料和搜索设置影响。本页没有重新编码全部矩阵或重跑搜索。
text.en: The supplements code T. imperator and T. navigans separately, then add MN 6588-V in the second matrix. Many character cells are missing, especially for T. imperator’s postcranial skeleton. The paper notes no differences in the scores available for the two species; missing anatomy means this cannot establish identical whole bodies or prove they are different sexes of one species. Some characters were ordered, and the result depends on the sampled taxa, character definitions, scorable remains and search settings. This guide has not recoded the full matrix or rerun the search.

title.zh: 扫描与数字模型提供不同层次的观察
title.en: Scans and digital models provide different observations

text.zh: 研究使用医学 CT 观察仍埋在围岩中的骨骼，报告体素尺寸为 0.976 毫米、重叠为 0.33 毫米。作者分割并重采样扫描资料生成网格，再将网格平滑以便展示。数字模型无法呈现扫描未分辨的细节、补回缺骨、消除压扁或确定完整活体姿势。本页依据论文公布的扫描参数与复原，不把原始 CT 切片当作新增观察。
text.en: Medical CT was used to see bones still enclosed in rock; the reported voxel size is 0.976 mm, with 0.33 mm overlap. The authors segmented and resampled the scans into meshes, then smoothed those meshes for display. A digital model cannot show detail the scan did not resolve, restore missing bones, reverse compression or establish a complete living pose. This account follows the published parameters and reconstructions; it does not add observations from raw CT slices.

title.zh: 融合肩带仍须与裂缝区分
title.en: Fused shoulder elements require distinguishing fractures

text.zh: 两侧肩胛乌喙骨都有保存，左侧更完整，但看不到肩胛与乌喙骨之间的骨缝。作者特意把左乌喙骨近端的横向骨折与两骨之间的关节缝区分开；右肩胛还保留了连接背椎联合体的关节面。这些结构说明胸肩带支撑；骨折不等于关节未融合，融合也不能单独测出确切年龄或起飞性能。
text.en: Both scapulocoracoids are present, although the left is better preserved and no scapula–coracoid suture is visible. The authors distinguish a transverse fracture near the left coracoid’s proximal end from that joint suture; the right scapula retains an articular surface for the notarium. These bones document the pectoral support system. A fracture is not evidence of an unfused joint, and fusion alone does not give an exact age or launch performance.

title.zh: 左右肱骨保存不同，肌肉嵴不是实测肌力
title.en: Different humeral preservation does not measure muscle force

text.zh: 左肱骨受压变扁，远端缺失一部分。右肱骨较完整，但近端和三角胸肌嵴区域仍埋在围岩中，作者借助 CT 观察。论文描述较宽的肌肉附着嵴和气孔。约 0.78 的肱骨／股骨长度比属于这件标本；嵴的大小不是保存下来的肌肉体积，也不是飞行功率的直接测量。
text.en: The left humerus is flattened and partly missing at its distal end. The right is complete, but its proximal and deltopectoral regions remain partly buried and were assessed by CT. Broad muscle-attachment crests and pneumatic openings are described. The humerus-to-femur ratio, about 0.78, belongs to this specimen; crest size is not preserved muscle volume or a direct measure of flight power.

title.zh: 腕掌结构把短手指与翼指分开
title.en: Wrist and metacarpal anatomy separates small fingers from the wing

text.zh: 腕部保存近端、远端融合腕骨及翼骨。第一至第三掌骨细长，不延伸到腕部，只到第四掌骨长度的大约一半；第四掌骨支撑翼指。右翼骨则超过尺骨长度的一半。两只手的暴露程度不同，右手部分需用 CT 查看。这些关系帮助认识翼部骨架，但没有保存完整翼膜，也不能证明某种攀爬或飞行行为。
text.en: The wrist preserves proximal and distal syncarpals and the pteroid. Metacarpals I–III are slender and stop short of the wrist, reaching only about halfway along metacarpal IV, which supports the wing finger; the right pteroid is longer than half the ulna. The two hands are exposed differently, and CT was needed for parts of the right side. These bones clarify wing construction, but no complete membrane is preserved and they do not prove a particular climbing or flight behavior.

title.zh: 骨盆保留成熟线索与未完全发育的信号
title.en: The pelvis combines maturity indicators with incomplete development

text.zh: 骨盆近乎完整，但缺少耻骨前骨和少量骨片，骨缝也无法辨认。长的髂骨前突可能因侧向挤压而旋转，因此化石朝向未必就是活体姿势。作者还认为坐耻骨板看起来未完全发育。这与其他融合特征支持的成熟解释并列；仅凭看不见骨缝不能确定繁殖年龄、性别或整个类群的融合顺序。
text.en: The pelvis is nearly complete, but the prepubis and small portions are absent, and its sutures cannot be made out. Lateral compression may have rotated the long preacetabular ilium, so the fossil’s orientation need not match the living posture. The authors also describe the ischiopubic plate as apparently incompletely developed. This sits alongside maturity inferred from other fused bones; invisible sutures alone cannot establish reproductive age, sex or a fusion sequence for the whole clade.

title.zh: 长后肢与四趾足不是奔跑速度记录
title.en: Long hindlimbs and a four-digit foot do not record running speed

text.zh: 胫骨约为股骨长度的 1.5 倍，腓骨较短。四个足趾保存了趾节，爪比手爪短，右足末端则不完整。这些比例可用于讨论支撑和运动假说，不是速度或食性的测量。腓骨／胫骨比和趾节式都不能解决更广泛的形态争议。
text.en: The tibiae are about one and a half times the femoral length, while the fibulae are shorter. Four toes preserve phalanges; their claws are shorter than the hand claws, and the right foot is incomplete at its tip. These proportions inform hypotheses about support and movement, not measured speed or diet. Neither the fibula-to-tibia ratio nor the toe formula resolves wider morphological disputes.

title.zh: 2.7 米翼展属于这件骨架的估计
title.en: The 2.7 m wingspan is a specimen estimate

text.zh: 作者根据 GP/2E 9266 的肱骨、尺骨、第四掌骨和翼指节，估计翼展约 2.7 米。表格还逐侧报告保存状况不同的骨骼尺寸，没有把它们拼成一个理想完整个体。第四翼指节的侧别在表 4 和保存描述中不一致，仍需检查图像或标本。该估计不是全种最大翼展，也不是飞行性能的直接测试。
text.en: The authors estimate a wingspan of about 2.7 m for GP/2E 9266 from the humerus, ulna, metacarpal IV and wing phalanges. Their tables also report side-specific measurements from bones with different preservation, rather than combining them into one ideal intact individual. The side reported for wing phalanx IV differs between Table 4 and the preservation account and still needs checking against the images or specimen. The estimate is not a maximum for the species or a direct test of flight performance.

title.zh: 把关联身体与孤立头部对读
title.en: Compare an associated body with isolated cranial material

text.zh: Huaxiapterus corollatus 页面可用于比较掌骨和翼指末节；Europejara olcadesorum 页面则从头骨而非关联骨架估算翼展。GP/2E 9266 因而提供肢骨比例，孤立头骨需要用相对尺度推算。两项对照都没有直接记录飞行，也不能确定飞行表现。
text.en: The linked Huaxiapterus corollatus page compares metacarpals and the terminal wing phalanges; the Europejara olcadesorum page estimates span from a skull rather than an associated skeleton. GP/2E 9266 therefore contributes limb proportions, while the isolated head requires relative scaling. Neither comparison records flight itself or establishes performance.

title.zh: 一件骨架把头冠与身体连接起来
title.en: One skeleton connects the crest with the body

text.zh: Beccari 等人在 2021 年描述的重点是 GP/2E 9266：一件大部分保持关节连接的 Tupandactylus navigans 骨架，保存头骨、头后骨骼和软组织痕迹。它是归入本种的材料，不是正模 SMNK PAL 2344。论文发表时，这是首件明确归入本属的头后骨骼材料，使身体解剖可以与已知头骨相联系；这项进展不表示所有归入材料后来都已复核。
text.en: Beccari and colleagues’ 2021 description centers on GP/2E 9266, a largely articulated Tupandactylus navigans skeleton with skull, postcranial bones and soft-tissue traces. It is referred material, not the holotype SMNK PAL 2344. At publication, it was the first postcranial specimen unambiguously assigned to the genus, linking body anatomy to the skull-based record. That advance does not mean all referred specimens have since been rechecked.

title.zh: 六块石板与不均匀的保存
title.en: Six slabs and uneven preservation

text.zh: 化石分布在六块可拼合的石灰岩板上，部分锯切线穿过骨骼和冠部组织。入藏前，一些破裂板曾用细金属条接合。保存情况不均：压扁、风化和缺失都存在，包括左侧第四翼指节缺失、右足远端不全。“近完整”指关联骨骼材料丰富，不是每处都完整无损。围岩将标本归入 Crato 组，但确切地点和层位未知；数据库中的 Nova Olinda 采集记录不等于已证实的标本精确地点。
text.en: The fossil is distributed across six matching limestone slabs, and some saw cuts cross bones and crest tissue. Before accession, thin metal bars had been used to reconnect some broken slabs. Preservation varies: compression, weathering and missing parts include the left fourth wing phalanx and the distal right foot. “Nearly complete” describes the amount of associated skeleton, not uniformly intact preservation. The matrix places it in the Crato Formation, but the exact locality and horizon are unknown; the database’s Nova Olinda collection is not proven to be this specimen’s precise site.

title.zh: 骨性支架与软组织共同形成头冠
title.en: Bone and soft tissue together form the crest

text.zh: 纤细、近乎竖直的前上颌骨上突支撑冠饰前部，后方顶骨冠短而圆；这些形态有助于鉴定为 T. navigans。保存的冠部软组织包括腹侧纤维区和较平滑的背侧区，向上高出头骨很多，但最顶端并未暴露。CT 还显示被围岩遮住的骨冠向前扩张。这些证据描述支架和组织的形态关系；化石深浅色斑可能来自氧化，不能确定活体颜色或性别。
text.en: A slender, almost vertical supra-premaxillary process supports the front of the crest; behind it, the parietal crest is short and rounded. Those shapes help identify the specimen as T. navigans. Preserved crest tissue has a fibrous ventral zone and smoother dorsal zone rising well above the skull, though its uppermost edge is not exposed. CT also shows an anterior expansion of the bony crest beneath matrix. This describes the support and tissue geometry; fossil color patches may reflect oxidation and cannot establish living colors or sex.

title.zh: 无齿颌与保存的喙鞘
title.en: Toothless jaws and a preserved beak sheath

text.zh: 上下颌无齿，吻端向下弯。组织鞘覆盖吻部和下颌前端，并延伸到深而呈刀片状的下颌冠；作者把它解释为角质喙鞘。上下喙之间的间隙限制了完全闭合状态的复原。处理小食物或较硬植物材料只是功能假说，不是已证实食谱；论文未报告胃内容物或直接取食观察。
text.en: The jaws lack teeth, and the snout turns downward. Tissue sheaths cover the front of the rostrum and lower jaw, continuing over the deep, blade-shaped dentary crest; the authors interpret them as a keratinous beak covering. A gap between upper and lower beak constrains how fully the mouth could close. Handling small food or harder plant material is a functional proposal, not a demonstrated menu: no stomach contents or direct feeding observations are reported.

title.zh: 颈椎、背椎融合与个体成熟度
title.en: Neck anatomy, fused dorsals and individual maturity

text.zh: 标本保存九枚颈椎，包括融合的寰椎—枢椎复合体。颈部中段椎骨较长，后段较短，部分关节突侧面有纵向沟槽。前五枚背椎的椎体融合为背椎联合体（notarium），但神经棘融合程度不同。作者再结合翼指伸肌腱突融合，推断个体成熟；胫跗骨未融合则提示另一种信号。现有翼手龙发育资料不足以把这些混合证据换算成确切年龄或物种生长曲线。
text.en: Nine cervical vertebrae are preserved, including a fused atlas–axis complex. The middle neck vertebrae are elongated, the posterior ones shorter, and some postzygapophyses carry lateral longitudinal grooves. The centra of the first five dorsal vertebrae form a notarium, although their neural spines are fused to different degrees. Together with fusion of the wing-extensor tendon process, this led the authors to infer maturity; the unfused tibiotarsus points the other way. Tapejarid growth is not documented well enough to convert this mixed signal into an exact age or species-wide growth curve.

title.zh: 带爪的手指与延长的翼指
title.en: Clawed fingers beside the elongated wing finger

text.zh: 左手前三指完整，指节式为 2–3–4，弯曲的爪保留了角质组织轮廓。第四指形成延长的翼指；左侧末节缺失，右侧翼指节则可以观察。爪记录了抓握结构，却不能单独证明攀树或某种取食行为。CT 分割使埋在围岩中的骨骼可见；平滑后的网格用于呈现，不能替代缺失骨片。
text.en: The first three digits of the left hand are complete, with phalangeal formula 2–3–4 and curved claws that retain a keratinous tissue outline. The fourth digit forms the elongated wing finger. Its terminal left phalanx is missing, while the right wing phalanges can be seen. The claws record grasping anatomy but do not alone prove tree climbing or a feeding behavior. CT segmentation reveals bones within the rock; smoothed meshes aid display and cannot replace missing elements.

title.zh: 飞行与地面觅食仍需力学检验
title.en: Flight and ground foraging need mechanical assessment

text.zh: 作者将背椎联合体、胸肌附着区和肢骨比例与飞行及四足起飞可能性联系起来，也讨论了地面觅食。长颈和巨大冠饰使早先把冠饰当作空气动力结构的解释更复杂。论文考虑短距离飞行，但明确需要进一步的生物力学研究。骨架没有直接测量飞行速度、航程、起飞频率，也未确立固定的地面生活方式。
text.en: The authors connect the notarium, pectoral muscle attachment area and limb proportions to flight and possible quadrupedal launch, and also discuss terrestrial foraging. The long neck and large crest complicate earlier ideas that treated the crest as an aerodynamic device. Short-distance flight is considered, but the paper calls for more biomechanical study. The skeleton does not directly measure speed, range, launch frequency or a settled ground-dwelling lifestyle.

title.zh: 种间差异与亲缘结果保留未决部分
title.en: Species differences and relationships retain uncertainty

text.zh: 2021 年矩阵将 T. navigans 放在 Tapejarinae 的未解多分叉中，与 T. imperator 等分类群同组；它没有证明两种 Tupandactylus 是最近姐妹群。作者比较冠饰方向和下颌冠形态，并提出但未检验性二型的可能。MN 6588-V 只鉴定到 Tupandactylus sp.，未可靠归入 T. navigans。因此，目录继续保留两个名录种，不把属级材料计为另一条种级出现记录。
text.en: In the 2021 matrix, T. navigans falls within Tapejarinae in an unresolved polytomy with T. imperator and other taxa; the analysis does not establish the two species as closest sisters. The authors compare crest direction and dentary-crest form, and raise—but do not test—the possibility of sexual dimorphism. MN 6588-V is assigned only to Tupandactylus sp., not confidently to T. navigans. The catalogue therefore keeps the two roster species separate and does not turn genus-level material into another species occurrence.

readerLimitations.zh:
本页将 2021 年关联骨架研究的选段双语导读与固定 PBDB 出现记录并列。标本精确地点和层位未知；论文地质背景写 Aptian，系统描述的层位行写 Albian，因此保留这项内部矛盾，不静默统一，也不据此改动 PBDB 年代。本批补读了此前未读的解剖分节，并选看两套官方补充矩阵的表头、相关分类行、性状定义和命令。原始描述、图像与补充资料尚未完整汇集或检查；没有独立检查标本、原始 CT 或完整矩阵，没有复量或重跑分析。食性、飞行、性二型与成熟度仍是作者解释。本页补入肩带、前臂、腕掌、骨盆、腿足及尺寸表的阅读内容，但未复量扫描；表 4 翼指节侧别差异尚未解决，读者端交付仍待完成。完整矩阵审计和树搜索重跑尚未进行，因此缺失编码和未解分叉不被写成已确定的种间关系。

PBDB 出现记录补充:

readerLimitations.en:
This page pairs a bilingual guide to selected passages of the 2021 associated-skeleton study with the fixed PBDB occurrence record. The exact specimen locality and horizon remain unknown. The paper calls the geological setting Aptian but labels the systematic horizon Albian; this internal discrepancy is retained rather than harmonized, and PBDB age brackets are not revised. This pass read previously unvisited anatomical subsections and selected headers, relevant taxon rows, character definitions and commands in both official supplements. Original descriptions, images and supplements are not fully assembled or inspected; the specimen, raw CT and matrix were not independently checked, measured or rerun. Diet, flight, sexual dimorphism and maturity remain author interpretations. The guide adds shoulder girdle, forearm, wrist/metacarpus, pelvis, legs/feet and measurement-table coverage, but does not remeasure scans; the Table 4 wing-phalanx side discrepancy remains unresolved and reader-facing delivery is pending. A complete matrix audit and tree rerun are still outstanding, so missing scores and an unresolved branching pattern are not treated as settled species relationships.

A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

This page summarizes selected PBDB records available on 2026-10-02. It belongs to a fixed 276-entry pterosaur roster and includes species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. PBDB’s accepted name and recorded parent chain organize the entry; they do not resolve specimen identifications or every taxonomic dispute, and same-name Catalogue of Life concepts remain separate. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and preservation labels describe different things. They do not establish the species’ complete range, exact origin or extinction, ecology, abundance or the condition of every specimen. The selected records do not form a full review of descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet or behavior.

evidenceSummary:
This page brings together selected findings from the 2023 revision and two PBDB collections. The synonymies and growth interpretations apply to the specimens analyzed; the morphometric sample excludes incomplete BPV-077 and a very young specimen. IVPP V-14377 remains disputed between the 2021 and 2023 assignments. The two database collections are not a complete range or a full species monograph.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 2 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

title.zh: 从未成熟正模读身体与种名
title.en: Read anatomy and names from an immature holotype

text.zh: 2023 年修订将正模 IVPP V 13363 判断为 Sinopterus dongi 幼体。作者把若干旧目录使用的名称并入本种，同时将 Huaxiadraco corollatus 保留为另一种。历史名称的存在本身不能证明每个名称都代表独立的生物物种。
text.en: In the 2023 revision, the holotype IVPP V 13363 is identified as a juvenile Sinopterus dongi. The authors place several names used in earlier catalogues within this species while retaining Huaxiadraco corollatus separately. Those historical names are not, by themselves, proof of separate biological species.

title.zh: 诊断使用头骨、颈椎与肢骨组合
title.en: Diagnosis combines skull, neck and limb features

text.zh: 作者依据一组特征组合鉴别本种：吻部轻微下折、眶前孔较长、眼眶近四边形、鼻骨下降突近乎垂直、第四颈椎长于第五颈椎，第一掌骨较长。其他特征还包括翼膜支骨短于尺骨的一半，以及第一跖骨不短于第二跖骨。正模有位移，部分比例依赖复位；应看整组特征，不把某一角度视为固定值。
text.en: The diagnosis is a combination: a gently downturned snout, an elongate opening ahead of the orbit, a roughly quadrangular orbit, a near-vertical descending nasal process, a fourth neck vertebra longer than the fifth, and an elongate first metacarpal. The authors also note a pteroid shorter than half the ulna and a first metatarsal at least as long as the second. Displacement in the holotype affects some reconstructed proportions, so the combination is more useful than treating one angle as fixed.

title.zh: 骨骼融合提供相对成长顺序
title.en: Fusion supplies a relative developmental sequence

text.zh: IVPP V 13363 的肩胛与乌喙骨、肱骨骨端、腕骨、第一翼指节上的肌腱突和胫跗骨等尚未融合。与较成熟标本比较后，修订将正模判断为幼体。约 1.2 米翼展是对这件标本的估计，不是成体最大值。研究以肱骨长度作体型代理，并用融合状态比较相对生长阶段，但没有给出确切年龄。
text.en: Several bones in IVPP V 13363 remain unfused, including the scapula and coracoid, humeral end, carpals, a tendon process on the first wing phalanx and the tibiotarsus. Compared with more mature specimens, the revision treats the holotype as juvenile. Its estimated wingspan is about 1.2 m: a size estimate for this specimen, not an adult maximum. Humeral length serves as a size proxy, and fusion helps order relative growth stages without giving exact ages.

title.zh: 先排除成长信号，再比较形态群
title.en: Separate growth signals before comparing morphotypes

text.zh: 作者以肱骨长度为体型代理，检查 21 项测量的大小相关和异速生长，再对其认为较少受成长影响的比例进行聚类与主成分分析。缺失值采用均值和迭代补值；材料不全的 BPV-077 与极幼小的 Nemicolopterus 标本被排除。这些取舍限定了分析范围；相关性未达显著，不等于已证明成长毫无影响。
text.en: The authors tested 21 measurements for size correlation and allometry, using humeral length as a size proxy. They then clustered and ran principal-component analyses on proportions judged less affected by growth. Missing values were filled by mean and iterative imputation. Incomplete BPV-077 and the very young specimen named Nemicolopterus were excluded. These choices bound the analysis; a nonsignificant correlation does not prove that growth has no effect.

title.zh: 两组形态支持作者的两种解释
title.en: Two morphotypes support the authors’ two-species interpretation

text.zh: 定量和解剖比较区分两个形态群，作者分别解释为 S. dongi 与 Huaxiadraco corollatus。2023 年的处理把 S. gui、Huaxiapterus jii、S. lingyuanensis 和 H. atavismus 并入 S. dongi 的异名。聚类描述相似性，属级归属另由系统发育分析讨论。本页保留这些已发表的分类处理，不把它们与数据库出现记录合并。
text.en: The quantitative and anatomical comparisons separate two morphotypes, which the authors identify as S. dongi and Huaxiadraco corollatus. Their 2023 treatment places S. gui, Huaxiapterus jii, S. lingyuanensis and H. atavismus in synonymy with S. dongi. Clusters describe similarity, while a separate phylogenetic analysis informs genus placement. This summary retains those published acts without combining them with the database occurrence rows.

title.zh: 冠的有无、大小和形状回答不同问题
title.en: Crest presence, size and shape answer different questions

text.zh: 最小幼体没有前上颌骨冠，作者将这一点与成长联系起来。同一形态群中较大的标本也有冠大小差异，可能涉及个体或性别差异。样本里，S. dongi 的冠呈隆起轮廓，Huaxiadraco corollatus 的冠较近梯形。这些模式不能确定任何个体的性别，也不能作为所有翼龙的冠饰规律。
text.en: The smallest juveniles lack a premaxillary crest, which the authors link to growth. Crest size also varies among larger specimens within a morphotype and may reflect individual or sexual variation. In the sample, the crest of S. dongi has a raised profile, while that of Huaxiadraco corollatus is more trapezoidal. These patterns do not determine an individual’s sex or set a universal crest shape for pterosaurs.

title.zh: 地层重叠尚不能确定同地点共栖
title.en: Stratigraphic overlap does not establish shared localities

text.zh: 修订指出两种的年代区间重叠，并认为可能同时存在，但目前没有在完全相同的地点发现两者。部分标本只定位到朝阳地区，具体层位控制不足。要检验生态位分化，还需要更细的地点和沉积资料；现有记录不能证明食物分工、群体行为或共同栖地。
text.en: The revision notes overlapping age ranges and considers the two forms possibly contemporaneous, but neither is known from the exact same locality as the other. Some specimens are located only to the Chaoyang area, with weak control of their precise beds. Better locality and sediment data would be needed to test niche separation; the current record does not demonstrate different diets, social behaviour or a shared habitat.

title.zh: 幼体模型中的名称需要随研究年份阅读
title.en: Read juvenile-model identities with their study date

text.zh: 2021 年飞行研究把 Nemicolopterus 正模 IVPP V-14377 解释为 S. dongi 的近出壳幼体。2023 年修订认为其过于幼小，无法可靠归入 S. dongi 或 Huaxiadraco corollatus，因此保留为 Sinopterinae 未定材料。基于 2021 年鉴定的飞行模型不能确立无争议的本种幼体性能。可对读 S. gui 的保存与异名，再看 Pterodaustro guinazui 的另一组模型输入。
text.en: A 2021 flight study treated IVPP V-14377, the Nemicolopterus holotype, as a near-hatching S. dongi. The 2023 revision considers it too young for a reliable assignment to either S. dongi or Huaxiadraco corollatus and retains it as indeterminate Sinopterinae. Flight models using the 2021 identification therefore do not establish uncontested, species-specific hatchling performance. Compare preservation and synonymy in S. gui, then the separate model inputs for Pterodaustro guinazui.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:
PBDB 将 Sinopterus dongi 记为 Sinopterus 属下的物种。所选样本有 2 条出现记录，涉及 2 个采集记录和 2 条引文；这些是数据库条目数量，不是化石或动物个体数。

Sinopterus dongi 在 PBDB 快照中对应分类条目 txn:138765。这份存档导读包含 2 条选取的出现记录，关联 2 个不同的 PBDB 采集记录编号和 2 个不同的 PBDB 引文编号。出现记录与采集记录是不同单位；这两个数量都不等于标本数或个体数。此页聚焦一个具体问题：这些记录各自连到哪些地点、年代界、材料说明和引文？
text.en:
PBDB lists Sinopterus dongi as a species under Sinopterus. The selected sample contains two occurrence records from two collections, linked to two references. These counts describe database records, not fossils or animals.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Sinopterus dongi is listed in the PBDB snapshot under taxon txn:138765. This archived guide contains 2 selected occurrence rows, linked to 2 distinct PBDB collection IDs and 2 distinct PBDB reference IDs. An occurrence row and a collection record are different units; neither count is a specimen or individual count. The reading question here is concrete: which recorded localities, age bounds, material notes, and citations are attached to these rows?

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh:
PBDB 列出中国辽宁的两个采集地：Lamagou, Dongdadao, Chaoyang 和 Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY)。两者地区代码均为 CN，地层均为 Jiufotang，数据库年代范围均为 121.4–113.2 Ma，时段标签为 Aptian。这些条目描述所选采集地，不代表本种的完整分布。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
存档导读包含 2 条出现记录，以下列出全部记录。每个 occ: 编号标识一条出现记录；col: 标识其关联的采集记录。

- 出现记录 occ:837511；PBDB 采集记录 col:92652。 地点字段 cnm=Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY)；地点分区字段 cc2=CN，stp=Liaoning。 记录年代界：eag 121.4 Ma; lag 113.2 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Aptian。 地层字段 sfm=Jiufotang。 记录署名 Lü et al. 2006；PBDB 引文编号 ref:31355。

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
This is a proxy location for all Jiufotang Formation pterosaurs for which the locality is given only as "Chaoyang City"
text.en:
PBDB lists two collections in Liaoning, China: Lamagou, Dongdadao, Chaoyang and Chaoyang pterosaurs (PROXY). Both carry region code CN, the Jiufotang stratum and an age bracket of 121.4–113.2 Ma, labelled Aptian. These entries describe the selected collections, not the species’ complete distribution.

evidenceSummary:
The 2023 revision interprets juvenile holotype BPV-077 as a young S. dongi and lists S. gui as its junior synonym. The described anatomy and growth evidence support that reading, but the incomplete holotype was excluded from the study's morphometric dataset. PBDB still keeps a separate S. gui entry, so the two names are not evidence here for two biological species. One proxy collection and its broad age interval do not establish a complete distribution or the specimen's precise age. This account retains the database name alongside the revision; the original 2003 description, other specimens and later taxonomic work are not fully represented.

title.zh: 这个入口保留一个有修订争议的历史种名
title.en: This entry retains a historically named, revised species concept

text.zh: Sinopterus gui 是当前固定 PBDB 工作名录的接受名，而 2023 年原研究将其正模 BPV-077 归入 S. dongi，并列 S. gui 为异名。本页保留数据库入口以追溯原记录，同时明确标本解释；两个目录入口不能直接计为两个已经证明独立的生物物种。
text.en: Sinopterus gui is an accepted name in the fixed PBDB working roster, while the 2023 study refers its holotype BPV-077 to S. dongi and treats S. gui as a junior synonym. This entry retains the database record for traceability alongside the specimen interpretation. Two catalogue entries do not directly establish two separate biological species.

title.zh: 破碎骨面限制可观察的身体细节
title.en: Damaged bone surfaces limit observable anatomy

text.zh: 2023 年记述 BPV-077 骨面破损、受压，头骨主要呈左侧视，后部另有破裂与转位。吻部没有前上颌骨冠、下颌联合有很浅的冠；可辨的翼指只有第一指节，掌骨比例与部分颈椎细节无法可靠评估。因此本页没有用缺失后段重建完整翼形或精确头骨姿势。
text.en: The 2023 account describes damaged, crushed bone surfaces in BPV-077. The skull is mainly exposed from the left, with breakage and displacement posteriorly. The rostrum lacks a premaxillary crest and the mandibular symphysis has a shallow crest; only the first wing phalanx is preserved, and metacarpal proportions and some cervical details cannot be reliably assessed. Missing portions do not supply a complete wing shape or exact skull posture.

title.zh: 未融合支持幼体判断，翼展估计仍有分歧
title.en: Unfused bones support youth while wingspan estimates differ

text.zh: 腭与后头骨、背椎椎体与神经弓、肩胛与乌喙骨、骨盆以及胫腓骨未融合，支持很幼小的个体解释。该标本专节引用约 64 厘米翼展，另一正模比较段却写约 0.8 米；本页保留同文估计差异，不选一个作为确定翼展。作者讨论中也纠正早期所称背椎融合，未由旧诊断断定成体。
text.en: Unfused palatal and posterior skull bones, dorsal centra and neural arches, scapula and coracoid, pelvis and tibia/fibula support a very young individual. Its specimen account cites roughly 64 cm wingspan, while another holotype-comparison passage gives about 0.8 m. This internal difference is retained without choosing a definitive body size. The discussion also rejects the earlier claim of fused dorsals rather than using that old diagnosis to infer adulthood.

title.zh: 归入 S. dongi 不等于本标本参加了全部统计
title.en: Referral to S. dongi does not mean inclusion in every analysis

text.zh: 修订认为 BPV-077 与 S. dongi 的差异主要可由成长解释，尤其是缺少前上颌骨冠，因而维持异名处理。但 BPV-077 因不完整没有进入形态测量数据集；它的归属依赖定性比较与整体解释，不能写成统计模型对本件进行了全部直接测量或单独证明其种级身份。
text.en: The revision interprets differences from S. dongi, especially the absent premaxillary crest, as compatible with growth and maintains synonymy. BPV-077 was excluded from the morphometric dataset because of incompleteness. Its referral therefore relies on qualitative comparison and the broader interpretation, rather than every statistical model directly measuring or independently proving this specimen’s species identity.

title.zh: 按标本、保存和研究归属追读
title.en: Follow specimen, preservation and study-specific referral

text.zh: 先读 BPV-077 的保存和融合情况，再进入 Sinopterus dongi 的身体组合与 2023 年异名解释。原始 2003 年描述尚未独立读齐，固定数据库的 PROXY 采集行也不是重新检查过的正模产地档案。这里没有根据异名把所有旧记录合并、重算分布或断定食性。
text.en: Read BPV-077 preservation and fusion first, then the anatomical combination and 2023 synonymy account in Sinopterus dongi. The original 2003 description has not been independently assembled in full, and the fixed database PROXY collection row is not a newly checked holotype locality archive. Synonymy does not merge all old records, recalculate distribution or establish diet here.

readerLimitations.zh:
2023 年修订将幼体正模 BPV-077 解释为 S. dongi，并把 S. gui 处理为其晚出异名。标本形态和生长信息支持这一解释，但正模不完整，未进入该研究的形态测量数据集。PBDB 仍保留单独的 S. gui 记录，因此两个名称不能直接算作两个已证实的生物物种。一个代理采集记录和宽年代区间也不能建立完整分布或标本的精确年龄。本页并列保留数据库名称与修订解释；2003 年原始描述、其他标本及后续分类研究尚未完整纳入。

PBDB 出现记录补充:

readerLimitations.en:
The 2023 revision interprets juvenile holotype BPV-077 as a young S. dongi and lists S. gui as its junior synonym. The described anatomy and growth evidence support that reading, but the incomplete holotype was excluded from the study's morphometric dataset. PBDB still keeps a separate S. gui entry, so the two names are not evidence here for two biological species. One proxy collection and its broad age interval do not establish a complete distribution or the specimen's precise age. This account retains the database name alongside the revision; the original 2003 description, other specimens and later taxonomic work are not fully represented.

title.zh: 一件近完整头骨与有限的身体材料
title.en: A nearly complete skull with limited body material

text.zh: 2025 年 Araripe 综述将正模 MN 4726-V 描述为近乎完整的头骨和下颌，另有肩胛骨、乌喙骨、胸骨、肱骨、右侧第四指第一节指骨的一部分及肋骨碎片。这不是完整骨架。综述保留原作者对成年个体的解释，但没有给出确切年龄、性别或成长序列。
text.en: The 2025 Araripe review describes holotype MN 4726-V as a nearly complete skull and lower jaw, accompanied by a scapula, coracoid, sternum, humerus, part of the right first phalanx of wing digit IV and rib fragments. This is not a complete skeleton. The review retains the original authors’ adult interpretation but gives no exact age, sex or growth series.

title.zh: 向下弯的吻部与沿前后延伸的骨冠
title.en: A downturned rostrum and a crest extending lengthwise

text.zh: 鉴定组合包括前后延伸的前上颌骨冠、下弯的吻部，以及略微凹入的头骨腹缘。上下颌前端闭合时相接。颧骨的泪骨突向后，方骨相对头骨腹缘约成 150°。这些描述标本形态；冠饰不能证明性别、展示行为或体温调节功能。
text.en: The diagnosis combines a front-to-back premaxillary crest, a downturned snout and a slightly concave lower skull margin. The front of the jaws meets without a gap. The jugal’s lacrimal process points backward, and the quadrate lies at about 150° to the lower skull margin. These features describe the specimen; the crest does not demonstrate sex, display or temperature control.

title.zh: 腭孔名称随骨界解释而改变
title.en: Palatal opening names depend on interpreted bone boundaries

text.zh: 2024 年研究通过其他翼龙的 CT 和层析成像，重新划分上颌骨、腭骨、翼骨与外翼骨的边界。骨骼归属改变后，部分开孔名称也随之调整，早期 Caupedactylus 图像被纳入比较。旧文所称的狭缝状 postpalatinal fenestra，须结合该研究采用的骨骼边界来理解；名称相同不保证不同研究指的是同一开孔。
text.en: A 2024 study used CT and laminography of other pterosaurs to redraw the boundaries among the maxilla, palatine, pterygoid and ectopterygoid. Reassigning bones changes the names applied to some openings, and earlier Caupedactylus illustrations enter that comparison. The older label slit-like postpalatinal fenestra must be read using that paper’s bone boundaries; matching names do not guarantee that studies mean the same opening.

title.zh: 本种参与比较，但没有被新扫描
title.en: Included in comparison without a new scan

text.zh: 2024 年论文表 1 列出 MN 4726-V，却没有标为该研究新扫描的标本；Caupedactylus 腭部插图注明改自早期文献。作者推测腭骨可能呈 Y 形、翼骨开孔较大，后鼻孔后缘也更靠后。这些是比较解释，不是对该正模进行新 CT 扫描所揭示的结构。
text.en: Table 1 of the 2024 paper lists MN 4726-V but does not mark it as newly scanned; the Caupedactylus palate illustration is credited as modified from earlier work. The authors suggest a possible Y-shaped palatine, larger pterygoid openings and a more rearward margin of the choanae. These are comparisons and interpretations, not structures newly revealed by a CT scan of this holotype.

title.zh: 潜在归入材料仍有条件
title.en: Possible referrals remain conditional

text.zh: 一件 2009 年拍卖的完整头骨目前下落不明。腭部残片 MPSC R 859 在后鼻孔前的平坦腭面上与正模相似，但破碎程度使其归属无法确定。综述还比较 SMNK PAL 6410 并讨论 KPMNH DL 84。这些记录不能确认所有材料都属于 Caupedactylus，也不能确定个体数量或扩大物种分布。
text.en: A complete skull sold at auction in 2009 has an unknown present location. Palatal fragment MPSC R 859 resembles the holotype in its flat palate before the choanae, but its breakage prevents a firm referral. The review also compares SMNK PAL 6410 and discusses KPMNH DL 84. These accounts do not confirm all material as Caupedactylus, establish an individual count or extend the species range.

title.zh: 后续亲缘方案与固定目录并列阅读
title.en: Read later relationship proposals beside the fixed directory

text.zh: 原始研究把该种视为较早分化的 tapejarid。2025 年综述汇总的后续分析则将其与 Aymberedactylus cearensis 一同置于 Caupedactylia，依据包括下颌联合背侧阶状隆起缺失和齿骨窝表面平坦。目录中的 Tapejarinae 父级是数据库分类记录，不代表所有已发表系统树。
text.en: The original study treated the species as an early-diverging tapejarid. Later analyses summarized in the 2025 review group it with Aymberedactylus cearensis in Caupedactylia, citing features such as no step-like dorsal ridge on the mandibular symphysis and a flat dentary-fossa surface. The directory’s Tapejarinae parent records database classification, not every published tree.

title.zh: 地面取食的泛食者是模型解释
title.en: A ground-feeding generalist is a model-based interpretation

text.zh: 2025 年综述转述一项 2021 年咬合力研究，将 Caupedactylus ybaka 解释为可能在地面取食的泛食者。颌部特征和较低的肌肉机械优势支持不同于 Tapejara 硬质植物食假说的功能模型。这是综述转述的解释，不是胃内容物、直接观察到的一餐或已证实的生态位分化。
text.en: The 2025 review summarizes a 2021 bite-force study that interpreted Caupedactylus ybaka as a possible ground-feeding generalist. Jaw features and lower muscular mechanical advantage support a different functional model from the hard-plant diet proposed for Tapejara. This is an interpretation reported through the review, not gut contents, an observed meal or a demonstrated division of ecological roles.

title.zh: 论文层位与数据库层名仍不一致
title.en: Paper horizon and database stratum remain discrepant

text.zh: 2025 年综述将正模归入 Romualdo 组，并说明具体地点未知；2013 年原始论文标题也提到 Romualdo。PBDB 采集行却记录 Crato 和 119.57–113.2 Ma。应保留这处差异：数据库行不能补出未知的正模地点，也没有直接测定正模年代。
text.en: The 2025 review assigns the holotype to the Romualdo Formation and says its exact locality is unknown; the 2013 original paper’s title also names Romualdo. The PBDB collection row instead lists Crato and 119.57–113.2 Ma. Keep the discrepancy visible: a database row does not fill in the holotype locality or directly date the specimen.

title.zh: 从多阶段骨床转向另一种翼龙
title.en: Move from a growth-series bonebed to another pterosaur

text.zh: 读完本种骨床与冠饰成长后，进入 Keresdrakon vilsoni 的长颌、骨骼鉴别和组织样本。2019 年研究把两者在 A–C 骨床的反复关联作为共存依据，同时提醒较大 Caiuajara 与较小 Keresdrakon 的孤立头后骨可能难以区分。比较时先看诊断部位与保存状态，不能只用骨骼大小决定归属。
text.en: After the bonebed and crest-growth sections, continue to Keresdrakon vilsoni for long jaws, anatomical diagnosis and histological samples. The 2019 study uses repeated association in bonebeds A–C to support coexistence, while warning that isolated postcranial bones of larger Caiuajara and smaller Keresdrakon can be difficult to distinguish. Compare diagnostic regions and preservation before using size to assign material.

title.zh: 把形态成长与年龄反推分别比较
title.en: Compare morphological development separately from retrocalculated ages

text.zh: 再读 Vespersaurus paranaensis 的股骨与胫骨组织学。本种冠饰和融合序列、Keresdrakon 的两件组织样本、恐龙的十一件后肢骨，所记录的身体部位和取样方法不同。恐龙研究假定的新生骨尺寸及股骨／胫骨年龄分歧不能移入本种；三页也没有被合并为同一个遗址的统一成长曲线。
text.en: Then read the femoral and tibial histology of Vespersaurus paranaensis. Caiuajara crest and fusion sequences, the two Keresdrakon histological samples and eleven dinosaur hind-limb bones use different body regions and sampling methods. The dinosaur’s assumed neonatal dimensions and femoral–tibial age disagreement are not transferred to Caiuajara, and the three pages do not form one site-wide growth curve.

title.zh: 一处骨床提供多个成长阶段
title.en: A bonebed preserves several growth stages

text.zh: Caiuajara dobruskii 来自巴西 Paraná 的 Cruzeiro do Oeste。2014 年原始描述以部分骨架 CP.V 1449 为正模，并利用同地点大量颅骨与身体材料比较大小不同的个体。骨床因此能提供超出单件头骨的成长资料，但多数骨骼混杂，不能把每一根骨头都还原到一个确定个体。2022 年研究加入头骨 CP.V 8175 等材料，继续检视头骨保存与变异。
text.en: Caiuajara dobruskii comes from Cruzeiro do Oeste, Paraná, Brazil. The 2014 original description designates partial skeleton CP.V 1449 as holotype and compares abundant cranial and postcranial material from the locality across different sizes. This provides growth evidence beyond one isolated skull, although most bones are mixed and cannot be allocated to particular individuals. A 2022 study adds skull CP.V 8175 and other material to examine cranial preservation and variation.

title.zh: 聚集记录包含多次埋藏与搬运
title.en: The accumulation includes repeated burial and transport

text.zh: 2014 年论文报告数百块骨骼，依据前上颌骨估计至少 47 个个体；该下限与数据库的一条出现行不是同一计数单位。材料来自多个相邻层位，有些保持关节连接，大多散开混杂，部分在埋藏前已断裂。作者还识别出水动力分选的迹象。骨床因此不能简单画成同一瞬间死亡的完整群体，最少个体数也不是古种群总规模。本文引用的是正文报告，没有独立重计补充清单。
text.en: The 2014 paper reports hundreds of bones and a minimum of 47 individuals based on premaxillae, a different unit from one database occurrence row. Material occurs at several nearby levels: some remains are articulated, most are disassociated and mixed, and some bones broke before burial. The authors also identify evidence of hydraulic sorting. The deposit cannot simply be reconstructed as one intact group dying simultaneously, and its minimum individual count is not total population size. The number is quoted from the main text without independently recounting the supplementary list.

title.zh: 无齿吻部与颅骨鉴别特征
title.en: A toothless rostrum and diagnostic cranial features

text.zh: 本种吻端向下弯曲，前上颌骨形成高冠，并有骨性扩张伸入鼻眶前孔。下颌咬合面的圆形凹陷也是原始诊断的一部分。前上颌骨上的小孔让作者推测存在类似鸟喙的角质覆盖；这不是保存了完整喙鞘的直接证据。骨性扩张的功能未明，形态诊断也不能独自确定水果或其他食物在食谱中的比例。
text.en: The toothless rostrum bends downward, with a tall premaxillary crest and a bony expansion projecting into the nasoantorbital fenestra. A rounded depression on the mandibular occlusal surface also forms part of the original diagnosis. Premaxillary foramina lead the authors to infer a birdlike horny covering, rather than directly documenting a complete preserved sheath. The bony expansion has no established function, and diagnostic morphology alone does not determine the share of fruit or other foods in the diet.

title.zh: 冠饰随生长改变，仍有个体差异
title.en: Crests change with growth and retain individual variation

text.zh: 2014 年样本中，小个体前上颌冠较小并向后倾，较大个体的冠更高、更陡；下颌冠也随较大的成长阶段更加发达。作者把这组差异主要解释为发育变化。2022 年又比较相近尺寸个体的冠后背缘，指出薄厚与形状并不完全一致，讨论了性二型可能性，也提醒尚未完全发育的个体可能与另一性别成体相似。因此，冠饰存在、大小或外形都不能直接当作个体性别标签，尺寸也不是精确年龄。
text.en: In the 2014 sample, small individuals have smaller, backward-inclined premaxillary crests; larger individuals have taller, steeper crests and more developed dentary crests. The authors mainly interpret this sequence as development. Comparing similarly sized individuals in 2022, researchers also find differences in the thickness and shape of the posterodorsal crest margin. They discuss possible sexual dimorphism while warning that immature individuals may resemble adults of another sex. Crest presence, size or shape therefore cannot directly label sex, and size is not an exact age.

title.zh: 身体比例与骨骼融合共同记录成长
title.en: Body proportions and fusion record different aspects of growth

text.zh: 原始描述中的肱骨和多数身体骨骼从小到大大体保持相似形状，但骨化、胸骨、前耻骨与乌喙骨仍有成长差异；成体肩胛骨与乌喙骨融合，幼体中未融合。论文没有发现背椎联合体。作者据较早出现的身体比例推测幼体可能很早具备飞行能力，但没有观察幼体起飞或测定首次飞行年龄。不能把“比例相似”改写成全部组织在各阶段都已经成熟。
text.en: Humeri and most postcranial elements retain broadly similar shapes across sizes in the original description, while ossification, sternum, prepubis and coracoid still vary with development. The scapula and coracoid fuse in adults but remain separate in juveniles; no notarium is reported. Early establishment of body proportions leads the authors to suggest flight at a young age, without observations of juvenile launch or an age at first flight. Similar proportions do not establish that every tissue is already mature.

title.zh: 群居解释与死亡原因各有边界
title.en: Social behavior and mortality retain different uncertainties

text.zh: 2014 年作者把密集、反复出现的材料解释为沙漠内陆湖附近的群居翼龙，也考虑过迁徙造访；长期居留是其偏好的方案。风暴搬运、干旱或风暴致死都被讨论，实际死因未确定。2022 年导言还记录同一地点有 Keresdrakon 等其他脊椎动物，不能把整个遗址说成只有一种动物。群体聚集不是亲代照护的直接观察，沙丘间沉积背景也不能自动证明完整生活史或食谱。
text.en: The 2014 authors interpret dense, repeated accumulations as gregarious pterosaurs around an inland desert lake. They also consider migratory visits, preferring longer residence. Storm transport, drought and storm mortality are discussed, but the actual causes of death remain unknown. The 2022 introduction records other vertebrates at the site, including Keresdrakon, so the whole locality is not a single-species assemblage. Aggregation does not directly document parental care, and an interdunal depositional setting does not establish a complete life history or diet.

title.zh: 后续头骨研究补充下颌联合诊断
title.en: Later cranial work adds a symphyseal diagnosis

text.zh: 2022 年 CP.V 8175 保留部分连接的头骨、下颌与手部材料，骨骼虽有立体保存，仍有风化、下颌压裂和眼眶周围骨骼分离。作者借 CP.V 5703 等对照材料指出，两侧齿骨在三个位置相接，形成带内部开口的联合结构，并把它加入诊断。新材料有助于重读旧标本，不等于每个细节都来自一件无损头骨；本页只读了该研究的选定材料、诊断与讨论，完整头骨分节尚未覆盖。
text.en: CP.V 8175 in the 2022 study preserves a partly articulated skull, lower jaw and manual material. Three-dimensional preservation coexists with weathering, mandibular cracking and separation around the orbit. Using comparisons including CP.V 5703, the authors identify dentaries meeting at three positions, forming a symphyseal shelf with internal openings, and add this to the diagnosis. New material helps reinterpret older fossils without making every feature an observation from one undamaged skull. This guide covers selected material, diagnosis and discussion passages, not the full anatomical description.

title.zh: 亲缘位置取决于矩阵与取样
title.en: Relationships depend on matrix and taxon sampling

text.zh: 2014 年矩阵将 Caiuajara 放在 Tapejarinae 内的多分支中；剔除两个信息较少的类群后，才得到与 Tupandactylus 的姐妹群关系。这说明该结果对取样有依赖，不能只保留较清楚的树而隐藏未解析结果。本页沿固定 PBDB 路径保存目录，未重算原矩阵，也没有宣称解决全部 Tapejarinae 亲缘或分类争议。
text.en: The 2014 matrix places Caiuajara in a Tapejarinae polytomy. A sister relationship with Tupandactylus appears after removing two less completely known taxa. This dependence on sampling prevents presenting only the more resolved tree while omitting the unresolved result. The directory retains its fixed PBDB path, without rerunning the original matrix or claiming to resolve all Tapejarinae relationships and taxonomic disputes.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh:
本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 121.4–72.2 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。

text.en:
Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 121.4–72.2 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh:

title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh:
数据库继续保留 Manzig et al.（2014）、ref:52235 的原署名。现已实际读取 2014 年原始描述主要正文，并以独立共享引文记录全部十位作者；另记录 2022 年头骨重描述六位作者及选读范围。补充标本清单、矩阵、图像与后续研究仍未读齐，没有独立检查或重新鉴定标本。

- occ:1221869：记录署名 Manzig et al. 2014；PBDB 引文编号 ref:52235。
text.en:
The database retains its original Manzig et al. (2014), ref:52235 attribution. The principal main-text sections of the original description have now been read, with all ten authors in a separate shared reference. A further reference records six authors and the selected scope of the 2022 cranial revision. Supplementary specimen lists, matrices, images and later studies remain incompletely read, without independent inspection or reidentification.

readerLimitations.zh:
本页结合 2014 年原始描述主要正文、2022 年头骨研究选段与固定 PBDB 出现资料。论文按当时地层对比讨论年龄争议，未在这里压缩为精确年代或改写数据库宽区间。未读齐全部补充资料、2022 年解剖分节、后续骨组织学与所有分类文献，也未独立检查标本、重计个体或重算矩阵。群居、幼年飞行、性二型、食性和死因各有推断限制；完整专论仍未完成。

比较路线另复用已读 2019 年共同骨床与 2020 年恐龙组织学主文；其取样和模型仅用于相应成员，没有据横向链接完成全部遗址动物或所有成长研究。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
此页导读的是 2026-10-02 快照中的 1 条 PBDB 选取出现记录，不是物种专论。地点和年代区间描述的是数据库记录，不能据此推出完整地理分布、连续存在的时间范围、生态、行为或种群大小。采集记录编号、出现记录编号、标本说明及来源明确给出的丰度单位彼此区分。地点坐标字段与古坐标／模型字段仍按不同来源字段保留。所列引文署名不代表已完成全文审读。
readerLimitations.en:
This page combines the principal 2014 original-description text, selected 2022 cranial passages and fixed PBDB occurrences. The original age discussion depends on stratigraphic correlations of its time and is not narrowed to an exact age or used to revise the broad database bracket. All supplements, the full 2022 anatomy, later histology and all taxonomic literature remain unread. No independent specimen inspection, individual recount or matrix rerun occurred. Aggregation, juvenile flight, sexual dimorphism, diet and mortality retain inference limits; a full monograph remain pending.

The comparative route additionally uses the already-read 2019 shared-bonebed and 2020 dinosaur-histology main texts. Samples and models apply to their respective taxa; cross-links do not complete the site fauna or all developmental research.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 1 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

overview: The 2016 description designates MN 7596-V, housed at Museu Nacional/UFRJ, as the holotype. It is a three-dimensionally preserved mandible about 270 mm long, lacking the left retroarticular process and part of the dentary crest. No associated upper jaw, postcranial skeleton or complete wing is known. The 2025 review lists no referred specimens, so this single mandible cannot supply a complete body or an age series.

evidenceSummary:
MN 7596-V is one known specimen and preserves only part of the jaws; the 2025 review lists no referred specimens. Subadult status, possible horny covering, jaw mechanics and an approximately 2 m wingspan are interpretations from incomplete bones or comparison. The broad depositional setting and database age bracket do not establish a preferred habitat or a precise specimen age. A complete body, growth series and direct dietary evidence are not available in this account.

title.zh: 近完整下颌是已知身体的起点
title.en: A nearly complete mandible anchors the known anatomy

text.zh: 2016 年原始描述指定 MN 7596-V 为正模，收藏于巴西国家博物馆／里约热内卢联邦大学。它是一件三维保存、长约 270 毫米的下颌，缺左侧关节后突与部分齿骨冠；没有与之关联的上颌、头后骨架或完整翼部。2025 年综述没有列出归入标本，因此不能由一个下颌推成完整身体或多年龄样本。
text.en: The 2016 description designates MN 7596-V, housed at Museu Nacional/UFRJ, as the holotype. It is a three-dimensionally preserved mandible about 270 mm long, lacking the left retroarticular process and part of the dentary crest. No associated upper jaw, postcranial skeleton or complete wing is known. The 2025 review lists no referred specimens, so this single mandible cannot supply a complete body or an age series.

title.zh: 无齿、较宽而呈 Y 形的下颌
title.en: A toothless, relatively broad Y-shaped mandible

text.zh: 两侧齿骨在前部融合，下颌联合约占全下颌长度的一半。联合后方的下颌支突然向两侧展开，形成明显 Y 形；作者报告宽长比约 0.34，两支夹角约 30°。这些比例来自所述标本及论文测量口径。虽然三维保存减少了某些压扁问题，作者仍指出背腹压缩可能减小吻端原有的向下弯曲程度。
text.en: The dentaries fuse anteriorly into a symphysis about half the total mandibular length. The rami expand abruptly behind it, producing a pronounced Y shape. The authors report a width-to-length ratio of about 0.34 and an angle near 30° between the rami, under their stated measurement conventions. Three-dimensional preservation does not remove all distortion: dorsoventral compression may have reduced the original downward curvature of the tip.

title.zh: 长关节后突与夹骨上的粗糙凹窝
title.en: An elongated retroarticular process and a rugose splenial fossa

text.zh: 原始诊断列出两个自衍征：关节后突约占全下颌长的 7%，以及夹骨上浅凹窝内独特的细粗糙纹理。较深的下颌联合后方平台、短浅的齿骨窝和全长凹入的联合背面共同补充诊断。齿骨窝腹缘破损，作者无法完整测定其原始长度；这些特征的缺损范围也要随鉴别一起阅读。
text.en: The original diagnosis identifies two autapomorphies: a retroarticular process about 7% of mandibular length and a shallow splenial fossa with distinctive fine rugosity. A deep symphyseal shelf, short shallow dentary fossa and continuously concave dorsal symphyseal surface complete the combination. Damage to the dentary fossa’s ventral margins prevents assessment of its entire original length.

title.zh: 浅冠与角质喙都有推断边界
title.en: A shallow crest and horny covering have inferential limits

text.zh: 齿骨冠大部破损，作者依据保留的前后腹缘和断裂基部宽度推断它较浅；这不是保存完整的冠高。下颌联合后背侧的小神经血管孔则被解释为可能有角质鞘覆盖。标本并未直接保存本种完整喙鞘或头顶冠饰，因此不能补出确定的颜色、轮廓或软组织结构。
text.en: Much of the dentary crest is damaged. Preserved anterior and posterior ventral edges and the widths of broken bases suggest a shallow crest rather than a directly measured complete height. Small posterodorsal neurovascular foramina suggest a possible horny sheath. Neither a complete beak covering nor a crest on the skull roof is preserved for this species, leaving color, full outline and soft-tissue architecture unknown.

title.zh: 骨缝支持亚成体，翼展来自比较
title.en: Sutures support a subadult; wingspan comes from comparison

text.zh: 2016 年作者依据齿骨与上角骨、夹骨与隅骨之间仍可见骨缝，以及关节表面的未完全骨化迹象，把正模解释为较晚亚成体。常用于翼龙成长判断的头后特征在本种未知。约 2 米翼展是以其他类群下颌比例缩放得到的估计，不是直接保存的双翼尺寸，也不是全种成年最大翼展。
text.en: Visible dentary–surangular and splenial–angular sutures, together with incomplete ossification interpreted at the joint surface, led the 2016 authors to regard the holotype as a late subadult. Postcranial maturity criteria are unavailable. The estimate of roughly 2 m wingspan is scaled from other taxa’s mandibles, rather than measured from preserved wings or established as the species’ adult maximum.

title.zh: 开口控制与弱咬合是功能假说
title.en: Jaw-opening control and weak biting are functional hypotheses

text.zh: 作者认为细薄联合、展开的下颌支和较小的肌肉附着凹窝不利于承受摇晃、扭转或处理较大且挣扎的猎物。较长关节后突则提示下颌降肌可能较发达，支持较好的开口控制。这些解释来自骨形和比较解剖，不是本种肌肉的直接保存、实测咬合力或进食观察；无齿也不能单独确定专食水果。
text.en: The authors infer that the thin symphysis, spread rami and small muscle-attachment fossae would limit resistance to shaking and torsion or handling large struggling prey. The long retroarticular process suggests a relatively developed jaw-depressor muscle and better control of opening. These are bone-based comparative interpretations rather than preserved muscles, measured bite force or an observed meal. Toothlessness alone does not establish obligate fruit eating.

title.zh: 原始位置对矩阵修改有依赖
title.en: The original placement depends on matrix changes

text.zh: 2016 年把新种加入原矩阵时，结果是与 Tapejarinae、Thalassodrominae 并列的未定成员；修改下颌比例性状并增加宽度性状后，五棵最简约树的严格共识把它置于较早分化的 Tapejarinae。作者还纠正了无齿类群锯齿性状的误编码。页面保留修改前后的区别，未独立检查补充矩阵或重跑分析；原文对比例性状编号有不一致，不在此自行裁决。
text.en: Adding the species to the original matrix left it in an unresolved relationship with Tapejarinae and Thalassodrominae. After modifying symphyseal proportions and adding jaw width, the strict consensus of five most parsimonious trees placed it as an early-diverging tapejarine. The authors also corrected serrated-tooth miscoding in toothless taxa. This distinction is retained without independently checking the supplementary matrix or rerunning analyses; inconsistent proportion-character numbering in the text is not adjudicated here.

title.zh: 与 Caupedactylus 对读后续分类
title.en: Compare later classification with Caupedactylus

text.zh: 2025 年综述保留本种有效性，指出它与 Tupandactylus 的关节后突长度和联合背侧阶状隆起不同，并汇总与 Caupedactylus ybaka 的姐妹群关系。该方案把本种置于非 tapejarid 的 tapejariform 范围，区别于 2016 年论文和当前固定目录的 Tapejarinae。综述并未把亚成体身份当作缺少阶状隆起的充分解释；本页未独立读完所引后续矩阵。
text.en: The 2025 review retains the species as valid, distinguishes it from Tupandactylus by retroarticular length and the symphysis’s dorsal step, and summarizes a sister relationship with Caupedactylus ybaka. Its non-tapejarid tapejariform scheme differs from the 2016 paper and the fixed directory’s Tapejarinae placement. The review rejects subadult status as a sufficient explanation for the missing step. Later cited matrices were not independently read in full here.

title.zh: 近采石场的来源与未给出的坐标
title.en: Quarry-area provenance without precise coordinates

text.zh: 原研究说标本来自 Nova Olinda 城附近采石场，以捐赠方式进入馆藏，研究没有进行新野外采集，也没有精确坐标。论文层位为 Crato 组，2025 年综述进一步指出基质类型与颜色符合 Nova Olinda 段，但精确地点未知。当前数据库的 119.57–113.2 Ma 区间继续作为记录边界；沉积水体、个体生活环境和起源地点不能互相替代。
text.en: The original study reports donation of a specimen found near Nova Olinda’s quarries, without new fieldwork or precise coordinates. It assigns the material to the Crato Formation; the 2025 review notes matrix type and coloration typical of the Nova Olinda Member while keeping the exact locality unknown. The database’s 119.57–113.2 Ma bracket remains a record boundary. Depositional waters, living habitat and geographic origin are distinct questions.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:

In recent stratigraphic schemes (e.g. Martill 2007) the Santana Formation and the "Romualdo Member" are essentially synonyms

PBDB’s accepted name and recorded parent chain organize the entry; they do not resolve specimen identifications or every taxonomic dispute, and same-name Catalogue of Life concepts are kept separate. Localities, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and collection-level preservation labels describe different things. They do not establish the species’ complete range, exact origin or extinction, ecology, abundance or the condition of every specimen. The selected records do not form a full review of descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet or behavior.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 2 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:
Paleobiology Database（PBDB）接受 Afrotapejara zouhri，并将 Afrotapejara 列为记录中的父级。本页选读两条可用的种级出现记录，分别来自 Hamada du Guir 和 Lamaaka；它们涉及两个采集记录，共用一个引文编号。这些是数据库记录数量，不是化石或动物个体数量。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
Afrotapejara zouhri 在 PBDB 快照中对应分类条目 txn:414550。这份存档导读包含 2 条选取的出现记录，关联 2 个不同的 PBDB 采集记录编号和 1 个不同的 PBDB 引文编号。出现记录与采集记录是不同单位；这两个数量都不等于标本数或个体数。此页聚焦一个具体问题：这些记录各自连到哪些地点、年代界、材料说明和引文？
text.en:
The Paleobiology Database (PBDB) accepts Afrotapejara zouhri under the recorded parent Afrotapejara. This page follows two eligible species-level occurrence records, one from Hamada du Guir and one from Lamaaka. They represent two collections and share one reference identifier; those counts describe database records, not fossils or individual animals.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Afrotapejara zouhri is listed in the PBDB snapshot under taxon txn:414550. This archived guide contains 2 selected occurrence rows, linked to 2 distinct PBDB collection IDs and 1 distinct PBDB reference IDs. An occurrence row and a collection record are different units; neither count is a specimen or individual count. The reading question here is concrete: which recorded localities, age bounds, material notes, and citations are attached to these rows?

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh:
Hamada du Guir pterosaurs (BSPG) 和 Lamaaka 两个采集记录都位于摩洛哥 Drâa-Tafilalet（地区代码 MA）。PBDB 给 Hamada du Guir 的年代范围为 100.5–93.9 Ma，早端对应 Early Cenomanian；Lamaaka 为 106.3–93.9 Ma，从 Late Albian 延至 Early Cenomanian。这两个具名采集地只是所选数据库记录，不能视为本种完整分布图。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
存档导读包含 2 条出现记录，以下列出全部记录。每个 occ: 编号标识一条出现记录；col: 标识其关联的采集记录。

- 出现记录 occ:819573；PBDB 采集记录 col:90076。 地点字段 cnm=Hamada du Guir pterosaurs (BSPG)；地点分区字段 cc2=MA，stp=Drâa-Tafilalet，cny=Errachidia。 记录年代界：eag 100.5 Ma; lag 93.9 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Early Cenomanian。 记录署名 Martill et al. 2020；PBDB 引文编号 ref:72064。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
See revised palaeontology and geology of the Kem Kem beds in Ibrahim et al. 2020

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Based on the nearby town Taouz. Specimens were collected privately so locality information is unavailable. Ibrahim et al. (2010) suggest that this material might be collected from their Aferdou N'Chaft locality.

- 出现记录 occ:1499994；PBDB 采集记录 col:208784。 地点字段 cnm=Lamaaka；地点分区字段 cc2=MA，stp=Drâa-Tafilalet，cny=Errachidia。 记录年代界：eag 106.3 Ma; lag 93.9 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Late Albian，oli=Early Cenomanian。 记录署名 Martill et al. 2020；PBDB 引文编号 ref:72064。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
See revised palaeontology and geology of the Kem Kem beds in Ibrahim et al. 2020

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
The specimen was reportedly collected from a series of small excavations in the Kem Kem beds near a small plateau called Ikhf N’ Taqmout (Takmout). One important fossil locality lies close to the prominent tajine-shaped hill of Al Gualb (1,100 m) and is close to the Spinosaurus aegyptiacus excavation site described by Ibrahim et al. (2014). This extensive area of fossil digging is centred around 31°36’55.87”N – 4°15’42.67” W. A second important area of fossil digging, and lying slightly closer to the Taqrout plateau is within and adjacent to a sandstone quarry at Lamaaka at 31°38’51.13” N – 4°13’41.47” W. This latter area is the most likely source of the fossil described here (Martill et al. 2020).
text.en:
The Hamada du Guir pterosaurs (BSPG) collection and Lamaaka collection are both recorded in Drâa-Tafilalet, Morocco (region code MA). PBDB gives Hamada du Guir an age bracket of 100.5–93.9 Ma, with Early Cenomanian as its early interval. Lamaaka spans 106.3–93.9 Ma, from Late Albian to Early Cenomanian. These two named collections are selected database records, not a complete map of the species’ distribution.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh:
两条所选记录合并后的年代外包区间为 106.3–93.9 Ma（Ma 表示百万年前）。这个范围把 Lamaaka 较早的边界与两个记录共有的较晚边界并列起来，不表示整个时段都有连续记录，也不能直接测定本种的起源、灭绝或任何个体的寿命。两个采集地仍各自保留原有范围；这里没有提供更精确的标本年龄。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
在这组 PBDB 记录中，最大记录 eag=106.3 Ma，见 occ:1499994；最小记录 lag=93.9 Ma，见 occ:819573。这些数值是具名数据库记录的年代界，不代表两者之间存在连续记录，也不是该物种的起源、灭绝或个体寿命日期。每条记录各自的 eag 与 lag 值见上文。
text.en:
Across the two selected records, the outer age envelope is 106.3–93.9 Ma (Ma means millions of years ago). This envelope joins the oldest bound from Lamaaka to the youngest bound shared by the records; it does not show continuous presence throughout that span or directly date the species’ origin, extinction or any animal’s life. Each collection keeps its own bracket, and no more precise specimen age is supplied.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Across these selected PBDB rows, the largest recorded eag=106.3 Ma in occ:1499994; the smallest recorded lag=93.9 Ma in occ:819573. These values are age bounds on named database records, not a continuous record between them and not dates of the species' origin, extinction, or lifespan. Each row keeps its own eag and lag values above.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh:
PBDB 将两个采集记录的环境都标为 “fluvial indet.”（河流环境，类型未定），保存方式都标为 “body”（实体化石）。这些是采集层级的数据库描述；单凭这些标签不能确定 Afrotapejara 的栖地或食性，也不能说明两个采集地中每件化石的保存状态。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
此页区分出现记录编号、采集记录编号和材料说明。PBDB 采集记录编号不是单件标本编号。来源行提供的鉴定、材料、丰度及坐标／模型字段照录如下；采集层级的说明不被扩展成对每件化石的断言。

- occ:819573：PBDB 分类名称字段 tna=Afrotapejara zouhri；材料说明字段 ocm=BSP 1997 I 67, fragment of anterior mandibular symphysis；丰度字段 abv=1，abu=specimens；PBDB 地点坐标字段 lng=-3.983333，lat=30.900000；古坐标／模型字段 pm1=gplates，pln=7.44，pla=25.28。
- occ:1499994：PBDB 原鉴定字段 idn=Afrotapejara zouhri n. gen. n. sp.；PBDB 分类名称字段 tna=Afrotapejara zouhri；材料说明字段 ocm=FSAC-KK 5004 - holotype; referred specimens: FSAC-KK 5006 and FSAC-KK 5007；PBDB 地点坐标字段 lng=-4.228333，lat=31.647499；古坐标／模型字段 pm1=gplates，pln=8.12，pla=26.8。
text.en:
PBDB labels both collections “fluvial indet.” for environment and “body” for preservation mode. These are collection-level database descriptions. They do not by themselves establish where Afrotapejara lived or what it ate, nor do they describe the condition of every fossil in either collection.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
The page keeps occurrence IDs, collection IDs, and material notes distinct. A PBDB collection ID is not an individual specimen ID. Where the source row supplies them, its identification, material, abundance, and coordinate/model fields are transcribed below without turning a collection-level note into a claim about every fossil.

- occ:1499994: PBDB original-identification field idn=Afrotapejara zouhri n. gen. n. sp.; PBDB taxon-name field tna=Afrotapejara zouhri; material note ocm=FSAC-KK 5004 - holotype; referred specimens: FSAC-KK 5006 and FSAC-KK 5007; PBDB locality-coordinate fields lng=-4.228333, lat=31.647499; paleocoordinate/model fields pm1=gplates, pln=8.12, pla=26.8.

The database preserves separate collection and identification records; this page does not provide a specimen-by-specimen reassessment.

overview: The fixed PBDB name Huaxiapterus benxiensis retains the older named record. The 2023 study finds its holotype BXGM V0011 insufficiently distinct from H. corollatus and treats the older name as a junior synonym of Huaxiadraco corollatus. The added account follows this specimen’s preservation and development without counting two catalogue names as two independent biological species.

evidenceSummary:
The PBDB accepted-name record and the 2023 anatomical revision represent different classification contexts. The revision treats BXGM V0011 as indistinguishable from H. corollatus and proposes synonymy; the database name remains a catalogue label. Damage limits anatomical and growth comparisons, while occurrence fields do not provide a complete range or habitat account.

title.zh: BXGM V0011 在修订中成为归入材料
title.en: BXGM V0011 becomes referred material in the revision

text.zh: 固定 PBDB 名称 Huaxiapterus benxiensis 保留这项旧种名记录。2023 年研究认为其正模 BXGM V0011 与 H. corollatus 不可可靠区分，将旧种名列为 Huaxiadraco corollatus 的异名。新增正文按这件材料的保存和成长说明证据，不把目录中两项名称重复计为两种独立生物。
text.en: The fixed PBDB name Huaxiapterus benxiensis retains the older named record. The 2023 study finds its holotype BXGM V0011 insufficiently distinct from H. corollatus and treats the older name as a junior synonym of Huaxiadraco corollatus. The added account follows this specimen’s preservation and development without counting two catalogue names as two independent biological species.

title.zh: 身体近完整但躯干与肱骨细节受损
title.en: A nearly complete body retains damaged trunk and humeral details

text.zh: BXGM V0011 近完整，躯干中的颈后脊柱、胸骨、肋骨及肩带却受损或被遮挡，两件肱骨也残缺。头骨骨面破坏限制细节，后部骨尚未完全融合。不能把“近完整”转成所有骨都完整，也不据采集集合的软组织标签声称本件保存全部翼膜。
text.en: BXGM V0011 is nearly complete, but post-cervical vertebrae, sternum, ribs and shoulder girdle are damaged or obscured, and both humeri are incomplete. Surface damage limits cranial detail and posterior skull bones remain unfused. Near-completeness does not mean every bone is intact, and a collection-level soft-tissue label does not establish preservation of the entire membrane in this specimen.

title.zh: 下折吻、鼻突与短翼骨支持比较
title.en: Rostral deflection, nasal process and short wing elements support comparison

text.zh: 修订记述约 20 度下折吻、向前倾的鼻骨下降突与较高梨形眼眶，第一掌骨约为第四掌骨四成，第四翼指节约为第一节两成。冠虽破损仍似梯形，组合接近 corollatus 正模。冠的较大尺寸或后部棘较长没有被当成已经证明的独立种差异；具体比例受保存和测量条件限制。
text.en: The revision describes roughly 20° rostral deflection, a forward-inclined descending nasal process and a tall piriform orbit, with metacarpal one about 40% the length of metacarpal four and wing phalanx four about 20% of phalanx one. The broken crest still appears trapezoidal, matching the corollatus combination. Larger crest size or a longer posterior spine does not establish a separate species, and proportions retain preservation and measurement limits.

title.zh: 残缺肱骨重评改变原有比例
title.en: Reassessment of an incomplete humerus changes the reported proportion

text.zh: 原描述把肱骨记为仅股骨长度的约 55%，2023 年作者认为依据的是不完整右肱骨；重识别左肱骨两端后，得到约 80% 的比较值。这个改动展示残损可能如何制造异常比例。本页引用作者的重评，未亲自测量或看原图；不能从旧异常比例推断特有飞行能力。
text.en: The original description gives a humerus only about 55% of femoral length. The 2023 authors attribute that value to an incomplete right humerus and identify damaged ends of the left humerus, giving a comparison near 80%. This illustrates how damage can create an anomalous proportion. The reassessment is cited without independent measurement or image inspection here; the older anomaly does not establish distinctive flight ability.

title.zh: 更多融合表示相对较成熟
title.en: More extensive fusion indicates relative maturity

text.zh: 肱骨骨端、腕骨、第一翼指节伸肌腱突和胫跗骨已融合，后头骨仍未完全融合；肩胛乌喙骨因损伤无法观察。作者判断为较晚亚成体，约 1.6 米翼展属于该标本估计。融合顺序来自同组比较，不把这件较成熟个体指定为已知年龄、性别或成体最大尺寸。
text.en: Fused humeral epiphyses, carpals, first wing-phalanx extensor tendon process and tibiotarsus contrast with still-unfused posterior skull bones; damage prevents assessment of scapula/coracoid fusion. The authors infer an advanced subadult with a specimen wingspan estimate near 1.6 m. Within-group fusion comparison does not establish exact age, sex or maximum adult size.

title.zh: 沿两件材料追到异名与保存问题

text.zh: 先比较 BXGM V0011 与 H. corollatus 的保存、掌骨与末端翼指节，再对读 S. dongi 的成长与形态分组方法。原始 2007 年描述尚未独立读齐；固定出现行与现代归入解释分别保留，未合并地点、年代或数量。
text.en: Compare BXGM V0011 with H. corollatus in preservation, metacarpals and terminal wing phalanges, then growth and morphotype methods in S. dongi. The original 2007 description remains incompletely read. Fixed occurrences and later referrals retain separate sources without merging sites, ages or counts.
