title.zh: 一具骨架分存于四块岩板
title.en: One skeleton preserved across four blocks

text.zh: Dearc sgiathanach 正模 NMS G.2021.6.1–4 出自苏格兰斯凯岛 Lealt Shale Formation 的 Upper Lonfearn Member。2025 年研究描述的同一关联骨架分在主骨板、头骨块、腹面对应板和单独的翼指节块中。腭部、舌骨和脑颅骨等细小结构仍可辨认，颈椎完整，右手保存尤其清楚。背椎与肋骨已散开，骨盆、尾部和后肢保存较差；硬石灰岩还遮挡不少骨面，即使骨骼仍有三维形态，也无法观察身体每处。
text.en: The holotype, NMS G.2021.6.1–4, comes from the Upper Lonfearn Member of the Lealt Shale Formation on Scotland’s Isle of Skye. The 2025 study describes one associated skeleton divided among a main slab, a skull block, a ventral counterslab and a separate wing-phalanx block. It preserves delicate palate, hyoid and braincase bones, a complete neck series and a particularly clear right hand. The back vertebrae and ribs are scattered; the pelvis, tail and hindlimbs are poorly preserved. Hard limestone still hides many surfaces, even where the bones retain three-dimensional form.

title.zh: CT 可见空腔，肌肉位置仍需推断
title.en: CT reveals cavities; muscles must be inferred

text.zh: 作者对分离的头骨块进行微 CT 扫描，再手动勾画内部空间。吻部骨骼与围岩对比清楚，头骨后段对比度较低、边界更难描出；脑腔和内耳空腔则较清楚。肌肉位置来自另一种推断：作者比较骨嵴、凹陷和表面纹理与现生鳄类、鸟类的对应关系。CT 可显示空腔，但肌肉布置仍是复原，化石没有保留活动肌肉，也未直接记录飞行。
text.en: Micro-CT scans of the detached skull block reveal internal spaces that were then outlined by hand. Bone and surrounding rock contrast clearly in the snout but less clearly at the rear of the skull, so those boundaries are harder to trace; the brain and inner-ear cavities are more distinct. Muscle positions come from a separate step: the authors compare ridges, hollows and surface textures with crocodilians and birds. The cavities are visible in the scan, but the muscle arrangement is a reconstruction, not preserved tissue or a record of flight.

title.zh: 牙齿磨损留下不止一种食性可能
title.en: Tooth wear leaves more than one feeding possibility

text.zh: Dearc 前端牙齿较长、向后弯曲，后部牙齿短直，横截面近似棱柱。前牙受侵蚀较重，部分仅存牙根或中段；几颗后牙可见牙冠缺损、釉质裂纹和剥落。作者将其与 Dorygnathus 等翼龙比较，提出它可能处理较硬的猎物；前牙交错也可能有助于抓鱼。但骨架没有胃内容物或猎物遗骸，这些牙齿不能确定它只吃鱼，也不能给出各类食物的比例。
text.en: Dearc has longer, recurved teeth at the front of the jaws and shorter, straight, prism-shaped teeth behind them. Erosion has removed much of some front teeth, leaving roots or middle sections; several rear crowns are chipped, cracked or flaked. By comparing the teeth with Dorygnathus and other pterosaurs, the authors suggest Dearc could handle relatively hard prey. They also propose that the overlapping front teeth may have helped seize fish. No meal is preserved with the skeleton, so neither idea fixes its diet or the share of fish it ate.

title.zh: 胸骨与上臂嵴有助辨认 Dearc
title.en: The sternum and upper-arm crests help identify Dearc

text.zh: 2025 年研究提出两项可区分 Dearc 的特征：三角胸肌嵴向肩端逐渐变宽，并高于尺侧嵴；胸骨前缘向前突出。胸骨薄而宽，后部可能尚未完全骨化。其他翼龙的胸骨保存较差，能作的比较有限。左右肱骨露出的方向不同，且有局部压扁和裂缝；曲度差异不足以证明活体左右不对称。骨嵴有助分类并可与肌肉附着位置比较，却不能直接测出肌肉大小或拍翼力量。
text.en: The 2025 study identifies two proposed distinguishing features: a deltopectoral crest that widens toward the shoulder and rises above the ulnar crest, and a sternum whose front edge projects forward. The sternum is broad and thin; its rear may not have finished ossifying. Few other pterosaur sterna are well enough preserved for a strong comparison. The two upper arms are exposed differently and show local flattening and fractures, so their differing curves do not establish asymmetry in life. These bone shapes help with identification and attachment comparisons, but do not measure muscle size or wing power.

title.zh: 骨面标记提示一种可能的飞行肌肉模式
title.en: Bone landmarks suggest a possible flight-muscle pattern

text.zh: 作者把扩大的三角胸肌嵴与胸肌附着联系起来，并把上臂其他痕迹与背阔肌、喙肱肌的附着点相比。据此，他们提出 Dearc 飞行时可能较多以内收、前伸上臂为动作。Dearc 与 Rhamphorhynchus 的区别提示，相近体型翼龙的拍翼方式未必相同。这仍是待检验的假说：肩带与手部骨骼不完整，体型影响、共同祖先和趋同演化也难区分；未来的肌骨模型可以检验这种解释。
text.en: The authors link the enlarged deltopectoral crest to the pectoralis muscle and compare other marks on the upper arm with attachment sites for latissimus dorsi and coracobrachialis. From this pattern they propose that Dearc may have drawn its upper arm inward and forward during flight. Differences from Rhamphorhynchus suggest that similarly sized pterosaurs need not have moved their wings in the same way. This remains a working hypothesis: the shoulder girdle and hand bones are incomplete, and body size, shared ancestry and convergent evolution are hard to separate. A future muscle-and-skeleton model could test the proposal.

title.zh: 弯曲的手爪或有助抓握
title.en: Curved hand claws may have helped with grasping

text.zh: 右手第一至第三指完整，支持翼面的第四指只保存部分。指端爪骨有发达的屈肌附着面和相关籽骨。作者把其二维曲度与攀爬、栖枝鸟类比较，提出抓握或攀爬的可能，也不排除辅助捕食。爪骨只是外覆角质爪的骨芯，鸟类的使用方式也不是 Dearc 的行为记录；它是否常攀爬、攀爬什么表面或用爪捕食，都没有直接证据。论文给出的爪长数字与后文“第三爪最长”的说法不一致，因此本页不排列爪长。
text.en: The right hand preserves digits I–III; only part of the elongated fourth, wing-supporting digit remains. The terminal claw bones have strong flexor attachment areas and associated sesamoid bones. Their curvature, compared in two dimensions with that of climbing and perching birds, leads the authors to suggest a role in grasping or climbing, perhaps with an additional role in catching prey. A claw bone is only the bony core of a keratin-covered claw, and bird comparisons cannot show what Dearc did. How often it climbed, what it might have climbed on, and whether its claws caught prey remain unknown. Because the study’s reported lengths conflict with its later ranking of the third claw as longest, this page does not rank them by size.

title.zh: 论文提出了不同的科级位置
title.en: The published family placements differ

text.zh: 2025 年论文采用 2022 年描述提出的 Angustinaripterini 分组；同时提到另一项纳入 Skiphosoura 的分析将 Dearc 放在更接近 Monofenestrata 的位置。较长颈椎等特征，可能来自不同身体模块以不同速度演化，也可能是体型相关的趋同。“过渡型”并不能证明 Dearc 是其他翼龙的直接祖先。PBDB 接受名层级用于数据库资料编排；科级亲缘方案仍分别归于各自研究。
text.en: The 2025 paper uses the Angustinaripterini grouping introduced in the 2022 description. It also notes a different analysis, which includes Skiphosoura, placing Dearc nearer to Monofenestrata. Its relatively long neck and other traits could reflect different body regions evolving at different rates or convergence linked to size. Calling Dearc “transitional” does not make it a demonstrated ancestor. The database’s accepted-name hierarchy is a record-keeping path; these competing family-level placements remain attributed to their respective studies.

title.en: One eligible occurrence links to one collection
title.zh: 一条可用出现记录对应一个采集地

text.zh:
固定的 Paleobiology Database（PBDB）翼龙名录将 Dearc sgiathanach 作为接受种，数据库父级为 Dearc。本页使用一条可用的种级出现记录，关联一个采集地和一个引文编号。这些数字分别表示数据库记录、采集地和引文，不表示骨骼、标本或个体数。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
Dearc sgiathanach 在 PBDB 快照中对应分类条目 txn:454355。这份存档导读包含 1 条选取的出现记录，关联 1 个不同的 PBDB 采集记录编号和 1 个不同的 PBDB 引文编号。出现记录与采集记录是不同单位；这两个数量都不等于标本数或个体数。此页聚焦一个具体问题：这些记录各自连到哪些地点、年代界、材料说明和引文？
text.en:
The fixed Paleobiology Database (PBDB) pterosaur roster accepts Dearc sgiathanach beneath the database parent Dearc. This guide draws on one eligible species-level occurrence, linked to one collection and one reference identifier. These are counts of database records, collections and citations—not counts of bones, specimens or individual animals.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Dearc sgiathanach is listed in the PBDB snapshot under taxon txn:454355. This archived guide contains 1 selected occurrence rows, linked to 1 distinct PBDB collection IDs and 1 distinct PBDB reference IDs. An occurrence row and a collection record are different units; neither count is a specimen or individual count. The reading question here is concrete: which recorded localities, age bounds, material notes, and citations are attached to these rows?

存档导读包含 1 条出现记录，以下列出全部记录。每个 occ: 编号标识一条出现记录；col: 标识其关联的采集记录。

text.en:
The selected collection is named Rubha nam Brathairean pterosaur (Scotland), with region code UK and stratum Lealt Shale. Its database age bracket is 168.2–165.3 Ma, with the early bound assigned to the Middle Bathonian. The collection and rock-unit names follow the database wording. One recorded locality cannot give a complete map of the species or show that it was absent elsewhere.

title.en: A bracket around records, not a continuous timeline
title.zh: 年代范围包住记录，不代表连续时间线

text.zh:
本页所选出现记录的总年代范围为 168.2–165.3 Ma（Ma 为百万年前）。它合并了最早和最晚的数据库边界，不表示这段时间处处都有化石，也不是物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命的测量。每个采集记录仍保留各自的年代范围；这里不把宽区间缩成精确标本年龄。

PBDB 出现记录补充:

text.en:
The selected occurrence falls within an outer bracket of 168.2–165.3 Ma (Ma means million years ago). This combines the earliest and latest database bounds; it does not mean the animal is recorded continuously throughout that span, or date its origin, extinction or lifespan. Each collection keeps its own bracket. The broad age range is not reduced to a more precise specimen date.

These values are age bounds on named database records, not a continuous record between them and not dates of the species' origin, extinction, or lifespan. Each row keeps its own eag and lag values above.

title.en: The collection setting is not the animal’s habitat

text.zh:

text.en:
The Rubha nam Brathairean collection carries the database environment label “lagoonal” and preservation-mode label “body.” These labels describe the collection and its depositional setting, not Dearc’s daily habitat or diet. title.en: The database citation and the anatomy study have different roles
title.zh: 数据库引文与骨骼研究各有用途

text.zh:
数据库采集记录引用 Jagielska 等人（2022），编号 81241；上文骨骼细节则来自另一篇 2025 年骨骼研究，书目记录列有全部八位作者、发表日期和开放许可。因此，两项引文支撑本页的不同内容：一项附在采集记录上，另一项详述正模解剖。

- occ:1685927：记录署名 Jagielska et al. 2022；PBDB 引文编号 ref:81241。
text.en:
The database collection cites Jagielska et al. (2022), reference 81241. The anatomical details summarized above come from a separate 2025 osteological study, listed with its eight authors, publication date and open license. The two citations therefore support different parts of this account: one is attached to the collection record, while the other describes the holotype’s anatomy.

readerLimitations.zh:
这里的解剖内容概述 2025 年研究选定的章节，不是完整专论；没有覆盖全部解剖或原始图像，也没有完整呈现 2022 年描述中的翼展回归与组织学。肌肉、食性和攀爬解释来自骨骼、牙齿及比较，是对行为的推论而非直接记录。这些材料也无法说明 Dearc 的生活史或最终确定其在翼龙中的亲缘位置。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
此页导读的是 2026-10-02 快照中的 1 条 PBDB 选取出现记录，不是物种专论。地点和年代区间描述的是数据库记录，不能据此推出完整地理分布、连续存在的时间范围、生态、行为或种群大小。采集记录编号、出现记录编号、标本说明及来源明确给出的丰度单位彼此区分。地点坐标字段与古坐标／模型字段仍按不同来源字段保留。所列引文署名不代表已完成全文审读。
readerLimitations.en:
The anatomical account here summarizes selected sections of the 2025 study rather than a complete monograph. It does not cover every structure or original image, nor the full 2022 description, including its wingspan regressions and histology. Muscle use, feeding and climbing are interpretations drawn from bones, teeth and comparisons; they are not direct records of behavior. This material also does not establish Dearc’s life history or settle its placement among pterosaurs.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 1 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

evidenceSummary:
This page summarizes PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02 for one name in a fixed set of 276 pterosaur entries. Included rows have a matching current name, a recorded parent path to Pterosauria and a species-level occurrence without an uncertain-identification qualifier. Those rules organize the database; they do not settle the identification of an individual fossil or every taxonomic dispute, and a same-name COL entry is not merged as the same taxonomic concept. Collection site, age, depositional setting and preservation are separate kinds of information. Together they do not give a complete range, exact origin or extinction, species-wide habitat, population size or the preservation state of every specimen. This is a guide to selected records, not a full account of the species biology.

The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh:
所选出现记录指向以下采集地：
- Solnhofen (Uppsala Collection)（Bavaria）（地区代码 DE），地层名为 Solnhofen；年代范围为 149.2–145.06 Ma，早端为 Early Tithonian。
- Eichstätt, Solnhofen (MfN collection)（Bayern）（地区代码 DE），地层名为 Solnhofener Plattenkalk；年代范围为 149.2–145.06 Ma，早端为 Early Tithonian。
- Compsognathus type, Kapfelberg (BSP)（Bayern）（地区代码 DE），地层名为 Painten；年代范围为 152.21–149.2 Ma，早端为 Late Kimmeridgian。
这些是已记录的发现地点，不是物种完整分布图；名称和年代范围按来源保留。

PBDB 出现记录补充:

- 出现记录 occ:849634；PBDB 采集记录 col:57682。 地点字段 cnm=Compsognathus type, Kapfelberg (BSP)；地点分区字段 cc2=DE，stp=Bayern。 记录年代界：eag 152.21 Ma; lag 149.2 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Late Kimmeridgian。 地层字段 sfm=Painten。 记录署名 Wellnhofer 1975；PBDB 引文编号 ref:32121。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Reisdorf & Wuttke: "Because of its uncertain origin, neither its biostratigraphical age nor its lithostratigraphic classification is considered certain (Fig. 2). If it originated in Jachenhausen, then it can be considered to be from the Painten Formation (Zandt Member; cf. Zeiss 1977), and thus of an assumed Early Tithonian age (Rueppellianus Zone, Riedense or Early Rueppellianus Subzone) (G. Schweigert, personal communication 2011). On the other hand, if it came from the Kelheim area, then it is either from the lithostratigraphic equivalent of the uppermost Kimmeridgian of the Kapfelberg locality, or from the Lower Tithonian plattenkalks of the Goldberg locality (cf. Röper 2005a; Schweigert 2007). Since Kapfelberg has delivered a great quantity of reptile finds, it is the more probable locality (cf. Abel 1922; Kemp 2001). Whatever the case, both of these Plattenkalk deposits are considered part of the Painten Formation (G. Schweigert, personal communication 2011)."

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Exact location is uncertain due to conflicting descritptions and all that can be said is it is perhaps somwhere in the Riedenburg-Kelheim area, though Reisdorf & Wuttke (2012) consider Kapfelberg more likely

- 出现记录 occ:849631；PBDB 采集记录 col:29012。 地点字段 cnm=Solnhofen (Uppsala Collection)；地点分区字段 cc2=DE，stp=Bavaria。 记录年代界：eag 149.2 Ma; lag 145.06 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Early Tithonian。 地层字段 sfm=Solnhofen。 记录署名 Wellnhofer 1975；PBDB 引文编号 ref:32121。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Lithographic limestone

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Quarries in the Eichstatt/Schernfeld/Solnhofen area

- 出现记录 occ:849633；PBDB 采集记录 col:84365。 地点字段 cnm=Eichstätt, Solnhofen (MfN collection)；地点分区字段 cc2=DE，stp=Bayern。 记录年代界：eag 149.2 Ma; lag 145.06 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Early Tithonian。 地层字段 sfm=Solnhofener Plattenkalk。 记录署名 Wellnhofer 1975；PBDB 引文编号 ref:32121。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
STRATIGRAPHIC RELATIONS: From several beds within the Solnhofener Plattenkalk, including Malm 2b, and the Hybonoticeras hybonotum biozone.  AGE: Lower Tithonian.

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
SPECIFIC LOCATION: Eichstätt, Bavaria, Germany. LAT/LONG: estimated based on Eichstätt, Germany
text.en:
The selected occurrence rows point to these collection records:
- At Solnhofen (Uppsala Collection) (Bavaria), region code DE, the recorded age bracket is 149.2–145.06 Ma; the named stratum is Solnhofen; the early end is labeled Early Tithonian.
- At Eichstätt, Solnhofen (MfN collection) (Bayern), region code DE, the recorded age bracket is 149.2–145.06 Ma; the named stratum is Solnhofener Plattenkalk; the early end is labeled Early Tithonian.
- At Compsognathus type, Kapfelberg (BSP) (Bayern), region code DE, the recorded age bracket is 152.21–149.2 Ma; the named stratum is Painten; the early end is labeled Late Kimmeridgian.
They identify documented fossil localities, not the complete geographic range of the species. The record names and age bounds follow the source.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh:
所选记录的年代外界为 152.21–145.06 Ma；Ma 指百万年前。这个区间合并了所选记录中最早的早端与最晚的晚端，并不表示期间每个时段都有化石，也不是对物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命的直接测定。各采集地仍保留自己的区间；本页不会把它改成精确标本年龄，也不改写来源中的测年解释。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
在这组 PBDB 记录中，最大记录 eag=152.21 Ma，见 occ:849634；最小记录 lag=145.06 Ma，见 occ:849631。这些数值是具名数据库记录的年代界，不代表两者之间存在连续记录，也不是该物种的起源、灭绝或个体寿命日期。每条记录各自的 eag 与 lag 值见上文。
text.en:
The selected records have an outer age interval of 152.21–145.06 Ma; Ma means millions of years ago. This span combines the oldest early bound with the youngest late bound among the chosen records. It does not show continuous presence through every intervening time or directly date the species origin, extinction or an individual lifespan. Each collection keeps its own bracket; this summary does not narrow it to a specimen age or revise the source dating interpretation.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Across these selected PBDB rows, the largest recorded eag=152.21 Ma in occ:849634; the smallest recorded lag=145.06 Ma in occ:849631. These values are age bounds on named database records, not a continuous record between them and not dates of the species' origin, extinction, or lifespan. Each row keeps its own eag and lag values above.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh:
采集记录列出了以下环境与保存方式：
- Solnhofen (Uppsala Collection)：环境标签为潟湖或受限浅潮下沉积环境（lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal）；保存标签为实体化石、压印保存（body,adpression）。
- Eichstätt, Solnhofen (MfN collection)：环境标签为潟湖或受限浅潮下沉积环境（lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal）；保存标签为mold/impression、压印保存、软组织（mold/impression,adpression,soft parts）。
- Compsognathus type, Kapfelberg (BSP)：环境标签为潟湖或受限浅潮下沉积环境（lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal）；保存标签为实体化石、mold/impression、压印保存、replaced with calcite（body,mold/impression,adpression,replaced with calcite）。
环境标签描述沉积背景，不能单独证明动物的生活栖地或食性；保存标签针对集合，也不一定适用于其中每件化石。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
此页区分出现记录编号、采集记录编号和材料说明。PBDB 采集记录编号不是单件标本编号。来源行提供的鉴定、材料、丰度及坐标／模型字段照录如下；采集层级的说明不被扩展成对每件化石的断言。

- occ:849631：PBDB 原鉴定字段 idn=Pterodactylus longicaudus；PBDB 分类名称字段 tna=Rhamphorhynchus muensteri；材料说明字段 ocm=Pal Museum Uppsala 150；丰度字段 abv=1，abu=specimens；PBDB 地点坐标字段 lng=11.170000，lat=48.900002；古坐标／模型字段 pm1=gplates，pln=23.89，pla=32.08。
- occ:849633：PBDB 原鉴定字段 idn=Rhamphorhynchus longicaudus；PBDB 分类名称字段 tna=Rhamphorhynchus muensteri；材料说明字段 ocm=BSPG 1964 XXIV 123 (cast), BSPG 1877 X 1, 1889 XI 1, 1960 I 470, 1938 I 503, Teyler-Museum 6930, MB 101 XVIII, 3967 (exemplars 4 & 19), Burgermeister-Museum BMM 7/SMNS 56301；丰度字段 abv=9，abu=specimens；PBDB 地点坐标字段 lng=11.375278，lat=48.909168；古坐标／模型字段 pm1=gplates，pln=24.05，pla=32.11。
text.en:
The collection records carry these setting and preservation tags:
- Solnhofen (Uppsala Collection): lagoon or restricted shallow-subtidal setting (lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal); body fossil, compression impression (body,adpression).
- Eichstätt, Solnhofen (MfN collection): lagoon or restricted shallow-subtidal setting (lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal); mold or impression, compression impression, soft tissues (mold/impression,adpression,soft parts).
- Compsognathus type, Kapfelberg (BSP): lagoon or restricted shallow-subtidal setting (lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal); body fossil, mold or impression, compression impression, calcite replacement (body,mold/impression,adpression,replaced with calcite).
The setting is the depositional context, not proof of the animal’s living habitat or diet. Preservation tags describe a collection and need not apply to every fossil within it.

readerLimitations.zh:
本页整理的是 PBDB 截至 2026-10-02 的出现记录，属于固定 276 项翼龙名录之一。纳入记录要求当前名称相符、记录的父级路径可追到 Pterosauria，且有不带不确定鉴定限定的种级出现记录。这些规则便于整理数据库，并不裁决单件化石鉴定或所有分类争议；COL 中的同名条目也未被合并为同一个分类概念。采集地、年代、沉积环境与保存方式是不同信息，不能共同推出完整分布、精确起灭时间、物种整体栖地、种群规模或每件标本的保存状态。本页导读选定记录，不是完整的物种生物学专论。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
此页导读的是 2026-10-02 快照中的 14 条 PBDB 选取出现记录，不是物种专论。地点和年代区间描述的是数据库记录，不能据此推出完整地理分布、连续存在的时间范围、生态、行为或种群大小。采集记录编号、出现记录编号、标本说明及来源明确给出的丰度单位彼此区分。地点坐标字段与古坐标／模型字段仍按不同来源字段保留。所列引文署名不代表已完成全文审读。
readerLimitations.en:
This page summarizes PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02 for one name in a fixed set of 276 pterosaur entries. Included rows have a matching current name, a recorded parent path to Pterosauria and a species-level occurrence without an uncertain-identification qualifier. Those rules organize the database; they do not settle the identification of an individual fossil or every taxonomic dispute, and a same-name COL entry is not merged as the same taxonomic concept. Collection site, age, depositional setting and preservation are separate kinds of information. Together they do not give a complete range, exact origin or extinction, species-wide habitat, population size or the preservation state of every specimen. This is a guide to selected records, not a full account of the species biology.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 14 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Based on detrital zircon U-Pb dating from this formation (but not this locality), Wang et al. (2018) suggested an Oxfordian age for the lower beds, rather than Middle Jurassic, with 159 ± 2 Ma as the maximum depositional age. However, from a section near the Dashanpu Dinosaur Quarry, Ren et al. (2022) documented the youngest age for the zircon sample as 166.0 ± 1.59 Ma, and weighed average ages of the youngest subpopulation under the constraints of 1σ and 2σ are 170.9 ± 0.64 Ma and 169.9 ± 0.63 Ma, with a maximum confidence age of 169.9 ± 0.63 Ma selected as the final result.

Dashanpu quarry, 10 km NE of Zigong, Sichuan, China

Older information: "possible dates [range] from Middle Jurassic to Early Cretaceous. However, published radioisotopic [both 40Ar/39Ar and zircon U-Pb] dating results span... 152 to 168 Myr" = Bathonian to Kimmeridgian (Zhang et al. 2008). Also referred to as Haifanggou Formation

"Several recent isotope datings, using both 40 Ar/39Ar and SHRIMP U-Pb methods, have indicated that the age of the (underlying) ignimbrite is between the late Middle Jurassic and early Late Jurassic, or 159-164 Ma. Therefore, the Daohugou Bed cannot be older than this age, and is not comparable to the Middle Jurassic Jiulongshan Formation" (Wang et al. 2005). Unit is older than overlying Yixian Formation. Age is therefore constrained to Callovian-Barremian

Daohugou, Ningcheng county, eastern Nei Mongol (west of Liaoning province), northeastern China. 41°18.979 ′N, longitude 119°14.318′E

text.en:
The selected records have an outer age interval of 161.5–143.1 Ma; Ma means millions of years ago. This span combines the oldest early bound with the youngest late bound among the chosen records. It does not show continuous presence through every intervening time or directly date the species origin, extinction or an individual lifespan. Each collection keeps its own bracket; this summary does not narrow it to a specimen age or revise the source dating interpretation.

- Jagua Vieja：环境标签为海洋沉积环境，类型未定（marine indet.）；保存标签为实体化石、铸型（body,cast）。
环境标签描述沉积背景，不能单独证明动物的生活栖地或食性；保存标签针对集合，也不一定适用于其中每件化石。

text.en:
The collection records carry these setting and preservation tags:
- Hoyo del Palmar; 10 km NE Viñales: carbonate setting, type unspecified (carbonate indet.); body fossil (body).
- Jagua Vieja: marine setting, type unspecified (marine indet.); body fossil, cast (body,cast).
The setting is the depositional context, not proof of the animal’s living habitat or diet. Preservation tags describe a collection and need not apply to every fossil within it.

readerLimitations.zh:
本页整理的是 PBDB 截至 2026-10-02 的出现记录，属于固定 276 项翼龙名录之一。纳入记录要求当前名称相符、记录的父级路径可追到 Pterosauria，且有不带不确定鉴定限定的种级出现记录。这些规则便于整理数据库，并不裁决单件化石鉴定或所有分类争议；COL 中的同名条目也未被合并为同一个分类概念。采集地、年代、沉积环境与保存方式是不同信息，不能共同推出完整分布、精确起灭时间、物种整体栖地、种群规模或每件标本的保存状态。本页导读选定记录，不是完整的物种生物学专论。

readerLimitations.en:
This page summarizes PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02 for one name in a fixed set of 276 pterosaur entries. Included rows have a matching current name, a recorded parent path to Pterosauria and a species-level occurrence without an uncertain-identification qualifier. Those rules organize the database; they do not settle the identification of an individual fossil or every taxonomic dispute, and a same-name COL entry is not merged as the same taxonomic concept. Collection site, age, depositional setting and preservation are separate kinds of information. Together they do not give a complete range, exact origin or extinction, species-wide habitat, population size or the preservation state of every specimen. This is a guide to selected records, not a full account of the species biology.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 2 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

"In the railway cutting at Kcnnington this sand, fully exposed, is varied with beds and large nodules of sandstone slightly calcareous, while, for a considerable space towards Littlemore, lie widely-interrupted parts of the next rock above, viz. coralline oolite. The oolite lies in separated patches on the same plane, which were probably connected; the intervals between them are occupied by sand which may be supposed to have been left after the decomposition of the oolite. The upper parts of the oolite are absent for a large tract hereabout; and it may be supposed that the large waste of them was caused by long exposure to atmospheric agency in very ancient times (pre-glacial or earlier). readerLimitations.zh:
本页汇集 2026-10-02 固定 276 项翼龙工作名录中的 PBDB 出现记录。旧组合可能对应数据库接受名，但这种对应关系不裁决标本鉴定或所有分类争议。PBDB 父级链用于整理名录名称，与 COL 概念及系统发育树各自有别。地点、年代、沉积环境和集合保存字段描述的是数据库记录，不能单独确定完整分布、精确起源或灭绝时间、物种整体生态、生物数量或每件化石的保存状态。

PBDB 出现记录补充:

readerLimitations.en:
This page summarizes selected PBDB pterosaur occurrences dated 2026-10-02 from the fixed 276-name working roster. Older combinations may appear under database accepted names, but that mapping does not settle specimen identification or every taxonomic dispute. The PBDB parent chain organizes catalogue names; it is separate from COL concepts and phylogenetic trees. Collection location, age, depositional setting and preservation describe database records, not a complete range, exact origin or extinction date, species-wide ecology, abundance or the condition of every fossil.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 1 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

title.en: The collection and its recorded age bracket
title.zh: 采集地及其记录年代区间

text.zh:
采集地为阿根廷 San Juan 的 Quebrada del Puma（地区代码 AR），记录地层为 Quebrada del Barro。PBDB 给出的年代区间是 227.3–205.7 Ma，并将较早端的时间段标为 Norian。这些是来源中的地点和年代字段；一条记录不能说明该物种的完整分布，也不能证明其他地区没有它。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
存档导读包含 1 条出现记录，以下列出全部记录。每个 occ: 编号标识一条出现记录；col: 标识其关联的采集记录。

- 出现记录 occ:1593287；PBDB 采集记录 col:182613。 地点字段 cnm=Quebrada del Puma；地点分区字段 cc2=AR，stp=San Juan，cny=Caucete。 记录年代界：eag 227.3 Ma; lag 205.7 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Norian。 地层字段 sfm=Quebrada del Barro。 记录署名 Martínez et al. 2022；PBDB 引文编号 ref:81563。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
A late Norian age was recently proposed for this formation based on biostratigraphic correlations with the Los Colorados Formation from the neighboring Ischigualasto-Villa Unión Basin
text.en:
The collection is Quebrada del Puma in San Juan, Argentina (region code AR); the recorded stratum is Quebrada del Barro. PBDB gives an age bracket of 227.3–205.7 Ma and marks the early interval as Norian. These are the source's locality and time fields: one record does not give the species' full distribution or show where it is absent.

title.en: Reading the time interval
title.zh: 怎样理解这个时间区间

text.zh:
所选出现记录的宽泛年代包络为 227.3–205.7 Ma；Ma 表示百万年前。它是数据库记录的时间区间，并不表示区间内每个时刻都有化石，也不是物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命的直接测量。每个采集地都应保留自己的年代范围；宽区间不能变成精确标本年龄。

PBDB 出现记录补充:

text.en:
The selected occurrence has an outer age envelope of 227.3–205.7 Ma; Ma means millions of years ago. This is the bracket carried by the database record, not a continuous run of fossils at every point in time or a measured origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Keep the collection's own interval with that collection; a broad bracket does not give an exact specimen age.

Each row keeps its own eag and lag values above.

title.en: What the collection setting can show
title.zh: 采集环境记录了什么

text.zh:
数据库把 Quebrada del Puma 的采集环境记为“fluvial indet.”（河流沉积、具体环境未定），保存方式记为“body”（实体化石）。这些标签描述采集地和集合，不足以确定本种的食性或生活环境，也不代表每件化石的保存情况。

- occ:1593287：PBDB 原鉴定字段 idn=Yelaphomte praderioi n. gen. n. sp.；PBDB 分类名称字段 tna=Yelaphomte praderioi；材料说明字段 ocm=Holotype: PVSJ 914, fragment of the rostrum preserving the anterior part of both maxillae and palatines from the anterior border of the narial fenestra as well as a posterior portion of both premaxillae；丰度字段 abv=1，abu=specimens；PBDB 地点坐标字段 lng=-67.266670，lat=-31.633333；古坐标／模型字段 pm1=gplates，pln=-21.45，pla=-41.31。
text.en:
The database labels Quebrada del Puma's collection environment “fluvial indet.” (river-deposited, setting unspecified) and its preservation mode “body.” These labels describe the collection, not the species' diet or living habitat, and they do not describe every fossil individually.

Included rows have a matching current name, a recorded parent path to Pterosauria and a species-level occurrence without an uncertain-identification qualifier. Those rules organize the database; they do not settle the identification of an individual fossil or every taxonomic dispute, and a same-name COL entry is not merged as the same taxonomic concept. Collection site, age, depositional setting and preservation are separate kinds of information. Together they do not give a complete range, exact origin or extinction, species-wide habitat, population size or the preservation state of every specimen. This is a guide to selected records, not a full account of the species biology.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 2 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

title.en: Age bounds of these records

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh:

- Daxishan pterosaurs：环境标签为湖泊沉积环境，类型未定（lacustrine indet.）；保存标签为实体化石（body）。
环境标签描述沉积背景，不能单独证明动物的生活栖地或食性；保存标签针对集合，也不一定适用于其中每件化石。

- occ:1204720：PBDB 分类名称字段 tna=Jianchangnathus robustus；材料说明字段 ocm=PMOL-AP00028, partial skeleton and skull；丰度字段 abv=1，abu=specimens；PBDB 地点坐标字段 lng=119.983330，lat=40.866669；古坐标／模型字段 pm1=gplates，pln=129.38，pla=49.84。
text.en:
The collection records carry these setting and preservation tags:
- Daxishan, Linglongta: lake setting, type unspecified (lacustrine indet.); body fossil, compression impression, soft tissues (body,adpression,soft parts).
- Daxishan pterosaurs: lake setting, type unspecified (lacustrine indet.); body fossil (body).
The setting is the depositional context, not proof of the animal’s living habitat or diet. Preservation tags describe a collection and need not apply to every fossil within it.

readerLimitations.zh:
本页汇集 2026-10-02 固定 276 项翼龙工作名录中的 PBDB 出现记录。旧组合可能对应数据库接受名，但这种对应关系不裁决标本鉴定或所有分类争议。PBDB 父级链用于整理名录名称，与 COL 概念及系统发育树各自有别。地点、年代、沉积环境和集合保存字段描述的是数据库记录，不能单独确定完整分布、精确起源或灭绝时间、物种整体生态、生物数量或每件化石的保存状态。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
此页导读的是 2026-10-02 快照中的 1 条 PBDB 选取出现记录，不是物种专论。地点和年代区间描述的是数据库记录，不能据此推出完整地理分布、连续存在的时间范围、生态、行为或种群大小。采集记录编号、出现记录编号、标本说明及来源明确给出的丰度单位彼此区分。地点坐标字段与古坐标／模型字段仍按不同来源字段保留。所列引文署名不代表已完成全文审读。
readerLimitations.en:
This page summarizes selected PBDB pterosaur occurrences dated 2026-10-02 from the fixed 276-name working roster. Older combinations may appear under database accepted names, but that mapping does not settle specimen identification or every taxonomic dispute. The PBDB parent chain organizes catalogue names; it is separate from COL concepts and phylogenetic trees. Collection location, age, depositional setting and preservation describe database records, not a complete range, exact origin or extinction date, species-wide ecology, abundance or the condition of every fossil.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 1 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

geography: Late Jurassic lithographic limestones of Bavaria, Germany
overview: Archaeopteryx is a Late Jurassic avialan, a member of the bird-line dinosaurs, known from a small series of Bavarian fossils. The cited analyses place it outside Neornithes, the crown group of living birds; the fossils are not presented as direct ancestors of modern birds.
overviewZh: Archaeopteryx 是晚侏罗世的鸟翼类，属于鸟类一侧的恐龙支系，目前由巴伐利亚少量化石代表。所引分析把它放在新鸟类之外；新鸟类是现生鸟类构成的冠群。这里记录的是化石与系统分析的关系，不是现代鸟类的已知直系祖先。

ecology.diet: The cited flight and systematic studies do not resolve diet.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from carbonate settings of the Solnhofen archipelago, represented by Bavarian lithographic limestones.
ecology.locomotion: The skeleton supports terrestrial and aerial capacities. Flight style is inferred from bone geometry rather than observed.
ecology.bodySize: The cited specimens are small-bodied paravians.
ecology.guild: The cited material does not establish one feeding guild.
ecology.dietZh: 所引飞行和系统学研究未能确定食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自索伦霍芬群岛的碳酸盐沉积环境，以巴伐利亚石灰华板岩为代表。
ecology.locomotionZh: 骨骼支持其具备地面活动和空中活动能力。其飞行方式是根据骨骼几何形态推断的，而非直接观察所得。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所引标本为小型近鸟类。
ecology.guildZh: 所引材料无法确定其属于哪一种摄食生态类群。

traits: Asymmetrical flight feathers occur with skeletal fossils
Toothed jaws and a long bony tail
Pectoral geometry is compatible with short-burst active flight in one biomechanical comparison
evidenceSummary: The oldest referred specimen extends the recorded genus range into the earliest Tithonian Painten Formation and documents anatomical variation. Synchrotron comparison supports active-flight capacity, not the performance of living crown birds.
evidenceSummaryZh: 目前归入该属的最早标本，把记录范围延伸到 Painten 组最早的提通期，并显示了解剖差异。同步辐射比较支持主动飞行能力的解释，但不能代表现生鸟类冠群的飞行表现。

title.en: What do the Bavarian fossils show about flight?
title.zh: 巴伐利亚化石对飞行能力说明什么？

text.en: Archaeopteryx is a Late Jurassic avialan, a member of the bird-line dinosaurs, known from a small series of Bavarian fossils. The cited analyses place it outside Neornithes, the crown group of living birds; the fossils are not presented as direct ancestors of modern birds.
text.zh: Archaeopteryx 是晚侏罗世的鸟翼类，属于鸟类一侧的恐龙支系，目前由巴伐利亚少量化石代表。所引分析把它放在新鸟类之外；新鸟类是现生鸟类构成的冠群。这里记录的是化石与系统分析的关系，不是现代鸟类的已知直系祖先。

title.en: Feathers accompany distinctive skeletal anatomy
title.zh: 羽毛与独特的骨骼解剖共同保存

text.en: Referred fossils are small-bodied paravians preserving asymmetrical flight feathers alongside toothed jaws and a long bony tail. The specimens show substantial anatomical variation; they do not demonstrate Archaeopteryx as the direct ancestor of living birds.
text.zh: 归入的化石是小型近鸟类，保存了不对称飞羽，同时具有带齿的颌骨和细长的骨质尾部。标本显示显著的解剖差异；它们不能证明始祖鸟是现生鸟类的直接祖先。

title.en: Wing geometry supports a bounded flight inference
title.zh: 翼部几何特征支持有限范围内的飞行推断

text.en: Synchrotron analyses found wing-bone geometry compatible with short-burst active flight in the tested comparison, supporting aerial capacity; this is a bounded model result, not observed behaviour or endurance. The skeletal record also supports terrestrial capacity, but this comparison does not measure how Archaeopteryx moved on land.
text.zh: 同步辐射分析发现，在所测试的比较模型中，翼骨几何形态与短时主动飞行相容，支持其具有空中活动能力。这是受模型条件限定的结果，不是对实际行为或耐力的观察。骨骼记录也支持其具备陆地活动能力，但该比较并未测量始祖鸟在陆地上的运动方式。

title.en: The oldest specimen of Archaeopteryx
title.zh: The oldest specimen of Archaeopteryx

scope.en: Rauhut et al. (2018), geological setting, systematic palaeontology, specimen descriptions (Figures 1?32) and Table 1: Bavarian material, anatomy, variation and the referred Painten specimen.

title.en: Wing bone geometry reveals active flight in Archaeopteryx
title.zh: Wing bone geometry reveals active flight in Archaeopteryx

scope.en: Voeten et al. (2018), Figures 1?4 and Supplementary Data 1?2: comparative wing-bone geometry and the short-burst active-flight interpretation.

readerLimitations.en: The described sample comes from Bavarian lithographic limestones in the Solnhofen archipelago. That depositional setting does not establish daily habitat; the cited work does not resolve diet or a feeding guild, and the flight model is not a performance measure for crown birds.
readerLimitations.zh: 所述样本来自索伦霍芬群岛的巴伐利亚石灰岩。该沉积环境不能证明日常栖息地；所引研究未确定食性或完整取食类群，飞行模型也不衡量今鸟类的飞行表现。

traitsZh: 骨骼化石伴有不对称的飞羽。
有齿的颌部和长长的骨质尾巴。
在一项生物力学比较中，胸带结构几何形态与短时主动飞行相符。

geography: Antarctica and Europe for the two Maastrichtian fossil tests highlighted here
overview: Neornithes is defined by the common ancestor of living birds and all descendants; Cretaceous membership depends on phylogenetic analysis.

ecology.diet: There is no single crown-wide diet. The Vegavis skull supports underwater prey capture only for that fossil.
ecology.habitat: Global across marine, freshwater and terrestrial environments today
ecology.locomotion: Predominantly volant, with multiple independently flight-reduced or flightless lineages
ecology.bodySize: Extremely diverse
ecology.dietZh: 冠群没有单一的共同食性。Vegavis 头骨仅支持对该化石所代表个体具有水下捕食能力的判断。

traits: Crown membership is defined relationally, not by one universally diagnostic fossil character
Vegavis skull anatomy combines an avian beak and crown-like neuroanatomy with a specialized feeding apparatus
Asteriornis preserves a different late Maastrichtian galloanseran character combination
evidenceSummary: Vegavis and Asteriornis shift among analyses, so the oldest highlighted crown-bird age depends on topology.

title.en: A crown group is defined from living birds
title.zh: 冠群由现生鸟类定义

text.en: Neornithes includes the most recent common ancestor of all living birds and every descendant of that ancestor. Archaeopteryx falls outside this crown boundary. There is no single fossil feature that defines every crown bird, so Cretaceous candidates such as Vegavis and Asteriornis must be tested in explicit phylogenetic analyses rather than assigned by age or resemblance alone.
text.zh: 今鸟类包含所有现生鸟类最近的共同祖先，以及该祖先的全部后代。始祖鸟位于这个冠群边界之外。没有一种化石特征能单独定义全部冠群鸟类，因此 Vegavis 和 Asteriornis 等白垩纪候选者必须通过明确的系统发育分析检验，不能只依据年代或相似外形归入其中。

title.en: Cretaceous skulls test the boundary in different ways
title.zh: 白垩纪头骨以不同方式检验这一边界

text.en: The Antarctic fossil Vegavis AMNH FARB 30899 dates to 69.2–68.4 million years ago. A 2025 analysis of its nearly complete skull supports crown-waterfowl affinity, while earlier studies recorded conflicting placements. The European Asteriornis holotype NHMM 2013 008 is younger, at 66.8–66.7 million years ago, and parsimony and tip-dated Bayesian analyses place it differently. The 69.2 Ma crown-bird minimum in this account therefore depends on accepting the 2025 placement of Vegavis; the two fossils do not map a complete Cretaceous range or an origin area.
text.zh: 南极洲的 Vegavis 标本 AMNH FARB 30899 年代为 6920–6840 万年前。2025 年对其近完整头骨的分析支持它属于冠群水禽，但较早研究曾提出互相冲突的位置。欧洲 Asteriornis 正模 NHMM 2013 008 年代较晚，为 6680–6670 万年前；简约法与尖端定年贝叶斯分析对其位置也有不同结果。因此，本档案中 6920 万年前的冠群鸟类化石下限取决于是否接受 2025 年对 Vegavis 的归属；这两件化石并不能绘出完整白垩纪分布或起源区域。

title.en: One fossil cannot define the ecology of all birds
title.zh: 一种化石不能代表所有鸟类的生态

text.en: The crown group includes birds with varied diets and habitats, so it has no single ecological guild. Vegavis preserves a narrow beak, an enlarged jaw-muscle attachment area and other skull features used to infer underwater prey capture. That functional interpretation applies to Vegavis alone; it is not evidence that all early or living crown birds shared the same feeding mode.
text.zh: 冠群鸟类的食性和栖息环境多样，不能归入单一生态类群。Vegavis 保存了狭窄的喙、较大的颌肌附着区等头骨特征，研究者据此推断它可能在水下捕食；这一功能解释只适用于 Vegavis，不能证明早期或现生冠群鸟类都采用相同取食方式。

title.en: Torres et al. (2025), Antarctic bird skull
title.zh: Torres 等（2025），南极鸟类头骨

scope.en: AMNH FARB 30899, its 69.2–68.4 Ma age statement, skull description and combined phylogenetic analyses, Figures 1–4. The source supports crown-waterfowl affinity in the 2025 matrix while documenting earlier placements; it does not make that placement historically uncontested.
scope.zh: AMNH FARB 30899、其 69.2–68.4 Ma 年代陈述、头骨描述与组合系统发育分析、图 1–4。该来源支持 2025 年矩阵中的冠群水禽位置，同时记录较早的其他归属；这一位置并非历来无争议。

title.en: Field et al. (2020), European crown-bird candidate
title.zh: Field 等（2020），欧洲冠群鸟类候选者

scope.en: NHMM 2013 008, its Maastrichtian geological setting and Figures 1–4, including the parsimony and tip-dated analyses. The placement differs between analyses; the source does not establish an undisputed crown position or complete fossil range.
scope.zh: NHMM 2013 008、马斯特里赫特期地质背景与图 1–4，包括简约法和尖端定年分析。不同分析给出不同位置；该来源不能确立无争议的冠群归属或完整化石延限。

overviewZh: Neornithes 是现生鸟类的冠群，定义为其最近共同祖先及其全部后代。某些白垩纪化石是否属于这一范围，取决于明确的系统发育分析；一件化石无法界定所有鸟类冠群成员的生态。
evidenceSummaryZh: 一项 2025 年的头骨分析支持将 Vegavis 置于冠群水鸟之内，但早期研究曾提出其他位置。不同分析对 Asteriornis 的近冠群位置也有不同结果，因此突出展示的最早冠群鸟类年代取决于所接受的系统树拓扑。

geography: Pekin Formation, Chatham County, North Carolina, United States
overview: The immature, partial holotype NCSM 21558 anchors Carnufex in the Carnian Pekin Formation; predator role and reconstructed size are study inferences.

ecology.diet: Serrated, recurved teeth support a faunivorous interpretation; the fossil does not preserve feeding.
ecology.habitat: The study treats Carnufex as terrestrial within the sampled Pekin Formation assemblage.
ecology.locomotion: The study treats it as terrestrial, but its bones do not directly record locomotor performance.
ecology.bodySize: About 3 m in the study's reconstruction; the estimate relies on an immature femur and incomplete skull material.
ecology.guild: The study interprets it as a top-tier terrestrial predator in the sampled Pekin Formation community.
ecology.dietZh: 带锯齿的弯曲牙齿支持其食动物的解释；化石未保存摄食行为。
ecology.habitatZh: 该研究认为 Carnufex 在所取样的 Pekin 组化石组合中为陆生动物。
ecology.locomotionZh: 研究将其视为陆生动物，但骨骼并未直接记录运动表现。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 研究重建估计约 3 米；该估计依据一根未成熟个体的股骨和不完整头骨材料。
ecology.guildZh: 该研究将其解释为所取样 Pekin 组生物群中的高阶陆生捕食者。

traits: NCSM 21558 preserves parts of the skull, vertebral column, ribs and left humerus
The reconstructed skull is slender and ornamented, with an estimated length greater than 50 cm
Premaxillary teeth are elongate, serrated and slightly recurved
evidenceSummary: Holotype anatomy and Pekin context are documented; size, predator role and basal crocodylomorph placement depend on comparison with an immature specimen.

title.en: What the partial skeleton preserves
title.zh: 部分骨骼保存了什么？

text.en: The holotype NCSM 21558 preserves parts of the skull, vertebral column, ribs and left humerus; a separate referred humerus is NCSM 21623. The reconstructed skull is slender and ornamented, with an estimated length greater than 50 cm. Its premaxillary teeth are long, serrated and slightly recurved. Because the holotype was still growing and is incomplete, these observations do not describe every Carnufex individual or adult body proportions.
text.zh: 正模 NCSM 21558 保存了部分头骨、脊柱、肋骨和左肱骨；另有一件归入的肱骨编号为 NCSM 21623。复原的头骨细长并带有装饰，估计长度超过 50 厘米；前颌齿较长、具锯齿且略向后弯。正模仍未成年且保存不完整，因此这些观察不能代表每只卡罗莱纳屠夫鳄或成年个体的全部体型比例。

title.en: How the study inferred a large predator
title.zh: 研究者如何推断它是大型捕食者？

text.en: The cited analysis estimated a body length of about 3 m using the reconstructed skull and an immature femur-length estimate of 354–441 mm. It placed Carnufex near the base of Crocodylomorpha in an unresolved polytomy in a matrix of 79 taxa and 413 characters. The same study interpreted it as a top-tier terrestrial predator in the Pekin Formation community. Length, branch position and ecological role are model-based conclusions from the sampled material, not direct evidence of adult size, behaviour or ancestry.
text.zh: 所引分析依据复原头骨和未成年个体的股骨长度估计（354–441 毫米），推算体长约 3 米。研究用包含 79 个类群、413 个性状的矩阵，将卡罗莱纳屠夫鳄置于鳄形类基部的未解析多分叉中；同一研究还把它解释为佩金组动物群中的顶级陆生捕食者。体长、分支位置和生态角色都是基于样本的分析结论，并非对成年体型、行为或祖先关系的直接观察。

title.en: Zanno et al. (2015), Carnufex anatomy and predator interpretation
title.zh: Zanno 等（2015），Carnufex 解剖与捕食者解释

scope.en: Holotype NCSM 21558, referred humerus NCSM 21623, Pekin Formation occurrence and the 79-taxon, 413-character analysis; Article 9276, Figures 1–2 and Supplementary Figure S9. The study's length, predator-guild and basal-placement conclusions remain bounded to this incomplete, skeletally immature sample and its matrix.
scope.zh: 正模 NCSM 21558、归入的肱骨 NCSM 21623、佩金组出现记录及 79 类群、413 性状分析；文章 9276、图 1–2 和补充图 S9。体长、捕食者功能群和基部位置等结论仍限于这件未成年且不完整的样本及其矩阵。

overviewZh: 不成熟且不完整的骨架 NCSM 21558，将 Carnufex 定位于北卡罗来纳州卡尼期 Pekin 组。该化石组合中，其锯齿状牙齿和重建体型使所引研究将其解释为大型陆生捕食者；这些生态和体型判断是推断，并非观察到的行为。
evidenceSummaryZh: 正模的解剖结构及其约 231 Ma 的 Pekin 组地层背景均有记录。研究对体型、捕食者角色和基干鳄形类位置的解释，取决于比较结果以及这件不完整、未成熟的标本。

overview: NHMM 2013 008 preserves a three-dimensional skull and fragmentary postcrania; analyses place Asteriornis near crown Galloanserae but differ on its position.

ecology.diet: Not resolved by the cited description
ecology.habitat: A possible littoral ecology inferred from the marine depositional context, not a directly observed habitat preference
ecology.locomotion: Not resolved by the cited description
ecology.bodySize: Mean body-mass estimate of 394 g from the study's skeletal scaling model
ecology.guild: No feeding or locomotor guild is assigned from the cited evidence

traits: A nearly complete, three-dimensionally preserved skull is associated with fragmentary postcranial elements
The skull combines galliform-like and anseriform-like features in the authors' comparison
Parsimony and tip-dated Bayesian analyses recover different near-galloanseran positions
evidenceSummary: The 66.8–66.7 Ma horizon, skull anatomy and 394 g body-mass estimate are tied to a named specimen and a scaling model. Exact branch placement and possible littoral ecology remain interpretations.

title.en: A genus introduced through its type specimen
title.zh: 从模式标本认识一个属

text.en: This route introduces genus Asteriornis through NHMM 2013 008, the holotype of A. maastrichtensis. It comes from the Maastricht Formation at Belgium’s CBR-Romontbos quarry; the cited 2020 study constrains its horizon to 66.8–66.7 Ma. CT imaging reveals a nearly complete three-dimensional skull and associated postcranial bones. This named fossil is the starting material, rather than a complete sample of variation across the genus.
text.zh: Asteriornis 属在本阅读路径中由 A. maastrichtensis 的正模 NHMM 2013 008 引入。材料来自比利时 CBR-Romontbos 采石场的 Maastricht 组，所引2020年研究将层位限定为6680万至6670万年前。CT 成像揭示近完整三维头骨及相关头后骨骼；这里阅读的是具名化石材料，不是整个属的完整变异样本。

title.en: Follow anatomy, relationships and inference limits
title.zh: 沿解剖、亲缘关系与解释边界继续阅读

text.en: Continue to the Asteriornis maastrichtensis species page: distinguish preserved cranial features from the authors’ landfowl and waterfowl comparisons, then compare the parsimony and tip-dated Bayesian placements. The 394-g body mass is a skeletal-scaling estimate; littoral ecology is a tentative depositional-context interpretation. The occurrence age establishes neither a global crown-bird first appearance nor direct ancestry.
text.zh: 接着读 Asteriornis maastrichtensis 的种级页：先区分保存下来的头骨特征与作者的鸡形类、雁形类比较，再看简约法与尖端定年贝叶斯分析为何给出不同位置。体重394克来自骨骼尺度估计；滨岸生态只是沉积背景所支持的可能解释。标本出现的年龄不能替代冠群鸟类全球首现，也不确立直接祖先关系。

overviewZh: 最晚马斯特里赫特期的鸟类 Asteriornis maastrichtensis 以经 CT 成像的正模 NHMM 2013 008 为主要依据。该标本包括一具近乎完整的三维头骨和零碎的颅后骨骼。已发表的分析将其置于冠群鸡雁类附近，但对其确切位置的判断不一。
evidenceSummaryZh: 66.8–66.7 Ma 地层层位、头骨解剖特征及 394 克体重估计，均对应到具名标本和体尺换算模型。确切的支系位置及可能的滨岸生态仍属解释。

title.en: Field et al. (2020), Asteriornis holotype anatomy and competing phylogenetic analyses
title.zh: Field 等（2020），Asteriornis 正模解剖与竞争系统发育分析

scope.en: NHMM 2013 008 and its quarry/horizon provenance; Figures 1–3, Extended Data Figures 7–9 and the cited description. Existing research claims delimit anatomy, competing topology results, the skeletal-scaling mass estimate and tentative littoral interpretation. These locators do not establish a complete global range, feeding behaviour, flight performance, direct ancestry of this guide.

readerLimitations.en: This genus route is limited to a named holotype and its cited study, without a complete genus range, ecology or variation account. The route’s 66.8–66.7 Ma interval applies to the cited sample; a global species range and first and last appearances remain unresolved. Recorded database placement and atlas navigation do not independently resolve competing phylogenetic results. This bilingual guide.
readerLimitations.zh: 这是单一具名正模及其所引研究的属级阅读入口，不能外推完整属级分布、生态或种内变异。本阅读路径中的6680万至6670万年前限定到已有样本，不表示已经证实全球首现与末现；种级整体范围仍缺少充分来源。数据库所录分类位置与图谱导航不能独立解决不同分析间的分支差异。。

geography: Pekin Formation, Chatham County, North Carolina, United States
overview: NCSM 21558 and referred humerus NCSM 21623 underlie a ~3 m reconstruction and terrestrial-predator interpretation, not adult size or observed hunting.

ecology.diet: Faunivory is inferred from serrated, recurved teeth rather than directly observed feeding
ecology.habitat: Terrestrial Pekin Formation assemblage in the study's reconstruction
ecology.locomotion: Treated as terrestrial in the cited comparison; locomotor performance was not directly tested
ecology.bodySize: Approximately 3 m in the study's reconstruction, with an immature femur-length estimate of 354–441 mm
ecology.guild: Top-tier terrestrial predator in the sampled Pekin Formation assemblage, as interpreted by the study

traits: NCSM 21558 preserves parts of the skull, vertebral column, ribs and left humerus
The reconstructed skull is slender and ornamented, with an estimated length greater than 50 cm
Premaxillary teeth are elongate, serrated and slightly recurved
evidenceSummary: Bones and horizon are observations; total length, predator role and placement are interpretations, and tooth shape alone does not show feeding.

title.en: The named bones and their age
title.zh: 具名骨骼与年代

text.en: NCSM 21558 preserves parts of the skull, vertebral column, ribs and left humerus; NCSM 21623 is a referred humerus. The fossils come from the Pekin Formation in Chatham County, dated to about 231 Ma in the cited account.
text.zh: NCSM 21558 保存了部分头骨、脊柱、肋骨和左肱骨；NCSM 21623 是归入标本的一块肱骨。引文所述化石产自查塔姆县的 Pekin 组，年代约为 2.31 亿年前。

title.en: A predator reconstruction with limits
title.zh: 有边界的捕食者复原

text.en: Serrated, slightly recurved teeth support an inference of feeding on animal matter. Scaling from an immature femur produces an estimated length of about 3 m, and the study interprets Carnufex as a high-tier terrestrial predator in this assemblage. Neither the size estimate nor predator role is a direct observation of an adult animal hunting.
text.zh: 锯齿状、略向后弯的牙齿支持其取食动物性食物的推断。根据未成熟个体股骨进行尺度推算，体长约 3 米；研究据此将 Carnufex 解释为该化石群落中的高阶陆生捕食者。这些体型和生态判断都不是对成年个体捕猎行为的直接观察。

overviewZh: 未成熟且不完整的正模 NCSM 21558 与归入肱骨 NCSM 21623 支持约 3 米体长和陆生捕食者的研究复原；这不是成年体长或捕猎行为的直接记录。
evidenceSummaryZh: 骨骼、Chatham County 的地层层位及约 231 Ma 的年代是直接记录。全长、捕食者角色和鳄形类位置属于研究解释；牙齿形态提示其食动物性，但不能证明其实际摄食。

overview: Holotype NHMM 2013 008 preserves a nearly complete three-dimensional skull with fragmentary postcranial bones from a 66.8–66.7 Ma Belgian horizon. Its cranial features combine galliform-like and anseriform-like states, but parsimony and tip-dated analyses disagree on its exact near-galloanseran position.

ecology.diet: The cited description does not resolve diet.
ecology.habitat: A littoral setting is possible from the marine deposits, but habitat preference is not directly observed.
ecology.locomotion: The cited description does not resolve locomotion.
ecology.bodySize: A skeletal-scaling model estimates a mean body mass of 394 g; this is not a direct weighing.
ecology.guild: No feeding or locomotor guild is assigned from these data.
ecology.dietZh: 所引描述未能确定食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 根据海相沉积，该化石可能来自滨海环境，但未直接观察到其生境偏好。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所引描述没有确定其运动方式。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 骨骼尺度模型估计平均体重为 394 克；这并非直接称重结果。
ecology.guildZh: 这些数据未用于指定其摄食或运动生态类群。

traits: The type combines a nearly complete, three-dimensionally preserved skull with fragmentary postcranial elements.
The skull combines galliform-like and anseriform-like features in the authors’ comparison.
Parsimony and tip-dated Bayesian analyses recover different near-galloanseran placements.
evidenceSummary: The profile is limited to NHMM 2013 008, its 66.8–66.7 Ma horizon and a 394 g model estimate. Exact crown placement and a possible littoral ecology remain interpretation-dependent; this fossil does not establish the geographic origin of crown birds.
overviewZh: 正模 NHMM 2013 008 保存了近乎完整的三维颅骨及零碎的颅后骨骼，出自比利时一个 66.8–66.7 Ma 的层位。其颅骨兼有鸡形类样和雁形类样特征，但简约法与尖端定年分析对它在近鸡雁类中的确切位置得出了不同结果。
evidenceSummaryZh: 本页限于 NHMM 2013 008、其 66.8–66.7 Ma 层位和一个 394 g 的模型估计。其在冠群中的确切位置及可能的滨岸生态仍取决于解释；这件化石不能确定冠群鸟类的地理起源。

title.en: A specimen from a constrained Belgian horizon
title.zh: 比利时限定层位中的具名标本

text.en: Holotype NHMM 2013 008 comes from the Maastricht Formation at the CBR-Romontbos quarry in Belgium. Field et al. (2020) constrain its source horizon to 66.8–66.7 Ma. This is a locality/horizon constraint, not the species’ complete duration or global first and last appearances. The collection number connects anatomy and phylogenetic interpretations to the same material; the locality does not identify the geographic origin of crown birds.
text.zh: 正模 NHMM 2013 008 出自比利时 CBR-Romontbos 采石场的 Maastricht 组。Field 等（2020）给出的6680万至6670万年前是该来源层位的年龄约束，不是本种完整存续期、全球首现或全球末现。馆藏号把后续解剖与系统发育解释连接到同一材料；出现地点也不确定冠群鸟类的地理起源。

title.en: What the fossil preserves
title.zh: 化石保存了什么

text.en: The specimen preserves a nearly complete three-dimensional skull with associated postcranial elements, studied through CT imaging and digital segmentation. In the authors’ comparison, its cranium combines galliform-like and anseriform-like features. These observations belong to the preserved material and comparison; the combination does not make it a modern chicken or duck or reveal unpreserved soft tissues and behaviour.
text.zh: 标本保存近完整、三维保存的头骨及相关头后骨骼，头骨经CT成像与数字分割研究。作者比较中，头骨呈现鸡形类样与雁形类样特征的组合。保存性状和比较结果是可限定到这件标本的证据；这种组合不表示它就是现代鸡或鸭，也不意味着未保存的软组织和行为已经确定。

title.en: Two analyses, two nearby placements
title.zh: 两种分析与两种相近位置

text.en: The study’s parsimony analysis recovered it as sister to crown Galloanserae. Its tip-dated Bayesian analysis instead placed it as the stemward-most member of Pangalliformes. Both concern its relationships near galloanserans, but they do not agree on the exact branch. This page reports the method-dependent results together; recorded database placement and atlas navigation do not independently resolve these competing results.
text.zh: 研究中的简约法把它恢复为冠群鸡雁类的姐妹群；尖端定年贝叶斯分析则把它放在全鸡形类最靠干群的位置。两项结果都关联近鸡雁类的比较，却并不一致地解决具体分支。本页并列报告这些方法依赖结果，数据库所录分类位置与图谱导航不能独立解决这些竞争结果。

title.en: A model estimate and a tentative habitat
title.zh: 模型体重与暂定环境解释

text.en: The reported mean body-mass estimate of 394 g is a skeletal-scaling model result, not a measured living animal. Small size and marine depositional context led the authors to suggest possible littoral ecology; burial setting does not directly establish habitat preference. The cited description does not resolve species-specific diet, locomotor performance or a feeding guild.
text.zh: 论文报告的平均体重估计为394克，是骨骼尺度模型结果，不是对活体的称量。小体型与海相沉积背景使作者提出可能的滨岸生态，但沉积地点不能直接证明动物的栖地偏好。所引描述没有确定本种食性、运动性能或摄食功能群；这里保持这些问题开放。

traitsZh: 正模兼有近乎完整、以三维形态保存的头骨和零碎的身体后部骨骼。
作者的比较显示，头骨兼具类似鸡形目和雁形目的特征。
简约法和尖端定年贝叶斯分析得出了不同的近鸡雁类位置。

readerLimitations.en: These sections are limited to NHMM 2013 008 and the description, comparisons and models in Field et al. (2020). A global range and first and last appearances remain unresolved for lack of sufficient provenance. Diet, flight or other locomotor performance, soft tissues and population variation are not established by the cited material. The horizon age does not close the range gap, and competing placements do not establish direct ancestry.
readerLimitations.zh: 四节限于正模NHMM 2013 008与Field等（2020）的描述、比较和模型。全球范围、最早与最晚出现仍缺少充分来源。食性、飞行或其他运动性能、软组织及群体变异均非所引材料所能确立。正文的层位年龄不解除这些范围缺口；两种系统位置也不确立直系祖先关系。

geography: Hell Creek, Lance and age-equivalent latest Maastrichtian formations
overview: A latest Maastrichtian tyrannosaurid represented by a large specimen sample; the dossier separates specimen anatomy and traces from fitted growth, bite-force and abundance models.

ecology.diet: Carnivorous, with direct bite-trace and coprolite evidence for bone consumption
ecology.habitat: Continental floodplain systems in western North America
ecology.bodySize: Large-bodied; size and mass estimates vary among specimens and reconstructions
ecology.guild: Large terrestrial predator and carcass processor

traits: Deep, robust skull with enlarged teeth
Two-fingered forelimb and powerful hindlimb
Ontogenetic cranial changes documented across a multi-institution specimen series
evidenceSummary: Stratigraphic census, growth-series anatomy, bone traces and coprolite contents are observations; population density, maturity, body mass, bite force and tooth pressure remain model-dependent inferences.

title.en: Several kinds of evidence, several kinds of inference
title.zh: 多种证据，对应不同层次的推断

text.en:
Tyrannosaurus rex is known from a large specimen sample, but no single fossil contains the whole account. A Hell Creek stratigraphic census tracks occurrences; a growth series compares skull changes across specimens; bite traces and coprolite contents preserve evidence of feeding on bone. Each line answers a different question about presence, development or behaviour.

The observations do not automatically yield population density, adult mass or bite performance. Those quantities depend on sampling and models, while tooth marks and coprolites support a narrower conclusion: bone was consumed. Keeping the sample, trace and model separate makes the animal’s history easier to read without turning one estimate into a universal fact.
text.zh:
暴龙有大量标本记录，但没有一件化石能独自讲完全部故事。Hell Creek 地层普查记录化石出现；生长序列比较不同个体的头骨变化；咬痕和粪化石内容物则保存了啃食骨骼的证据。每条证据回答不同问题，分别涉及出现、发育或行为。

这些观察并不会自动给出种群密度、成体体重或咬合性能。相关数值取决于取样和模型；牙痕与粪化石能支持的结论更窄：暴龙曾摄食骨骼。把样本、痕迹和模型分开阅读，才能避免把某个估计当成普遍事实。

Some skulls combine cranial characters that are intermediate between named forms.

overview: The cited redescription treats the type and referred material of Ankylosaurus magniventris, documenting its long, low skull, large neck armour and broad tail club. This account stays with those named specimens and formations.

ecology.diet: Not resolved by the cited anatomical redescription
ecology.habitat: Not resolved beyond the named formation occurrences
ecology.locomotion: Not resolved by the cited anatomical redescription
ecology.bodySize: Not resolved by the cited anatomical redescription

traits: A long, low skull with prominent laterally or dorsolaterally projecting cranial horns
A large cervical half-ring associated with the shoulder region
A large, low tail club documented in the redescribed material

title.en: A low skull, neck armour and tail club
title.zh: 低矮头骨、颈部甲片与尾锤

text.en: The redescription documents a long, low skull with prominent horns, a large cervical half-ring over the shoulder region, and a broad, low tail club. These are anatomical observations from the type and referred material in the cited study.
text.zh: 重描述记录了长而低矮、带有明显角突的头骨，肩部上方的大型颈部半环，以及宽阔、低矮的尾锤。这些是引文研究所讨论正模和归入标本的形态观察。

title.en: Anatomy is not a behavior record
title.zh: 形态记录不等于行为记录

text.en: The named material and formations support the described anatomy and occurrences. The redescription does not test what Ankylosaurus ate or how it moved, and the formation setting alone cannot assign a preferred habitat.
text.zh: 具名标本和地层记录支持这里描述的形态与出现信息。重描述没有检验 Ankylosaurus 的食物或运动方式，仅凭地层环境也无法指定其偏好的栖地。

overviewZh: 所引重描述研究考察了 Ankylosaurus magniventris 的模式材料和归入材料，记录其头骨细长低平、颈部甲片大，以及尾锤宽阔。本条仅涉及这些明确列出的标本和地层。
evidenceSummaryZh: 重新描述提供了标本层面的解剖结构、甲胄和地层记录。它没有直接确定食性、行为、运动方式或该物种整体的栖息地偏好。

geography: Candelária Sequence, Santa Maria Formation, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil
overview: Carnian sauropodomorph holotype ULBRA-PVT280 preserves an articulated skeleton. Its anatomy and teeth inform a faunivory hypothesis, while reconstruction of ancestral diet depends on the sampled evolutionary tree.

ecology.diet: Recurved, serrated teeth are compatible with faunivory in the study’s character-based reconstruction; gut contents are not preserved.
ecology.habitat: The record is bounded to the Candelária Sequence; a broader habitat is not established.
ecology.locomotion: A terrestrial, bipedal gait is an anatomical interpretation, not observed behavior.
ecology.bodySize: It is small-bodied within the early dinosauromorph comparison; no exact size is given here.
ecology.guild: The study reconstructs it as a faunivorous early sauropodomorph, a result dependent on its character sampling and tree.
ecology.dietZh: 弯曲且具锯齿的牙齿与研究中特征分析所支持的动物性食物假说相符；没有保存胃内容物。
ecology.habitatZh: 现有记录限于 Candelária 层序，不能据此概括更广的栖地。
ecology.locomotionZh: 陆生双足行走是根据解剖作出的解释，并非直接观察到的行为。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 在早期恐龙形类比较中属于小型；这里没有给出精确体型。

traits: The articulated holotype includes a partial skull, axial skeleton, forelimb and nearly complete left hind limb.
The preserved teeth are recurved and serrated.
A sampled morphological matrix recovers Buriolestes among sauropodomorphs.
evidenceSummary: The holotype and formation context are direct evidence. Diet, locomotion and placement in the sampled tree are comparative inferences and do not establish direct ancestry.
overviewZh: 肉食龙正模 ULBRA-PVT280 保存了关节连接的骨架。其解剖和牙齿用于检验取食动物性食物的假说；祖先食性的重建则取决于所采用的演化树。
traitsZh: 关节连接的正模包括部分头骨、躯干骨骼、前肢和近乎完整的左后肢。
保存的牙齿呈弯曲状并有锯齿。
一项取样的形态矩阵将 Buriolestes 恢复为蜥脚形类。
evidenceSummaryZh: 正模与地层背景属于直接证据；食性、运动方式及其在取样树中的位置是比较推断，不能证明直接祖先关系。

overview: Yinlong downsi is represented by the nearly complete holotype IVPP V14530 from the upper Shishugou Formation. The specimen preserves a broad skull behind the eyes and a shallow snout; the published matrix places it among basal ceratopsians, but does not establish direct ancestry.

ecology.diet: The anatomical and phylogenetic study does not directly establish diet.
ecology.habitat: The holotype locality is Wucaiwan in the Junggar Basin, Xinjiang; a broader habitat preference is not resolved.
ecology.locomotion: Short forelimbs and robust hindlimbs are compatible with bipedality, but gait is not observed in the fossil.
ecology.bodySize: The holotype is estimated at about 120 cm in total length; the estimate applies to this specimen.
ecology.guild: The cited anatomy and matrix study does not assign an ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: 这项解剖和系统发育研究没有直接确定其食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 正模产地位于新疆准噶尔盆地的五彩湾；尚未确定更广泛的生境偏好。
ecology.locomotionZh: 前肢较短、后肢粗壮，与两足行走相符，但化石没有记录其实际步态。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 估计正模全长约 120 cm；该估计仅适用于这件标本。

traits: Holotype IVPP V14530 is a nearly complete skeleton missing the distal tail
The skull is proportionally broad in the post-orbital region and shallow in the pre-orbital region
The diagnosis records distinctive cranial features including a frontal midline fossa and a trapezoidal quadratojugal
evidenceSummary: IVPP V14530, its upper Shishugou Formation locality and the described anatomy are specimen-level evidence. The study's 161.2–155.7 Ma envelope applies to this occurrence, not a global first appearance. Bipedality is inferred from limb proportions, and basal placement remains a result of the sampled character matrix.

title.en: What the holotype preserves
title.zh: 正模保存的结构

text.en: The nearly complete skeleton IVPP V14530 is missing the distal tail. Its skull is broad behind the eye sockets and shallow in front; the diagnosis also records a frontal midline fossa and a trapezoidal quadratojugal. The individual is estimated at about 120 cm long. Short forelimbs and robust hindlimbs support a bipedal interpretation, not an observed gait.
text.zh: 近完整骨架 IVPP V14530 只缺少尾部末端。头骨在眼眶后较宽、吻部较浅；诊断还记录了额骨中线凹窝和梯形方轭骨。正模个体估计全长约 120 厘米。前肢较短、后肢粗壮与两足行走解释相容，但化石没有直接保存步态。

title.en: The sample and the character analysis
title.zh: 取样地点与性状分析

text.en: The holotype comes from Wucaiwan in the Junggar Basin, Xinjiang, in the upper Shishugou Formation. The 161.2–155.7 Ma interval is a literature-bounded envelope for this occurrence. A character-matrix analysis recovers Yinlong downsi as a basal ceratopsian; that placement depends on the study's character scoring and sampling and does not make the specimen a direct ancestor or a global first appearance.
text.zh: 正模来自新疆准噶尔盆地五彩湾的上石树沟组。161.2–155.7 Ma 是文献为这件出现记录设定的年代包络。性状矩阵分析将 Yinlong downsi 恢复为基干角龙类；位置取决于研究的性状评分和类群取样，并不说明该标本是直系祖先或全球最早记录。

title.en: A basal ceratopsian with transitional features from the Late Jurassic of northwestern China
title.zh: A basal ceratopsian with transitional features from the Late Jurassic of northwestern China
